name: QPCF.Beta.not_condCU_const
statement:
theorem not_condCU_const (c : ℝ) (U : Remainder) :
    ¬ CondCU (fun _ => c) U
proof:
:= by
  intro hCU
  obtain ⟨m, S, hS, p, hp⟩ := hCU 1;
  
  have h_deg_zero : ∀ j : Fin (m + 1), (p j).natDegree = 0 := by
    intro j
    apply natDegree_eq_zero_of_eventually_eq_const_on_mem U S hS (p j) (realPQ j.1 c) (by
    filter_upwards [ hp.1 j ] with n hn hn' using hn hn' ▸ rfl);
  aesop

proof:

  intro h
  let U : Remainder := Classical.choice inferInstance
  rcases h U with hB | ⟨_, hC⟩

name: QPCF.Beta.realPQ_one_one_div_nat
statement:
lemma realPQ_one_one_div_nat {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    QPCF.realPQ 1 (1 / (n : ℝ)) = n
proof:
:= by
  rw [QPCF.realPQ, show QPCF.realGaussIter 1 (1 / (n : ℝ)) =
    (Int.fract (1 / (n : ℝ)))⁻¹ by
      simpa using QPCF.realGaussIter_succ_fract 0 (1 / (n : ℝ))]
  have hnpos : (0 : ℝ) < n := by positivity
  have hlt : (1 : ℝ) / n < 1 := (div_lt_one hnpos).2 (by exact_mod_cast hn)
  have hfloor : ⌊(1 : ℝ) / n⌋ = 0 :=
    Int.floor_eq_zero_iff.mpr ⟨by positivity, hlt⟩
  rw [Int.fract, hfloor]
  norm_num

name: QPCF.Beta.armB_square_sample_decay
statement:
lemma armB_square_sample_decay
    (P Q : Polynomial ℚ) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (M : ℕ)
    (hflat : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      n ∈ QPCF.ThreadClass (QPCF.ZHat.ofNat 1) M →
      Q.eval (n : ℚ) ≠ 0 ∧
      |squareSeparator n - (((P.eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) /
        ((Q.eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ))| ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ (-2 : ℤ)) :
    (P * Polynomial.X - 2 * Q = 0 ∨
      (P * Polynomial.X - 2 * Q).natDegree + 2 ≤ (Q * Polynomial.X).natDegree) ∧
    (P * Polynomial.X - Q = 0 ∨
      (P * Polynomial.X - Q).natDegree + 2 ≤ (Q * Polynomial.X).natDegree)

name: QPCF.Beta.sq_le_sixteen_mul_two_pow
statement: private lemma sq_le_sixteen_mul_two_pow : ∀ i : ℕ, (i : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ 16 * 2 ^ i
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  induction i with
  | zero => norm_num
  | succ n ih =>
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge n 3 with hn | hn
    · interval_cases n <;> norm_num
    · have h3 : (3 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
      have key : ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      calc ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 = ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 := by push_cast; ring
        _ ≤ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 := key
        _ ≤ 2 * (16 * 2 ^ n) := by linarith
        _ = 16 * 2 ^ (n + 1) := by ring

name: QPCF.Beta.sample_ratio_tendsto_zero
statement:
private lemma sample_ratio_tendsto_zero :
    Tendsto (fun i : ℕ => ((i : ℝ) + 2) / 2 ^ i) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hup : ∀ᶠ i : ℕ in atTop,
      ((i : ℝ) + 2) / 2 ^ i ≤ (16 * ((i : ℝ) + 2)) / (i : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop 1] with i hi
    have h1 : (0 : ℝ) < (i : ℝ) ^ 2 := by positivity
    have h2 : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ i := by positivity
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ h2 h1]
    have hi' : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (i : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hi
    nlinarith [sq_le_sixteen_mul_two_pow i, hi']
  have hlow : ∀ᶠ i : ℕ in atTop, (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((i : ℝ) + 2) / 2 ^ i := by
    filter_upwards with i; positivity
  have hrat : Tendsto (fun i : ℕ => (16 * ((i : ℝ) + 2)) / (i : ℝ) ^ 2)
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    
    have h := Polynomial.div_tendsto_atTop_zero_of_degree_lt
      ((Polynomial.C (16 : ℝ)) * Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C 32)
      (Polynomial.X ^ 2) (by
        simp [Polynomial.degree_X_pow]
        
        )
    have := h.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
    convert this using 2 with i
    simp [Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_pow]
    ring
  exact tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le'
    (tendsto_const_nhds) hrat hlow hup

name: QPCF.Beta.succ_lt_two_pow
statement: private lemma succ_lt_two_pow : ∀ i : ℕ, 2 ≤ i → i + 1 < 2 ^ i
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  induction i with
  | zero => omega
  | succ n ih =>
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge n 2 with hn | hn
    · have hn' : n = 1 := by omega
      subst n
      norm_num
    · have h1 := ih hn
      have h2 : 1 ≤ 2 ^ n := Nat.one_le_two_pow
      calc n + 1 + 1 < 2 ^ n + 2 ^ n := by omega
        _ = 2 ^ (n + 1) := by ring

name: QPCF.Beta.two_pow_div_tendsto_atTop
statement:
private lemma two_pow_div_tendsto_atTop :
    Tendsto (fun i : ℕ => (2 : ℝ) ^ i / ((i : ℝ) + 2)) atTop atTop
proof:
:= by
  rw [tendsto_atTop]
  intro b
  have hb : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / (max b 1) := by positivity
  filter_upwards [sample_ratio_tendsto_zero.eventually (eventually_lt_nhds hb),
    eventually_ge_atTop 0] with i hsmall _
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < (i : ℝ) + 2 := by positivity
  have hpow : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ i := by positivity
  have hmax : (0 : ℝ) < max b 1 := by positivity
  have h1 : ((i : ℝ) + 2) < (2 : ℝ) ^ i / (max b 1) := by
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ hpow] at hsmall
    calc
      (i : ℝ) + 2 < (1 / max b 1) * (2 : ℝ) ^ i := hsmall
      _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ i / max b 1 := by ring
  have h2 : max b 1 ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ i / ((i : ℝ) + 2) := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hpos]
    have h1' := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h1 hmax
    have heq : max b 1 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ i / max b 1) = (2 : ℝ) ^ i := by
      field_simp
    rw [heq] at h1'
    exact le_of_lt h1'
  exact le_trans (le_max_left b 1) h2

name: QPCF.Beta.eventually_realPQ_one_valuationSequence_powTwo
statement:
lemma eventually_realPQ_one_valuationSequence_powTwo :
    ∀ᶠ i : ℕ in atTop,
      realPQ 1 (valuationSequence (powTwo i)) =
        Nat.floor ((powTwo i : ℝ) / (i + 1 : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop 2] with i hi
  set y : ℝ := valuationSequence (powTwo i) with hy
  have hval : y = ((i : ℝ) + 1) / (powTwo i : ℝ) := by
    rw [hy, valuationSequence_powTwo]; push_cast; ring
  have hnpos : (0 : ℝ) < (powTwo i : ℝ) := by
    simp [powTwo]
  have hy0 : (0 : ℝ) < y := by rw [hval]; positivity
  have hy1 : y < 1 := by
    rw [hval, div_lt_one hnpos]
    have := succ_lt_two_pow i hi
    have h2 : ((i : ℕ) + 1 : ℝ) < ((2 ^ i : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast this
    simpa [powTwo] using h2
  
  rw [QPCF.realPQ, show QPCF.realGaussIter 1 y = (Int.fract y)⁻¹ by
    simpa using QPCF.realGaussIter_succ_fract 0 y]
  have hfloor : ⌊y⌋ = 0 := Int.floor_eq_zero_iff.mpr ⟨le_of_lt hy0, hy1⟩
  rw [Int.fract, hfloor]
  have hinv : (y - (0 : ℤ))⁻¹ = (powTwo i : ℝ) / ((i : ℝ) + 1) := by
    rw [hval]; push_cast; rw [sub_zero, inv_div]
  rw [hinv]
  
  have hxnn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (powTwo i : ℝ) / ((i : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
  have hfnonneg : 0 ≤ ⌊(powTwo i : ℝ) / ((i : ℝ) + 1)⌋ :=
    Int.floor_nonneg.mpr hxnn
  exact_mod_cast (Int.toNat_of_nonneg hfnonneg).symm

name: QPCF.Beta.polynomial_not_floor_powTwo_div_succ
statement:
lemma polynomial_not_floor_powTwo_div_succ (p : Polynomial ℚ) :
    ¬ ∃ᶠ i : ℕ in atTop,
      ((p.eval (powTwo i : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) =
        Nat.floor ((powTwo i : ℝ) / (i + 1 : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  intro hfreq
  
  have hbounds : ∀ᶠ i : ℕ in atTop,
      (2 : ℝ) ^ i / ((i : ℝ) + 1) - 1
        ≤ (Nat.floor ((powTwo i : ℝ) / (i + 1 : ℝ)) : ℝ) ∧
      (Nat.floor ((powTwo i : ℝ) / (i + 1 : ℝ)) : ℝ)
        ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ i / ((i : ℝ) + 1) := by
    filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop 1] with i _
    have hpow2 : (powTwo i : ℝ) = 2 ^ i := by simp [powTwo]
    have hx : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (powTwo i : ℝ) / ((i : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
    constructor
    · have := Nat.lt_floor_add_one ((powTwo i : ℝ) / (i + 1 : ℝ))
      rw [hpow2] at *
      linarith [this]
    · have := Nat.floor_le hx
      rw [hpow2] at *
      linarith [this]
  by_cases hp : p = 0
  · 
    have hone : ∀ᶠ i : ℕ in atTop,
        (1 : ℝ) ≤ (Nat.floor ((powTwo i : ℝ) / (i + 1 : ℝ)) : ℝ) := by
      have hbig : ∀ᶠ i : ℕ in atTop,
          (2 : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ i / ((i : ℝ) + 1) := by
        filter_upwards [two_pow_div_tendsto_atTop.eventually
          (eventually_ge_atTop 2), eventually_ge_atTop 1] with i h2 _
        have : (2 : ℝ) ^ i / ((i : ℝ) + 1) ≥ (2 : ℝ) ^ i / ((i : ℝ) + 2) := by
          apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) (by positivity)
          · linarith
        linarith
      filter_upwards [hbounds, hbig] with i hb h2
      linarith [hb.1]
    obtain ⟨i, heq, hge⟩ := (hfreq.and_eventually hone).exists
    rw [hp] at heq
    simp at heq
    linarith [heq ▸ hge]
  · 
    set g : ℕ → ℝ :=
      fun i => ((p.eval (powTwo i : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) / (powTwo i : ℝ) with hg
    have hgsmall : ∀ᶠ i : ℕ in atTop, ∀ hi : True,
        (((p.eval (powTwo i : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) =
          Nat.floor ((powTwo i : ℝ) / (i + 1 : ℝ))) →
        |g i| ≤ 1 / ((i : ℝ) + 1) := by
      filter_upwards [hbounds, eventually_ge_atTop 2] with i hb hi _ heq
      have hpow2 : (powTwo i : ℝ) = 2 ^ i := by simp [powTwo]
      have hppos : (0 : ℝ) < (powTwo i : ℝ) := by rw [hpow2]; positivity
      have hnn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ g i := by
        rw [hg]; dsimp only
        rw [heq]
        positivity
      rw [abs_of_nonneg hnn, hg]; dsimp only
      rw [heq]
      calc
        (Nat.floor ((powTwo i : ℝ) / (i + 1 : ℝ)) : ℝ) / (powTwo i : ℝ)
            ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ i / ((i : ℝ) + 1)) / (powTwo i : ℝ) :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hb.2 (le_of_lt hppos)
        _ = 1 / ((i : ℝ) + 1) := by rw [hpow2]; field_simp
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hlow⟩ : ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧
        ∀ᶠ i : ℕ in atTop, ε ≤ |g i| := by
      have hpowtend : Tendsto (fun i : ℕ => ((powTwo i : ℕ) : ℝ))
          atTop atTop := by
        have : Tendsto powTwo atTop atTop := by
          simpa [powTwo] using
            tendsto_pow_atTop_atTop_of_one_lt (by norm_num : 1 < 2)
        exact tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop.comp this
      have hfun : ∀ i : ℕ, g i =
          (((p.eval (powTwo i : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)) /
            (((Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℚ).eval (powTwo i : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) := by
        intro i; rw [hg]; dsimp only; norm_num
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge 1 p.natDegree with hdeg | hdeg
      · 
        have hd : (Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℚ).degree < p.degree := by
          rw [Polynomial.degree_X, Polynomial.degree_eq_natDegree hp]
          exact_mod_cast hdeg
        have ht := Polynomial.abs_div_tendsto_atTop_atTop_of_degree_gt
          (p.map (algebraMap ℚ ℝ))
          ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℚ).map (algebraMap ℚ ℝ))
          (by simpa [Polynomial.degree_map] using hd)
          (by simp)
        refine ⟨1, one_pos, ?_⟩
        have := (ht.comp hpowtend).eventually (eventually_ge_atTop 1)
        filter_upwards [this] with i hi
        rw [hfun i]
        simpa [Polynomial.eval_map, abs_div] using hi
      · 
        
        
        
        rcases Nat.lt_or_ge p.natDegree 1 with hdeg0 | hdeg1
        · 
          exfalso
          have hdegzero : p.natDegree = 0 := by omega
          obtain ⟨c, hpC⟩ : ∃ c : ℚ, p = Polynomial.C c := by
            exact ⟨p.coeff 0, Polynomial.eq_C_of_natDegree_eq_zero hdegzero⟩
          subst p
          have hcne : c ≠ 0 := by
            intro h; exact hp (by rw [h]; simp)
          have hbig : ∀ᶠ i : ℕ in atTop,
              |((c : ℚ) : ℝ)| + 1 ≤
                (Nat.floor ((powTwo i : ℝ) / (i + 1 : ℝ)) : ℝ) := by
            have := two_pow_div_tendsto_atTop.eventually
              (eventually_ge_atTop (|((c : ℚ) : ℝ)| + 3))
            filter_upwards [this, hbounds, eventually_ge_atTop 1]
              with i hi hb _
            have : (2 : ℝ) ^ i / ((i : ℝ) + 1)
                ≥ (2 : ℝ) ^ i / ((i : ℝ) + 2) := by
              apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) (by positivity)
              · linarith
            linarith [hb.1]
          obtain ⟨i, heq, hge⟩ := (hfreq.and_eventually hbig).exists
          rw [Polynomial.eval_C] at heq
          have := heq ▸ hge
          nlinarith [le_abs_self (((c:ℚ):ℝ)), neg_abs_le (((c:ℚ):ℝ))]
        · 
          have hdeq : p.natDegree = 1 := le_antisymm hdeg hdeg1
          have hd : p.degree = (Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℚ).degree := by
            rw [Polynomial.degree_X, Polynomial.degree_eq_natDegree hp, hdeq]
            norm_num
          have ht := Polynomial.div_tendsto_atTop_leadingCoeff_div_of_degree_eq
            (p.map (algebraMap ℚ ℝ))
            ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℚ).map (algebraMap ℚ ℝ))
            (by simpa [Polynomial.degree_map] using hd)
          set a : ℝ := ((p.leadingCoeff : ℚ) : ℝ) with ha
          have hane : a ≠ 0 := by
            rw [ha]
            exact_mod_cast Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hp
          have ht' : Tendsto g atTop (nhds a) := by
            have hc := ht.comp hpowtend
            convert hc using 2
            · funext i
              rw [hg]
              simp [Polynomial.eval_map]
            · simp [ha, Polynomial.leadingCoeff_map]
          refine ⟨|a| / 2, by positivity, ?_⟩
          have := ht'.abs.eventually
            (eventually_ge_nhds (by
              have : (0:ℝ) < |a| := abs_pos.mpr hane
              linarith : |a| / 2 < |a|))
          exact this
    
    have hsmalleps : ∀ᶠ i : ℕ in atTop, 1 / ((i : ℝ) + 1) < ε := by
      have := tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ) |>.eventually
        (eventually_gt_atTop (1 / ε))
      filter_upwards [this, eventually_ge_atTop 1] with i hi _
      rw [div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < (i:ℝ)+1)]
      rw [div_lt_iff₀ hε] at hi
      nlinarith
    obtain ⟨i, heq, himp, hlo, hsm⟩ :=
      (hfreq.and_eventually (hgsmall.and (hlow.and hsmalleps))).exists
    have h1 := himp trivial heq
    linarith [lt_of_le_of_lt h1 hsm, hlo]

name: QPCF.Beta.valuationSequence_not_armBU
statement:
theorem valuationSequence_not_armBU :
    ¬ ArmBU valuationSequence avoidingValuationUltrafilter
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨P, Q, hQ, hflat⟩
  obtain ⟨S, hSU, hev⟩ := hflat 2
  have hfreq := frequently_powTwo_mem_of_mem_avoiding hSU
  have hpow : Tendsto powTwo atTop atTop := by
    have : Tendsto (fun i : ℕ => 2 ^ i) atTop atTop :=
      tendsto_pow_atTop_atTop_of_one_lt (by norm_num)
    simpa [powTwo] using this
  
  set v : ℕ → ℝ :=
    fun n => (((P.eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) / ((Q.eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)) with hv
  
  have hev' : ∀ᶠ i : ℕ in atTop, powTwo i ∈ S →
      |((i : ℝ) + 1) - (powTwo i : ℝ) * v (powTwo i)| ≤ 1 := by
    have h1 := hpow.eventually hev
    filter_upwards [h1, eventually_ge_atTop 1] with i himp hi1 hiS
    obtain ⟨-, hbound⟩ := himp hiS
    have hn1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (powTwo i : ℝ) := by
      have : (1 : ℕ) ≤ powTwo i := Nat.one_le_two_pow
      exact_mod_cast this
    have hnpos : (0 : ℝ) < (powTwo i : ℝ) := by linarith
    have hval : valuationSequence (powTwo i) = ((i : ℝ) + 1) / (powTwo i : ℝ) := by
      rw [valuationSequence_powTwo]; push_cast; ring
    rw [hval] at hbound
    have hscale : |((i : ℝ) + 1) - (powTwo i : ℝ) * v (powTwo i)|
        = (powTwo i : ℝ) * |((i : ℝ) + 1) / (powTwo i : ℝ) - v (powTwo i)| := by
      calc
        _ = |(powTwo i : ℝ) *
            (((i : ℝ) + 1) / (powTwo i : ℝ) - v (powTwo i))| := by
              congr 1
              field_simp
        _ = |(powTwo i : ℝ)| *
            |((i : ℝ) + 1) / (powTwo i : ℝ) - v (powTwo i)| := abs_mul _ _
        _ = _ := by rw [abs_of_pos hnpos]
    rw [hscale]
    have hzpow : (powTwo i : ℝ) * (powTwo i : ℝ) ^ (-(2 : ℤ)) ≤ 1 := by
      rw [zpow_neg, ← div_eq_mul_inv]  
      rw [div_le_one (by positivity)]
      calc (powTwo i : ℝ) = (powTwo i : ℝ) ^ (1 : ℤ) := by simp
        _ ≤ (powTwo i : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℤ) := by
            exact zpow_le_zpow_right₀ hn1 (by norm_num)
    calc (powTwo i : ℝ) * |((i : ℝ) + 1) / (powTwo i : ℝ) - v (powTwo i)|
        ≤ (powTwo i : ℝ) * (powTwo i : ℝ) ^ (-(2 : ℤ)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbound (le_of_lt hnpos)
      _ ≤ 1 := hzpow
  
  by_cases hP : P = 0
  · obtain ⟨i, hiS, himp, hi2⟩ :=
      (hfreq.and_eventually (hev'.and (eventually_ge_atTop 2))).exists
    have := himp hiS
    simp only [hP, hv, Polynomial.eval_zero, Rat.cast_zero, zero_div,
      mul_zero, sub_zero] at this
    have : ((i : ℝ) + 1) ≤ 1 := le_trans (le_abs_self _) this
    have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (i : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hi2
    linarith
  
  rcases le_or_gt (P.natDegree + 1) Q.natDegree with hdeg | hdeg
  
  · have hfun : ∀ n : ℕ, (n : ℝ) * v n =
        ((((P * Polynomial.X).eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) /
          ((Q.eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)) := by
      intro n
      simp only [hv, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X]
      push_cast
      ring
    have hPX0 : P * Polynomial.X ≠ 0 :=
      mul_ne_zero hP Polynomial.X_ne_zero
    have hQ0 : Q ≠ 0 := hQ
    have hdegX : (P * Polynomial.X).natDegree = P.natDegree + 1 := by
      rw [Polynomial.natDegree_mul hP Polynomial.X_ne_zero,
        Polynomial.natDegree_X]
    obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ : ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, |(n : ℝ) * v n| ≤ B := by
      rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hdeg with hlt | heq
      · 
        have hd : (P * Polynomial.X).degree < Q.degree := by
          rw [Polynomial.degree_eq_natDegree hPX0,
            Polynomial.degree_eq_natDegree hQ0]
          exact_mod_cast hdegX ▸ hlt
        have ht := Polynomial.div_tendsto_atTop_zero_of_degree_lt
          ((P * Polynomial.X).map (algebraMap ℚ ℝ)) (Q.map (algebraMap ℚ ℝ))
          (by simpa [Polynomial.degree_map] using hd)
        have ht' := ht.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
        refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
        have := (ht'.abs).eventually
          (eventually_le_nhds (show |(0 : ℝ)| < 1 by norm_num))
        filter_upwards [this] with n hn
        rw [hfun n]
        simpa [Polynomial.eval_map, Polynomial.eval₂_at_natCast] using hn
      · 
        set c : ℝ := (((P * Polynomial.X).leadingCoeff : ℚ) : ℝ) /
          ((Q.leadingCoeff : ℚ) : ℝ) with hc
        have hd : (P * Polynomial.X).degree = Q.degree := by
          rw [Polynomial.degree_eq_natDegree hPX0,
            Polynomial.degree_eq_natDegree hQ0]
          exact_mod_cast hdegX ▸ heq
        have ht := Polynomial.div_tendsto_atTop_leadingCoeff_div_of_degree_eq
          ((P * Polynomial.X).map (algebraMap ℚ ℝ)) (Q.map (algebraMap ℚ ℝ))
          (by simpa [Polynomial.degree_map] using hd)
        have ht' := ht.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
        refine ⟨|c| + 1, ?_⟩
        have := (ht'.abs).eventually
          (eventually_le_nhds (lt_add_one _))
        filter_upwards [this] with n hn
        rw [hfun n]
        
        
        simpa [Polynomial.eval_map, Polynomial.leadingCoeff_map, hc] using hn
    obtain ⟨i, hiS, himp, hbnd, hsz⟩ :=
      (hfreq.and_eventually (hev'.and ((hpow.eventually hB).and
        ((tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop).eventually
          (eventually_gt_atTop (B + 2)))))).exists
    have h1 := himp hiS
    have h2 : |(powTwo i : ℝ) * v (powTwo i)| ≤ B := hbnd
    have h3 : (B + 2 : ℝ) < (i : ℝ) := hsz
    have : ((i : ℝ) + 1) ≤ 1 + B := by
      have := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub ((i : ℝ) + 1)
        ((powTwo i : ℝ) * v (powTwo i))
      have habs : |((i : ℝ) + 1)| = (i : ℝ) + 1 := abs_of_pos (by positivity)
      nlinarith [h1, h2, abs_nonneg ((i : ℝ) + 1 - (powTwo i : ℝ) * v (powTwo i))]
    linarith
  
  · have hQP : Q.natDegree ≤ P.natDegree := by omega
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hlow⟩ : ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, ε ≤ |v n| := by
      rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hQP with hlt | heq
      · 
        have hd : Q.degree < P.degree := by
          rw [Polynomial.degree_eq_natDegree hP, Polynomial.degree_eq_natDegree hQ]
          exact_mod_cast hlt
        have ht := Polynomial.abs_div_tendsto_atTop_atTop_of_degree_gt
          (P.map (algebraMap ℚ ℝ)) (Q.map (algebraMap ℚ ℝ))
          (by simpa [Polynomial.degree_map] using hd)
          (by simpa using hQ)
        have ht' := ht.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
        exact ⟨1, one_pos, by
          have := ht'.eventually (eventually_ge_atTop 1)
          filter_upwards [this] with n hn
          simpa [hv, Polynomial.eval_map, abs_div] using hn⟩
      · 
        set c : ℝ := ((P.leadingCoeff : ℚ) : ℝ) / ((Q.leadingCoeff : ℚ) : ℝ)
          with hc
        have hcne : c ≠ 0 := by
          apply div_ne_zero <;>
            simpa using Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr ‹_›
        have hd : P.degree = Q.degree := by
          rw [Polynomial.degree_eq_natDegree hP, Polynomial.degree_eq_natDegree hQ]
          exact_mod_cast heq.symm
        have ht := Polynomial.div_tendsto_atTop_leadingCoeff_div_of_degree_eq
          (P.map (algebraMap ℚ ℝ)) (Q.map (algebraMap ℚ ℝ))
          (by simpa [Polynomial.degree_map] using hd)
        have ht' : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => v n) atTop (nhds c) := by
          convert ht.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop using 2 <;>
            norm_num [hv, hc, Polynomial.aeval_def]
        refine ⟨|c| / 2, by positivity, ?_⟩
        have hcpos : 0 < |c| := abs_pos.mpr hcne
        have := (ht'.abs).eventually
          (eventually_ge_nhds (a := |c|) (b := |c| / 2) (by linarith))
        filter_upwards [this] with n hn
        simpa [hv, Polynomial.eval_map, Polynomial.leadingCoeff_map, hc] using hn
    
    have hsmall : ∀ᶠ i : ℕ in atTop, ((i : ℝ) + 2) / 2 ^ i < ε :=
      sample_ratio_tendsto_zero.eventually (eventually_lt_nhds hε)
    obtain ⟨i, hiS, himp, hlowi, hsm⟩ :=
      (hfreq.and_eventually (hev'.and ((hpow.eventually hlow).and hsmall))).exists
    have h1 := himp hiS
    have hn1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (powTwo i : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_two_pow
    have hup : |v (powTwo i)| ≤ ((i : ℝ) + 2) / 2 ^ i := by
      have hnpos : (0 : ℝ) < (powTwo i : ℝ) := by linarith
      have h2 : (powTwo i : ℝ) * |v (powTwo i)| ≤ (i : ℝ) + 2 := by
        have := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub ((powTwo i : ℝ) * v (powTwo i))
          ((i : ℝ) + 1)
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hnpos] at this
        have habs : |((i : ℝ) + 1)| = (i : ℝ) + 1 := abs_of_pos (by positivity)
        nlinarith [h1, abs_sub_comm ((i:ℝ)+1) ((powTwo i : ℝ) * v (powTwo i))]
      have hpow2 : (powTwo i : ℝ) = 2 ^ i := by
        simp [powTwo]
      apply (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ i)).2
      rw [← hpow2]
      nlinarith
    linarith [lt_of_le_of_lt hup hsm, hlowi]

name: QPCF.Beta.valuationSequence_not_armAU_one
statement:
theorem valuationSequence_not_armAU_one :
    ¬ ArmAU valuationSequence avoidingValuationUltrafilter 1
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨S, hSU, p, htrack, -, -⟩
  have hfreq := frequently_powTwo_mem_of_mem_avoiding hSU
  have hpow : Tendsto powTwo atTop atTop := by
    simpa [powTwo] using
      tendsto_pow_atTop_atTop_of_one_lt (by norm_num : 1 < 2)
  have htr := hpow.eventually (htrack ⟨1, by norm_num⟩)
  have hcomb : ∃ᶠ i : ℕ in atTop,
      ((( (p ⟨1, by norm_num⟩).eval (powTwo i : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) =
        Nat.floor ((powTwo i : ℝ) / (i + 1 : ℝ))) := by
    have := hfreq.and_eventually
      (htr.and eventually_realPQ_one_valuationSequence_powTwo)
    refine this.mono ?_
    rintro i ⟨hiS, himp, hval⟩
    rw [← himp hiS, hval]
  exact polynomial_not_floor_powTwo_div_succ _ hcomb

name: QPCF.Beta.regression_R3_valuation_not_mem_SBeta
statement:
theorem regression_R3_valuation_not_mem_SBeta :
    valuationSequence ∉ SBeta
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  rcases h avoidingValuationUltrafilter with hB | ⟨hA, _⟩
  · exact valuationSequence_not_armBU hB
  · exact valuationSequence_not_armAU_one (hA 1)

name: QPCF.Beta.armAU_polynomial_canonical
statement:
theorem armAU_polynomial_canonical
    {a : ℕ → ℝ} {U : Remainder} {m : ℕ}
    {S S' : Set ℕ} (hS : S ∈ U.1) (hS' : S' ∈ U.1)
    {p p' : Fin (m + 1) → Polynomial ℚ}
    (hp : ∀ j, ∀ᶠ n in atTop, n ∈ S →
      QPCF.realPQ j.1 (a n) = (((p j).eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ))
    (hp' : ∀ j, ∀ᶠ n in atTop, n ∈ S' →
      QPCF.realPQ j.1 (a n) = (((p' j).eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)) :
    p = p'

name: QPCF.Beta.evenSet_infinite
statement: private lemma evenSet_infinite : evenSet.Infinite
proof:
:= by
  exact Set.infinite_of_forall_exists_gt fun n => ⟨ 2 * n + 2, by norm_num [ evenSet ], by linarith ⟩

name: QPCF.Beta.evenSet_compl_infinite
statement: private lemma evenSet_compl_infinite : evenSetᶜ.Infinite
proof:
:= by
  exact Set.infinite_of_forall_exists_gt fun n => ⟨ 2 * n + 1, by simp +decide [ evenSet ], by linarith ⟩

name: QPCF.Beta.documentedFree_empty
statement: theorem documentedFree_empty (U : Ultrafilter ℕ) : ¬ DocumentedFree U

name: QPCF.Beta.documentedRemainder_isEmpty
statement: theorem documentedRemainder_isEmpty : IsEmpty DocumentedRemainder
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro U
  exact documentedFree_empty U.1 U.2

name: QPCF.Beta.isFree_iff_ne_pure

theorem isFree_iff_ne_pure (U : Ultrafilter ℕ) :

    (hS : S ∈ (U.1 : Filter ℕ)) : S.Infinite
proof:
:= by

name: QPCF.Beta.existsUnique_mem_finitePartition
statement:
theorem existsUnique_mem_finitePartition (U : Remainder) {ι : Type*}
    (s : Finset ι) (A : ι → Set ℕ)
    (hdisj : Set.PairwiseDisjoint (↑s : Set ι) A)
    (hcover : (⋃ i ∈ s, A i) ∈ Filter.cofinite) :
    ∃! i : ι, i ∈ s ∧ A i ∈ (U.1 : Filter ℕ)

name: QPCF.Beta.beta_canonical_tracking
statement:
theorem beta_canonical_tracking (a : ℕ → ℝ) (U : Remainder)
    (hA : ∀ m, ArmAU a U m) (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ S : Set ℕ, S ∈ U.1 ∧
      (∀ j ≤ m, ∀ᶠ n in atTop, n ∈ S →
        realPQ j (a n) = (((betaCanonicalPQ a U hA j).eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)) ∧
      (∀ j ≤ m, ∀ n ∈ S, 1 ≤ n →
        ∃ z : ℤ, (betaCanonicalPQ a U hA j).eval (n : ℚ) = (z : ℚ)) ∧
      (∀ j ≤ m, 1 ≤ j → ∀ᶠ n in atTop,
        n ∈ S → 1 ≤ (betaCanonicalPQ a U hA j).eval (n : ℚ))

name: QPCF.Beta.beta_canonical_leadingCoeff_pos
statement:
theorem beta_canonical_leadingCoeff_pos (a : ℕ → ℝ) (U : Remainder)
    (hA : ∀ m, ArmAU a U m) (j : ℕ) (hj : 1 ≤ j) :
    0 < (betaCanonicalPQ a U hA j).leadingCoeff

name: QPCF.Beta.beta_continuant_denominator_degree
statement:
theorem beta_continuant_denominator_degree (a : ℕ → ℝ) (U : Remainder)
    (hA : ∀ m, ArmAU a U m) (m : ℕ) :
    0 < (polyContDen (betaCanonicalPQ a U hA) (m + 1)).leadingCoeff ∧
      (polyContDen (betaCanonicalPQ a U hA) (m + 1)).natDegree =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, (betaCanonicalPQ a U hA (j + 1)).natDegree
proof:
:= by
  exact polyContDen_natDegree_of_leadingCoeff_pos _
    (beta_canonical_leadingCoeff_pos a U hA) m

name: QPCF.Beta.beta_continuant_denominator_degree_unbounded
statement:
theorem beta_continuant_denominator_degree_unbounded (a : ℕ → ℝ) (U : Remainder)
    (hA : ∀ m, ArmAU a U m) (hC : CondCU a U) (B : ℕ) :
    ∃ m, B ≤ (polyContDen (betaCanonicalPQ a U hA) (m + 1)).natDegree

name: QPCF.Beta.beta_consecutive_coeff_eq
statement:
theorem beta_consecutive_coeff_eq
    (a : ℕ → ℝ) (U : Remainder) (hA : ∀ m, ArmAU a U m) (m : ℕ) (i : ℤ)
    (hi : i < (polyContDen (betaCanonicalPQ a U hA) (m + 1)).natDegree +
      (polyContDen (betaCanonicalPQ a U hA) (m + 2)).natDegree) :
    (betaArmAConvergent a U hA (m + 1)).coeff i =
      (betaArmAConvergent a U hA m).coeff i

name: QPCF.Beta.beta_convergents_eventually_coeff_eq
statement:
theorem beta_convergents_eventually_coeff_eq (a : ℕ → ℝ) (U : Remainder)
    (hA : ∀ m, ArmAU a U m) (hC : CondCU a U) (D : ℤ) :
    ∃ M, ∀ m ≥ M, ∀ n ≥ M, ∀ i < D,
      (betaArmAConvergent a U hA m).coeff i =
        (betaArmAConvergent a U hA n).coeff i

name: QPCF.Beta.beta_germ_limit_cauchy
statement:
theorem beta_germ_limit_cauchy (a : ℕ → ℝ) (U : Remainder)
    (hA : ∀ m : ℕ, ArmAU a U m) (hC : CondCU a U) :
    CauchySeq (betaArmAConvergent a U hA)

name: QPCF.Beta.beta_germ_limit
statement:
theorem beta_germ_limit (a : ℕ → ℝ) (U : Remainder)
    (hA : ∀ m, ArmAU a U m) (hC : CondCU a U) :
    ∃ g : ℚ⸨X⸩, Tendsto (betaArmAConvergent a U hA) atTop (𝓝 g)

name: QPCF.Beta.beta_armB_germ_governs
statement:
theorem beta_armB_germ_governs (a : ℕ → ℝ) (U : Remainder)
    (P Q : Polynomial ℚ) (hQ : Q ≠ 0)
    (hflat : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ S : Set ℕ, S ∈ U.1 ∧
      ∀ᶠ n in atTop, n ∈ S → Q.eval (n : ℚ) ≠ 0 ∧
        |a n - (((P.eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) /
          ((Q.eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ))| ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ (-(k : ℤ))) :
    GovAtU U (betaArmBGerm P Q) a

name: QPCF.Beta.beta_germ_eventually_coeff_eq
statement:
theorem beta_germ_eventually_coeff_eq (a : ℕ → ℝ) (U : Remainder)
    (hA : ∀ m, ArmAU a U m) (hC : CondCU a U) (D : ℤ) :
    ∃ M, ∀ m ≥ M, ∀ i < D,
      (betaArmAGerm a U hA hC).coeff i =
        (betaArmAConvergent a U hA m).coeff i

name: QPCF.Beta.beta_real_convergent_error
statement:
theorem beta_real_convergent_error (a : ℕ → ℝ) (U : Remainder)
    (hA : ∀ m, ArmAU a U m) (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ S : Set ℕ, S ∈ U.1 ∧ ∀ᶠ n in atTop, n ∈ S →
      |a n -
        (((polyContNum (betaCanonicalPQ a U hA) (m + 1)).eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) /
        (((polyContDen (betaCanonicalPQ a U hA) (m + 1)).eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)| ≤
      1 / ((((polyContDen (betaCanonicalPQ a U hA) (m + 1)).eval
        (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) ^ 2)

name: QPCF.Beta.beta_convergent_governs_to_degree
statement:
theorem beta_convergent_governs_to_degree (a : ℕ → ℝ) (U : Remainder)
    (hA : ∀ m, ArmAU a U m) (m : ℕ) (N : ℤ)
    (hN : N + 1 ≤ 2 *
      (polyContDen (betaCanonicalPQ a U hA) (m + 1)).natDegree) :
    ∃ S : Set ℕ, S ∈ U.1 ∧ ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ᶠ n in atTop, n ∈ S →
      |a n - pval (betaArmAConvergent a U hA m) N n| ≤
        C * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(N + 1))

name: QPCF.Beta.beta_armA_germ_governs
statement:
theorem beta_armA_germ_governs (a : ℕ → ℝ) (U : Remainder)

name: QPCF.Beta.beta_admissible_germ_governs
statement:
theorem beta_admissible_germ_governs (a : ℕ → ℝ) (U : Remainder) (g : ℚ⸨X⸩)
    (hg : BetaAdmissibleGerm a U g) : GovAtU U g a
proof:
:= by
  rcases hg with ⟨P, Q, hQ, hflat, rfl⟩ | ⟨hA, hC, rfl⟩
  · exact beta_armB_germ_governs a U P Q hQ hflat
  · exact beta_armA_germ_governs a U hA hC

name: QPCF.Beta.betaGermValue_admissible
statement:
theorem betaGermValue_admissible (a : ℕ → ℝ) (U : Remainder)
    (h : ResolvedU a U) : BetaAdmissibleGerm a U (betaGermValue a U h)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold betaGermValue
  split_ifs with hB
  · left
    exact ⟨Classical.choose hB,
      Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec hB),
      (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec hB)).1,
      (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec hB)).2, rfl⟩
  · right
    exact ⟨(Or.resolve_left h hB).1, (Or.resolve_left h hB).2, rfl⟩

name: QPCF.Beta.selectedResidue_mem
statement:
lemma selectedResidue_mem (U : Remainder) (M : ℕ) :
    {n : ℕ | (n : ZMod M.factorial) = selectedResidue U M} ∈ U.1
proof:
:= by
  have := Classical.choose_spec ( existsUnique_mem_finitePartition U Finset.univ ( fun r : ZMod M.factorial => { n : ℕ | ( n : ZMod M.factorial ) = r } ) ( by
    exact fun x _ y _ hxy => Set.disjoint_left.mpr fun n hn hn' => hxy <| hn.symm.trans hn' ) ( by
    simp +decide [ Set.compl_def ] ) );
  convert this.1.2 using 1

name: QPCF.Beta.selectedResidue_unique
statement:
lemma selectedResidue_unique (U : Remainder) (M : ℕ) (r : ZMod M.factorial)
    (hr : {n : ℕ | (n : ZMod M.factorial) = r} ∈ U.1) :
    r = selectedResidue U M
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ s, hs ⟩ := existsUnique_mem_finitePartition U Finset.univ ( fun r : ZMod M.factorial => { n : ℕ | ( n : ZMod M.factorial ) = r } ) ( by
    exact fun x _ y _ hxy => Set.disjoint_left.mpr fun n hn hn' => hxy <| hn.symm.trans hn' ) ( by
    simp +decide [ Set.compl_def ] );
  convert hs.2 r ⟨ Finset.mem_univ _, hr ⟩ |> Eq.trans <| hs.2 ( selectedResidue U M ) ⟨ Finset.mem_univ _, selectedResidue_mem U M ⟩ |> Eq.symm using 1

QPCF.Beta.beta_caseA_depth
statement:
theorem beta_caseA_depth
    {L : ℚ⸨X⸩} {a : ℕ → ℝ} {U : Remainder}
    (hgov : GovAtU U L a) (hirr : ¬ QPCF.IsRat L) (J : ℕ) :
    let β := QPCF.threadBranch L (threadOf U)
    ∃ S : Set ℕ, S ∈ U.1 ∧
      (∀ j : Fin (J + 1), ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ∈ S →
        QPCF.realPQ j.1 (a n) =
          ((((QPCF.bfloorPoly (β.tower j) (β.Ds j) (β.b j)).eval (n : ℚ)) : ℚ) : ℝ)) ∧
      (∀ j : Fin (J + 1), ∀ n : ℕ, n ∈ S → 1 ≤ n →
        ∃ z : ℤ, (QPCF.bfloorPoly (β.tower j) (β.Ds j) (β.b j)).eval (n : ℚ) = (z : ℚ)) ∧
      (∀ j : Fin (J + 1), 1 ≤ j.1 → ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ∈ S →
        1 ≤ (QPCF.bfloorPoly (β.tower j) (β.Ds j) (β.b j)).eval (n : ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  let t := threadOf U
  let β := QPCF.threadBranch L t
  let D := QPCF.allResModulus L J
  have hD : 0 < D := QPCF.allResModulus_pos _ _
  have hDfac : D ∣ D.factorial := Nat.dvd_factorial hD le_rfl
  have hsub0 : QPCF.ThreadClass t D ⊆ {n : ℕ | n ≡ β.b J [MOD β.Ds J]} := by
    intro n hn
    have hh := QPCF.threadClass_modEq_proj_val t D D hDfac hn
    change n ≡ (QPCF.ZHat.proj D t).val % D [MOD D]
    exact hh.trans (Nat.mod_modEq (QPCF.ZHat.proj D t).val D).symm
  obtain ⟨Md, c, K₀, hc, hnd⟩ := β.branch_nondeg hirr J
  obtain ⟨K₇, htrack⟩ := β.branch_tracking hirr J
  set Kbound := max K₀ K₇
  set Nsched : ℕ → ℕ := fun m =>
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc m J, 2 * Md i) + Kbound + 1
  have hbud : ∀ m ≤ J, 2 * Md m < Nsched m := by
    intro m hm
    have hle : 2 * Md m ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc m J, 2 * Md i :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => Nat.zero_le (2 * Md i))
        (Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨le_rfl, hm⟩)
    simp only [Nsched]
    omega
  have hsched : ∀ m, m < J → Nsched (m + 1) + 2 * Md m ≤ Nsched m := by
    intro m hm
    have hsplit : ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc m J, 2 * Md i =
        (∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc (m + 1) J, 2 * Md i) + 2 * Md m := by
      have hunion : Finset.Icc m J = insert m (Finset.Icc (m + 1) J) := by
        ext x
        simp only [Finset.mem_Icc, Finset.mem_insert]
        omega
      rw [hunion, Finset.sum_insert (by simp only [Finset.mem_Icc]; omega)]
      ring
    simp only [Nsched]
    omega
  obtain ⟨S₀, hS₀, hgu₀⟩ := govUpToOn_of_govAtU hgov ((Nsched 0 : ℤ) - 1)
  let S := S₀ ∩ QPCF.ThreadClass t D
  have hS : S ∈ U.1 := Filter.inter_mem hS₀ (threadClass_threadOf_mem U D)
  have hsub : S ⊆ {n : ℕ | n ≡ β.b J [MOD β.Ds J]} :=
    fun n hn => hsub0 hn.2
  have hgu : QPCF.GovernsUpToOn ((Nsched 0 : ℤ) - 1) S L a :=
    hgu₀.subset Set.inter_subset_left
  have hstab : ∀ m ≤ J, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ∈ S →
      QPCF.realPQ m (a n) =
        (⌊QPCF.realGaussIter m (QPCF.pval L ((Nsched 0 : ℤ) - 1) n)⌋ : ℝ) := by
    refine QPCF.formal_stability_i_governs_on_finite S a L ((Nsched 0 : ℤ) - 1)
      J Md Nsched c hc le_rfl hgu hbud hsched ?_
    intro m hm
    have hNspos : 1 ≤ Nsched 0 := by simp only [Nsched]; omega
    have hcast : ((Nsched 0 - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (Nsched 0 : ℤ) - 1 := by omega
    have hK₀le : K₀ ≤ Nsched 0 - 1 := by simp only [Nsched, Kbound]; omega
    filter_upwards [hnd (Nsched 0 - 1) hK₀le m hm] with n hn hnS
    rw [← hcast]
    exact hn (hsub hnS)
  refine ⟨S, hS, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j
    have hNspos : 1 ≤ Nsched 0 := by simp only [Nsched]; omega
    have hcast : ((Nsched 0 - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (Nsched 0 : ℤ) - 1 := by omega
    have hK₇le : K₇ ≤ Nsched 0 - 1 := by simp only [Nsched, Kbound]; omega
    filter_upwards [hstab j j.is_le, htrack (Nsched 0 - 1) hK₇le j j.is_le]
      with n hn hn' hnS
    rw [hn hnS, ← QPCF.bfloorVal_eq_bfloorPoly_eval, ← hcast]
    exact hn' (hsub hnS)
  · intro j n hnS hn1
    have hclass : n ≡ β.b j [MOD β.Ds j] := β.class_subset j.is_le (hsub hnS)
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := QPCF.bfloorVal_intVal (β.hper j) (β.b j) hn1 hclass
    exact ⟨z, by rw [← QPCF.bfloorVal_eq_bfloorPoly_eval]; exact_mod_cast hz⟩
  · intro j hj
    filter_upwards [QPCF.eventually_one_le_bfloorPoly_on_branch hirr β J j j.is_le hj]
      with n hn hnS
    exact hn (hsub hnS)

proof:

  refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
  convert U.2 (Filter.eventually_cofinite_ne 0) using 1

  intro U N
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := QPCF.Governs.one N
  refine ⟨C, U.2 (Filter.mem_cofinite.mpr ?_)⟩
  have hev : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      1 ≤ n ∧ |(1 : ℝ) - QPCF.pval (1 : ℚ⸨X⸩) N n| ≤
        C * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(N + 1)) := by
    filter_upwards [hC, Filter.eventually_ge_atTop 1] with n hn hn1
    exact ⟨hn1, hn⟩
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp hev
  exact Set.finite_iff_bddAbove.mpr
    ⟨M, fun n hn => not_lt.mp fun h => hn (hM n h.le)⟩

statement:
lemma govAtU_iff_UBigOpow (U : Remainder) (f : ℚ⸨X⸩) (a : ℕ → ℝ) :
    GovAtU U f a ↔
      ∀ N : ℤ, UBigOpow U (fun n => a n - QPCF.pval f N n) (-(N + 1))
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: QPCF.Beta.GovBeta.mul
proof:
:= by
  intro U; specialize ha U; specialize hb U; simp_all +decide [ GovBeta ] ;
  intro N
  set f := F U
  set g := G U
  set L := min f.order g.order
  set M := max N (max (N - L) 1) with hM
  have hfg : UBigOpow U (fun n => (a n - pval f M n) * (b n - pval g M n)) (-(2 * M + 2)) := by
    convert UBigOpow.mul U ( govAtU_iff_UBigOpow U f a |>.1 ha M ) ( govAtU_iff_UBigOpow U g b |>.1 hb M ) using 1 ; ring
  have hfg' : UBigOpow U (fun n => (a n - pval f M n) * pval g M n) (-(M + 1 + g.order)) := by
    convert UBigOpow.mul U ( govAtU_iff_UBigOpow U f a |>.1 ha M ) ( UBigOpow.of_bigOpow U ( QPCF.pval_bigOpow g M ) ) using 1 ; ring!;
  have hfg'' : UBigOpow U (fun n => pval f M n * (b n - pval g M n)) (-(M + 1 + f.order)) := by
    have hfg'' : UBigOpow U (fun n => pval f M n) (-f.order) := by
      exact UBigOpow.of_bigOpow U ( QPCF.pval_bigOpow f M );
    convert UBigOpow.mul U hfg'' ( govAtU_iff_UBigOpow U g b |>.1 hb M ) using 1 ; ring
  have hfg''' : UBigOpow U (fun n => pval f M n * pval g M n - pval (f * g) N n) (-(N + 1)) := by
    apply UBigOpow.of_bigOpow;
    convert QPCF.pval_mul_sub_bigOpow f g N M _ _ using 1 <;> norm_num [ hM ]; all_goals grind
  have hfg'''' : UBigOpow U (fun n => a n * b n - pval (f * g) N n) (-(N + 1)) := by
    have hfg'''' : UBigOpow U (fun n => (a n - pval f M n) * (b n - pval g M n) + (a n - pval f M n) * pval g M n + pval f M n * (b n - pval g M n) + (pval f M n * pval g M n - pval (f * g) N n)) (-(N + 1)) := by
      have hfg'''' : UBigOpow U (fun n => (a n - pval f M n) * (b n - pval g M n)) (-(N + 1)) := by
        exact UBigOpow.mono U hfg ( by omega )
      have hfg''''' : UBigOpow U (fun n => (a n - pval f M n) * pval g M n) (-(N + 1)) := by
        apply UBigOpow.mono U hfg' (by
        grind)
      have hfg'''''' : UBigOpow U (fun n => pval f M n * (b n - pval g M n)) (-(N + 1)) := by
        apply UBigOpow.mono U hfg'' (by
        grind)
      exact UBigOpow.add U ( UBigOpow.add U ( UBigOpow.add U hfg'''' hfg''''' ) hfg'''''' ) hfg''';
    convert hfg'''' using 2 ; ring
  exact hfg''''

name: QPCF.Beta.finite_range_of_continuous_discrete
statement:
lemma finite_range_of_continuous_discrete {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y]
    [DiscreteTopology Y] (f : Remainder → Y) (hf : Continuous f) :
    (Set.range f).Finite
proof:
:= by
  have hcov : (univ : Set Remainder) ⊆ ⋃ y : Y, f ⁻¹' {y} := by
    intro U _; exact mem_iUnion.2 ⟨f U, rfl⟩
  have hopen : ∀ y : Y, IsOpen (f ⁻¹' {y}) :=
    fun y => (isOpen_discrete _).preimage hf
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := (isCompact_univ (X := Remainder)).elim_finite_subcover
    (fun y : Y => f ⁻¹' {y}) hopen hcov
    
    
    
  refine Set.Finite.subset t.finite_toSet ?_
  rintro y ⟨U, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hUz⟩ := mem_iUnion₂.1 (ht (mem_univ U))
  simpa using (mem_singleton_iff.1 hUz) ▸ hz

name: QPCF.Beta.beta_coeff_agree_clopen
statement:
lemma beta_coeff_agree_clopen (F : C(Remainder, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (U : Remainder)
    (K : ℤ) :
    ∃ S : Set ℕ, S ∈ U.1 ∧ ∀ V : Remainder, S ∈ V.1 →
      ∀ k : ℤ, k ≤ K → (F V).coeff k = (F U).coeff k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := QPCF.Compactification.order_uniform_bound F
  let A : Set Remainder := {V | ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc L K,
    (F V).coeff k = (F U).coeff k}
  have hAU : U ∈ A := by simp [A]
  have hAo : IsOpen A := by
    simp only [A, Set.setOf_forall]
    apply isOpen_biInter_finset
    intro k hk
    letI : UniformSpace ℚ := ⊥
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply] using
      ((isOpen_discrete ({(F U).coeff k} : Set ℚ)).preimage
        ((LaurentSeries.uniformContinuous_coeff k).continuous.comp F.continuous))
  have hb := (ultrafilterBasis_is_basis.induced
    (fun V : Remainder => V.1)).exists_subset_of_mem_open hAU hAo
  obtain ⟨B, ⟨B₀, hB₀, rfl⟩, hUB, hBA⟩ := hb
  obtain ⟨S, rfl⟩ := hB₀
  refine ⟨S, hUB, ?_⟩
  intro V hV k hk
  by_cases hkL : k < L
  · rw [hL V k hkL, hL U k hkL]
  · exact hBA hV k (Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨le_of_not_gt hkL, hk⟩)

name: QPCF.Beta.disjointify_pairwise

      (S i \ ⋃ p, ⋃ (_ : p < i), S p) ∩
        (S j \ ⋃ q, ⋃ (_ : q < j), S q) = ∅

name: QPCF.Beta.finite_iUnion_of_not_infinite
statement:
private lemma finite_iUnion_of_not_infinite
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (D : ι → Set ℕ) :
    (⋃ i, ⋃ (_ : ¬ (D i).Infinite), D i).Finite
proof:
:= by
  exact Set.finite_iUnion fun i => Set.finite_iUnion fun hi => Set.not_infinite.mp hi

name: QPCF.Beta.complement_infinite_parts_subset
statement:
private lemma complement_infinite_parts_subset
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (D : ι → Set ℕ) :
    (⋃ i, ⋃ (_ : (D i).Infinite), D i)ᶜ ⊆
      (⋃ i, D i)ᶜ ∪ (⋃ i, ⋃ (_ : ¬ (D i).Infinite), D i)

name: QPCF.Beta.finite_cover_disjoint_infinite_refinement
statement:
lemma finite_cover_disjoint_infinite_refinement
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι]
    (S : ι → Set ℕ) (hcofin : (⋃ i, S i)ᶜ.Finite) :
    ∃ pieces : Finset (Set ℕ),
      (∀ A ∈ pieces, ∀ B ∈ pieces, A ≠ B → A ∩ B = ∅) ∧
      (⋃ A ∈ pieces, A)ᶜ.Finite ∧
      (∀ A ∈ pieces, A.Infinite) ∧
      (∀ A ∈ pieces, ∃ i, A ⊆ S i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set D : ι → Set ℕ := fun i => S i \ ⋃ j, ⋃ (_ : j < i), S j with hDdef
  set good : Finset ι := Finset.univ.filter (fun i => (D i).Infinite)
    with hgood
  refine ⟨good.image D, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  
  · rintro A hA B hB hAB
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hA
    obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hB
    have hij : i ≠ j := fun h => hAB (by rw [h])
    exact disjointify_pairwise S i j hij
    
    
    
    
    
  
  · 
    have himg : (⋃ A ∈ good.image D, A) =
        ⋃ i, ⋃ (_ : (D i).Infinite), D i := by
      ext x
      constructor
      · intro hx
        simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, exists_prop] at hx
        obtain ⟨A, hA, hxA⟩ := hx
        obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hA
        have hinf : (D i).Infinite := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
        exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨hinf, hxA⟩⟩
        
        
        
      · intro hx
        obtain ⟨i, hrest⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
        obtain ⟨hinf, hxi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hrest
        refine Set.mem_biUnion ?_ hxi
        exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem D
          (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ i, hinf⟩)
        
        
        
    rw [himg]
    have hDU : (⋃ i, D i) = ⋃ i, S i := disjointify_covers S
    
    have hcofinD : (⋃ i, D i)ᶜ.Finite := by rw [hDU]; exact hcofin
    exact Set.Finite.subset (hcofinD.union (finite_iUnion_of_not_infinite D))
      (complement_infinite_parts_subset D)
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
  
  · rintro A hA
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hA
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
  
  · rintro A hA
    obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hA
    exact ⟨i, Set.diff_subset⟩

name: QPCF.Beta.exists_realizationStage
statement:
lemma exists_realizationStage (F : C(Remainder, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (m : ℕ) :
    Nonempty (RealizationStage F m)

name: QPCF.Beta.coeffBound_pos
statement:
lemma coeffBound_pos (F : C(Remainder, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (k : ℤ) :
    0 < coeffBound F k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold coeffBound
  split <;> rename_i hfin
  · have hne : hfin.toFinset.Nonempty := by
      simp only [Set.Finite.toFinset_nonempty]
      exact ⟨_, Set.mem_range_self (Classical.arbitrary Remainder)⟩
    obtain ⟨q, hqmem⟩ := hne
    have hq := Finset.le_sup'_of_le
      (fun q : ℚ => |(q : ℝ)|) hqmem (abs_nonneg (q : ℝ))
    linarith
    
    
  · norm_num

name: QPCF.Beta.abs_coeff_le_coeffBound
statement:
lemma abs_coeff_le_coeffBound (F : C(Remainder, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (k : ℤ)
    (hfin : (Set.range fun U : Remainder => (F U).coeff k).Finite)
    (U : Remainder) : |(((F U).coeff k : ℚ) : ℝ)| ≤ coeffBound F k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold coeffBound
  rw [dif_pos hfin]
  have hmem : (F U).coeff k ∈ hfin.toFinset := by
    simp [Set.mem_toFinset]
  have := Finset.le_sup' (fun q : ℚ => |(q : ℝ)|) hmem
  linarith

name: QPCF.Beta.tail_sum_bound
statement:
lemma tail_sum_bound (F : C(Remainder, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (N : ℤ) (m : ℕ) (n : ℕ)
    (M : ℤ → ℝ) (hM : ∀ k, 0 < M k)
    (hn1 : 1 ≤ n)
    (hdom : (∑ k ∈ Finset.Ioc (0 : ℤ) (m : ℤ), M k) ≤ (n : ℝ))
    (c : ℤ → ℝ) (hc : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Ioc N (m : ℤ), |c k| ≤ M k) :
    |∑ k ∈ Finset.Ioc N (m : ℤ), c k * (n : ℝ) ^ (-k)| ≤
      ((∑ k ∈ Finset.Ioc N (max (N + 1) 1), M k) + 1) * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(N + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hnR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn1
  have hnpos : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) := by linarith
  have hmono : ∀ e e' : ℤ, e ≤ e' → (n : ℝ) ^ e ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ e' :=
    fun e e' h => zpow_le_zpow_right₀ hnR h
    
  
  set t : ℤ := max (N + 1) 1 with ht
  have hNt : N ≤ t := le_trans (by omega) (le_max_left _ _)
  by_cases hmt : (m : ℤ) ≤ t
  · 
    have hsub : Finset.Ioc N (m : ℤ) ⊆ Finset.Ioc N t :=
      Finset.Ioc_subset_Ioc le_rfl hmt
    calc |∑ k ∈ Finset.Ioc N (m : ℤ), c k * (n : ℝ) ^ (-k)|
        ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ioc N (m : ℤ), |c k * (n : ℝ) ^ (-k)| :=
          Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ioc N (m : ℤ), M k * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(N + 1)) := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro k hk
          rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (zpow_pos hnpos _)]
          exact mul_le_mul (hc k hk) (hmono _ _ (by
            have := (Finset.mem_Ioc.1 hk).1; omega)) (le_of_lt (zpow_pos hnpos _))
            (le_of_lt (hM k))
      _ = (∑ k ∈ Finset.Ioc N (m : ℤ), M k) * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(N + 1)) := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
      _ ≤ ((∑ k ∈ Finset.Ioc N t, M k) + 1) * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(N + 1)) := by
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (le_of_lt (zpow_pos hnpos _))
          have := Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsub
            (fun k _ _ => le_of_lt (hM k))
          linarith
  · have htm : t < (m : ℤ) := lt_of_not_ge hmt
    
    
    have hsplit : Finset.Ioc N (m : ℤ) =
        Finset.Ioc N t ∪ Finset.Ioc t (m : ℤ) :=
      (Finset.Ioc_union_Ioc_eq_Ioc hNt (le_of_lt htm)).symm
    have hdisj : Disjoint (Finset.Ioc N t) (Finset.Ioc t (m : ℤ)) := by
      simp [Finset.disjoint_left, Finset.mem_Ioc]
      intro k _ hk2 hk3; omega
    rw [hsplit, Finset.sum_union hdisj]
    refine le_trans (abs_add_le _ _) ?_
    have hhead : |∑ k ∈ Finset.Ioc N t, c k * (n : ℝ) ^ (-k)|
        ≤ (∑ k ∈ Finset.Ioc N t, M k) * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(N + 1)) := by
      calc |∑ k ∈ Finset.Ioc N t, c k * (n : ℝ) ^ (-k)|
          ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ioc N t, |c k * (n : ℝ) ^ (-k)| :=
            Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
        _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ioc N t, M k * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(N + 1)) := by
            apply Finset.sum_le_sum
            intro k hk
            rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (zpow_pos hnpos _)]
            exact mul_le_mul (hc k (Finset.mem_Ioc.mpr ⟨
              (Finset.mem_Ioc.mp hk).1,
              (Finset.mem_Ioc.mp hk).2.trans (le_of_lt htm)⟩)) (hmono _ _ (by
              have := (Finset.mem_Ioc.1 hk).1; omega))
              (le_of_lt (zpow_pos hnpos _)) (le_of_lt (hM k))
        _ = _ := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
    have hdeep : |∑ k ∈ Finset.Ioc t (m : ℤ), c k * (n : ℝ) ^ (-k)|
        ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ (-(N + 1)) := by
      calc |∑ k ∈ Finset.Ioc t (m : ℤ), c k * (n : ℝ) ^ (-k)|
          ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ioc t (m : ℤ), |c k * (n : ℝ) ^ (-k)| :=
            Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
        _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ioc t (m : ℤ), M k * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(N + 2)) := by
            apply Finset.sum_le_sum
            intro k hk
            rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (zpow_pos hnpos _)]
            refine mul_le_mul (hc k (Finset.mem_Ioc.mpr ⟨
              hNt.trans_lt (Finset.mem_Ioc.mp hk).1,
              (Finset.mem_Ioc.mp hk).2⟩)) (hmono _ _ ?_)
              (le_of_lt (zpow_pos hnpos _)) (le_of_lt (hM k))
            have h1 := (Finset.mem_Ioc.1 hk).1
            have h2 : N + 2 ≤ t + 1 := by omega
            omega
        _ = (∑ k ∈ Finset.Ioc t (m : ℤ), M k) * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(N + 2)) := by
            rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
        _ ≤ (n : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(N + 2)) := by
            apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (le_of_lt (zpow_pos hnpos _))
            refine le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg ?_
              (fun k _ _ => le_of_lt (hM k))) hdom
            apply Finset.Ioc_subset_Ioc _ le_rfl
            omega
            
            
        _ = (n : ℝ) ^ (-(N + 1)) := by
            have hz := zpow_add₀ (ne_of_gt hnpos) (1 : ℤ) (-(N + 2))
            simp only [zpow_one] at hz
            rw [← hz]
            congr 1
            omega
    calc |∑ k ∈ Finset.Ioc N t, c k * (n : ℝ) ^ (-k)|
          + |∑ k ∈ Finset.Ioc t (m : ℤ), c k * (n : ℝ) ^ (-k)|
        ≤ (∑ k ∈ Finset.Ioc N t, M k) * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(N + 1))
          + (n : ℝ) ^ (-(N + 1)) := add_le_add hhead hdeep
      _ = ((∑ k ∈ Finset.Ioc N t, M k) + 1) * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(N + 1)) := by ring

name: QPCF.Beta.schedThreshold_strictMono
statement:
lemma schedThreshold_strictMono (M : ℤ → ℝ) (E : ℕ → ℕ) :
    StrictMono (schedThreshold M E)
proof:
:= by
  apply strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ
  intro m
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.lt_succ_self _) (le_max_left _ _)

name: QPCF.Beta.stageOf_spec
statement:
lemma stageOf_spec (M : ℤ → ℝ) (E : ℕ → ℕ) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    schedThreshold M E (stageOf M E n) ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  unfold stageOf
  apply Nat.findGreatest_spec (m := 0)
      (P := fun m => schedThreshold M E m ≤ n)
  · exact Nat.zero_le _
  · simpa [schedThreshold] using hn

name: QPCF.Beta.stageOf_ge
statement:
lemma stageOf_ge (M : ℤ → ℝ) (E : ℕ → ℕ) (n : ℕ) (m : ℕ)
    (hm : schedThreshold M E m ≤ n) : m ≤ stageOf M E n
proof:
:= by
  unfold stageOf
  apply Nat.le_findGreatest (P := fun j => schedThreshold M E j ≤ n)
  · exact ((schedThreshold_strictMono M E).id_le m).trans hm
  · exact hm

name: QPCF.Beta.stageOf_tendsto
statement:
lemma stageOf_tendsto (M : ℤ → ℝ) (E : ℕ → ℕ) :
    Tendsto (stageOf M E) atTop atTop
proof:
:= by
  apply tendsto_atTop_atTop.2
  intro m
  exact ⟨schedThreshold M E m, fun n hn => stageOf_ge M E n m hn⟩

name: QPCF.Beta.realizationStage_succ
statement:
lemma realizationStage_succ (F : C(Remainder, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (m : ℕ)
    (P : RealizationStage F m) :
    ∃ R : RealizationStage F (m + 1),
      ∀ A ∈ R.pieces, ∃ B ∈ P.pieces, A ⊆ B

name: QPCF.Beta.exists_refining_chain
statement:
lemma exists_refining_chain (F : C(Remainder, ℚ⸨X⸩)) :
    ∃ St : ∀ m : ℕ, RealizationStage F m,
      ∀ m, ∀ A ∈ (St (m + 1)).pieces, ∃ B ∈ (St m).pieces, A ⊆ B
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨refiningChainAux F, ?_⟩
  intro m A hA
  have hdef : refiningChainAux F (m + 1) =
      (realizationStage_succ F m (refiningChainAux F m)).choose := rfl
  rw [hdef] at hA
  exact (realizationStage_succ F m (refiningChainAux F m)).choose_spec A hA

name: QPCF.Beta.stage_piece_mem_ultrafilter
QPCF.Beta.chain_refines_of_le
statement:
lemma chain_refines_of_le {F : C(Remainder, ℚ⸨X⸩)}
    (St : ∀ m : ℕ, RealizationStage F m)
    (href : ∀ m, ∀ A ∈ (St (m + 1)).pieces, ∃ B ∈ (St m).pieces, A ⊆ B)
    {m s : ℕ} (hms : m ≤ s) :
    ∀ A ∈ (St s).pieces, ∃ B ∈ (St m).pieces, A ⊆ B
proof:
:= by
  induction s, hms using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => exact fun A hA => ⟨A, hA, subset_rfl⟩
  | succ s hms ih =>
    intro A hA
    obtain ⟨A', hA', hAA'⟩ := href s A hA
    obtain ⟨B, hB, hA'B⟩ := ih A' hA'
    exact ⟨B, hB, hAA'.trans hA'B⟩

name: QPCF.Beta.deep_piece_subset_selected
statement:
lemma deep_piece_subset_selected {F : C(Remainder, ℚ⸨X⸩)}
    (St : ∀ m : ℕ, RealizationStage F m)
    (href : ∀ m, ∀ A ∈ (St (m + 1)).pieces, ∃ B ∈ (St m).pieces, A ⊆ B)
    {m s : ℕ} (hms : m ≤ s)
    {A : Set ℕ} (hA : A ∈ (St s).pieces)
    {A₀ : Set ℕ} (hA₀ : A₀ ∈ (St m).pieces)
    {n : ℕ} (hnA : n ∈ A) (hnA₀ : n ∈ A₀) :
    A ⊆ A₀
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨B, hB, hAB⟩ := chain_refines_of_le St href hms A hA
  have hBA₀ : B = A₀ := by
    by_contra hne
    have hdisj := (St m).disj B hB A₀ hA₀ hne
    have hn : n ∈ B ∩ A₀ := ⟨hAB hnA, hnA₀⟩
    rw [hdisj] at hn
    exact hn
  exact hBA₀ ▸ hAB

name: QPCF.Beta.coeff_agree_of_subset
statement:
lemma coeff_agree_of_subset {F : C(Remainder, ℚ⸨X⸩)}
    {m s : ℕ} (hms : m ≤ s)
    (Stm : RealizationStage F m) (Sts : RealizationStage F s)
    {A : Set ℕ} (hA : A ∈ Sts.pieces)
    {A₀ : Set ℕ} (hA₀ : A₀ ∈ Stm.pieces) (hsub : A ⊆ A₀)
    {k : ℤ} (hk : k ≤ (m : ℤ)) :
    (Sts.val A).coeff k = (Stm.val A₀).coeff k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V, hV⟩ := exists_free_ultrafilter_mem_of_infinite (Sts.inf A hA)
  have hV₀ : A₀ ∈ V.1 := Filter.mem_of_superset hV hsub
  have h1 := Sts.agree A hA V hV k (le_trans hk (by exact_mod_cast hms))
  have h2 := Stm.agree A₀ hA₀ V hV₀ k hk
  rw [← h1, h2]

name: QPCF.Beta.pval_sub_pval_eq_tail
statement:
lemma pval_sub_pval_eq_tail (g : ℚ⸨X⸩) (N s' : ℤ) (hNs : N ≤ s') (n : ℕ) :
    QPCF.pval g s' n - QPCF.pval g N n =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ioc N s', ((g.coeff k : ℚ) : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) ^ (-k)

name: QPCF.Beta.coeff_range_finite
statement:
lemma coeff_range_finite (F : C(Remainder, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (k : ℤ) :
    (Set.range fun U : Remainder => (F U).coeff k).Finite
proof:
:= by
  letI : UniformSpace ℚ := ⊥
  apply finite_range_of_continuous_discrete
  exact (LaurentSeries.uniformContinuous_coeff k).continuous.comp F.continuous

name: QPCF.Beta.schedThreshold_pos
statement:
lemma schedThreshold_pos (M : ℤ → ℝ) (E : ℕ → ℕ) (m : ℕ) :
    1 ≤ schedThreshold M E m
proof:
:= by
  cases m with
  | zero => simp [schedThreshold]
  | succ m =>
      simp only [schedThreshold]
      omega

name: QPCF.Beta.stageOf_clears_exception
statement:
lemma stageOf_clears_exception (M : ℤ → ℝ) (E : ℕ → ℕ) (n : ℕ)
    (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hs : 0 < stageOf M E n) :
    E (stageOf M E n) ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (Nat.ne_of_gt hs)
  have hspec := stageOf_spec M E n hn
  rw [hm] at hspec ⊢
  have hEth : E (m + 1) + 1 ≤ schedThreshold M E (m + 1) := by
    simp only [schedThreshold]
    exact le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
  simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one] at hspec ⊢
  exact (Nat.le_of_succ_le hEth).trans hspec

name: QPCF.Beta.schedule_dominates
statement:
lemma schedule_dominates (M : ℤ → ℝ) (hM : ∀ k, 0 ≤ M k) (E : ℕ → ℕ)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.Ioc (0 : ℤ) ((stageOf M E n : ℕ) : ℤ), M k) ≤ (n : ℝ)

name: QPCF.Beta.realizedSeq_eq_pval_of_mem
QPCF.Beta.realizedSeq_govAtU
statement:
lemma realizedSeq_govAtU (F : C(Remainder, ℚ⸨X⸩))
    (St : ∀ m : ℕ, RealizationStage F m)
    (href : ∀ m, ∀ A ∈ (St (m + 1)).pieces, ∃ B ∈ (St m).pieces, A ⊆ B)
    (M : ℤ → ℝ) (hM : ∀ k, M k = coeffBound F k) (E : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hE : ∀ m, ∀ n, E m ≤ n → (∃ A ∈ (St m).pieces, n ∈ A))
    (U : Remainder) :
    GovAtU U (F U) (realizedSeq F St M E)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro N
  set m₀ : ℕ := max N.toNat 1 with hm₀
  obtain ⟨A₀, hA₀p, hA₀U⟩ := stage_piece_mem_ultrafilter (St m₀) U
  let C : ℝ := (∑ k ∈ Finset.Ioc N (max (N + 1) 1), M k) + 1
  refine ⟨C, ?_⟩
  have hthresh_mem : {n : ℕ | schedThreshold M E m₀ ≤ n} ∈ U.1 := by
    apply U.2
    rw [Nat.cofinite_eq_atTop]
    exact Filter.eventually_ge_atTop (schedThreshold M E m₀)
  have hSmem : (A₀ ∩ {n : ℕ | schedThreshold M E m₀ ≤ n}) ∈ U.1 :=
    Filter.inter_mem hA₀U hthresh_mem
  apply Filter.mem_of_superset hSmem
  rintro n ⟨hnA₀, hnT⟩
  have hn1 : 1 ≤ n := (schedThreshold_pos M E m₀).trans hnT
  refine ⟨hn1, ?_⟩
  have hs_ge : m₀ ≤ stageOf M E n := stageOf_ge M E n m₀ hnT
  have hs_pos : 0 < stageOf M E n := lt_of_lt_of_le (by omega) hs_ge
  have hEclear : E (stageOf M E n) ≤ n :=
    stageOf_clears_exception M E n hn1 hs_pos
  obtain ⟨A, hAp, hnA⟩ := hE (stageOf M E n) n hEclear
  have ha_eq := realizedSeq_eq_pval_of_mem St M E n hAp hnA
  have hsub : A ⊆ A₀ :=
    deep_piece_subset_selected St href hs_ge hAp hA₀p hnA hnA₀
  have hNm₀ : (N : ℤ) ≤ (m₀ : ℤ) := by
    have h1 : N ≤ (N.toNat : ℤ) := Int.self_le_toNat N
    have h2 : (N.toNat : ℤ) ≤ (m₀ : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast le_max_left _ _
    exact h1.trans h2
  have hagree : ∀ k : ℤ, k ≤ N →
      ((St (stageOf M E n)).val A).coeff k = (F U).coeff k := by
    intro k hk
    have h1 := coeff_agree_of_subset hs_ge (St m₀) (St (stageOf M E n))
      hAp hA₀p hsub (hk.trans hNm₀)
    have h2 := (St m₀).agree A₀ hA₀p U hA₀U k (hk.trans hNm₀)
    rw [h1, ← h2]
  have hpc : QPCF.pval ((St (stageOf M E n)).val A) N n =
      QPCF.pval (F U) N n := by
    apply QPCF.pval_congr
    exact hagree
  have hNs : N ≤ ((stageOf M E n : ℕ) : ℤ) :=
    hNm₀.trans (by exact_mod_cast hs_ge)
  have htail := pval_sub_pval_eq_tail ((St (stageOf M E n)).val A) N
    ((stageOf M E n : ℕ) : ℤ) hNs n
  have hcb : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Ioc N ((stageOf M E n : ℕ) : ℤ),
      |((((St (stageOf M E n)).val A).coeff k : ℚ) : ℝ)| ≤ M k := by
    intro k hk
    obtain ⟨V, hV⟩ := exists_free_ultrafilter_mem_of_infinite
      ((St (stageOf M E n)).inf A hAp)
    have heq := (St (stageOf M E n)).agree A hAp V hV k
      (Finset.mem_Ioc.mp hk).2
    rw [← heq, hM k]
    exact abs_coeff_le_coeffBound F k (coeff_range_finite F k) V
  have hdom := schedule_dominates M
    (fun k => by rw [hM k]; exact (coeffBound_pos F k).le) E n hn1
  have hbound := tail_sum_bound F N (stageOf M E n) n M
    (fun k => by rw [hM k]; exact coeffBound_pos F k) hn1 hdom
    (fun k => (((St (stageOf M E n)).val A).coeff k : ℝ)) hcb
  calc
    |realizedSeq F St M E n - QPCF.pval (F U) N n| =
        |QPCF.pval ((St (stageOf M E n)).val A) ((stageOf M E n : ℕ) : ℤ) n -
          QPCF.pval ((St (stageOf M E n)).val A) N n| := by rw [ha_eq, hpc]
    _ = |∑ k ∈ Finset.Ioc N ((stageOf M E n : ℕ) : ℤ),
          ((((St (stageOf M E n)).val A).coeff k : ℚ) : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) ^ (-k)| := by
        rw [htail]
    _ ≤ ((∑ k ∈ Finset.Ioc N (max (N + 1) 1), M k) + 1) *
          (n : ℝ) ^ (-(N + 1)) := hbound

name: QPCF.Beta.Phi_beta_surjective
statement: theorem Phi_beta_surjective : Function.Surjective Phi_beta
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro F
  obtain ⟨St, href⟩ := exists_refining_chain F
  set E : ℕ → ℕ := fun m =>
    if h : ((St m).cofin.toFinset).Nonempty
    then ((St m).cofin.toFinset).max' h + 1 else 0 with hE_def
  have hE : ∀ m, ∀ n, E m ≤ n → ∃ A ∈ (St m).pieces, n ∈ A := by
    intro m n hn
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    have hnc : n ∈ (⋃ A ∈ (St m).pieces, A)ᶜ := by
      simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_iUnion, exists_prop, not_exists, not_and]
      exact hcon
    have hmem : n ∈ (St m).cofin.toFinset :=
      (Set.Finite.mem_toFinset _).mpr hnc
    have hne : ((St m).cofin.toFinset).Nonempty := ⟨n, hmem⟩
    have hle := Finset.le_max' _ n hmem
    rw [hE_def] at hn
    simp only [dif_pos hne] at hn
    omega
  let a := realizedSeq F St (fun k => coeffBound F k) E
  have hgov : GovBeta F a := fun U =>
    realizedSeq_govAtU F St href (fun k => coeffBound F k) (fun _ => rfl) E hE U
  let x : SgovBetaSubring := ⟨a, ⟨F, hgov⟩⟩
  refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
  exact betaFamily_eq_iff.mpr hgov

name: QPCF.Beta.SBeta_eq_SgovBeta

name: QPCF.Beta.threadDiagonal_spec
statement:
lemma threadDiagonal_spec (t : QPCF.ZHat) (j : ℕ) :
    threadDiagonal t j ∈ QPCF.ThreadClass t j ∧ j < threadDiagonal t j
proof:
:= by
  unfold threadDiagonal
  exact Classical.choose_spec
    (Set.infinite_of_forall_exists_gt
      (fun n => by
        have h := QPCF.ZHat.frequently_ofNat_proj t j
        rw [Filter.frequently_atTop] at h
        obtain ⟨m, hm, hclass⟩ := h (n + 1)
        exact ⟨m, hclass, by omega⟩) |>.exists_gt j)

name: QPCF.Beta.exists_free_containing_all_threadClasses
statement:
lemma exists_free_containing_all_threadClasses (t : QPCF.ZHat) :
    ∃ U : Remainder, ∀ M : ℕ, QPCF.ThreadClass t M ∈ U.1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set f : Filter ℕ :=
    Filter.cofinite ⊓ ⨅ M : ℕ, Filter.principal (QPCF.ThreadClass t M) with hf
  have hdir : Directed (· ≥ ·) (QPCF.ThreadClass t) := by
    intro M M'
    exact ⟨max M M', QPCF.ThreadClass.antitone t (le_max_left _ _),
      QPCF.ThreadClass.antitone t (le_max_right _ _)⟩
  have hbasis := Filter.hasBasis_iInf_principal hdir
  have hne : f.NeBot := Filter.neBot_iff.mpr (by
    intro hbot
    have hempty : ({} : Set ℕ) ∈ f := by
      rw [hbot]
      exact Filter.mem_bot
    rw [hf] at hempty
    obtain ⟨u, hu, v, hv, huv⟩ := Filter.mem_inf_iff.1 hempty
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hbasis.mem_iff.1 hv
    have hsub : QPCF.ThreadClass t M ⊆ uᶜ := by
      intro n hn hnu
      have : n ∈ ({} : Set ℕ) := huv ▸ ⟨hnu, hM.2 hn⟩
      exact this
    exact (threadClass_infinite t M)
      ((Filter.mem_cofinite.1 hu).subset hsub))
  obtain ⟨V, hV⟩ := Filter.exists_ultrafilter_le (f := f)
  refine ⟨⟨V, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · exact le_trans hV (hf ▸ inf_le_left)
  · intro M
    have hmem : QPCF.ThreadClass t M ∈ f := by
      rw [hf]
      exact Filter.mem_inf_of_right
        (Filter.mem_iInf_of_mem M (Filter.mem_principal_self _))
    exact hV hmem

name: QPCF.Beta.threadOf_surjective
statement: theorem threadOf_surjective : Function.Surjective threadOf
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := exists_free_containing_all_threadClasses t
  refine ⟨U, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  funext M
  exact (selectedResidue_unique U M (QPCF.ZHat.proj M t) (hU M)).symm

lemma pval_eq_on_threadClass (G : C(QPCF.ZHat, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (t : QPCF.ZHat)
    (N : ℤ) : ∃ M : ℕ, ∀ n ∈ QPCF.ThreadClass t M,
      QPCF.pval (G (QPCF.ZHat.ofNat n)) N n = QPCF.pval (G t) N n

name: QPCF.Beta.govC_to_govBeta
statement:
theorem govC_to_govBeta {G : C(QPCF.ZHat, ℚ⸨X⸩)} {a : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hG : QPCF.GovC G a) : GovBeta (betaPullback G) a
proof:
:= by
  intro U N
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hG N
  rw [← Nat.cofinite_eq_atTop] at hC
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := pval_eq_on_threadClass G (threadOf U) N
  have htail : {n : ℕ | 1 ≤ n ∧
      |a n - QPCF.pval (G (QPCF.ZHat.ofNat n)) N n| ≤
        C * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(N + 1))} ∈ U.1 := by
    apply U.2
    have hone : {n : ℕ | 1 ≤ n} ∈ Filter.cofinite := by
      rw [Nat.cofinite_eq_atTop]
      exact Filter.eventually_ge_atTop 1
    refine Filter.mem_of_superset (Filter.inter_mem hone hC) ?_
    intro n hn
    exact ⟨hn.1, hn.2⟩
  refine ⟨C, Filter.mem_of_superset
    (Filter.inter_mem (threadClass_threadOf_mem U M) htail) ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  refine ⟨hn.2.1, ?_⟩
  rw [show (betaPullback G) U = G (threadOf U) by rfl, ← hM n hn.1]
  exact hn.2.2

statement:
theorem beta_projection_strict_corollary :
    Function.Surjective threadOf ∧

      Phi_beta ⟨x.1, ⟨betaPullback (QPCF.govGenPhi x),

name: QPCF.Beta.remainder_set_isClosed
statement:
theorem remainder_set_isClosed :
    IsClosed {U : Ultrafilter ℕ | IsFree U}
proof:
:= by
  rw [← isOpen_compl_iff]
  have heq : {U : Ultrafilter ℕ | IsFree U}ᶜ =
      ⋃ n : ℕ, {U : Ultrafilter ℕ | U = pure n} := by
    ext U
    simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_iUnion]
    constructor
    · intro hnfree
      rcases Ultrafilter.le_cofinite_or_eq_pure U with hfree | hpure
      · exact False.elim (hnfree hfree)
      · exact hpure
    · rintro ⟨n, rfl⟩ hfree
      exact (isFree_iff_ne_pure (pure n)).mp hfree n rfl
  rw [heq]
  apply isOpen_iUnion
  intro n
  have hset : {U : Ultrafilter ℕ | U = pure n} =
      {U : Ultrafilter ℕ | ({n} : Set ℕ) ∈ U} := by
    ext U
    constructor
    · rintro rfl
      simp
    · intro hn
      exact Ultrafilter.eq_of_le (Filter.le_pure_iff.mpr hn)
  rw [hset]
  exact ultrafilter_isOpen_basic {n}

name: QPCF.Beta.exists_free_ultrafilter_mem_of_infinite
statement:
lemma exists_free_ultrafilter_mem_of_infinite {S : Set ℕ} (hS : S.Infinite) :
    ∃ U : Remainder, S ∈ U.1
proof:
:= by
  letI : Infinite S := hS.to_subtype
  let V : Ultrafilter S := Filter.hyperfilter S
  let U0 : Ultrafilter ℕ := V.map Subtype.val
  have hfree : IsFree U0 := by
    intro T hT
    change T ∈ U0
    rw [show U0 = V.map Subtype.val from rfl, Ultrafilter.mem_map]
    apply Filter.mem_hyperfilter_of_finite_compl
    have hTc : Tᶜ.Finite := Filter.mem_cofinite.mp hT
    have heq : ((Subtype.val : S → ℕ) ⁻¹' T)ᶜ =
        (Subtype.val : S → ℕ) ⁻¹' Tᶜ := by ext; simp
    rw [heq]
    exact hTc.preimage Subtype.val_injective.injOn
  refine ⟨⟨U0, hfree⟩, ?_⟩
  change S ∈ U0
  rw [show U0 = V.map Subtype.val from rfl, Ultrafilter.mem_map]
  have hpre : (Subtype.val : S → ℕ) ⁻¹' S = Set.univ := by ext; simp
  rw [hpre]
  exact Filter.univ_mem

name: QPCF.Beta.finite_betaClopen_cover_cofinite
statement:
theorem finite_betaClopen_cover_cofinite {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (A : ι → Set ℕ)
    (hcover : (Set.univ : Set Remainder) ⊆ ⋃ i ∈ s, betaClopen (A i)) :
    (⋃ i ∈ s, A i) ∈ Filter.cofinite
proof:
:= by
  rw [Filter.mem_cofinite]
  by_contra hinf
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := exists_free_ultrafilter_mem_of_infinite
    (Set.not_finite.mp hinf)
  have hUc : U ∈ ⋃ i ∈ s, betaClopen (A i) := hcover trivial
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, betaClopen] at hUc
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hAi⟩ := hUc
  have hUnion : A i ⊆ ⋃ j ∈ s, A j :=
    Set.subset_iUnion₂_of_subset i hi (Set.Subset.rfl)
  have hempty : A i ∩ (⋃ j ∈ s, A j)ᶜ = ∅ := by
    ext n
    simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_iUnion,
      Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
    intro hn
    exact hn.2 ⟨i, hi, hn.1⟩
  have hinter := Filter.inter_mem hAi hU
  rw [hempty] at hinter
  exact (Filter.NeBot.ne (f := (U.1 : Filter ℕ)) inferInstance)
    (Filter.empty_mem_iff_bot.mp hinter)

name: QPCF.Beta.diff_finite_mem_iff
statement:
theorem diff_finite_mem_iff (U : Remainder) (A F : Set ℕ) (hF : F.Finite) :

proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact fun h => Filter.mem_of_superset h Set.diff_subset
  · intro hA
    have hFc : Fᶜ ∈ U.1 := U.2 (Filter.mem_cofinite.mpr (by simpa))
    change A ∩ Fᶜ ∈ U.1
    exact Filter.inter_mem hA hFc

name: QPCF.Beta.beta_coeff_eq_of_governance_intersection
statement:
theorem beta_coeff_eq_of_governance_intersection
    (a : ℕ → ℝ) (f g : ℚ⸨X⸩) (K : ℤ)
    (Sf Sg : Set ℕ) (hInf : (Sf ∩ Sg).Infinite)
    (Cf Cg : ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ n ∈ Sf,
      |a n - QPCF.pval f K n| ≤ Cf * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(K + 1)))
    (hg : ∀ n ∈ Sg,
      |a n - QPCF.pval g K n| ≤ Cg * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(K + 1))) :
    ∀ k : ℤ, k ≤ K → f.coeff k = g.coeff k
proof:
:= by
  convert QPCF.part3_coeff_eq_of_common_governance a f g ( Sf ∩ Sg ) _ K _ _ using 1;
  · rw [Filter.frequently_atTop]
    intro N
    obtain ⟨n, hn, hnN⟩ := hInf.exists_gt N
    exact ⟨n, hnN.le, hn⟩
  · exact ⟨ Cf, Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n hn => hf n hn.1 ⟩;
  · exact ⟨ Cg, Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n hn => hg n hn.2 ⟩

name: QPCF.Beta.beta_witness_coherence
statement:
theorem beta_witness_coherence
    (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha : a ∈ SBeta) (U V : Remainder) (K : ℤ)
    (g : ℚ⸨X⸩) (hg : BetaAdmissibleGerm a V g)
    (hmem : betaGovSet a U (ha U) K ∈ V.1) :
    ∀ k : ℤ, k ≤ K → (betaGermValue a U (ha U)).coeff k = g.coeff k
proof:
:= by
  have := beta_admissible_germ_governs a V g hg K; (
  obtain ⟨ C, hC ⟩ := this; have := Filter.inter_mem hmem hC; simp_all +decide [ BetaAdmissibleGerm ] ;
  apply beta_coeff_eq_of_governance_intersection a (betaGermValue a U (ha U)) g K (betaGovSet a U (ha U) K) {n | 1 ≤ n ∧ |a n - QPCF.pval g K n| ≤ C * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(K + 1))} (by
  exact mem_infinite _ ( Filter.inter_mem hmem hC ) |> fun h => by simpa [ neg_add_eq_sub ] using h;) (betaGovConst a U (ha U) K) C (by
  exact fun n hn => hn.2 |> fun h => by simpa [ neg_add_eq_sub ] using h;) (by
  exact fun n hn => hn.2));

name: QPCF.Beta.beta_per_cutoff_kernel
statement:
theorem beta_per_cutoff_kernel
    (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha : a ∈ SBeta) (K : ℤ) :
    ∀ U : Remainder, ∃ S : Set ℕ, S ∈ U.1 ∧
      ∀ V : Remainder, S ∈ V.1 →
        ∀ g : ℚ⸨X⸩, BetaAdmissibleGerm a V g →
          ∀ k : ℤ, k ≤ K →
            (betaGermValue a U (ha U)).coeff k = g.coeff k
proof:
:= by
  intro U
  exact ⟨betaGovSet a U (ha U) K, betaGovSet_mem a U (ha U) K,
    fun V hV g hg => beta_witness_coherence a ha U V K g hg hV⟩

name: QPCF.Gamma.eventuallyPeriodic_thread_dichotomy
statement:
theorem eventuallyPeriodic_thread_dichotomy (S : Set ℕ) (hS : EventuallyPeriodic S)
    (t : QPCF.ZHat) :
    (∃ M N : ℕ, {n | N ≤ n} ∩ QPCF.ThreadClass t M ⊆ S) ∨
    (∃ M N : ℕ, {n | N ≤ n} ∩ QPCF.ThreadClass t M ⊆ Sᶜ)
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨χ, hS_eq, N₀, p, hp, hperiod⟩ := hS
  
  let M := p
  have hMp : p ∣ M.factorial := Nat.dvd_factorial hp le_rfl
  
  let a := (QPCF.ZHat.proj p t).val % p
  
  
  let m := if a < N₀ then (N₀ - a + p - 1) / p else 0
  let r := a + m * p
  have hr_ge : N₀ ≤ r := by
    simp only [r, m]
    split_ifs with h
    · have h₁ : N₀ - a > 0 := by omega
      have h₂ : (N₀ - a + p - 1) / p * p ≥ N₀ - a := by
        have h := Nat.div_add_mod (N₀ - a + p - 1) p
        have hm := Nat.mod_lt (N₀ - a + p - 1) hp
        have hle : N₀ - a + p - 1 ≥ p := by omega
        have key : p * ((N₀ - a + p - 1) / p) + (N₀ - a + p - 1) % p = N₀ - a + p - 1 := h
        have hbound : (N₀ - a + p - 1) % p ≤ p - 1 := Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt hm
        
        
        calc (N₀ - a + p - 1) / p * p 
            = p * ((N₀ - a + p - 1) / p) := by ring
          _ = N₀ - a + p - 1 - (N₀ - a + p - 1) % p := by omega
          _ ≥ N₀ - a + p - 1 - (p - 1) := by omega
          _ = N₀ - a := by omega
      omega
    · simpa using h
  have hr_cong : r ≡ a [MOD p] := by
    show (a + m * p) % p = a % p
    simp [Nat.add_mul_mod_self_right]
  by_cases hr : χ r = true
  · 
    left
    use M, r
    intro n hn
    obtain ⟨hn, hn_mem⟩ := hn
    
    have hn_cong : n ≡ a [MOD p] := by
      have h1 := threadClass_modEq_proj_val t M p hMp hn_mem
      have h2 : (QPCF.ZHat.proj M t).val ≡ (QPCF.ZHat.proj p t).val [MOD p] := by
        have hfac : (QPCF.ZHat.proj M t).val % p.factorial =
            (QPCF.ZHat.proj p t).val % p.factorial := by
          erw [← ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff']
        exact Nat.ModEq.of_dvd (Nat.dvd_factorial hp le_rfl) hfac
      calc n ≡ (QPCF.ZHat.proj M t).val [MOD p] := h1
        _ ≡ (QPCF.ZHat.proj p t).val [MOD p] := h2
        _ ≡ a [MOD p] := Nat.mod_modEq _ _ |> Eq.symm
    
    have hn_r_cong : n ≡ r [MOD p] := hn_cong.trans hr_cong.symm
    
    have hχn : χ n = true := by
      have hdiv : p ∣ (n - r) := by
        have hmod : (n - r) % p = 0 := by
          have h1 : n % p = r % p := hn_r_cong
          have h2 : r ≤ n := hn
          exact Nat.sub_mod_eq_zero_of_mod_eq h1
        exact Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero hmod
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hdiv
      have hn_eq : n = r + k * p := by
        have hkp : p * k = k * p := mul_comm p k
        linarith [Nat.sub_add_cancel hn, hk ▸ hkp]
      subst hn_eq
      have hχ_period : ∀ j, N₀ ≤ r + j * p → χ (r + j * p) = χ r := by
        intro j
        induction j with
        | zero => simp
        | succ j ih =>
          intro hj
          rw [Nat.succ_mul, ← add_assoc]
          exact hperiod (r + j * p) (by omega) ▸ ih (by omega)
      exact hχ_period k (by omega) ▸ hr
    rw [hS_eq]
    exact hχn
  · 
    right
    use M, r
    intro n hn
    obtain ⟨hn, hn_mem⟩ := hn
    have hn_cong : n ≡ a [MOD p] := by
      have h1 := threadClass_modEq_proj_val t M p hMp hn_mem
      have h2 : (QPCF.ZHat.proj M t).val ≡ (QPCF.ZHat.proj p t).val [MOD p] := by
        have hfac : (QPCF.ZHat.proj M t).val % p.factorial =
            (QPCF.ZHat.proj p t).val % p.factorial := by
          erw [← ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff']
        exact Nat.ModEq.of_dvd (Nat.dvd_factorial hp le_rfl) hfac
      calc n ≡ (QPCF.ZHat.proj M t).val [MOD p] := h1
        _ ≡ (QPCF.ZHat.proj p t).val [MOD p] := h2
        _ ≡ a [MOD p] := Nat.mod_modEq _ _ |> Eq.symm
    have hn_r_cong : n ≡ r [MOD p] := hn_cong.trans hr_cong.symm
    have hχn : χ n ≠ true := by
      have hdiv : p ∣ (n - r) := by
        have hmod : (n - r) % p = 0 := by
          have h1 : n % p = r % p := hn_r_cong
          exact Nat.sub_mod_eq_zero_of_mod_eq h1
        exact Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero hmod
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hdiv
      have hn_eq : n = r + k * p := by
        have hkp : p * k = k * p := mul_comm p k
        linarith [Nat.sub_add_cancel hn, hk ▸ hkp]
      subst hn_eq
      have hχ_period : ∀ j, N₀ ≤ r + j * p → χ (r + j * p) = χ r := by
        intro j
        induction j with
        | zero => simp
        | succ j ih =>
          intro hj
          rw [Nat.succ_mul, ← add_assoc]
          exact hperiod (r + j * p) (by omega) ▸ ih (by omega)
      rw [hχ_period k (by omega)]
      exact hr
    rw [hS_eq]
    exact hχn

name: QPCF.Gamma.gammaUltrafilterOfThread_threadClass_mem
statement:
theorem gammaUltrafilterOfThread_threadClass_mem (t : QPCF.ZHat) (M : ℕ) :
    (gammaUltrafilterOfThread t).1.Mem
      ⟨QPCF.ThreadClass t M,
        (gammaResidueClass EP M (QPCF.ZHat.proj M t)).2⟩
proof:
:= by
  change ∃ M' N : ℕ, {n | N ≤ n} ∩ QPCF.ThreadClass t M' ⊆
    QPCF.ThreadClass t M
  exact ⟨M, 0, fun _ hn => hn.2⟩

name: QPCF.Gamma.gammaThreadOf_gammaUltrafilterOfThread
statement:
theorem gammaThreadOf_gammaUltrafilterOfThread (t : QPCF.ZHat) :
    gammaThreadOf EP (gammaUltrafilterOfThread t) = t
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  funext M
  exact (gammaSelectedResidue_unique EP (gammaUltrafilterOfThread t) M
    (QPCF.ZHat.proj M t) (gammaUltrafilterOfThread_threadClass_mem t M)).symm

name: QPCF.Gamma.gammaUltrafilterOfThread_gammaThreadOf
statement:
theorem gammaUltrafilterOfThread_gammaThreadOf (U : gammaRemainder EP) :
    gammaUltrafilterOfThread (gammaThreadOf EP U) = U
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply GammaUltrafilter.ext
  intro S
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨M, N, hsub⟩
    have hfin : ({n : ℕ | N ≤ n}ᶜ).Finite := by
      simpa only [compl_setOf, not_le] using Set.finite_Iio N
    let T : BSet EP := ⟨{n | N ≤ n}, cofinite_mem EP hfin⟩
    have hT : U.1.Mem T := U.2 T hfin
    have hi := U.1.inter_mem hT (threadClass_gammaThreadOf_mem EP U M)
    exact U.1.superset_mem hsub hi
  · intro hS
    rcases eventuallyPeriodic_thread_dichotomy S.1 S.2 (gammaThreadOf EP U) with h | h
    · exact h
    · obtain ⟨M, N, hsub⟩ := h
      exfalso
      have hfin : ({n : ℕ | N ≤ n}ᶜ).Finite := by
        simpa only [compl_setOf, not_le] using Set.finite_Iio N
      let T : BSet EP := ⟨{n | N ≤ n}, cofinite_mem EP hfin⟩
      have hT : U.1.Mem T := U.2 T hfin
      have hi := U.1.inter_mem hT (threadClass_gammaThreadOf_mem EP U M)
      have hc : U.1.Mem ⟨S.1ᶜ, EP.compl_mem S.2⟩ := U.1.superset_mem hsub hi
      exact U.1.empty_not_mem (by simpa using U.1.inter_mem hS hc)

name: QPCF.Gamma.gammaTop_left_inv
statement: theorem gammaTop_left_inv (U : gammaRemainder (⊤ : GoverningStructure)) : betaToGammaTop (gammaTopToBeta U) = U
proof:
:= by

  apply GammaUltrafilter.ext
  intro S
  change U.1.Mem ⟨S.1, mem_top S.1⟩ ↔ U.1.Mem S
  exact Iff.rfl

name: QPCF.Gamma.gammaTop_right_inv
statement: theorem gammaTop_right_inv (U : QPCF.Beta.Remainder) : gammaTopToBeta (betaToGammaTop U) = U
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Ultrafilter.ext
  intro S
  change S ∈ U.1 ↔ S ∈ U.1

name: QPCF.Gamma.SGamma_top_eq_SBeta
statement:
theorem SGamma_top_eq_SBeta :
    SGamma (⊤ : GoverningStructure) = QPCF.Beta.SBeta
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  constructor
  · intro ha U
    have h := ha (betaToGammaTop U)
    rcases h with h | h
    · left
      rcases h with ⟨P, Q, hQ, h⟩
      refine ⟨P, Q, hQ, ?_⟩
      intro k
      obtain ⟨S, hS, hs⟩ := h k
      exact ⟨S.1, hS, hs⟩
    · right
      constructor
      · intro m
        obtain ⟨S, hS, p, hp⟩ := h.1 m
        exact ⟨S.1, hS, p, hp⟩
      · intro D
        obtain ⟨m, S, hS, p, hp⟩ := h.2 D
        exact ⟨m, S.1, hS, p, hp⟩
  · intro ha U
    have h := ha (gammaTopToBeta U)
    rcases h with h | h
    · left
      rcases h with ⟨P, Q, hQ, h⟩
      refine ⟨P, Q, hQ, ?_⟩
      intro k
      obtain ⟨S, hS, hs⟩ := h k
      exact ⟨⟨S, mem_top S⟩, hS, hs⟩
    · right
      constructor
      · intro m
        obtain ⟨S, hS, p, hp⟩ := h.1 m
        exact ⟨⟨S, mem_top S⟩, hS, p, hp⟩
      · intro D
        obtain ⟨m, S, hS, p, hp⟩ := h.2 D
        exact ⟨m, ⟨S, mem_top S⟩, hS, p, hp⟩
