name: QPCF.Gamma.poly_intVal_cofinite
statement:
theorem poly_intVal_cofinite (q : Polynomial ℚ) (K₀ : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ k : ℕ, K₀ ≤ k → ∃ z : ℤ, q.eval (k : ℚ) = (z : ℚ)) :
    ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ z : ℤ, q.eval (k : ℚ) = (z : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  
  
  
  classical
  set S : Subring ℚ := (Int.castRingHom ℚ).range with hS
  have hmemS : ∀ x : ℚ, x ∈ S ↔ ∃ z : ℤ, x = (z : ℚ) := by
    intro x; constructor
    · rintro ⟨z, rfl⟩; exact ⟨z, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨z, rfl⟩; exact ⟨z, rfl⟩
  have hsmul : ∀ (m : ℤ) (x : ℚ), x ∈ S → m • x ∈ S := by
    intro m x hx
    have : m • x = (Int.castRingHom ℚ m) * x := by simp [zsmul_eq_mul]
    rw [this]; exact S.mul_mem ⟨m, rfl⟩ hx
  set f : ℚ → ℚ := fun x => q.eval x with hf
  set D := q.natDegree with hD
  have hzero : (fwdDiff (1:ℚ))^[D+1] f = 0 := by
    simpa [hf, hD] using Polynomial.fwdDiff_iter_degree_add_one_eq_zero q
  set c : ℕ → ℤ := fun i => (-1:ℤ)^(D+1-i) * ((D+1).choose i : ℤ) with hc
  have hc0 : c 0 = (-1:ℤ)^(D+1) := by simp [hc]
  have hc0sq : c 0 * c 0 = 1 := by
    rw [hc0, ← pow_add]; exact Even.neg_one_pow ⟨D+1, rfl⟩
  have hval : ∀ k0 : ℕ, f k0 = - ∑ i ∈ (Finset.range (D+2)).erase 0,
      (c 0 * c i) • f ((k0 + i : ℕ) : ℚ) := by
    intro k0
    have hsum := fwdDiff_iter_eq_sum_shift (1:ℚ) f (D+1) (k0:ℚ)
    rw [show ((fwdDiff (1:ℚ))^[D+1] f (k0:ℚ)) = (0:ℚ) by rw [hzero]; rfl] at hsum
    have hshift : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (D+2),
        (c i) • f ((k0:ℚ) + i • (1:ℚ)) = (c i) • f ((k0 + i : ℕ):ℚ) := by
      intro i _; congr 1; push_cast; ring
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hshift] at hsum
    have h0mem : (0:ℕ) ∈ Finset.range (D+2) := by simp
    rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ h0mem] at hsum
    have hk00 : ((k0 + 0 : ℕ):ℚ) = (k0:ℚ) := by push_cast; ring
    rw [hk00] at hsum
    have h2 := congrArg (fun x => (c 0) • x) hsum
    simp only [smul_zero, smul_add, smul_smul, hc0sq, one_smul, Finset.smul_sum] at h2
    linear_combination -h2
  have key : ∀ k0 : ℕ,
      (∀ i ∈ (Finset.range (D+2)).erase 0, f ((k0+i:ℕ):ℚ) ∈ S) → f (k0:ℚ) ∈ S := by
    intro k0 hmem
    rw [hval k0]
    refine S.neg_mem (S.sum_mem ?_)
    intro i hi
    exact hsmul _ _ (hmem i hi)
  have main : ∀ g k0 : ℕ, K₀ - k0 = g → f (k0:ℚ) ∈ S := by
    intro g
    induction g using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | _ g ih =>
      intro k0 hg
      by_cases hk : K₀ ≤ k0
      · obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := h k0 hk
        exact (hmemS _).2 ⟨z, by simpa [hf] using hz⟩
      · push_neg at hk
        apply key k0
        intro i hi
        have hi1 : 1 ≤ i := by
          rcases Finset.mem_erase.mp hi with ⟨hi0, _⟩; omega
        exact ih (K₀ - (k0+i)) (by omega) (k0+i) rfl
  intro k0
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (hmemS _).1 (main (K₀ - k0) k0 rfl)
  exact ⟨z, by simpa [hf] using hz⟩

name: QPCF.Gamma.armA_intVal_propagate
statement:
theorem armA_intVal_propagate (t : QPCF.ZHat) (M N : ℕ) (p : Polynomial ℚ)
    (h : ∀ n : ℕ, n ∈ QPCF.ThreadClass t M → N ≤ n → ∃ z : ℤ, p.eval (n : ℚ) = (z : ℚ)) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, n ∈ QPCF.ThreadClass t M → ∃ z : ℤ, p.eval (n : ℚ) = (z : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  set d := M.factorial with hd_def
  have hd : 0 < d := Nat.factorial_pos M
  haveI : NeZero d := ⟨hd.ne'⟩
  have hdne : (d : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hd.ne'
  set r := (QPCF.ZHat.proj M t).val with hr_def
  have hrlt : r < d := by rw [hr_def]; exact ZMod.val_lt _
  
  have hmem : ∀ n : ℕ, n ∈ QPCF.ThreadClass t M ↔ n % d = r % d := by
    intro n
    constructor
    · intro hn
      have := QPCF.threadClass_modEq_proj_val t M d (dvd_refl _) hn
      simpa [Nat.ModEq, hr_def] using this
    · intro hn
      show QPCF.ZHat.proj M (QPCF.ZHat.ofNat n) = QPCF.ZHat.proj M t
      rw [QPCF.ZHat.proj_ofNat]
      have : (n : ZMod d) = ((QPCF.ZHat.proj M t).val : ZMod d) := by
        rw [ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff]
        simpa [Nat.ModEq, hr_def] using hn
      rw [this]
      exact ZMod.natCast_zmod_val (QPCF.ZHat.proj M t)
  
  set q : Polynomial ℚ :=
    p.comp (Polynomial.C (r : ℚ) + Polynomial.C (d : ℚ) * Polynomial.X) with hq_def
  have hq_eval : ∀ k : ℕ, q.eval (k : ℚ) = p.eval ((r + d * k : ℕ) : ℚ) := by
    intro k
    simp only [hq_def, Polynomial.eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul,
      Polynomial.eval_C, Polynomial.eval_X]
    push_cast
    ring_nf
  
  have hform : ∀ n : ℕ, n ∈ QPCF.ThreadClass t M → n = r + d * (n / d) := by
    intro n hn
    have hnmod : n % d = r := by
      have h2 := (hmem n).1 hn
      rwa [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hrlt] at h2
    calc n = d * (n / d) + n % d := (Nat.div_add_mod n d).symm
      _ = r + d * (n / d) := by rw [hnmod]; ring
  
  have hqcof : ∀ k : ℕ, N ≤ k → ∃ z : ℤ, q.eval (k : ℚ) = (z : ℚ) := by
    intro k hk
    rw [hq_eval]
    have hmemk : (r + d * k) ∈ QPCF.ThreadClass t M := by
      rw [hmem]
      simp [Nat.add_mul_mod_self_left]
    exact h (r + d * k) hmemk (by nlinarith [Nat.zero_le (r), Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hd.ne'])
  
  have hqall := poly_intVal_cofinite q N hqcof
  intro n hn
  rw [hform n hn, ← hq_eval]
  exact hqall (n / d)

name: QPCF.Gamma.SCF_subset_SGamma_EP
statement: theorem SCF_subset_SGamma_EP : QPCF.SCF_TR' ⊆ SGamma EP
proof:
:= by
  intro a hcf U
  set t := gammaThreadOf EP U with htdef
  have ht := hcf t
  rcases ht with hB | ⟨hA, hC⟩
  · 
    left
    obtain ⟨P, Q, hQ, hk⟩ := hB
    refine ⟨P, Q, hQ, fun k => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hk k
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp hM
    refine ⟨threadClassTailB t M N, mem_threadClassTailB U M N, ?_⟩
    filter_upwards with n
    rintro ⟨hncls, hnN⟩
    exact hN n hnN hncls
  · right
    refine ⟨fun m => ?_, ?_⟩
    · 
      obtain ⟨M, p, htrack, hint, hpos⟩ := hA m
      have hcomb : ∀ᶠ n in atTop,
          (∀ j : Fin (m + 1), n ∈ QPCF.ThreadClass t M →
            QPCF.realPQ j.1 (a n) = (((p j).eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)) ∧
          (∀ j : Fin (m + 1), 1 ≤ j.1 → n ∈ QPCF.ThreadClass t M →
            1 ≤ (p j).eval (n : ℚ)) := by
        refine (Filter.eventually_all.2 htrack).and (Filter.eventually_all.2 ?_)
        intro j
        by_cases hj : 1 ≤ j.1
        · filter_upwards [hpos j hj] with n hn _; exact hn
        · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun n hcon => absurd hcon hj)
      obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp hcomb
      refine ⟨threadClassTailB t M N, mem_threadClassTailB U M N, p, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro j
        filter_upwards with n
        rintro ⟨hncls, hnN⟩
        exact (hN n hnN).1 j hncls
      · intro j n hnS hn1
        exact hint j n hn1 hnS.1
      · intro j hj
        filter_upwards with n
        rintro ⟨hncls, hnN⟩
        exact (hN n hnN).2 j hj hncls
    · 
      intro D
      obtain ⟨m, M, p, htrack, hint, hpos, hdeg⟩ := hC D
      have hcomb : ∀ᶠ n in atTop,
          (∀ j : Fin (m + 1), n ∈ QPCF.ThreadClass t M →
            QPCF.realPQ j.1 (a n) = (((p j).eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)) ∧
          (∀ j : Fin (m + 1), 1 ≤ j.1 → n ∈ QPCF.ThreadClass t M →
            1 ≤ (p j).eval (n : ℚ)) := by
        refine (Filter.eventually_all.2 htrack).and (Filter.eventually_all.2 ?_)
        intro j
        by_cases hj : 1 ≤ j.1
        · filter_upwards [hpos j hj] with n hn _; exact hn
        · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun n hcon => absurd hcon hj)
      obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp hcomb
      refine ⟨m, threadClassTailB t M N, mem_threadClassTailB U M N, p, ?_, ?_, ?_, hdeg⟩
      · intro j
        filter_upwards with n
        rintro ⟨hncls, hnN⟩
        exact (hN n hnN).1 j hncls
      · intro j n hnS hn1
        exact hint j n hn1 hnS.1
      · intro j hj
        filter_upwards with n
        rintro ⟨hncls, hnN⟩
        exact (hN n hnN).2 j hj hncls

name: QPCF.Gamma.SGamma_EP_subset_SCF
statement: theorem SGamma_EP_subset_SCF : SGamma EP ⊆ QPCF.SCF_TR'
proof:
:= by
  intro a hγ t
  have hres := hγ (gammaUltrafilterOfThread t)
  rcases hres with hB | ⟨hA, hC⟩
  · 
    left
    obtain ⟨P, Q, hQ, hk⟩ := hB
    refine ⟨P, Q, hQ, fun k => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨S, hSmem, hbound⟩ := hk k
    obtain ⟨M, N, hsub⟩ := (mem_gammaUltrafilterOfThread t S).1 hSmem
    refine ⟨M, ?_⟩
    filter_upwards [hbound, Filter.eventually_ge_atTop N] with n hn hnN
    intro hncls
    exact hn (hsub ⟨hnN, hncls⟩)
  · right
    refine ⟨fun m => ?_, ?_⟩
    · 
      obtain ⟨S, hSmem, p, htrack, hint, hpos⟩ := hA m
      obtain ⟨M, N, hsub⟩ := (mem_gammaUltrafilterOfThread t S).1 hSmem
      refine ⟨M, p, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro j
        filter_upwards [htrack j, Filter.eventually_ge_atTop N] with n hn hnN
        intro hncls
        exact hn (hsub ⟨hnN, hncls⟩)
      · intro j n hn1 hncls
        have htail : ∀ n' : ℕ, n' ∈ QPCF.ThreadClass t M → max N 1 ≤ n' →
            ∃ z : ℤ, (p j).eval (n' : ℚ) = (z : ℚ) := by
          intro n' hn'cls hn'
          exact hint j n' (hsub ⟨(le_max_left N 1).trans hn', hn'cls⟩)
            (le_trans (le_max_right N 1) hn')
        exact armA_intVal_propagate t M (max N 1) (p j) htail n hncls
      · intro j hj
        filter_upwards [hpos j hj, Filter.eventually_ge_atTop N] with n hn hnN
        intro hncls
        exact hn (hsub ⟨hnN, hncls⟩)
    · 
      intro D
      obtain ⟨m, S, hSmem, p, htrack, hint, hpos, hdeg⟩ := hC D
      obtain ⟨M, N, hsub⟩ := (mem_gammaUltrafilterOfThread t S).1 hSmem
      refine ⟨m, M, p, ?_, ?_, ?_, hdeg⟩
      · intro j
        filter_upwards [htrack j, Filter.eventually_ge_atTop N] with n hn hnN
        intro hncls
        exact hn (hsub ⟨hnN, hncls⟩)
      · intro j n hn1 hncls
        have htail : ∀ n' : ℕ, n' ∈ QPCF.ThreadClass t M → max N 1 ≤ n' →
            ∃ z : ℤ, (p j).eval (n' : ℚ) = (z : ℚ) := by
          intro n' hn'cls hn'
          exact hint j n' (hsub ⟨(le_max_left N 1).trans hn', hn'cls⟩)
            (le_trans (le_max_right N 1) hn')
        exact armA_intVal_propagate t M (max N 1) (p j) htail n hncls
      · intro j hj
        filter_upwards [hpos j hj, Filter.eventually_ge_atTop N] with n hn hnN
        intro hncls
        exact hn (hsub ⟨hnN, hncls⟩)

name: QPCF.Gamma.SGamma_EP_eq_SCF
statement: theorem SGamma_EP_eq_SCF : SGamma EP = QPCF.SCF_TR'
proof:
:=

name: QPCF.Gamma.continuous_gammaRestrict

name: QPCF.Gamma.gammaRestrict_EP_top_identifies_threadOf

theorem gammaRestrict_EP_top_identifies_threadOf

proof:
:= by

  change gammaSelectedResidue EP (restrict (fun S _ => mem_top S) U) M =
    QPCF.Beta.selectedResidue (gammaTopToBeta U) M
  symm

        QPCF.Beta.threadOf (gammaTop_homeo U)) ∧

proof:

    QPCF.Beta.beta_projection_strict_corollary.1⟩

name: QPCF.Gamma.mem_bsetTail
statement:

name: QPCF.Gamma.mem_bsetIInter
statement:
theorem mem_bsetIInter (U : gammaRemainder B) (m : ℕ)
    (f : Fin (m + 1) → BSet B) (hf : ∀ j, U.1.Mem (f j)) :
    U.1.Mem (bsetIInter B m f)
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => exact hf 0
  | succ m ih =>
      exact U.1.inter_mem (ih (fun j => f j.castSucc) (fun j => hf _)) (hf _)

name: QPCF.Gamma.bsetIInter_subset
statement:
theorem bsetIInter_subset (m : ℕ) (f : Fin (m + 1) → BSet B)
    (j : Fin (m + 1)) : (bsetIInter B m f).1 ⊆ (f j).1
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
      rw [Fin.fin_one_eq_zero j]
      exact Set.Subset.rfl
  | succ m ih =>
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun i => ?_) j
      · exact Set.inter_subset_right
      · exact Set.Subset.trans Set.inter_subset_left (ih (fun k => f k.castSucc) i)

name: QPCF.Gamma.gamma_canonical_tracking
statement:
theorem gamma_canonical_tracking (a : ℕ → ℝ) (U : gammaRemainder B)
    (hA : ∀ m, ArmAGamma B a U m) (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ S : BSet B, U.1.Mem S ∧
      (∀ j ≤ m, ∀ᶠ n in atTop, n ∈ S.1 →
        QPCF.realPQ j (a n) = (((gammaCanonicalPQ B a U hA j).eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)) ∧
      (∀ j ≤ m, ∀ n ∈ S.1, 1 ≤ n →
        ∃ z : ℤ, (gammaCanonicalPQ B a U hA j).eval (n : ℚ) = (z : ℚ)) ∧
      (∀ j ≤ m, 1 ≤ j → ∀ᶠ n in atTop,
        n ∈ S.1 → 1 ≤ (gammaCanonicalPQ B a U hA j).eval (n : ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  let f : Fin (m + 1) → BSet B := fun j => Classical.choose (hA j.1)
  refine ⟨bsetIInter B m f, mem_bsetIInter B U m f ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j
    exact (Classical.choose_spec (hA j.1)).1
  · intro j hj
    let i : Fin (m + 1) := ⟨j, by omega⟩
    have hsub := bsetIInter_subset B m f i
    let p := Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (hA j)).2
    have hp := (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (hA j)).2).1
    have hint := (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (hA j)).2).2.1
    have hpos := (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (hA j)).2).2.2
    have hcanon : p (Fin.last j) = gammaCanonicalPQ B a U hA j := by
      unfold p gammaCanonicalPQ
      congr 1
    filter_upwards [hp (Fin.last j)] with n hn
    intro hnS
    rw [← hcanon]
    exact hn (hsub hnS)
  · intro j hj n hnS hn1
    let i : Fin (m + 1) := ⟨j, by omega⟩
    have hsub := bsetIInter_subset B m f i
    let p := Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (hA j)).2
    have hp := (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (hA j)).2).1
    have hint := (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (hA j)).2).2.1
    have hpos := (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (hA j)).2).2.2
    have hcanon : p (Fin.last j) = gammaCanonicalPQ B a U hA j := by
      unfold p gammaCanonicalPQ
      congr 1
    rw [← hcanon]
    exact hint (Fin.last j) n (hsub hnS) hn1
  · intro j hj hjpos
    let i : Fin (m + 1) := ⟨j, by omega⟩
    have hsub := bsetIInter_subset B m f i
    let p := Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (hA j)).2
    have hp := (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (hA j)).2).1
    have hint := (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (hA j)).2).2.1
    have hpos := (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (hA j)).2).2.2
    have hcanon : p (Fin.last j) = gammaCanonicalPQ B a U hA j := by
      unfold p gammaCanonicalPQ
      congr 1
    filter_upwards [hpos (Fin.last j) hjpos] with n hn
    intro hnS
    rw [← hcanon]
    exact hn (hsub hnS)

name: QPCF.Gamma.gamma_canonical_leadingCoeff_pos
statement:
theorem gamma_canonical_leadingCoeff_pos (a : ℕ → ℝ) (U : gammaRemainder B)
    (hA : ∀ m, ArmAGamma B a U m) (j : ℕ) (hj : 1 ≤ j) :
    0 < (gammaCanonicalPQ B a U hA j).leadingCoeff
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hS₁, hS₂, hS₃, hS₄⟩ := gamma_canonical_tracking B a U hA j
  by_cases hnonpos : (gammaCanonicalPQ B a U hA j).leadingCoeff ≤ 0
  · have hpoly : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, (gammaCanonicalPQ B a U hA j).eval (n : ℚ) ≤ 0 := by
      by_cases hdeg : (gammaCanonicalPQ B a U hA j).natDegree = 0
      · rw [Polynomial.eq_C_of_natDegree_eq_zero hdeg] at hnonpos ⊢
        aesop
      · have ht : Tendsto (fun x : ℚ => (gammaCanonicalPQ B a U hA j).eval x)
            atTop atBot := by
          rw [Polynomial.tendsto_atBot_iff_leadingCoeff_nonpos]
          exact ⟨Polynomial.natDegree_pos_iff_degree_pos.mp (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hdeg), hnonpos⟩
        exact (ht.eventually (Filter.eventually_le_atBot 0)).natCast_atTop
    have hcontra : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ∈ S.1 → False := by
      filter_upwards [hS₄ j le_rfl hj, hpoly] with n hn₁ hn₂ hnS
      linarith [hn₁ hnS]
    have hfinite : S.1.Finite := by
      exact Set.finite_iff_bddAbove.mpr (by
        rcases Filter.eventually_atTop.mp hcontra with ⟨N, hN⟩
        exact ⟨N, fun n hn => not_lt.mp fun hc => hN n hc.le hn⟩)
    exact False.elim (hfinite.not_infinite (mem_infinite B U S hS₁))
  · exact not_le.mp hnonpos

name: QPCF.Gamma.gamma_continuant_denominator_degree
statement:
theorem gamma_continuant_denominator_degree (a : ℕ → ℝ) (U : gammaRemainder B)
    (hA : ∀ m, ArmAGamma B a U m) (m : ℕ) :
    0 < (QPCF.polyContDen (gammaCanonicalPQ B a U hA) (m + 1)).leadingCoeff ∧
      (QPCF.polyContDen (gammaCanonicalPQ B a U hA) (m + 1)).natDegree =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, (gammaCanonicalPQ B a U hA (j + 1)).natDegree
proof:
:= by
  exact QPCF.polyContDen_natDegree_of_leadingCoeff_pos _
    (gamma_canonical_leadingCoeff_pos B a U hA) m

name: QPCF.Gamma.gamma_continuant_denominator_degree_unbounded
statement:
theorem gamma_continuant_denominator_degree_unbounded (a : ℕ → ℝ)
    (U : gammaRemainder B) (hA : ∀ m, ArmAGamma B a U m)
    (hCond : CondCGamma B a U) (D : ℕ) :
    ∃ m, D ≤ (QPCF.polyContDen (gammaCanonicalPQ B a U hA) (m + 1)).natDegree
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, S, hS, p, hp₁, hp₂, hp₃, hp₄⟩ :=
    hCond (D + (gammaCanonicalPQ B a U hA 0).natDegree + 1)
  have hp_eq : p = fun j => gammaCanonicalPQ B a U hA j.val := by
    obtain ⟨S', hS', hp₁', hp₂', hp₃'⟩ := gamma_canonical_tracking B a U hA m
    apply armAGamma_polynomial_canonical B hS hS'
    · exact hp₁
    · exact fun j => hp₁' _ j.is_le
  have hdeg := gamma_continuant_denominator_degree B a U hA m
  simp_all +decide [Finset.sum_range, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  grind

name: QPCF.Gamma.gamma_consecutive_coeff_eq
statement:
theorem gamma_consecutive_coeff_eq (a : ℕ → ℝ) (U : gammaRemainder B)
    (hA : ∀ m, ArmAGamma B a U m) (m : ℕ) (i : ℤ)
    (hi : i < (QPCF.polyContDen (gammaCanonicalPQ B a U hA) (m + 1)).natDegree +
      (QPCF.polyContDen (gammaCanonicalPQ B a U hA) (m + 2)).natDegree) :
    (gammaArmAConvergent B a U hA (m + 1)).coeff i =
      (gammaArmAConvergent B a U hA m).coeff i

name: QPCF.Gamma.gamma_convergents_eventually_coeff_eq
statement:
theorem gamma_convergents_eventually_coeff_eq (a : ℕ → ℝ) (U : gammaRemainder B)
    (hA : ∀ m, ArmAGamma B a U m) (hCond : CondCGamma B a U) (D : ℤ) :
    ∃ M, ∀ m ≥ M, ∀ n ≥ M, ∀ i < D,
      (gammaArmAConvergent B a U hA m).coeff i =
        (gammaArmAConvergent B a U hA n).coeff i

name: QPCF.Gamma.gamma_germ_limit_cauchy
statement:
theorem gamma_germ_limit_cauchy (a : ℕ → ℝ) (U : gammaRemainder B)
    (hA : ∀ m, ArmAGamma B a U m) (hCond : CondCGamma B a U) :
    CauchySeq (gammaArmAConvergent B a U hA)

name: QPCF.Gamma.gamma_germ_limit
statement:
theorem gamma_germ_limit (a : ℕ → ℝ) (U : gammaRemainder B)
    (hA : ∀ m, ArmAGamma B a U m) (hCond : CondCGamma B a U) :
    ∃ g : ℚ⸨X⸩, Tendsto (gammaArmAConvergent B a U hA) atTop (𝓝 g)
proof:
:= by
  convert cauchySeq_tendsto_of_complete (gamma_germ_limit_cauchy B a U hA hCond)

name: QPCF.Gamma.gamma_germ_eventually_coeff_eq
statement:
theorem gamma_germ_eventually_coeff_eq (a : ℕ → ℝ) (U : gammaRemainder B)
    (hA : ∀ m, ArmAGamma B a U m) (hCond : CondCGamma B a U) (D : ℤ) :
    ∃ M, ∀ m ≥ M, ∀ i < D,
      (gammaArmAGerm B a U hA hCond).coeff i =
        (gammaArmAConvergent B a U hA m).coeff i

name: QPCF.Gamma.gamma_real_convergent_error
statement:
theorem gamma_real_convergent_error (a : ℕ → ℝ) (U : gammaRemainder B)
    (hA : ∀ m, ArmAGamma B a U m) (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ S : BSet B, U.1.Mem S ∧ ∀ᶠ n in atTop, n ∈ S.1 →
      |a n -
        (((QPCF.polyContNum (gammaCanonicalPQ B a U hA) (m + 1)).eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) /
        (((QPCF.polyContDen (gammaCanonicalPQ B a U hA) (m + 1)).eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)| ≤
      1 / ((((QPCF.polyContDen (gammaCanonicalPQ B a U hA) (m + 1)).eval
        (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) ^ 2)

name: QPCF.Gamma.gamma_convergent_governs_to_degree
statement:
theorem gamma_convergent_governs_to_degree (a : ℕ → ℝ) (U : gammaRemainder B)
    (hA : ∀ m, ArmAGamma B a U m) (m : ℕ) (N : ℤ)
    (hN : N + 1 ≤ 2 *
      (QPCF.polyContDen (gammaCanonicalPQ B a U hA) (m + 1)).natDegree) :
    ∃ S : BSet B, U.1.Mem S ∧ ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ᶠ n in atTop, n ∈ S.1 →
      |a n - QPCF.pval (gammaArmAConvergent B a U hA m) N n| ≤
        C * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(N + 1))

name: QPCF.Gamma.gamma_armA_germ_governs
statement:
theorem gamma_armA_germ_governs (a : ℕ → ℝ) (U : gammaRemainder B)
    (hA : ∀ m, ArmAGamma B a U m) (hCond : CondCGamma B a U) :
    GovAtGamma B U (gammaArmAGerm B a U hA hCond) a
proof:
:= by
  intro N
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := gamma_continuant_denominator_degree_unbounded B a U hA hCond
    ((N.toNat + 1) * 2)
  obtain ⟨mg, hmg⟩ := gamma_germ_eventually_coeff_eq B a U hA hCond (N + 1)
  obtain ⟨S, hS, C, hC⟩ := gamma_convergent_governs_to_degree B a U hA
    (max m mg) N (by
      have hdeg :
          (QPCF.polyContDen (gammaCanonicalPQ B a U hA) (max m mg + 1)).natDegree ≥
            (QPCF.polyContDen (gammaCanonicalPQ B a U hA) (m + 1)).natDegree := by
        rw [(gamma_continuant_denominator_degree B a U hA (max m mg)).2,
          (gamma_continuant_denominator_degree B a U hA m).2]
        exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset (Finset.range_mono (le_max_left _ _))
      bv_omega)
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp hC
  let T : BSet B :=
    ⟨S.1 ∩ (bsetTail B M).1, B.inter_mem S.2 (bsetTail B M).2⟩
  refine ⟨C, T, U.1.inter_mem hS (mem_bsetTail B U M), ?_⟩
  rintro n ⟨hnS, hnM⟩ hn1
  have hb := hM n hnM hnS
  have hcoeff := hmg (max m mg) (le_max_right m mg)
  convert hb using 2
  unfold QPCF.pval
  simp +decide [Finset.sum_range_succ', hcoeff]
  exact finsum_congr fun k => by aesop

statement: theorem beattyB_mem_BeattyStructure : beattyB ∈ BeattyStructure
proof:
:= by
  have : beattyB = {n : ℕ | Int.fract ((n : ℝ) * Real.sqrt 2)
      ∈ Set.Ico ((0 : ℚ) : ℝ) ((1 / 2 : ℚ) : ℝ)} := by

name: QPCF.Gamma.beattySeparator_mem_SGamma_Beatty
statement:
theorem beattySeparator_mem_SGamma_Beatty :
    beattySeparator ∈ SGamma BeattyStructure
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro U
  by_cases hU : U.1.Mem ⟨beattyB, beattyB_mem_BeattyStructure⟩
  · 
    refine Or.inl ⟨Polynomial.C 2, Polynomial.X, by norm_num, fun k => ?_⟩
    refine ⟨⟨beattyB, beattyB_mem_BeattyStructure⟩, hU, ?_⟩
    filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop 1] with n hn hmem
    have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
    have hval : beattySeparator n = 2 / (n : ℝ) := by simp [beattySeparator, hmem]
    refine ⟨by simp only [Polynomial.eval_X]; exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mp hn, ?_⟩
    have hPQ : (((Polynomial.C 2).eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) / (((Polynomial.X).eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)
        = 2 / (n : ℝ) := by
      simp only [Polynomial.eval_C, Polynomial.eval_X]; push_cast; ring
    rw [hval, hPQ, sub_self, abs_zero]
    positivity
  · 
    have hUc : U.1.Mem ⟨beattyBᶜ, BeattyStructure.compl_mem beattyB_mem_BeattyStructure⟩ :=
      (U.1.compl_mem_iff_not_mem ⟨beattyB, beattyB_mem_BeattyStructure⟩).mpr hU
    refine Or.inl ⟨Polynomial.C 1, Polynomial.X, by norm_num, fun k => ?_⟩
    refine ⟨⟨beattyBᶜ, BeattyStructure.compl_mem beattyB_mem_BeattyStructure⟩, hUc, ?_⟩
    filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop 1] with n hn hmem
    have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
    have hmem' : n ∉ beattyB := hmem
    have hval : beattySeparator n = 1 / (n : ℝ) := by simp [beattySeparator, hmem']
    refine ⟨by simp only [Polynomial.eval_X]; exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mp hn, ?_⟩
    have hPQ : (((Polynomial.C 1).eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) / (((Polynomial.X).eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)
        = 1 / (n : ℝ) := by
      simp only [Polynomial.eval_C, Polynomial.eval_X]; push_cast; ring
    rw [hval, hPQ, sub_self, abs_zero]
    positivity

name: QPCF.Gamma.nat_orbit_dense
statement:
theorem nat_orbit_dense (β : ℝ) (hβ : Irrational β) :
    DenseRange (fun j : ℕ => (j • (β : AddCircle (1 : ℝ))))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Fact ((0 : ℝ) < 1) := ⟨one_pos⟩
  have hz : DenseRange (fun k : ℤ => k • (β : AddCircle (1 : ℝ))) := by
    rw [AddCircle.denseRange_zsmul_coe_iff]; simpa using hβ
  have hsub : Dense (↑(AddSubgroup.closure {(β : AddCircle (1 : ℝ))}) : Set (AddCircle (1 : ℝ))) := by
    have hrz : (Set.range fun k : ℤ => k • (β : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)))
        = (↑(AddSubgroup.zmultiples (β : AddCircle (1 : ℝ))) : Set (AddCircle (1 : ℝ))) := by
      ext x; simp [AddSubgroup.mem_zmultiples_iff, eq_comm]
    rw [← AddSubgroup.zmultiples_eq_closure, ← hrz]; exact hz
  have hmon : Dense (↑(AddSubmonoid.closure {(β : AddCircle (1 : ℝ))}) : Set (AddCircle (1 : ℝ))) :=
    dense_addSubmonoidClosure_iff_addSubgroupClosure.mpr hsub
  have hrange : (Set.range fun j : ℕ => (j • (β : AddCircle (1 : ℝ))))
      = (↑(AddSubmonoid.closure {(β : AddCircle (1 : ℝ))}) : Set (AddCircle (1 : ℝ))) := by
    ext x; simp [AddSubmonoid.mem_closure_singleton, eq_comm]
  rw [DenseRange, hrange]; exact hmon

name: QPCF.Gamma.forward_orbit_dense
statement:
theorem forward_orbit_dense (β : ℝ) (hβ : Irrational β) (x₀ c d : ℝ)
    (hcd : c < d) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hd : d ≤ 1) (N : ℕ) :
    ∃ j : ℕ, N ≤ j ∧ Int.fract (x₀ + j * β) ∈ Set.Ioo c d
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Fact ((0 : ℝ) < 1) := ⟨one_pos⟩
  set y₀ : ℝ := x₀ + (N : ℝ) * β with hy₀
  have hdense : DenseRange (fun j : ℕ => ((y₀ + (j : ℝ) * β : ℝ) : AddCircle (1 : ℝ))) := by
    have h1 : DenseRange (fun j : ℕ => (y₀ : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) + j • (β : AddCircle (1 : ℝ))) :=
      ((Homeomorph.addLeft (y₀ : AddCircle (1 : ℝ))).surjective.denseRange).comp
        (nat_orbit_dense β hβ) (Homeomorph.addLeft _).continuous
    have heq : (fun j : ℕ => ((y₀ + (j : ℝ) * β : ℝ) : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)))
             = (fun j : ℕ => (y₀ : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) + j • (β : AddCircle (1 : ℝ))) := by
      funext j
      rw [AddCircle.coe_add]; congr 1
      rw [← nsmul_eq_mul]; exact map_nsmul (QuotientAddGroup.mk' _) j β
    rw [heq]; exact h1
  set V : Set (AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) := (fun x : ℝ => (x : AddCircle (1 : ℝ))) '' (Set.Ioo c d) with hV
  have hVopen : IsOpen V := QuotientAddGroup.isOpenQuotientMap_mk.isOpenMap _ isOpen_Ioo
  have hVne : V.Nonempty := ⟨_, ⟨(c + d) / 2, ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, rfl⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hdense.exists_mem_open hVopen hVne
  obtain ⟨y, hyIoo, hyeq⟩ := hj
  refine ⟨N + j, by omega, ?_⟩
  have hcast : (x₀ + ((N + j : ℕ) : ℝ) * β) = y₀ + (j : ℝ) * β := by push_cast [hy₀]; ring
  rw [hcast]
  have hcirc : ((Int.fract (y₀ + (j : ℝ) * β) : ℝ) : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) = (y : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) := by
    rw [AddCircle.coe_fract]; exact hyeq.symm
  have hy01 : y ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) (0 + 1) :=
    ⟨le_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt hc hyIoo.1), by have := hyIoo.2; linarith⟩
  have hf01 : Int.fract (y₀ + (j : ℝ) * β) ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) (0 + 1) :=
    ⟨Int.fract_nonneg _, by have := Int.fract_lt_one (y₀ + (j : ℝ) * β); linarith⟩
  have hyf : Int.fract (y₀ + (j : ℝ) * β) = y :=
    (AddCircle.coe_eq_coe_iff_of_mem_Ico hf01 hy01).mp hcirc
  rw [hyf]; exact hyIoo

name: QPCF.Gamma.beattyB_frequently_in_class
statement:
theorem beattyB_frequently_in_class (D r : ℕ) (hD : 0 < D) :
    (∃ᶠ n in atTop, n % D = r % D ∧ Int.fract ((n : ℝ) * Real.sqrt 2) < 1 / 2) ∧
    (∃ᶠ n in atTop, n % D = r % D ∧ 1 / 2 ≤ Int.fract ((n : ℝ) * Real.sqrt 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hβ : Irrational ((D : ℝ) * Real.sqrt 2) := irrational_sqrt_two.natCast_mul (by omega)
  have hjmul : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ j * D := fun j => Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right j hD
  constructor
  · rw [Filter.frequently_atTop]
    intro N
    obtain ⟨j, hjN, hj⟩ := forward_orbit_dense ((D : ℝ) * Real.sqrt 2) hβ ((r : ℝ) * Real.sqrt 2)
      0 (1 / 2) (by norm_num) (le_refl 0) (by norm_num) N
    refine ⟨r + j * D, by have := hjmul j; omega, by simp [Nat.add_mul_mod_self_right], ?_⟩
    have hcast : ((r + j * D : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.sqrt 2
        = (r : ℝ) * Real.sqrt 2 + (j : ℝ) * ((D : ℝ) * Real.sqrt 2) := by push_cast; ring
    rw [hcast]; exact hj.2
  · rw [Filter.frequently_atTop]
    intro N
    obtain ⟨j, hjN, hj⟩ := forward_orbit_dense ((D : ℝ) * Real.sqrt 2) hβ ((r : ℝ) * Real.sqrt 2)
      (1 / 2) 1 (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (le_refl 1) N
    refine ⟨r + j * D, by have := hjmul j; omega, by simp [Nat.add_mul_mod_self_right], ?_⟩
    have hcast : ((r + j * D : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.sqrt 2
        = (r : ℝ) * Real.sqrt 2 + (j : ℝ) * ((D : ℝ) * Real.sqrt 2) := by push_cast; ring
    rw [hcast]; exact le_of_lt hj.1

name: QPCF.Gamma.mem_threadClass_ofNat_iff
statement:
theorem mem_threadClass_ofNat_iff (c S n : ℕ) :
    n ∈ QPCF.ThreadClass (QPCF.ZHat.ofNat c) S ↔ n % S.factorial = c % S.factorial
proof:
:= by
  unfold QPCF.ThreadClass
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, QPCF.ZHat.proj_ofNat]
  rw [ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff]; rfl

name: QPCF.Gamma.beattyB_iff_fract
statement: theorem beattyB_iff_fract (n : ℕ) : n ∈ beattyB ↔ Int.fract ((n : ℝ) * Real.sqrt 2) < 1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [beattyB, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_Ico]
  exact ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨Int.fract_nonneg _, h⟩⟩

name: QPCF.Gamma.beatty_freq_thread_inB
statement:
theorem beatty_freq_thread_inB (M : ℕ) :
    ∃ᶠ n in atTop, n ∈ QPCF.ThreadClass (QPCF.ZHat.ofNat 1) M ∧ n ∈ beattyB
proof:
:= by
  have hD : 0 < M.factorial := Nat.factorial_pos M
  refine ((beattyB_frequently_in_class M.factorial 1 hD).1).mono ?_
  rintro n ⟨hmod, hfract⟩
  exact ⟨(mem_threadClass_ofNat_iff 1 M n).mpr hmod, (beattyB_iff_fract n).mpr hfract⟩

name: QPCF.Gamma.beatty_freq_thread_notB
statement:
theorem beatty_freq_thread_notB (M : ℕ) :
    ∃ᶠ n in atTop, n ∈ QPCF.ThreadClass (QPCF.ZHat.ofNat 1) M ∧ n ∉ beattyB
proof:
:= by
  have hD : 0 < M.factorial := Nat.factorial_pos M
  refine ((beattyB_frequently_in_class M.factorial 1 hD).2).mono ?_
  rintro n ⟨hmod, hfract⟩
  refine ⟨(mem_threadClass_ofNat_iff 1 M n).mpr hmod, ?_⟩
  rw [beattyB_iff_fract]; linarith

name: QPCF.Gamma.beatty_freq_thread_inB_odd
statement:
theorem beatty_freq_thread_inB_odd (M : ℕ) :
    ∃ᶠ n in atTop, n ∈ QPCF.ThreadClass (QPCF.ZHat.ofNat 1) M ∧ n ∈ beattyB ∧ n % 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hD : 0 < 2 * M.factorial := by have := Nat.factorial_pos M; omega
  refine ((beattyB_frequently_in_class (2 * M.factorial) 1 hD).1).mono ?_
  rintro n ⟨hmod, hfract⟩
  have hme : n ≡ 1 [MOD 2 * M.factorial] := hmod
  refine ⟨(mem_threadClass_ofNat_iff 1 M n).mpr ?_, (beattyB_iff_fract n).mpr hfract, ?_⟩
  · exact hme.of_dvd ⟨2, by ring⟩
  · have h2 : n ≡ 1 [MOD 2] := hme.of_dvd ⟨M.factorial, rfl⟩
    simpa [Nat.ModEq] using h2

name: QPCF.Gamma.beatty_freq_thread_notB_odd
statement:
theorem beatty_freq_thread_notB_odd (M : ℕ) :
    ∃ᶠ n in atTop, n ∈ QPCF.ThreadClass (QPCF.ZHat.ofNat 1) M ∧ n ∉ beattyB ∧ n % 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hD : 0 < 2 * M.factorial := by have := Nat.factorial_pos M; omega
  refine ((beattyB_frequently_in_class (2 * M.factorial) 1 hD).2).mono ?_
  rintro n ⟨hmod, hfract⟩
  have hme : n ≡ 1 [MOD 2 * M.factorial] := hmod
  refine ⟨(mem_threadClass_ofNat_iff 1 M n).mpr ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact hme.of_dvd ⟨2, by ring⟩
  · rw [beattyB_iff_fract]; linarith
  · have h2 : n ≡ 1 [MOD 2] := hme.of_dvd ⟨M.factorial, rfl⟩
    simpa [Nat.ModEq] using h2

name: QPCF.Gamma.beattySeparator_eq_two
statement: theorem beattySeparator_eq_two (n : ℕ) (h : n ∈ beattyB) : beattySeparator n = 2 / (n : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [beattySeparator, h]

name: QPCF.Gamma.beattySeparator_eq_one
statement: theorem beattySeparator_eq_one (n : ℕ) (h : n ∉ beattyB) : beattySeparator n = 1 / (n : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [beattySeparator, h]

name: QPCF.Gamma.armB_beatty_sample_decay
statement:
theorem armB_beatty_sample_decay (P Q : Polynomial ℚ) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (M : ℕ)
    (hflat : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      n ∈ QPCF.ThreadClass (QPCF.ZHat.ofNat 1) M →
      Q.eval (n : ℚ) ≠ 0 ∧
      |beattySeparator n - (((P.eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) /
        ((Q.eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ))| ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ (-2 : ℤ)) :
    (P * Polynomial.X - 2 * Q = 0 ∨
      (P * Polynomial.X - 2 * Q).natDegree + 2 ≤ (Q * Polynomial.X).natDegree) ∧
    (P * Polynomial.X - Q = 0 ∨
      (P * Polynomial.X - Q).natDegree + 2 ≤ (Q * Polynomial.X).natDegree)
proof:
:= by
  have := @QPCF.expansion_order_of_eval_decay
  constructor
  · contrapose! this
    refine ⟨P * Polynomial.X - 2 * Q, Q * Polynomial.X, ?_, 2, 1,
      {n : ℕ | n ∈ ThreadClass (ZHat.ofNat 1) M ∧ beattySeparator n = 2 / (n : ℝ)}, ?_, ?_, this⟩
    · simp [hQ]
    · refine (beatty_freq_thread_inB M).mono ?_
      rintro n ⟨hc, hb⟩
      exact ⟨hc, beattySeparator_eq_two n hb⟩
    · filter_upwards [hflat, Filter.eventually_gt_atTop 0] with n hn hn0 hmem
      obtain ⟨hclass, hval⟩ := hmem
      obtain ⟨hQn, hbound⟩ := hn hclass
      rw [hval] at hbound
      have hnR : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn0
      have hQR : ((Q.eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hQn
      have hEq : (((P * Polynomial.X - 2 * Q).eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) /
            (((Q * Polynomial.X).eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)
          = (((P.eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) / ((Q.eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)) - 2 / (n : ℝ) := by
        simp only [Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X,
          Polynomial.eval_ofNat]
        push_cast; field_simp
      rw [hEq, show (((P.eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) / ((Q.eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)) - 2 / (n : ℝ)
            = -(2 / (n : ℝ) - ((P.eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) / ((Q.eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)) by ring,
        abs_neg, one_mul]
      exact hbound
  · contrapose! this
    refine ⟨P * Polynomial.X - Q, Q * Polynomial.X, ?_, 2, 1,
      {n : ℕ | n ∈ ThreadClass (ZHat.ofNat 1) M ∧ beattySeparator n = 1 / (n : ℝ)}, ?_, ?_, this⟩
    · simp [hQ]
    · refine (beatty_freq_thread_notB M).mono ?_
      rintro n ⟨hc, hb⟩
      exact ⟨hc, beattySeparator_eq_one n hb⟩
    · filter_upwards [hflat, Filter.eventually_gt_atTop 0] with n hn hn0 hmem
      obtain ⟨hclass, hval⟩ := hmem
      obtain ⟨hQn, hbound⟩ := hn hclass
      rw [hval] at hbound
      have hnR : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn0
      have hQR : ((Q.eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hQn
      have hEq : (((P * Polynomial.X - Q).eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) /
            (((Q * Polynomial.X).eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)
          = (((P.eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) / ((Q.eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)) - 1 / (n : ℝ) := by
        simp only [Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X]
        push_cast; field_simp
      rw [hEq, show (((P.eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) / ((Q.eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)) - 1 / (n : ℝ)
            = -(1 / (n : ℝ) - ((P.eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) / ((Q.eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)) by ring,
        abs_neg, one_mul]
      exact hbound

name: QPCF.Gamma.beattySeparator_not_armB_at_one
statement:
theorem beattySeparator_not_armB_at_one :
    ¬ QPCF.ArmB beattySeparator (QPCF.ZHat.ofNat 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨P, Q, hQ, hflat⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hflat 2
  exact QPCF.Beta.incompatible_square_sample_decay P Q hQ
    (armB_beatty_sample_decay P Q hQ M hM)

name: QPCF.Gamma.beattySeparator_not_armA_at_one
statement:
theorem beattySeparator_not_armA_at_one :
    ¬ QPCF.ArmA' beattySeparator (QPCF.ZHat.ofNat 1) 1
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨M, p, htrack, _, _⟩ := h
  have htrack1 := htrack 1
  have hpoly_eq : ∀ (a b : Polynomial ℚ), Set.Infinite {x : ℚ | a.eval x = b.eval x} → a = b := by
    intro a b hinf
    by_contra hne
    exact hinf (Set.Finite.subset ((a - b).roots.toFinset.finite_toSet)
      (fun x hx => by
        simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hx
        simp only [Multiset.mem_toFinset, Finset.mem_coe]
        rw [Polynomial.mem_roots (sub_ne_zero.mpr hne)]
        simp [hx]))
  have hfreqA : ∃ᶠ (n : ℕ) in atTop, (p 1).eval (n : ℚ) = ((n : ℚ) - 1) / 2 := by
    have hfreq := beatty_freq_thread_inB_odd M
    refine (hfreq.and_eventually (htrack1.and (Filter.eventually_ge_atTop 3))).mono ?_
    rintro n ⟨⟨hclass, hb, hodd⟩, htr, hge3⟩
    have hsep : beattySeparator n = 2 / (n : ℝ) := beattySeparator_eq_two n hb
    have hreal : (((p 1).eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) = ((n : ℝ) - 1) / 2 := by
      have h1 := htr hclass
      rw [show ((1 : Fin (1 + 1)) : ℕ) = 1 from rfl, hsep,
        QPCF.Beta.realPQ_one_two_div_odd_nat hge3 hodd] at h1
      exact h1.symm
    exact_mod_cast hreal
  have hfreqB : ∃ᶠ (n : ℕ) in atTop, (p 1).eval (n : ℚ) = (n : ℚ) := by
    have hfreq := beatty_freq_thread_notB_odd M
    refine (hfreq.and_eventually (htrack1.and (Filter.eventually_ge_atTop 2))).mono ?_
    rintro n ⟨⟨hclass, hb, hodd⟩, htr, hge2⟩
    have hsep : beattySeparator n = 1 / (n : ℝ) := beattySeparator_eq_one n hb
    have hreal : (((p 1).eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) = (n : ℝ) := by
      have h1 := htr hclass
      rw [show ((1 : Fin (1 + 1)) : ℕ) = 1 from rfl, hsep,
        QPCF.Beta.realPQ_one_one_div_nat hge2] at h1
      exact h1.symm
    exact_mod_cast hreal
  set qA : Polynomial ℚ := Polynomial.C (1 / 2 : ℚ) * (Polynomial.X - 1) with hqA
  have hinfA : Set.Infinite {x : ℚ | (p 1).eval x = qA.eval x} := by
    have hnat : Set.Infinite {n : ℕ | (p 1).eval (n : ℚ) = ((n : ℚ) - 1) / 2} :=
      Nat.frequently_atTop_iff_infinite.mp hfreqA
    have himg := hnat.image (f := (Nat.cast : ℕ → ℚ)) (Set.injOn_of_injective Nat.cast_injective)
    refine himg.mono ?_
    rintro x ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hn ⊢
    rw [hn, hqA]; simp; ring
  have hinfB : Set.Infinite {x : ℚ | (p 1).eval x = (Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℚ).eval x} := by
    have hnat : Set.Infinite {n : ℕ | (p 1).eval (n : ℚ) = (n : ℚ)} :=
      Nat.frequently_atTop_iff_infinite.mp hfreqB
    have himg := hnat.image (f := (Nat.cast : ℕ → ℚ)) (Set.injOn_of_injective Nat.cast_injective)
    refine himg.mono ?_
    rintro x ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hn ⊢
    rw [hn]; simp
  have hA : p 1 = qA := hpoly_eq _ _ hinfA
  have hB : p 1 = Polynomial.X := hpoly_eq _ _ hinfB
  have hcontra : qA = (Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℚ) := hA ▸ hB
  have h0 := congr_arg (Polynomial.eval (0 : ℚ)) hcontra
  rw [hqA] at h0; simp at h0

name: QPCF.Gamma.squares_infinite

proof:
:= by

    simpa using Nat.pow_left_injective (by norm_num) hab

name: QPCF.Gamma.sqF_squares

:=
  Ultrafilter.of_le _ (Filter.mem_inf_of_right (Filter.mem_principal_self _))

name: QPCF.Gamma.sqF_free

name: QPCF.Gamma.sqF_infinite

proof:

name: QPCF.Gamma.fract_mem_of_coe_mem
statement:
theorem fract_mem_of_coe_mem {c d x : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hd : d ≤ 1)
    (hx : ((x : ℝ) : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) ∈ (fun t : ℝ => (t : AddCircle (1 : ℝ))) '' Set.Ioo c d) :
    Int.fract x ∈ Set.Ioo c d
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Fact ((0 : ℝ) < 1) := ⟨one_pos⟩
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hwx⟩ := hx
  have hcirc : ((Int.fract x : ℝ) : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) = (w : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) := by
    rw [AddCircle.coe_fract]; exact hwx.symm
  have hfx01 : Int.fract x ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) (0 + 1) :=
    ⟨Int.fract_nonneg _, by have := Int.fract_lt_one x; linarith⟩
  have hw01 : w ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) (0 + 1) :=
    ⟨le_trans hc (le_of_lt hw.1), by have := lt_of_lt_of_le hw.2 hd; linarith⟩
  have hfeq : Int.fract x = w := (AddCircle.coe_eq_coe_iff_of_mem_Ico hfx01 hw01).mp hcirc
  rw [hfeq]; exact hw

name: QPCF.Gamma.visits_syndetic
statement:
theorem visits_syndetic (β : ℝ) (hβ : Irrational β) (c d : ℝ)
    (hcd : c < d) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hd : d ≤ 1) :
    ∃ G : ℕ, ∀ y : ℝ, ∃ j : ℕ, j ≤ G ∧ Int.fract (y + j * β) ∈ Set.Ioo c d
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Fact ((0 : ℝ) < 1) := ⟨one_pos⟩
  classical
  
  set W : Set (AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) := (fun x : ℝ => (x : AddCircle (1 : ℝ))) '' Set.Ioo c d with hW
  have hWopen : IsOpen W :=
    QuotientAddGroup.isOpenQuotientMap_mk.isOpenMap _ isOpen_Ioo
  have hWne : W.Nonempty := ⟨_, ⟨(c + d) / 2, ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, rfl⟩⟩
  set A : ℕ → Set (AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) :=
    fun j => (fun z => z + j • (β : AddCircle (1 : ℝ))) ⁻¹' W with hA
  have hAopen : ∀ j, IsOpen (A j) := fun j => hWopen.preimage (by continuity)
  
  have hcover : (Set.univ : Set (AddCircle (1 : ℝ))) ⊆ ⋃ j : ℕ, A j := by
    intro z _
    have hdz : DenseRange (fun j : ℕ => z + j • (β : AddCircle (1 : ℝ))) :=
      ((Homeomorph.addLeft z).surjective.denseRange).comp (nat_orbit_dense β hβ)
        (Homeomorph.addLeft _).continuous
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hdz.exists_mem_open hWopen hWne
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨j, hj⟩
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := isCompact_univ.elim_finite_subcover A hAopen hcover
  rcases t.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | htne
  · exact absurd (ht (Set.mem_univ ((0 : ℝ) : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)))) (by simp)
  refine ⟨t.max' htne, fun y => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨j, hjt, hj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp (ht (Set.mem_univ ((y : ℝ) : AddCircle (1 : ℝ))))
  refine ⟨j, t.le_max' j hjt, ?_⟩
  
  have hco : ((y + j * β : ℝ) : AddCircle (1 : ℝ))
      = (y : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) + j • (β : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) := by
    rw [AddCircle.coe_add]; congr 1
    rw [← nsmul_eq_mul]; exact map_nsmul (QuotientAddGroup.mk' _) j β
  have hmemW : ((y + j * β : ℝ) : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) ∈ W := by rw [hco]; exact hj
  exact fract_mem_of_coe_mem hc hd hmemW

name: QPCF.Gamma.cell_bounded_gaps
statement:
theorem cell_bounded_gaps (c : Cell) (a : ℕ) (cc dd : ℝ)
    (ha : cellCong c.1 a) (hL : 0 < Density.congModulus c.1)
    (hcd : cc < dd) (hc0 : 0 ≤ cc) (hd1 : dd ≤ 1) (hsub : Set.Ioo cc dd ⊆ c.2) :
    ∃ G : ℕ, ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ k : ℕ, m ≤ k ∧ k ≤ m + G ∧ k ∈ cellSet c
proof:
:= by
  set L := Density.congModulus c.1 with hLdef
  have hβ : Irrational ((L : ℝ) * Real.sqrt 2) := irrational_sqrt_two.natCast_mul (by omega)
  obtain ⟨G0, hG0⟩ := visits_syndetic ((L : ℝ) * Real.sqrt 2) hβ cc dd hcd hc0 hd1
  have hcong_iff : {n : ℕ | cellCong c.1 n} = {n : ℕ | n ≡ a [MOD L]} :=
    Density.nat_multiCong_eq_class c.1 a ha
  refine ⟨(G0 + 2) * L, fun m => ?_⟩
  have hrL : a % L < L := Nat.mod_lt _ hL
  have hqle : m / L * L ≤ m := Nat.div_mul_le_self m L
  have hq2 : m < m / L * L + L := by
    have h1 := Nat.div_add_mod m L
    have h2 := Nat.mod_lt m hL
    have h3 : m / L * L = L * (m / L) := Nat.mul_comm _ _
    omega
  set b1 : ℕ := a % L + m / L * L + L with hb1
  obtain ⟨j, hjG0, hjfract⟩ := hG0 ((b1 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt 2)
  have hjL : j * L ≤ G0 * L := by gcongr
  have hexp : (G0 + 2) * L = G0 * L + 2 * L := by ring
  refine ⟨b1 + j * L, by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    have heq : b1 + j * L = a % L + (m / L + 1 + j) * L := by rw [hb1]; ring
    have hmod : a % L + (m / L + 1 + j) * L ≡ a [MOD L] := by
      unfold Nat.ModEq; simp [Nat.add_mul_mod_self_right]
    have hmem : (b1 + j * L) ∈ {n : ℕ | n ≡ a [MOD L]} := by rw [heq]; exact hmod
    rw [← hcong_iff] at hmem
    exact hmem
  · 
    show Int.fract (((b1 + j * L : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.sqrt 2) ∈ c.2
    apply hsub
    have hcast : ((b1 + j * L : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.sqrt 2
        = (b1 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt 2 + (j : ℝ) * ((L : ℝ) * Real.sqrt 2) := by push_cast; ring
    rw [hcast]; exact hjfract

name: QPCF.Gamma.beatty_normal_form
statement: theorem beatty_normal_form {S : Set ℕ} (h : BeattyCarrier S) : HasNF S
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | sturmian a b => exact hasNF_sturmian a b
  | ep h => exact hasNF_ep h
  | compl _ ih => exact hasNF_compl ih
  | union _ _ ihS ihT => exact hasNF_union ihS ihT
  | inter _ _ ihS ihT => exact hasNF_inter ihS ihT

name: QPCF.Gamma.exists_infinite_cell
statement:
theorem exists_infinite_cell (cells : List Cell) (h : (cellsUnion cells).Infinite) :
    ∃ c ∈ cells, (cellSet c).Infinite
proof:
:= by
  induction cells with
  | nil => simp only [cellsUnion, List.not_mem_nil, Set.iUnion_of_empty, Set.iUnion_empty,
      Set.infinite_coe_iff, Set.not_infinite] at h; exact absurd Set.finite_empty h
  | cons c rest ih =>
    rw [cellsUnion_cons, Set.infinite_union] at h
    rcases h with hc | hr
    · exact ⟨c, List.mem_cons_self, hc⟩
    · obtain ⟨c', hc', hc'inf⟩ := ih hr
      exact ⟨c', List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hc', hc'inf⟩

name: QPCF.Gamma.beatty_nonsquares_infinite
statement:
theorem beatty_nonsquares_infinite (S : Set ℕ) (hS : S ∈ BeattyStructure) (hinf : S.Infinite) :
    {n : ℕ | n ∈ S ∧ ¬ ∃ q, n = q ^ 2}.Infinite
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨cells, F, hIFIU, hagree⟩ := beatty_normal_form hS
  
  have hcu_inf : (cellsUnion cells).Infinite := by
    have hsub : S \ (F : Set ℕ) ⊆ cellsUnion cells := by
      intro n hn
      exact (hagree n hn.2).mp hn.1
    exact (hinf.diff F.finite_toSet).mono hsub
  obtain ⟨c, hc_mem, hc_inf⟩ := exists_infinite_cell cells hcu_inf
  have hc_IFIU := hIFIU c hc_mem
  obtain ⟨a, cc, dd, ha, hcc0, hccdd, hdd1, hsub⟩ :=
    cellSet_infinite_structure c hc_IFIU hc_inf
  
  have hclass : {n : ℕ | cellCong c.1 n} = {n : ℕ | n ≡ a [MOD Density.congModulus c.1]} :=
    Density.nat_multiCong_eq_class c.1 a ha
  have hL : 0 < Density.congModulus c.1 := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (Density.congModulus c.1) with hL0 | hLpos
    · exfalso
      have hsub' : cellSet c ⊆ {a} := by
        intro n hn
        have h1 : n ∈ {n : ℕ | cellCong c.1 n} := hn.1
        rw [hclass] at h1
        have h2 : n ≡ a [MOD Density.congModulus c.1] := h1
        rw [hL0] at h2
        have : n = a := by simpa [Nat.ModEq, Nat.mod_zero] using h2
        simpa using this
      exact hc_inf (Set.Finite.subset (Set.finite_singleton a) hsub')
    · exact hLpos
  obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ := cell_bounded_gaps c a cc dd ha hL hccdd hcc0 hdd1 hsub
  have hcell_ns := Density.boundedGaps_nonsquares_infinite (cellSet c) G hG
  
  refine (hcell_ns.diff F.finite_toSet).mono ?_
  intro n hn
  obtain ⟨⟨hnc, hnsq⟩, hnF⟩ := hn
  have hnF' : n ∉ F := by simpa using hnF
  have hnS : n ∈ S := (hagree n hnF').mpr (mem_cellsUnion.mpr ⟨c, hc_mem, hnc⟩)
  exact ⟨hnS, hnsq⟩

name: QPCF.Gamma.sqU_mem_squares_infinite

proof:
:= by

  refine (sqF_infinite _ (Filter.inter_mem hInS sqF_squares)).mono ?_

statement:

statement:

proof: := by simp [QPCF.Beta.squareSeparator, h]

name: QPCF.Gamma.realPQ_one_two_div_lt
statement: theorem realPQ_one_two_div_lt (n : ℕ) (hn : 3 ≤ n) : QPCF.realPQ 1 (2 / (n : ℝ)) < n
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.even_or_odd n with he | ho
  · obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := he
    have hm : 2 ≤ m := by omega
    have h2 : (2 : ℝ) / ((m + m : ℕ) : ℝ) = 1 / (m : ℝ) := by
      have : (0 : ℝ) < m := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < m)
      push_cast; field_simp; ring
    rw [h2, QPCF.Beta.realPQ_one_one_div_nat hm]
    have : (0 : ℝ) < m := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < m)
    push_cast; linarith
  · rw [QPCF.Beta.realPQ_one_two_div_odd_nat hn (Nat.odd_iff.mp ho)]
    have : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < n)
    linarith

name: QPCF.Gamma.squareSeparator_not_armBGamma_sqU
statement:
theorem squareSeparator_not_armBGamma_sqU :
    ¬ ArmBGamma BeattyStructure QPCF.Beta.squareSeparator sqU
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨P, Q, hQ, h⟩
  obtain ⟨S, hSmem, hflat⟩ := h 2
  refine QPCF.Beta.incompatible_square_sample_decay P Q hQ ?_
  have hsqinf := sqU_mem_squares_infinite S hSmem
  have hnsinf := sqU_mem_nonsquares_infinite S hSmem
  have hexp := @QPCF.expansion_order_of_eval_decay
  constructor
  · contrapose! hexp
    refine ⟨P * Polynomial.X - 2 * Q, Q * Polynomial.X, ?_, 2, 1,
      {n : ℕ | n ∈ S.1 ∧ QPCF.Beta.squareSeparator n = 2 / (n : ℝ)}, ?_, ?_, hexp⟩
    · simp [hQ]
    · rw [← Nat.frequently_atTop_iff_infinite] at hsqinf
      refine hsqinf.mono ?_
      rintro n ⟨hnS, hsq⟩; exact ⟨hnS, sqSep_eq_two n hsq⟩
    · filter_upwards [hflat, Filter.eventually_gt_atTop 0] with n hn hn0 hmem
      obtain ⟨hnS, hval⟩ := hmem
      obtain ⟨hQn, hbound⟩ := hn hnS
      rw [hval] at hbound
      have hnR : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn0
      have hQR : ((Q.eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hQn
      have hEq : (((P * Polynomial.X - 2 * Q).eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) /
            (((Q * Polynomial.X).eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)
          = (((P.eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) / ((Q.eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)) - 2 / (n : ℝ) := by
        simp only [Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X,
          Polynomial.eval_ofNat]
        push_cast; field_simp
      rw [hEq, show (((P.eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) / ((Q.eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)) - 2 / (n : ℝ)
            = -(2 / (n : ℝ) - ((P.eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) / ((Q.eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)) by ring,
        abs_neg, one_mul]
      exact hbound
  · contrapose! hexp
    refine ⟨P * Polynomial.X - Q, Q * Polynomial.X, ?_, 2, 1,
      {n : ℕ | n ∈ S.1 ∧ QPCF.Beta.squareSeparator n = 1 / (n : ℝ)}, ?_, ?_, hexp⟩
    · simp [hQ]
    · rw [← Nat.frequently_atTop_iff_infinite] at hnsinf
      refine hnsinf.mono ?_
      rintro n ⟨hnS, hns⟩; exact ⟨hnS, sqSep_eq_one n hns⟩
    · filter_upwards [hflat, Filter.eventually_gt_atTop 0] with n hn hn0 hmem
      obtain ⟨hnS, hval⟩ := hmem
      obtain ⟨hQn, hbound⟩ := hn hnS
      rw [hval] at hbound
      have hnR : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn0
      have hQR : ((Q.eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hQn
      have hEq : (((P * Polynomial.X - Q).eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) /
            (((Q * Polynomial.X).eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)
          = (((P.eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) / ((Q.eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)) - 1 / (n : ℝ) := by
        simp only [Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X]
        push_cast; field_simp
      rw [hEq, show (((P.eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) / ((Q.eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)) - 1 / (n : ℝ)
            = -(1 / (n : ℝ) - ((P.eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) / ((Q.eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)) by ring,
        abs_neg, one_mul]
      exact hbound

name: QPCF.Gamma.squareSeparator_not_armAGamma_sqU
statement:
theorem squareSeparator_not_armAGamma_sqU :
    ¬ ArmAGamma BeattyStructure QPCF.Beta.squareSeparator sqU 1
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨S, hSmem, p, htrack, _, _⟩
  have htrack1 := htrack 1
  have hns := sqU_mem_nonsquares_infinite S hSmem
  have hsq := sqU_mem_squares_infinite S hSmem
  have hp1X : p 1 = Polynomial.X := by
    have hfreq : ∃ᶠ (n : ℕ) in atTop, (p 1).eval (n : ℚ) = (n : ℚ) := by
      rw [← Nat.frequently_atTop_iff_infinite] at hns
      refine (hns.and_eventually (htrack1.and (Filter.eventually_ge_atTop 2))).mono ?_
      rintro n ⟨⟨hnS, hnns⟩, htr, hge2⟩
      have hsep := sqSep_eq_one n hnns
      have h1 := htr hnS
      rw [show ((1 : Fin (1 + 1)) : ℕ) = 1 from rfl, hsep,
        QPCF.Beta.realPQ_one_one_div_nat hge2] at h1
      have : (((p 1).eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) = (n : ℝ) := h1.symm
      exact_mod_cast this
    have hinf : Set.Infinite {x : ℚ | (p 1).eval x = (Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℚ).eval x} := by
      have hnat : Set.Infinite {n : ℕ | (p 1).eval (n : ℚ) = (n : ℚ)} :=
        Nat.frequently_atTop_iff_infinite.mp hfreq
      have himg := hnat.image (f := (Nat.cast : ℕ → ℚ)) (Set.injOn_of_injective Nat.cast_injective)
      refine himg.mono ?_
      rintro x ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩; simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hn ⊢; rw [hn]; simp
    by_contra hne
    exact hinf (Set.Finite.subset ((p 1 - Polynomial.X).roots.toFinset.finite_toSet)
      (fun x hx => by
        simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hx
        simp only [Multiset.mem_toFinset, Finset.mem_coe]
        rw [Polynomial.mem_roots (sub_ne_zero.mpr hne)]; simp [hx]))
  rw [← Nat.frequently_atTop_iff_infinite] at hsq
  obtain ⟨n, ⟨hnS, hnsq⟩, htr, hge3⟩ :=
    (hsq.and_eventually (htrack1.and (Filter.eventually_ge_atTop 3))).exists
  have hsep := sqSep_eq_two n hnsq
  have h1 := htr hnS
  rw [show ((1 : Fin (1 + 1)) : ℕ) = 1 from rfl, hsep, hp1X] at h1
  simp only [Polynomial.eval_X] at h1
  have hval : QPCF.realPQ 1 (2 / (n : ℝ)) = (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h1
  have hlt := realPQ_one_two_div_lt n hge3
  rw [hval] at hlt
  exact lt_irrefl _ hlt

statement:
