proof:
:= by
  simp [cellsUnion]

name: QPCF.Gamma.cellSet_combine
statement:
theorem cellSet_combine (c₁ c₂ : Cell) :
    cellSet (c₁.1 ++ c₂.1, c₁.2 ∩ c₂.2) = cellSet c₁ ∩ cellSet c₂
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  simp [cellSet, cellCong, Set.mem_inter_iff]
  simp only [or_imp]
  simp only [and_imp, forall_and]
  tauto

name: QPCF.Gamma.cells_inter
statement:
theorem cells_inter (cs ds : List Cell)
    (hcs : ∀ c ∈ cs, IsFiniteIcoUnion c.2) (hds : ∀ c ∈ ds, IsFiniteIcoUnion c.2) :
    ∃ ps : List Cell, (∀ c ∈ ps, IsFiniteIcoUnion c.2) ∧
      cellsUnion cs ∩ cellsUnion ds = cellsUnion ps
proof:
:= by
  
  let ps := ds.flatMap (fun d => cs.map (fun c => (c.1 ++ d.1, c.2 ∩ d.2)))
  use ps
  constructor
  · 
    intro c hc
    simp only [ps] at hc
    rw [List.mem_flatMap] at hc
    obtain ⟨d, hd, hd'⟩ := hc
    rw [List.mem_map] at hd'
    obtain ⟨e, he, rfl⟩ := hd'
    exact isFiniteIcoUnion_inter (hcs e he) (hds d hd)
  · 
    simp only [cellsUnion]
    ext n
    simp_rw [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_iUnion]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨c, hc, hnc⟩, ⟨d, hd, hnd⟩⟩
      refine ⟨(c.1 ++ d.1, c.2 ∩ d.2), ?_, (cellSet_combine c d).symm ▸ ⟨hnc, hnd⟩⟩
      show (c.1 ++ d.1, c.2 ∩ d.2) ∈ ds.flatMap (fun d => cs.map (fun c => (c.1 ++ d.1, c.2 ∩ d.2)))
      simp_rw [List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_map]
      exact ⟨d, hd, c, hc, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨e, he, hne⟩
      rw [List.mem_flatMap] at he
      obtain ⟨d, hd, hd'⟩ := he
      simp_rw [List.mem_map] at hd'
      obtain ⟨c, hc, hc'⟩ := hd'
      rw [← hc'] at hne
      rw [cellSet_combine c d] at hne
      exact ⟨⟨c, hc, hne.1⟩, ⟨d, hd, hne.2⟩⟩

name: QPCF.Gamma.fract_notMem_as_cell
statement:
theorem fract_notMem_as_cell (U : Set ℝ) (hU : IsFiniteIcoUnion U) :
    ∃ d : Cell, IsFiniteIcoUnion d.2 ∧
      {n : ℕ | Int.fract ((n : ℝ) * Real.sqrt 2) ∉ U} = cellSet d
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hVU⟩ := isFiniteIcoUnion_compl01 hU
  refine ⟨(([] : List (ℕ × ℕ)), V), hV, ?_⟩
  ext n
  simp only [cellSet, cellCong, List.not_mem_nil, IsEmpty.forall_iff, forall_const,
    Set.mem_setOf_eq, true_and]
  have hb : Int.fract ((n : ℝ) * Real.sqrt 2) ∈ Set.Ico (0:ℝ) 1 :=
    ⟨Int.fract_nonneg _, Int.fract_lt_one _⟩
  exact (hVU _ hb).symm

name: QPCF.Gamma.cong_compl_cells
statement:
theorem cong_compl_cells (p : ℕ × ℕ) :
    ∃ (ds : List Cell) (F : Finset ℕ), (∀ d ∈ ds, IsFiniteIcoUnion d.2) ∧
      ∀ n, n ∉ F → (¬ (n ≡ p.2 [MOD p.1]) ↔ n ∈ cellsUnion ds)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, r⟩ := p
  
  
  have hcellmem : ∀ (s n : ℕ),
      n ∈ cellSet (([(D, s)] : List (ℕ × ℕ)), Set.Ico (0:ℝ) 1) ↔ n ≡ s [MOD D] := by
    intro s n
    simp only [cellSet, cellCong, List.mem_singleton, forall_eq, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    exact ⟨fun h => h.1, fun h => ⟨h, ⟨Int.fract_nonneg _, Int.fract_lt_one _⟩⟩⟩
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos D with hD0 | hD
  · 
    
    subst hD0
    refine ⟨[(([] : List (ℕ × ℕ)), Set.Ico (0:ℝ) 1)], {r}, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro d hd
      simp only [List.mem_singleton] at hd; subst hd; exact isFiniteIcoUnion_Ico01
    · intro n hn
      simp only [Finset.mem_singleton] at hn
      rw [mem_cellsUnion]
      constructor
      · intro _
        exact ⟨(([] : List (ℕ × ℕ)), Set.Ico (0:ℝ) 1), List.mem_singleton.mpr rfl,
          ⟨by intro q hq; simp at hq, ⟨Int.fract_nonneg _, Int.fract_lt_one _⟩⟩⟩
      · intro _ hmod
        exact hn (by simpa [Nat.ModEq, Nat.mod_zero] using hmod)
  · 
    
    refine ⟨((List.range D).filter (fun s => decide (s ≠ r % D))).map
        (fun s => (([(D, s)] : List (ℕ × ℕ)), Set.Ico (0:ℝ) 1)), ∅, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro d hd
      rw [List.mem_map] at hd
      obtain ⟨s, _, rfl⟩ := hd
      exact isFiniteIcoUnion_Ico01
    · intro n _
      rw [mem_cellsUnion]
      constructor
      · intro h
        refine ⟨(([(D, n % D)] : List (ℕ × ℕ)), Set.Ico (0:ℝ) 1), ?_,
          (hcellmem _ n).mpr (Nat.mod_modEq n D).symm⟩
        simp only [List.mem_map, List.mem_filter, List.mem_range, decide_eq_true_eq]
        refine ⟨n % D, ⟨Nat.mod_lt n hD, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
        intro he; exact h he
      · rintro ⟨c, hc, hnc⟩
        simp only [List.mem_map, List.mem_filter, List.mem_range, decide_eq_true_eq] at hc
        obtain ⟨s, ⟨hsD, hsr⟩, rfl⟩ := hc
        have hns : n ≡ s [MOD D] := (hcellmem s n).mp hnc
        intro hnr
        apply hsr
        have hsrr : s % D = r % D := by rw [← hns]; exact hnr
        rwa [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hsD] at hsrr

name: QPCF.Gamma.cellCong_compl_cells
statement:
theorem cellCong_compl_cells (congs : List (ℕ × ℕ)) :
    ∃ (ds : List Cell) (F : Finset ℕ), (∀ d ∈ ds, IsFiniteIcoUnion d.2) ∧
      ∀ n, n ∉ F → (¬ cellCong congs n ↔ n ∈ cellsUnion ds)
proof:
:= by
  induction congs with
  | nil =>
    refine ⟨[], ∅, by simp, ?_⟩
    intro n _
    simp [cellCong, cellsUnion]
  | cons p rest ih =>
    obtain ⟨dr, Fr, hdr, hdreq⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨dp, Fp, hdp, hdpeq⟩ := cong_compl_cells p
    refine ⟨dp ++ dr, Fp ∪ Fr, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro d hd; rw [List.mem_append] at hd
      rcases hd with h | h
      · exact hdp d h
      · exact hdr d h
    · intro n hn
      rw [Finset.mem_union] at hn
      have hnp : n ∉ Fp := fun h => hn (Or.inl h)
      have hnr : n ∉ Fr := fun h => hn (Or.inr h)
      have hcong : cellCong (p :: rest) n ↔ (n ≡ p.2 [MOD p.1]) ∧ cellCong rest n := by
        simp only [cellCong, List.mem_cons, forall_eq_or_imp]
      rw [hcong, not_and_or, hdpeq n hnp, hdreq n hnr]
      simp only [cellsUnion, mem_iUnion, List.mem_append]
      constructor
      · rintro (⟨d, hd, hnd⟩ | ⟨d, hd, hnd⟩)
        · exact ⟨d, Or.inl hd, hnd⟩
        · exact ⟨d, Or.inr hd, hnd⟩
      · rintro ⟨d, hd, hnd⟩
        rcases hd with h | h
        · exact Or.inl ⟨d, h, hnd⟩
        · exact Or.inr ⟨d, h, hnd⟩

name: QPCF.Gamma.single_cell_compl
statement:
theorem single_cell_compl (c : Cell) (hc : IsFiniteIcoUnion c.2) :
    ∃ (ds : List Cell) (F : Finset ℕ), (∀ d ∈ ds, IsFiniteIcoUnion d.2) ∧
      ∀ n, n ∉ F → (n ∈ (cellSet c)ᶜ ↔ n ∈ cellsUnion ds)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨dcong, Fcong, hdcong, hdcongeq⟩ := cellCong_compl_cells c.1
  obtain ⟨dU, hdU, hdUeq⟩ := fract_notMem_as_cell c.2 hc
  refine ⟨dcong ++ [dU], Fcong, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro d hd; rw [List.mem_append] at hd
    rcases hd with h | h
    · exact hdcong d h
    · simp only [List.mem_singleton] at h; subst h; exact hdU
  · intro n hn
    have hUmem : (Int.fract ((n : ℝ) * Real.sqrt 2) ∉ c.2) ↔ n ∈ cellSet dU :=
      Set.ext_iff.mp hdUeq n
    rw [Set.mem_compl_iff]
    simp only [cellSet, Set.mem_setOf_eq, not_and_or]
    rw [hdcongeq n hn, hUmem]
    simp only [cellsUnion, mem_iUnion, List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton]
    constructor
    · rintro (⟨d, hd, hnd⟩ | h)
      · exact ⟨d, Or.inl hd, hnd⟩
      · exact ⟨dU, Or.inr rfl, h⟩
    · rintro ⟨d, hd, hnd⟩
      rcases hd with h | rfl
      · exact Or.inl ⟨d, h, hnd⟩
      · exact Or.inr hnd

name: QPCF.Gamma.cellsUnion_cons
statement:
theorem cellsUnion_cons (c : Cell) (cs : List Cell) :
    cellsUnion (c :: cs) = cellSet c ∪ cellsUnion cs
proof:
:= by
  ext n; simp only [cellsUnion, Set.mem_iUnion, List.mem_cons, Set.mem_union]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨d, (rfl | hd), hnd⟩
    · exact Or.inl hnd
    · exact Or.inr ⟨d, hd, hnd⟩
  · rintro (h | ⟨d, hd, hnd⟩)
    · exact ⟨c, Or.inl rfl, h⟩
    · exact ⟨d, Or.inr hd, hnd⟩

name: QPCF.Gamma.cellSet_Ico01_univ
statement: theorem cellSet_Ico01_univ : cellSet (([] : List (ℕ × ℕ)), Set.Ico (0:ℝ) 1) = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  simp only [cellSet, cellCong, List.not_mem_nil, IsEmpty.forall_iff, forall_const,
    Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_univ, iff_true, true_and]
  exact ⟨Int.fract_nonneg _, Int.fract_lt_one _⟩

name: QPCF.Gamma.cells_compl
statement:
theorem cells_compl (cs : List Cell) (hcs : ∀ c ∈ cs, IsFiniteIcoUnion c.2) :
    ∃ (ds : List Cell) (F : Finset ℕ), (∀ d ∈ ds, IsFiniteIcoUnion d.2) ∧
      ∀ n, n ∉ F → (n ∈ (cellsUnion cs)ᶜ ↔ n ∈ cellsUnion ds)
proof:
:= by
  induction cs with
  | nil =>
    refine ⟨[(([] : List (ℕ × ℕ)), Set.Ico (0:ℝ) 1)], ∅, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro d hd
      simp only [List.mem_singleton] at hd; subst hd; exact isFiniteIcoUnion_Ico01
    · intro n _
      rw [cellsUnion_cons, cellSet_Ico01_univ]
      simp [cellsUnion]
  | cons c rest ih =>
    obtain ⟨dr, Fr, hdr, hdreq⟩ := ih (fun d hd => hcs d (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hd))
    obtain ⟨dc, Fc, hdc, hdceq⟩ := single_cell_compl c (hcs c List.mem_cons_self)
    obtain ⟨ps, hps, hpseq⟩ := cells_inter dc dr hdc hdr
    refine ⟨ps, Fc ∪ Fr, hps, ?_⟩
    intro n hn
    rw [Finset.mem_union] at hn
    have hnc : n ∉ Fc := fun h => hn (Or.inl h)
    have hnr : n ∉ Fr := fun h => hn (Or.inr h)
    rw [cellsUnion_cons, Set.compl_union, Set.mem_inter_iff, hdceq n hnc, hdreq n hnr]
    have hx := Set.ext_iff.mp hpseq n
    rw [Set.mem_inter_iff] at hx
    exact hx

name: QPCF.Gamma.hasNF_union
statement: theorem hasNF_union {S T : Set ℕ} (hS : HasNF S) (hT : HasNF T) : HasNF (S ∪ T)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨cells_S, F_S, hcells_S, hS_equiv⟩ := hS
  obtain ⟨cells_T, F_T, hcells_T, hT_equiv⟩ := hT
  use cells_S ++ cells_T, F_S ∪ F_T
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro c hc
    rw [List.mem_append] at hc
    cases hc with
    | inl h => exact hcells_S c h
    | inr h => exact hcells_T c h
  · 
    intro n hn
    simp only [Set.mem_union]
    rw [Finset.mem_union] at hn
    have hnS : n ∉ F_S := fun h => hn (Or.inl h)
    have hnT : n ∉ F_T := fun h => hn (Or.inr h)
    rw [hS_equiv n hnS, hT_equiv n hnT]
    simp only [cellsUnion, mem_iUnion, List.mem_append]
    constructor
    · rintro (⟨i, hi, hni⟩ | ⟨i, hi, hni⟩)
      · exact ⟨i, Or.inl hi, hni⟩
      · exact ⟨i, Or.inr hi, hni⟩
    · rintro ⟨i, hi, hni⟩; cases hi with
      | inl h => left; exact ⟨i, h, hni⟩
      | inr h => right; exact ⟨i, h, hni⟩

name: QPCF.Gamma.hasNF_inter
statement: theorem hasNF_inter {S T : Set ℕ} (hS : HasNF S) (hT : HasNF T) : HasNF (S ∩ T)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨cS, FS, hcS, hSeq⟩ := hS
  obtain ⟨cT, FT, hcT, hTeq⟩ := hT
  obtain ⟨ps, hps, hpseq⟩ := cells_inter cS cT hcS hcT
  refine ⟨ps, FS ∪ FT, hps, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  rw [Finset.mem_union] at hn
  have hnS : n ∉ FS := fun h => hn (Or.inl h)
  have hnT : n ∉ FT := fun h => hn (Or.inr h)
  rw [Set.mem_inter_iff, hSeq n hnS, hTeq n hnT]
  have hx := Set.ext_iff.mp hpseq n
  rw [Set.mem_inter_iff] at hx
  exact hx

name: QPCF.Gamma.hasNF_compl
statement: theorem hasNF_compl {S : Set ℕ} (hS : HasNF S) : HasNF Sᶜ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨cs, F, hcs, hSeq⟩ := hS
  obtain ⟨ds, F', hds, hdseq⟩ := cells_compl cs hcs
  refine ⟨ds, F ∪ F', hds, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  rw [Finset.mem_union] at hn
  have hnF : n ∉ F := fun h => hn (Or.inl h)
  have hnF' : n ∉ F' := fun h => hn (Or.inr h)
  rw [Set.mem_compl_iff, hSeq n hnF]
  have hx := hdseq n hnF'
  rw [Set.mem_compl_iff] at hx
  exact hx

name: QPCF.Gamma.hasNF_sturmian
statement:
theorem hasNF_sturmian (a b : ℚ) :
    HasNF {n : ℕ | Int.fract ((n : ℝ) * Real.sqrt 2) ∈ Set.Ico (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ)}
proof:
:= by
  
  refine ⟨[(∅, Set.Ico (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ))], ∅, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    simp
    exact ⟨[((a : ℝ), (b : ℝ))], by simp⟩
  · 
    simp [cellsUnion, cellSet, cellCong]

name: QPCF.Gamma.hasNF_ep
statement: theorem hasNF_ep {S : Set ℕ} (h : EventuallyPeriodic S) : HasNF S
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨χ, hS, N, p, hp, hperiod⟩ := h
  
  
  let residueInS : ℕ → Bool := fun r => χ (N + (r + p - N % p) % p)
  
  let residues : List ℕ := List.range p |>.filter (fun r => residueInS r = true)
  
  let cells : List Cell := residues.map (fun r => ([(p, r)], Set.Ico 0 1))
  use cells
  use Finset.range N
  constructor
  · 
    intro c hc
    simp [cells] at hc
    obtain ⟨r, _, rfl⟩ := hc
    exact isFiniteIcoUnion_Ico01
  · 
    intro n hn
    simp [Finset.mem_range] at hn
    rw [hS]
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    
    have hχ_eq : χ n = χ (N + (n - N) % p) := by
      have hex : n = N + (n - N) % p + p * ((n - N) / p) := by
        have := Nat.div_add_mod (n - N) p
        omega
      have help : ∀ k, χ (N + (n - N) % p + p * k) = χ (N + (n - N) % p) := by
        intro k
        induction k with
        | zero => simp
        | succ k ih =>
          have hge : N ≤ N + (n - N) % p + p * k := by nlinarith [Nat.zero_le ((n - N) % p), Nat.zero_le k]
          rw [show N + (n - N) % p + p * (k + 1) = (N + (n - N) % p + p * k) + p by ring, hperiod _ hge]
          exact ih
      conv_lhs => rw [hex, help]
    
    have hmod : n % p = (N + (n - N) % p) % p := by
      conv_lhs => rw [show n = N + (n - N) by omega]
      rw [Nat.add_mod]
      simp [Nat.mod_mod]
    
    rw [hχ_eq]
    
    
    
    
    
    have hcells : n ∈ cellsUnion cells ↔ n % p ∈ residues := by
      rw [mem_cellsUnion]
      
      
      simp only [cells, List.mem_map]
      constructor
      · 
        intro ⟨c, hc, hnc⟩
        obtain ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩ := hc
        
        rw [cellSet] at hnc
        obtain ⟨hcong, _⟩ := hnc
        
        simp [cellCong] at hcong
        
        rw [Nat.ModEq] at hcong
        
        have hr_lt : r < p := by
          have := List.mem_filter.mp hr
          exact List.mem_range.mp this.1
        rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hr_lt] at hcong
        exact hcong ▸ hr
      · 
        intro hn_res
        use (([(p, n % p)]), Set.Ico 0 1)
        constructor
        · exact ⟨n % p, hn_res, rfl⟩
        · rw [cellSet]
          constructor
          · simp [cellCong]
            exact (Nat.mod_modEq n p).symm
          · 
            exact Set.mem_Ico.mpr ⟨Int.fract_nonneg _, Int.fract_lt_one _⟩
    rw [hcells]
    
    
    have hkey : N + (n - N) % p = N + ((n % p) + p - N % p) % p := by
      congr 1
      
      have hr : n % p < p := Nat.mod_lt _ hp
      have hb : N % p < p := Nat.mod_lt _ hp
      have hnN : n - N = p * (n / p) + n % p - (p * (N / p) + N % p) := by
        rw [Nat.div_add_mod n p, Nat.div_add_mod N p]
      
      
      
      have h1 : (n - N) % p = (n % p + p - N % p) % p := by
        rw [hmod]
        set r := (n - N) % p with hr_def
        have hr_lt : r < p := Nat.mod_lt _ hp
        rw [Nat.add_mod]
        simp only [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hr_lt]
        by_cases h : N % p + r < p
        · 
          rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h]
          have : N % p + r + p - N % p = r + p := by omega
          rw [this, Nat.add_mod]
          simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hr_lt]
        · 
          have h2 : N % p + r < 2 * p := by omega
          have h3 : N % p + r - p < p := by omega
          have hle : p ≤ N % p + r := by omega
          have h4 : (N % p + r) % p = (N % p + r - p) % p := Nat.mod_eq_sub_mod hle
          have h5 : (N % p + r - p) % p = N % p + r - p := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h3
          rw [h4, h5]
          have heq : N % p + r - p + p - N % p = r := by omega
          rw [heq, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hr_lt]
      exact h1
    rw [hkey]
    
    
    
    have hr : n % p < p := Nat.mod_lt _ hp
    simp only [residues, List.mem_filter, List.mem_range, residueInS]
    simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact ⟨hr, h⟩
    · intro ⟨hr', hχ⟩
      exact hχ

name: QPCF.Gamma.cellSet_infinite_structure
statement:
theorem cellSet_infinite_structure (c : Cell) (hc : IsFiniteIcoUnion c.2)
    (hinf : (cellSet c).Infinite) :
    ∃ (a : ℕ) (cc dd : ℝ),
      cellCong c.1 a ∧ 0 ≤ cc ∧ cc < dd ∧ dd ≤ 1 ∧ Set.Ioo cc dd ⊆ c.2
proof:
:= by
  
  have hne : (cellSet c).Nonempty := hinf.nonempty
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hne
  
  have hcong : cellCong c.1 n := hn.1
  
  have hfrac_mem : Int.fract ((n : ℝ) * Real.sqrt 2) ∈ c.2 := hn.2
  have hfrac_bounds : Int.fract ((n : ℝ) * Real.sqrt 2) ∈ Set.Ico 0 1 := ⟨Int.fract_nonneg _, Int.fract_lt_one _⟩
  
  
  have h_inf : (cellSet c).Infinite := hinf
  have : ∃ m ∈ cellSet c, m > 0 := by
    by_contra hall
    push_neg at hall
    have hsub : cellSet c ⊆ {0} := by
      intro m hm
      exact Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (hall m hm)
    have : (cellSet c).Finite := Set.Finite.subset (Set.finite_singleton 0) hsub
    exact h_inf this
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hm_pos⟩ := this
  
  have hcong_m : cellCong c.1 m := hm.1
  have hfrac_mem_m : Int.fract ((m : ℝ) * Real.sqrt 2) ∈ c.2 := hm.2
  have hfrac_upper : Int.fract ((m : ℝ) * Real.sqrt 2) < 1 := Int.fract_lt_one _
  have hfrac_pos : Int.fract ((m : ℝ) * Real.sqrt 2) > 0 := by
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    have hzero : Int.fract ((m : ℝ) * Real.sqrt 2) = 0 := le_antisymm h (Int.fract_nonneg _)
    rw [Int.fract_eq_iff] at hzero
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hzero.2.2
    
    have hrat : ∃ q : ℚ, Real.sqrt 2 = q := by
      use k / m
      rw [show (↑k / ↑m : ℚ) = (k : ℝ) / m by simp]
      rw [eq_div_iff (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hm_pos.ne')]
      rw [sub_zero] at hk
      linarith [hk]
    exact irrational_sqrt_two ⟨hrat.choose, hrat.choose_spec.symm⟩
  
  have hne_Ioo : (c.2 ∩ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1).Nonempty := ⟨Int.fract ((m : ℝ) * Real.sqrt 2), hfrac_mem_m, ⟨hfrac_pos, hfrac_upper⟩⟩
  
  obtain ⟨cc, dd, hcc, hcd, hdd, hsub⟩ := isFiniteIcoUnion_contains_Ioo hc hne_Ioo
  refine ⟨m, cc, dd, hcong_m, hcc, hcd, hdd, hsub⟩

name: QPCF.Gamma.gamma_admissible_germ_governs
statement:
theorem gamma_admissible_germ_governs
    (a : ℕ → ℝ) (U : gammaRemainder B) (g : ℚ⸨X⸩)
    (hg : GammaAdmissibleGerm B a U g) : GovAtGamma B U g a
proof:
:= by
  rcases hg with ⟨P, Q, hQ, hflat, rfl⟩ | ⟨hA, hC, hg⟩
  · exact gamma2_engine_armB_germ B a U P Q hQ hflat
  · exact hg

name: QPCF.Gamma.gammaGermValue_admissible
statement:
theorem gammaGermValue_admissible (a : ℕ → ℝ) (U : gammaRemainder B)
    (h : ResolvedGamma B a U) :
    GammaAdmissibleGerm B a U (gammaGermValue B a U h)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold gammaGermValue
  split_ifs with hB
  · left
    exact ⟨Classical.choose hB, Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec hB),
      (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec hB)).1,
      (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec hB)).2, rfl⟩
  · right
    exact ⟨(Or.resolve_left h hB).1, (Or.resolve_left h hB).2,
      Classical.choose_spec (gamma2_engine_armA_germ B a U
        (Or.resolve_left h hB).1 (Or.resolve_left h hB).2)⟩

name: QPCF.Gamma.Density.isFiniteIcoUnion_union
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L₁, hL₁⟩ := hU
  obtain ⟨L₂, hL₂⟩ := hV
  refine ⟨L₁ ++ L₂, ?_⟩
  rw [hL₁, hL₂]
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_iUnion, List.mem_append]
  constructor
  · rintro (⟨i, hi, hx⟩ | ⟨i, hi, hx⟩)
    · exact ⟨i, Or.inl hi, hx⟩
    · exact ⟨i, Or.inr hi, hx⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, hi, hx⟩
    exact hi.elim (fun h => Or.inl ⟨i, h, hx⟩) (fun h => Or.inr ⟨i, h, hx⟩)

name: QPCF.Gamma.Density.isFiniteIcoUnion_inter
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨LU, hLU⟩ := hU
  obtain ⟨LV, hLV⟩ := hV
  
  let pairs := LU.product LV |>.map (fun ⟨p, q⟩ => (max p.1 q.1, min p.2 q.2))
  use pairs
  rw [hLU, hLV]
  trans (⋃ p ∈ LU, ⋃ q ∈ LV, (Ico p.1 p.2 ∩ Ico q.1 q.2))
  · ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_inter_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨p, hp, hxp⟩, ⟨q, hq, hxq⟩⟩
      exact ⟨p, hp, q, hq, ⟨hxp, hxq⟩⟩
    · rintro ⟨p, hp, q, hq, ⟨hxp, hxq⟩⟩
      exact ⟨⟨p, hp, hxp⟩, ⟨q, hq, hxq⟩⟩
  · simp_rw [Set.Ico_inter_Ico]
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, pairs]
    simp only [List.mem_map]
    aesop

name: QPCF.Gamma.Density.isFiniteIcoUnion_compl01
statement:
theorem isFiniteIcoUnion_compl01 {U : Set ℝ} (hU : IsFiniteIcoUnion U) :
    ∃ V, IsFiniteIcoUnion V ∧ ∀ x ∈ Set.Ico (0:ℝ) 1, (x ∈ V ↔ x ∉ U)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := hU
  subst hL
  induction L with
  | nil =>
    use Set.Ico 0 1
    refine ⟨⟨[(0, 1)], by simp⟩, ?_⟩
    simp
  | cons p L' ih =>
    
    
    
    obtain ⟨V₂, hV₂_finite, hV₂⟩ := ih
    
    
    
    let W : Set ℝ := Set.Ico (0:ℝ) 1 \ Set.Ico p.1 p.2
    
    have hW : W = {x | x ∈ Set.Ico 0 1 ∧ x ∉ Set.Ico p.1 p.2} := by
      ext x
      rfl
    
    
    let intervals : List (ℝ × ℝ) := [
      (0, min p.1 1),
      (max p.2 0, 1)
    ]
    have hW_eq : W = ⋃ q ∈ intervals, Set.Ico q.1 q.2 := by
      apply Set.ext
      intro x
      show x ∈ Set.Ico (0:ℝ) 1 \ Set.Ico p.1 p.2 ↔ x ∈ ⋃ q ∈ [(0, min p.1 1), (max p.2 0, 1)], Set.Ico q.1 q.2
      rw [Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_iUnion]
      simp [List.mem_cons, Set.mem_Ico]
      constructor
      · intro ⟨⟨h0, h1⟩, hxp⟩
        by_cases h : x < p.1
        · refine ⟨0, h0, min p.1 1, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, lt_min h h1⟩
        · have hp1 : p.1 ≤ x := not_lt.mp h
          have hp2 : p.2 ≤ x := hxp hp1
          refine ⟨max p.2 0, max_le hp2 h0, 1, Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, h1⟩
      · intro h
        obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hcase, hb'⟩ := h
        rcases hcase with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        · exact ⟨⟨ha, hb'.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)⟩, fun hp1 => False.elim (hb'.not_ge (min_le_left _ _ |>.trans hp1))⟩
        · have : p.2 ≤ x := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) ha
          exact ⟨⟨ha.trans' (le_max_right _ _), hb'⟩, fun _ => this⟩
    have hW_finite : IsFiniteIcoUnion W := ⟨intervals, hW_eq⟩
    
    use W ∩ V₂
    refine ⟨isFiniteIcoUnion_inter hW_finite hV₂_finite, ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    rw [Set.mem_inter_iff, hW, hV₂ x hx]
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, List.mem_cons]
    push_neg
    simp only [Set.mem_Ico]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨⟨h0, h1⟩, hp⟩, hL'⟩ i hi
      rcases hi with rfl | hi
      · exact hp
      · exact hL' i hi
    · rintro h
      refine ⟨⟨⟨hx.1, hx.2⟩, h p (Or.inl rfl)⟩, ?_⟩
      intro i hi
      exact h i (Or.inr hi)

name: QPCF.Gamma.Density.isFiniteIcoUnion_Ico01
statement: theorem isFiniteIcoUnion_Ico01 : IsFiniteIcoUnion (Set.Ico (0:ℝ) 1)

name: QPCF.Gamma.Density.isFiniteIcoUnion_contains_Ioo
statement:
theorem isFiniteIcoUnion_contains_Ioo {U : Set ℝ} (hU : IsFiniteIcoUnion U)
    (hne : (U ∩ Set.Ioo (0:ℝ) 1).Nonempty) :
    ∃ c d : ℝ, 0 ≤ c ∧ c < d ∧ d ≤ 1 ∧ Set.Ioo c d ⊆ U
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hne
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := hU
  rw [hL] at hx
  simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff] at hx
  have hx1 := hx.1
  have hx2 : x ∈ Set.Ioo (0:ℝ) 1 := hx.2
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, mem_sep_iff] at hx1
  obtain ⟨p, hpL, hpx⟩ := hx1
  
  
  have hx_bounds : p.1 ≤ x ∧ x < p.2 := hpx
  have hx'_bounds : (0 : ℝ) < x ∧ x < 1 := hx2
  
  set c := max 0 p.1 with hc_def
  set d := min 1 p.2 with hd_def
  use c, d
  refine ⟨le_max_left _ _, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    refine max_lt (lt_min ?_ ?_) (lt_min ?_ ?_) <;> linarith [hx_bounds.1, hx_bounds.2, hx'_bounds.1, hx'_bounds.2]
  · 
    exact min_le_left _ _
  · 
    rw [hL]
    intro y hy
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, mem_sep_iff]
    refine ⟨p, hpL, ?_⟩
    rw [Set.mem_Ioo] at hy
    rw [Set.mem_Ico]
    rw [hc_def, hd_def] at hy
    rw [max_lt_iff] at hy
    rw [lt_min_iff] at hy
    obtain ⟨hy1, hy2⟩ := hy
    constructor <;> linarith [hx_bounds.1, hx_bounds.2, hx'_bounds.1, hx'_bounds.2]

name: QPCF.Gamma.Density.nat_multiCong_eq_class
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  constructor
  · intro hn
    
    have hna_all : ∀ p ∈ congs, n ≡ a [MOD p.1] := by
      intro p hp
      exact (hn p hp).trans (ha p hp).symm
    
    unfold congModulus
    have hdvd_lcm : ∀ (xs : List ℕ) (x : ℕ), x ∈ xs → x ∣ xs.foldr Nat.lcm 1 := by
      intro xs x hx
      induction xs generalizing x with
      | nil => simp at hx
      | cons hd tl ih =>
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with h | h
        · subst h; simp [List.foldr]; exact Nat.dvd_lcm_left _ _
        · simp [List.foldr]; exact Nat.dvd_trans (ih x h) (Nat.dvd_lcm_right _ _)
    unfold Nat.ModEq at *
    
    
    
    let moduli := congs.map Prod.fst
    have h_moduli : ∀ m ∈ moduli, n % m = a % m := by
      intro m hm
      simp only [moduli] at hm
      obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hm
      exact hna_all p hp
    
    have lcm_modEq : ∀ m k n a, n % m = a % m → n % k = a % k → n % Nat.lcm m k = a % Nat.lcm m k := by
      intro m k n a hnm hak
      
      have hn_int : (m : ℤ) ∣ (n : ℤ) - (a : ℤ) := by
        by_cases hm : m = 0
        · simp [hm] at hnm ⊢; omega
        · have h1 : (n : ℤ) % m = (n % m : ℕ) := by simp
          have h2 : (a : ℤ) % m = (a % m : ℕ) := by simp
          have h3 : (n : ℤ) / m = (n / m : ℕ) := by simp
          have h4 : (a : ℤ) / m = (a / m : ℕ) := by simp
          rw [Int.dvd_iff_emod_eq_zero, Int.sub_emod, h1, h2, hnm]
          simp
      have hk_int : (k : ℤ) ∣ (n : ℤ) - (a : ℤ) := by
        by_cases hk : k = 0
        · simp [hk] at hak ⊢; omega
        · have h1 : (n : ℤ) % k = (n % k : ℕ) := by simp
          have h2 : (a : ℤ) % k = (a % k : ℕ) := by simp
          rw [Int.dvd_iff_emod_eq_zero, Int.sub_emod, h1, h2, hak]
          simp
      have hlcm_int : (Nat.lcm m k : ℤ) ∣ (n : ℤ) - (a : ℤ) := by
        have hn_abs : (m : ℤ) ∣ Int.natAbs ((n : ℤ) - (a : ℤ)) := by simpa using hn_int
        have hk_abs : (k : ℤ) ∣ Int.natAbs ((n : ℤ) - (a : ℤ)) := by simpa using hk_int
        have hlcm_dvd : Int.lcm (m : ℤ) k ∣ Int.natAbs ((n : ℤ) - (a : ℤ)) := Int.lcm_dvd hn_abs hk_abs
        simpa [Int.natCast_dvd] using hlcm_dvd
      by_cases hlcm : Nat.lcm m k = 0
      · simp [hlcm] at hlcm_int ⊢; omega
      · have hlcm_pos : 0 < Nat.lcm m k := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hlcm
        exact Nat.modEq_of_dvd (by simpa [Int.ofNat_sub] using hlcm_int.neg_right)
    
    have foldr_modEq : ∀ (xs : List ℕ), (∀ m ∈ xs, n % m = a % m) → n % xs.foldr Nat.lcm 1 = a % xs.foldr Nat.lcm 1 := by
      intro xs
      induction xs with
      | nil => simp [Nat.mod_one]
      | cons hd tl ih =>
        intro hxs
        have h_hd : n % hd = a % hd := hxs hd (by simp)
        have h_tl : ∀ m ∈ tl, n % m = a % m := fun m hm => hxs m (by simp [hm])
        have ih' := ih h_tl
        rw [List.foldr]
        exact lcm_modEq hd (tl.foldr Nat.lcm 1) n a h_hd ih'
    exact foldr_modEq moduli h_moduli
  · intro hn p hp
    have hdvd : p.1 ∣ congModulus congs := by
      unfold congModulus
      have hdvd_lcm : ∀ (xs : List ℕ) (x : ℕ), x ∈ xs → x ∣ xs.foldr Nat.lcm 1 := by
        intro xs x hx
        induction xs generalizing x with
        | nil => simp at hx
        | cons hd tl ih =>
          rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with h | h
          · subst h; simp [List.foldr]; exact Nat.dvd_lcm_left _ _
          · simp [List.foldr]; exact Nat.dvd_trans (ih x h) (Nat.dvd_lcm_right _ _)
      exact hdvd_lcm _ _ (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩)
    have hna : n ≡ a [MOD p.1] := Nat.ModEq.of_dvd hdvd hn
    have haj : a ≡ p.2 [MOD p.1] := ha p hp
    exact hna.trans haj

name: QPCF.Gamma.Density.not_isSquare_of_between
statement:
theorem not_isSquare_of_between {q n : ℕ} (h1 : q ^ 2 < n) (h2 : n < (q + 1) ^ 2) :
    ¬ ∃ r, n = r ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨r, rfl⟩
  have hqr : q < r := by
    by_contra hle
    push_neg at hle
    have : r ^ 2 ≤ q ^ 2 := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hle 2
    linarith
  have hrq : r < q + 1 := by
    by_contra hge
    push_neg at hge
    have : (q + 1) ^ 2 ≤ r ^ 2 := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hge 2
    linarith
  linarith

name: QPCF.Gamma.Density.boundedGaps_nonsquares_infinite
statement:
theorem boundedGaps_nonsquares_infinite (A : Set ℕ) (G : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ k : ℕ, m ≤ k ∧ k ≤ m + G ∧ k ∈ A) :
    {n : ℕ | n ∈ A ∧ ¬ ∃ q, n = q ^ 2}.Infinite
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.infinite_iff_exists_gt]
  intro N
  
  let q := max (N + 1) (G + 1)
  have hq1 : q ^ 2 > N := by
    calc q ^ 2 ≥ (N + 1) ^ 2 := by
           apply Nat.pow_le_pow_left (Nat.le_max_left _ _) 2
         _ > N := by nlinarith
  have hq2 : 2 * q > G := by
    calc 2 * q ≥ 2 * (G + 1) := by
           apply Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.le_max_right _ _)
         _ > G := by nlinarith
  
  have hwindow : q ^ 2 + 1 + G < (q + 1) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  
  obtain ⟨k, hk1, hk2, hkA⟩ := h (q ^ 2 + 1)
  
  have hkb : N < k := by omega
  
  have hku : k < (q + 1) ^ 2 := by omega
  
  have hkl : q ^ 2 < k := by omega
  
  have hknss : ¬∃ r, k = r ^ 2 := not_isSquare_of_between hkl hku
  exact ⟨k, ⟨hkA, hknss⟩, hkb⟩

name: QPCF.Gamma.gammaSelectedResidue_mem
statement:
lemma gammaSelectedResidue_mem (U : gammaRemainder B) (M : ℕ) :
    U.1.Mem (gammaResidueClass B M (gammaSelectedResidue B U M))
proof:
:= by
  exact (Classical.choose_spec (existsUnique_mem_finitePartition B U Finset.univ
    (gammaResidueClass B M)
    (by
      exact fun x _ y _ hxy => Set.disjoint_left.mpr fun n hn hn' => hxy <| hn.symm.trans hn')
    (by
      have heq : (⋃ r : ZMod M.factorial, (gammaResidueClass B M r : Set ℕ)) = Set.univ := by
        ext n; simp [gammaResidueClass]
      simpa [heq]))).1.2

name: QPCF.Gamma.gammaSelectedResidue_unique
statement:
lemma gammaSelectedResidue_unique (U : gammaRemainder B) (M : ℕ) (r : ZMod M.factorial)
    (hr : U.1.Mem (gammaResidueClass B M r)) :
    r = gammaSelectedResidue B U M
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := existsUnique_mem_finitePartition B U Finset.univ
    (gammaResidueClass B M)
    (by exact fun x _ y _ hxy => Set.disjoint_left.mpr fun n hn hn' => hxy <| hn.symm.trans hn')
    (by
      have heq : (⋃ r : ZMod M.factorial, (gammaResidueClass B M r : Set ℕ)) = Set.univ := by
        ext n; simp [gammaResidueClass]
      simpa [heq])
  exact (hs.2 r ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hr⟩).trans
    (hs.2 (gammaSelectedResidue B U M) ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, gammaSelectedResidue_mem B U M⟩).symm

name: QPCF.Gamma.threadClass_gammaThreadOf_mem
statement:
theorem threadClass_gammaThreadOf_mem (U : gammaRemainder B) (M : ℕ) :
    U.1.Mem ⟨QPCF.ThreadClass (gammaThreadOf B U) M,
      (gammaResidueClass B M (gammaSelectedResidue B U M)).2⟩
proof:
:= by
  exact gammaSelectedResidue_mem B U M

name: QPCF.Gamma.continuous_gammaThreadOf
statement: theorem continuous_gammaThreadOf : Continuous (gammaThreadOf B)
proof:
:= by
  refine Continuous.subtype_mk (continuous_pi fun M => ?_) _
  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
  intro U
  rw [continuousAt_def]
  intro s hs
  apply mem_of_superset
    ((basicClopen_isClopen B (gammaResidueClass B M (gammaSelectedResidue B U M))).isOpen.mem_nhds
      (gammaSelectedResidue_mem B U M))
  intro V hV
  have heq := gammaSelectedResidue_unique B V M _ hV
  change gammaSelectedResidue B V M ∈ s
  rw [← heq]
  exact mem_of_mem_nhds hs

name: QPCF.Gamma.gammaGovUpToOn_of_govAt
proof:
:= by
  let f : Fin (Int.toNat (K - L.order) + 1) → BSet B := fun j =>
    Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (h (L.order + j.1)))
  let T₀ := bsetIInter B (Int.toNat (K - L.order)) f
  let Sbase : BSet B := Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (h (L.order - 1)))
  let T : BSet B := ⟨Sbase.1 ∩ T₀.1, B.inter_mem Sbase.2 T₀.2⟩
  refine ⟨T, U.1.inter_mem
    (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (h (L.order - 1)))).1
    (mem_bsetIInter B U _ f fun j =>
      (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (h (L.order + j.1)))).1), ?_⟩
  intro N hN
  by_cases hlow : N < L.order
  · let C := Classical.choose (h (L.order - 1))
    refine ⟨C, ?_⟩
    filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_gt_atTop 0] with n hn
    intro hnT
    have hbase := (Classical.choose_spec
      (Classical.choose_spec (h (L.order - 1)))).2 n hnT.1 hn
    have hpN : QPCF.pval L N n = 0 := by
      rw [QPCF.pval_eq_finset_sum]
      exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun k hk => by
        rw [HahnSeries.coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_order (by
          have := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hk).2
          omega)]
        simp
    have hpbase : QPCF.pval L (L.order - 1) n = 0 := by
      rw [QPCF.pval_eq_finset_sum]
      exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun k hk => by
        rw [HahnSeries.coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_order (by
          have := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hk).2
          omega)]
        simp
    rw [hpbase] at hbase
    rw [hpN]
    have hC : 0 ≤ C := by
      have hp : 0 < (n : ℝ) ^ (-(L.order - 1 + 1)) := by positivity
      have hm : 0 ≤ C * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(L.order - 1 + 1)) :=
        le_trans (abs_nonneg _) hbase
      exact nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_left hm hp
    exact hbase.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (mod_cast hn) (by omega)) hC)
  · have hidx : Int.toNat (N - L.order) < Int.toNat (K - L.order) + 1 := by omega
    let j : Fin (Int.toNat (K - L.order) + 1) :=
      ⟨Int.toNat (N - L.order), hidx⟩
    have hj : L.order + (j.1 : ℤ) = N := by
      simp only [j]
      rw [Int.toNat_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (not_lt.mp hlow))]
      omega
    let C := Classical.choose (h (L.order + j.1))
    refine ⟨C, ?_⟩
    filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop 1] with n hn
    intro hnT
    have hsub := bsetIInter_subset B _ f j hnT.2
    change n ∈ (Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec
      (h (L.order + j.1))) : BSet B).1 at hsub
    have hs := (Classical.choose_spec
      (Classical.choose_spec (h (L.order + j.1)))).2 n hsub hn
    rw [← hj]
    exact hs

name: QPCF.Gamma.gamma_caseA_depth
statement:
theorem gamma_caseA_depth
    {L : ℚ⸨X⸩} {a : ℕ → ℝ} {U : gammaRemainder B}
    (hgov : GovAtGamma B U L a) (hirr : ¬ QPCF.IsRat L) (J : ℕ) :
    let β := QPCF.threadBranch L (gammaThreadOf B U)
    ∃ S : BSet B, U.1.Mem S ∧
      (∀ j : Fin (J + 1), ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ∈ S.1 →
        QPCF.realPQ j.1 (a n) =
          ((((QPCF.bfloorPoly (β.tower j) (β.Ds j) (β.b j)).eval (n : ℚ)) : ℚ) : ℝ)) ∧
      (∀ j : Fin (J + 1), ∀ n : ℕ, n ∈ S.1 → 1 ≤ n →
        ∃ z : ℤ, (QPCF.bfloorPoly (β.tower j) (β.Ds j) (β.b j)).eval (n : ℚ) = (z : ℚ)) ∧
      (∀ j : Fin (J + 1), 1 ≤ j.1 → ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ∈ S.1 →
        1 ≤ (QPCF.bfloorPoly (β.tower j) (β.Ds j) (β.b j)).eval (n : ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  let t := gammaThreadOf B U
  let β := QPCF.threadBranch L t
  let D := QPCF.allResModulus L J
  have hD : 0 < D := QPCF.allResModulus_pos _ _
  have hDfac : D ∣ D.factorial := Nat.dvd_factorial hD le_rfl
  let R := gammaResidueClass B D (gammaSelectedResidue B U D)
  have hsub0 : R.1 ⊆ {n : ℕ | n ≡ β.b J [MOD β.Ds J]} := by
    intro n hn
    have hh := QPCF.threadClass_modEq_proj_val t D D hDfac hn
    change n ≡ (QPCF.ZHat.proj D t).val % D [MOD D]
    exact hh.trans (Nat.mod_modEq (QPCF.ZHat.proj D t).val D).symm
  obtain ⟨Md, c, K₀, hc, hnd⟩ := β.branch_nondeg hirr J
  obtain ⟨K₇, htrack⟩ := β.branch_tracking hirr J
  set Kbound := max K₀ K₇
  set Nsched : ℕ → ℕ := fun m =>
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc m J, 2 * Md i) + Kbound + 1
  have hbud : ∀ m ≤ J, 2 * Md m < Nsched m := by
    intro m hm
    have hle : 2 * Md m ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc m J, 2 * Md i :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => Nat.zero_le (2 * Md i))
        (Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨le_rfl, hm⟩)
    simp only [Nsched]
    omega
  have hsched : ∀ m, m < J → Nsched (m + 1) + 2 * Md m ≤ Nsched m := by
    intro m hm
    have hsplit : ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc m J, 2 * Md i =
        (∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc (m + 1) J, 2 * Md i) + 2 * Md m := by
      have hunion : Finset.Icc m J = insert m (Finset.Icc (m + 1) J) := by
        ext x
        simp only [Finset.mem_Icc, Finset.mem_insert]
        omega
      rw [hunion, Finset.sum_insert (by simp only [Finset.mem_Icc]; omega)]
      ring
    simp only [Nsched]
    omega
  obtain ⟨S₀, hS₀, hgu₀⟩ := gammaGovUpToOn_of_govAt B hgov ((Nsched 0 : ℤ) - 1)
  let S : BSet B := ⟨S₀.1 ∩ R.1, B.inter_mem S₀.2 R.2⟩
  have hS : U.1.Mem S := U.1.inter_mem hS₀ (gammaSelectedResidue_mem B U D)
  have hsub : S.1 ⊆ {n : ℕ | n ≡ β.b J [MOD β.Ds J]} :=
    fun n hn => hsub0 hn.2
  have hgu : QPCF.GovernsUpToOn ((Nsched 0 : ℤ) - 1) S.1 L a :=
    hgu₀.subset Set.inter_subset_left
  have hstab : ∀ m ≤ J, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ∈ S.1 →
      QPCF.realPQ m (a n) =
        (⌊QPCF.realGaussIter m (QPCF.pval L ((Nsched 0 : ℤ) - 1) n)⌋ : ℝ) := by
    refine QPCF.formal_stability_i_governs_on_finite S.1 a L ((Nsched 0 : ℤ) - 1)
      J Md Nsched c hc le_rfl hgu hbud hsched ?_
    intro m hm
    have hNspos : 1 ≤ Nsched 0 := by simp only [Nsched]; omega
    have hcast : ((Nsched 0 - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (Nsched 0 : ℤ) - 1 := by omega
    have hK₀le : K₀ ≤ Nsched 0 - 1 := by simp only [Nsched, Kbound]; omega
    filter_upwards [hnd (Nsched 0 - 1) hK₀le m hm] with n hn hnS
    rw [← hcast]
    exact hn (hsub hnS)
  refine ⟨S, hS, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j
    have hNspos : 1 ≤ Nsched 0 := by simp only [Nsched]; omega
    have hcast : ((Nsched 0 - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (Nsched 0 : ℤ) - 1 := by omega
    have hK₇le : K₇ ≤ Nsched 0 - 1 := by simp only [Nsched, Kbound]; omega
    filter_upwards [hstab j j.is_le, htrack (Nsched 0 - 1) hK₇le j j.is_le]
      with n hn hn' hnS
    rw [hn hnS, ← QPCF.bfloorVal_eq_bfloorPoly_eval, ← hcast]
    exact hn' (hsub hnS)
  · intro j n hnS hn1
    have hclass : n ≡ β.b j [MOD β.Ds j] := β.class_subset j.is_le (hsub hnS)
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := QPCF.bfloorVal_intVal (β.hper j) (β.b j) hn1 hclass
    exact ⟨z, by rw [← QPCF.bfloorVal_eq_bfloorPoly_eval]; exact_mod_cast hz⟩
  · intro j hj
    filter_upwards [QPCF.eventually_one_le_bfloorPoly_on_branch hirr β J j j.is_le hj]
      with n hn hnS
    exact hn (hsub hnS)

name: QPCF.Gamma.gamma_forward_irrational
statement:
theorem gamma_forward_irrational
    (F : C(gammaRemainder B, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (hgov : GovGamma B F a)
    (U : gammaRemainder B) (hirr : ¬ QPCF.IsRat (F U)) :
    (∀ m : ℕ, ArmAGamma B a U m) ∧ CondCGamma B a U

name: QPCF.Gamma.gamma_armB_of_termination
statement:
theorem gamma_armB_of_termination
    {L : ℚ⸨X⸩} {a : ℕ → ℝ} {U : gammaRemainder B}
    (hgov : GovAtGamma B U L a) (d : ℕ) (hnd : QPCF.CFNondegThrough L d)
    (hterm : QPCF.fFract L d = 0) :
    ArmBGamma B a U
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ P, Q, hQ, h ⟩ := QPCF.terminating_eq_polyExpansion_div L d hnd hterm;
  
  have h_error_bound : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∃ S : BSet B, U.1.Mem S ∧
      ∀ n ∈ S.1, 1 ≤ n →
        |a n - (P.eval (n : ℚ) / Q.eval (n : ℚ) : ℝ)| ≤
          C * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(k + 1) : ℤ) := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨C, S, hS, hC⟩ := hgov k;
    obtain ⟨ D, hD ⟩ := QPCF.ratSeq_governs_expansion P Q hQ k;
    rw [Filter.eventually_atTop] at hD
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hD
    let T : BSet B := ⟨S.1 ∩ (bsetTail B M).1, B.inter_mem S.2 (bsetTail B M).2⟩
    refine ⟨C + D, T, U.1.inter_mem hS (mem_bsetTail B U M), ?_⟩
    intro n hnT hn1
    have ha := hC n hnT.1 hn1
    have hb := hM n hnT.2
    rw [h] at ha
    rw [abs_sub_le_iff] at ha ⊢
    rw [abs_sub_le_iff] at hb
    constructor <;> linarith
  refine' ⟨ P, Q, hQ, fun k => _ ⟩;
  obtain ⟨ C, S, hS, hC ⟩ := h_error_bound k;
  let T : BSet B := ⟨S.1 ∩ (bsetTail B (⌈C⌉₊ + 1)).1, B.inter_mem S.2 (bsetTail B (⌈C⌉₊ + 1)).2⟩
  refine' ⟨ T, U.1.inter_mem hS (mem_bsetTail B U _), _ ⟩;
  have hQ_nonzero : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, Q.eval (n : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact ( Q.roots.toFinset.finite_toSet.bddAbove.elim fun N hN => Filter.eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨ ⌊N⌋₊ + 1, fun n hn => by exact fun h => not_lt_of_ge ( hN <| by aesop ) <| Nat.lt_of_floor_lt hn ⟩ );
  filter_upwards [ hQ_nonzero ] with n hn
  intro hnT
  have hn' : ⌈C⌉₊ < n := by exact hnT.2
  have hn₂ := hC n hnT.1 (by omega)
  norm_cast at * ; simp_all +decide [ zpow_add₀, zpow_neg ];
  refine le_trans hn₂ ?_; rw [ mul_inv_le_iff₀ (pow_pos (by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < n from by omega)) _) ] ; ring_nf; norm_cast;
  have hn₁ : 1 ≤ n := by omega
  simpa [ mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, ne_of_gt ( zero_lt_one.trans_le hn₁ ) ] using Nat.le_ceil C |> le_trans <| mod_cast by nlinarith [ pow_pos ( zero_lt_one.trans_le hn₁ ) k ] ;

name: QPCF.Gamma.gamma_forward_rational
statement:
theorem gamma_forward_rational
    (F : C(gammaRemainder B, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (hgov : GovGamma B F a)
    (U : gammaRemainder B) (hrat : QPCF.IsRat (F U)) :
    ArmBGamma B a U
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ : ∃ d : ℕ, QPCF.fFract (F U) d = 0 :=
    (QPCF.terminates_iff_isRat_uncond).2 hrat
  contrapose! hd
  induction' d using Nat.strong_induction_on with d ih
  exact fun h => hd (gamma_armB_of_termination B (hgov U) d
    (fun m hm => ih m hm) h)

name: QPCF.Gamma.gamma2_engine_forward
statement:
theorem gamma2_engine_forward :
    ∀ (F : C(gammaRemainder B, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (a : ℕ → ℝ), GovGamma B F a →
      ∀ U : gammaRemainder B, ResolvedGamma B a U
proof:
:= by
  intro F a hgov U
  by_cases hrat : QPCF.IsRat (F U)
  · exact Or.inl (gamma_forward_rational B F a hgov U hrat)
  · exact Or.inr (gamma_forward_irrational B F a hgov U hrat)

name: QPCF.Gamma.gamma2_engine_armA_germ
statement:
theorem gamma2_engine_armA_germ :
    ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (U : gammaRemainder B),
      (∀ m, ArmAGamma B a U m) → CondCGamma B a U →
      ∃ g : ℚ⸨X⸩, GovAtGamma B U g a
proof:
:= by
  intro a U hA hCond
  exact ⟨gammaArmAGerm B a U hA hCond,
    gamma_armA_germ_governs B a U hA hCond⟩

name: QPCF.Gamma.gamma2_engine_armB_germ
statement:
theorem gamma2_engine_armB_germ :
    ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (U : gammaRemainder B) (P Q : Polynomial ℚ), Q ≠ 0 →
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ S : BSet B, U.1.Mem S ∧
        ∀ᶠ n in atTop, n ∈ S.1 → Q.eval (n : ℚ) ≠ 0 ∧
          |a n - (((P.eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) /
            ((Q.eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ))| ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ (-(k : ℤ))) →
      GovAtGamma B U (QPCF.polyExpansion P * (QPCF.polyExpansion Q)⁻¹) a
proof:
:= by
  intro a U P Q hQ hflat N
  obtain ⟨S, hS_mem, hS_flat⟩ := hflat (Int.toNat (N + 1))
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ᶠ n in atTop, n ∈ S.1 →
      |a n - QPCF.pval
        (QPCF.polyExpansion P * (QPCF.polyExpansion Q)⁻¹) N n| ≤
        C * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(N + 1)) := by
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ᶠ n in atTop, n ∈ S.1 →
        |QPCF.pval (QPCF.polyExpansion P * (QPCF.polyExpansion Q)⁻¹) N n -
          (P.eval (n : ℚ) / Q.eval (n : ℚ) : ℝ)| ≤
          C * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(N + 1)) := by
      obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := QPCF.ratSeq_governs_expansion P Q hQ N
      exact ⟨C, by
        filter_upwards [hC] with n hn hnS
        rw [abs_sub_comm]
        exact hn⟩
    use C + 1
    filter_upwards [hS_flat, hC, Filter.eventually_gt_atTop 0] with n hn hn' hn''
    intro hnS
    have h_bound :
        |a n - ((P.eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) / ((Q.eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)| ≤
          (n : ℝ) ^ (-(N + 1)) := by
      exact le_trans (hn hnS).2 (le_trans (by norm_num)
        (zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (mod_cast hn'') (neg_le_neg (Int.self_le_toNat _))))
    exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by
      linarith [abs_le.mp h_bound, abs_le.mp (hn' hnS)], by
      linarith [abs_le.mp h_bound, abs_le.mp (hn' hnS)]⟩
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp hC
  let T : BSet B := ⟨S.1 ∩ {n | n ≥ M} ∩ {n | 1 ≤ n},
    B.inter_mem (B.inter_mem S.2
      (cofinite_mem B (Set.finite_iff_bddAbove.mpr
        ⟨M, fun n hn => not_lt.mp fun h => hn h.le⟩)))
      (cofinite_mem B (Set.finite_iff_bddAbove.mpr
        ⟨1, fun n hn => not_lt.mp fun h => hn h.le⟩))⟩
  refine ⟨C, T, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact U.1.inter_mem (U.1.inter_mem hS_mem
      (U.2 ⟨{n | n ≥ M}, cofinite_mem B (Set.finite_iff_bddAbove.mpr
        ⟨M, fun n hn => not_lt.mp fun h => hn h.le⟩)⟩
        (Set.finite_iff_bddAbove.mpr ⟨M, fun n hn => not_lt.mp fun h => hn h.le⟩)))
      (U.2 ⟨{n | 1 ≤ n}, cofinite_mem B (Set.finite_iff_bddAbove.mpr
        ⟨1, fun n hn => not_lt.mp fun h => hn h.le⟩)⟩
        (Set.finite_iff_bddAbove.mpr ⟨1, fun n hn => not_lt.mp fun h => hn h.le⟩))
  · intro n hnT hn1
    exact hM n hnT.1.2 hnT.1.1

name: QPCF.Gamma.gamma_forward
statement:
theorem gamma_forward
    (F : C(gammaRemainder B, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (hgov : GovGamma B F a) :
    ∀ U : gammaRemainder B, ResolvedGamma B a U
proof:
:=
  gamma2_engine_forward B F a hgov

name: QPCF.Gamma.gammaGovAt_iff_bigOpow
statement:
lemma gammaGovAt_iff_bigOpow (U : gammaRemainder B) (f : ℚ⸨X⸩)
    (a : ℕ → ℝ) :
    GovAtGamma B U f a ↔
      ∀ N : ℤ, GammaBigOpow B U (fun n => a n - QPCF.pval f N n) (-(N + 1))
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: QPCF.Gamma.GammaBigOpow.add
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, S, hS, hf⟩ := hf
  obtain ⟨D, T, hT, hg⟩ := hg
  refine ⟨C + D, ⟨S.1 ∩ T.1, B.inter_mem S.2 T.2⟩,
    U.1.inter_mem hS hT, ?_⟩
  intro n hn hn1
  rw [add_mul]
  exact (abs_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (hf n hn.1 hn1) (hg n hn.2 hn1))

name: QPCF.Gamma.GammaBigOpow.mul
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, S, hS, hf⟩ := hf
  obtain ⟨D, T, hT, hg⟩ := hg
  refine ⟨C * D, ⟨S.1 ∩ T.1, B.inter_mem S.2 T.2⟩,
    U.1.inter_mem hS hT, ?_⟩
  intro n hn hn1
  have hn0 : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt hn1)
  simpa [abs_mul, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, zpow_add₀ hn0] using
    mul_le_mul (hf n hn.1 hn1) (hg n hn.2 hn1)
      (by positivity) (le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hf n hn.1 hn1))

name: QPCF.Gamma.GammaBigOpow.mono
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, S, hS, hf⟩ := hf
  refine ⟨max C 0, S, hS, ?_⟩
  intro n hn hn1
  exact (hf n hn hn1).trans (mul_le_mul (le_max_left _ _)
    (zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (by exact_mod_cast hn1) h) (by positivity) (by positivity))

name: QPCF.Gamma.GammaBigOpow.of_bigOpow
statement:
lemma GammaBigOpow.of_bigOpow (U : gammaRemainder B) {f : ℕ → ℝ} {e : ℤ}
    (h : QPCF.BigOpow f e) : GammaBigOpow B U f e
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp hC
  have hfin : ({n : ℕ | N ≤ n}ᶜ).Finite := by
    simpa only [Set.compl_setOf, not_le] using Set.finite_Iio N
  let S : BSet B := ⟨{n | N ≤ n}, cofinite_mem B hfin⟩
  refine ⟨C, S, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact U.2 S hfin
  · intro n hn hn1
    exact hN n hn

name: QPCF.Gamma.GovGamma.zero
statement: theorem GovGamma.zero : GovGamma B (0 : C(gammaRemainder B, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (fun _ => 0)
proof:
:= by
  intro U N
  refine ⟨0, ⟨Set.univ, QPCF.Gamma.univ_mem B⟩, U.1.univ_mem, ?_⟩
  intro n hn hn1
  simp [QPCF.pval]

name: QPCF.Gamma.GovGamma.one
statement: theorem GovGamma.one : GovGamma B (1 : C(gammaRemainder B, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (fun _ => 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro U N
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := QPCF.Governs.one N
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp hC
  have hfin : ({n : ℕ | M ≤ n}ᶜ).Finite := by
    simpa only [Set.compl_setOf, not_le] using Set.finite_Iio M
  let S : BSet B := ⟨{n | M ≤ n}, cofinite_mem B hfin⟩
  refine ⟨C, S, U.2 S hfin, ?_⟩
  intro n hn hn1
  exact hM n hn

name: QPCF.Gamma.GovGamma.neg
statement:
theorem GovGamma.neg {F : C(gammaRemainder B, ℚ⸨X⸩)} {a : ℕ → ℝ}
    (ha : GovGamma B F a) : GovGamma B (-F) (fun n => -a n)
proof:
:= by
  intro U N
  obtain ⟨C, S, hS, h⟩ := ha U N
  refine ⟨C, S, hS, ?_⟩
  intro n hn hn1
  rw [show (-F) U = -(F U) by rfl, QPCF.pval_neg]
  simpa only [Pi.neg_apply, neg_sub_neg, abs_neg, abs_sub_comm] using h n hn hn1

name: QPCF.Gamma.GovGamma.add
proof:
:= by
  intro U N
  obtain ⟨C, S, hS, ha⟩ := ha U N
  obtain ⟨D, T, hT, hb⟩ := hb U N
  refine ⟨C + D, ⟨S.1 ∩ T.1, B.inter_mem S.2 T.2⟩,
    U.1.inter_mem hS hT, ?_⟩
  intro n hn hn1
  rw [show (F + G) U = F U + G U by rfl, QPCF.pval_add]
  rw [show a n + b n - (QPCF.pval (F U) N n + QPCF.pval (G U) N n) =
    (a n - QPCF.pval (F U) N n) + (b n - QPCF.pval (G U) N n) by ring]
  exact (abs_add_le _ _).trans (by rw [add_mul]; exact add_le_add (ha n hn.1 hn1) (hb n hn.2 hn1))

name: QPCF.Gamma.GovGamma.mul
proof:
:= by
  intro U N
  let f := F U
  let g := G U
  let L := min f.order g.order
  let M := max N (max (N - L) 1)
  have hfg : GammaBigOpow B U (fun n => (a n - QPCF.pval f M n) *
      (b n - QPCF.pval g M n)) (-(2 * M + 2)) := by
    convert GammaBigOpow.mul B U
      ((gammaGovAt_iff_bigOpow B U f a).1 (ha U) M)
      ((gammaGovAt_iff_bigOpow B U g b).1 (hb U) M) using 1 <;> ring
  have hfg' : GammaBigOpow B U (fun n => (a n - QPCF.pval f M n) *
      QPCF.pval g M n) (-(M + 1 + g.order)) := by
    convert GammaBigOpow.mul B U
      ((gammaGovAt_iff_bigOpow B U f a).1 (ha U) M)
      (GammaBigOpow.of_bigOpow B U (QPCF.pval_bigOpow g M)) using 1 <;> ring
  have hfg'' : GammaBigOpow B U (fun n => QPCF.pval f M n *
      (b n - QPCF.pval g M n)) (-(M + 1 + f.order)) := by
    convert GammaBigOpow.mul B U
      (GammaBigOpow.of_bigOpow B U (QPCF.pval_bigOpow f M))
      ((gammaGovAt_iff_bigOpow B U g b).1 (hb U) M) using 1 <;> ring
  have htrunc : GammaBigOpow B U (fun n => QPCF.pval f M n * QPCF.pval g M n -
      QPCF.pval (f * g) N n) (-(N + 1)) := by
    apply GammaBigOpow.of_bigOpow
    apply QPCF.pval_mul_sub_bigOpow
    all_goals simp [M, L] <;> omega
  have h1 := GammaBigOpow.mono B U hfg (show -(2 * M + 2) ≤ -(N + 1) by simp [M]; omega)
  have h2 := GammaBigOpow.mono B U hfg' (show -(M + 1 + g.order) ≤ -(N + 1) by simp [M, L]; omega)
  have h3 := GammaBigOpow.mono B U hfg'' (show -(M + 1 + f.order) ≤ -(N + 1) by simp [M, L]; omega)
  have hall := GammaBigOpow.add B U (GammaBigOpow.add B U
    (GammaBigOpow.add B U h1 h2) h3) htrunc
  change GammaBigOpow B U (fun n => a n * b n - QPCF.pval (f * g) N n) (-(N + 1))
  convert hall using 2 <;> ring

name: QPCF.Gamma.GovGamma.unique
statement:
theorem GovGamma.unique {F G : C(gammaRemainder B, ℚ⸨X⸩)} {a : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hF : GovGamma B F a) (hG : GovGamma B G a) : F = G
proof:
:= by
  ext U k
  obtain ⟨C, S, hS, hFb⟩ := hF U k
  obtain ⟨D, T, hT, hGb⟩ := hG U k
  have hi : (S.1 ∩ T.1).Infinite :=
    mem_infinite B U ⟨S.1 ∩ T.1, B.inter_mem S.2 T.2⟩ (U.1.inter_mem hS hT)
  exact gamma_coeff_eq_of_governance_intersection a (F U) (G U) k S.1 T.1 hi C D hFb hGb k le_rfl

name: QPCF.Gamma.gammaFamily_spec
statement:
theorem gammaFamily_spec (x : SgovGammaSubring B) :
    GovGamma B (gammaFamily B x) x.1
proof: := Classical.choose_spec x.2

name: QPCF.Gamma.gammaFamily_eq_iff
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl; exact gammaFamily_spec B x
  · exact fun h => GovGamma.unique B (gammaFamily_spec B x) h

name: QPCF.Gamma.Phi_gamma_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem Phi_gamma_apply (x : SgovGammaSubring B) :
    Phi_gamma B x = gammaFamily B x
proof: := rfl

name: QPCF.Gamma.finite_range_of_continuous_discrete
statement:
lemma finite_range_of_continuous_discrete {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y]
    [DiscreteTopology Y] (f : gammaRemainder B → Y) (hf : Continuous f) :
    (Set.range f).Finite
proof:
:= by
  have hcov : (univ : Set (gammaRemainder B)) ⊆ ⋃ y : Y, f ⁻¹' {y} := by
    intro U _; exact mem_iUnion.2 ⟨f U, rfl⟩
  have hopen : ∀ y : Y, IsOpen (f ⁻¹' {y}) :=
    fun y => (isOpen_discrete _).preimage hf
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := (isCompact_univ (X := gammaRemainder B)).elim_finite_subcover
    (fun y : Y => f ⁻¹' {y}) hopen hcov
  refine Set.Finite.subset t.finite_toSet ?_
  rintro y ⟨U, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hUz⟩ := mem_iUnion₂.1 (ht (mem_univ U))
  simpa using (mem_singleton_iff.1 hUz) ▸ hz

name: QPCF.Gamma.gamma_coeff_agree_clopen
statement:
lemma gamma_coeff_agree_clopen (F : C(gammaRemainder B, ℚ⸨X⸩))
    (U : gammaRemainder B) (K : ℤ) :
    ∃ S : BSet B, U.1.Mem S ∧ ∀ V : gammaRemainder B, V.1.Mem S →
      ∀ k : ℤ, k ≤ K → (F V).coeff k = (F U).coeff k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := QPCF.Compactification.order_uniform_bound F
  let A : Set (gammaRemainder B) := {V | ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc L K,
    (F V).coeff k = (F U).coeff k}
  have hAU : U ∈ A := by simp [A]
  have hAo : IsOpen A := by
    simp only [A, Set.setOf_forall]
    apply isOpen_biInter_finset
    intro k hk
    letI : UniformSpace ℚ := ⊥
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply] using
      ((isOpen_discrete ({(F U).coeff k} : Set ℚ)).preimage
        ((LaurentSeries.uniformContinuous_coeff k).continuous.comp F.continuous))
  obtain ⟨C, ⟨S, rfl⟩, hUC, hCA⟩ :=
    (basicClopen_basis B).exists_subset_of_mem_open hAU hAo
  refine ⟨S, hUC, ?_⟩
  intro V hV k hk
  by_cases hkL : k < L
  · rw [hL V k hkL, hL U k hkL]
  · exact hCA hV k (Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨le_of_not_gt hkL, hk⟩)

name: QPCF.Gamma.bsetDisjointPiece_pairwise
statement:
private lemma bsetDisjointPiece_pairwise
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι] (S : ι → BSet B) :
    ∀ i j, i ≠ j →
      (bsetDisjointPiece B S i).1 ∩ (bsetDisjointPiece B S j).1 = ∅
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  ext x
  simp +decide [bsetDisjointPiece, hij]
  cases lt_or_gt_of_ne hij <;> tauto

name: QPCF.Gamma.bsetDisjointPiece_covers
statement:
private lemma bsetDisjointPiece_covers
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι] (S : ι → BSet B) :
    (⋃ i, (bsetDisjointPiece B S i).1) = ⋃ i, (S i).1
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp +decide [bsetDisjointPiece, Set.ext_iff]
  constructor
  · exact fun ⟨i, hi, _⟩ => ⟨i, hi⟩
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hx
    let t : Finset ι := Set.Finite.toFinset
      (show Set.Finite {j | x ∈ (S j).1} from Set.toFinite _)
    have ht : t.Nonempty := ⟨i, by simpa [t] using hi⟩
    let j := t.min' ht
    have hj : x ∈ (S j).1 := by
      have := Finset.min'_mem t ht
      simpa [t, j] using this
    refine ⟨j, hj, ?_⟩
    intro q hq
    intro hxq
    have hqt : q ∈ t := by simpa [t] using hxq
    exact not_lt_of_ge (Finset.min'_le t q hqt) hq

name: QPCF.Gamma.finite_iUnion_of_not_infinite_bset
statement:
private lemma finite_iUnion_of_not_infinite_bset
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (D : ι → BSet B) :
    (⋃ i, ⋃ (_ : ¬ (D i).1.Infinite), (D i).1).Finite
proof:
:= by
  exact Set.finite_iUnion fun i => Set.finite_iUnion fun hi => Set.not_infinite.mp hi

name: QPCF.Gamma.complement_infinite_bset_parts_subset
statement:
private lemma complement_infinite_bset_parts_subset
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (D : ι → BSet B) :
    (⋃ i, ⋃ (_ : (D i).1.Infinite), (D i).1)ᶜ ⊆
      (⋃ i, (D i).1)ᶜ ∪
        (⋃ i, ⋃ (_ : ¬ (D i).1.Infinite), (D i).1)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  by_cases h : ∃ i, x ∈ (D i).1
  · right
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := h
    refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, ?_⟩
    by_cases hinf : (D i).1.Infinite
    · exact False.elim (hx (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i,
        Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨hinf, hi⟩⟩))
    · exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨hinf, hi⟩
  · left
    simpa only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_iUnion, not_exists] using h

name: QPCF.Gamma.finite_cover_disjoint_infinite_refinement
statement:
lemma finite_cover_disjoint_infinite_refinement
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι]
    (S : ι → BSet B) (hcofin : (⋃ i, (S i).1)ᶜ.Finite) :
    ∃ pieces : Finset (BSet B),
      (∀ A ∈ pieces, ∀ C ∈ pieces, A ≠ C → A.1 ∩ C.1 = ∅) ∧
      (⋃ A ∈ pieces, A.1)ᶜ.Finite ∧
      (∀ A ∈ pieces, A.1.Infinite) ∧
      (∀ A ∈ pieces, ∃ i, A.1 ⊆ (S i).1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let D : ι → BSet B := bsetDisjointPiece B S
  let good : Finset ι := Finset.univ.filter (fun i => (D i).1.Infinite)
  refine ⟨good.image D, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro A hA C hC hAC
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hA
    obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hC
    have hij : i ≠ j := fun h => hAC (by rw [h])
    exact bsetDisjointPiece_pairwise B S i j hij
  · have himg : (⋃ A ∈ good.image D, A.1) =
        ⋃ i, ⋃ (_ : (D i).1.Infinite), (D i).1 := by
      ext x
      simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, exists_prop]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨A, hA, hxA⟩
        obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hA
        exact ⟨i, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2, hxA⟩
      · rintro ⟨i, hinf, hxi⟩
        exact ⟨D i, Finset.mem_image_of_mem D
          (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ i, hinf⟩), hxi⟩
    rw [himg]
    have hcofinD : (⋃ i, (D i).1)ᶜ.Finite := by
      rw [show (⋃ i, (D i).1) = ⋃ i, (S i).1 from bsetDisjointPiece_covers B S]
      exact hcofin
    exact Set.Finite.subset
      (hcofinD.union (finite_iUnion_of_not_infinite_bset B D))
      (complement_infinite_bset_parts_subset B D)
  · rintro A hA
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hA
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
  · rintro A hA
    obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hA
    exact ⟨i, fun x hx => hx.1⟩

name: QPCF.Gamma.exists_realizationStage
statement:
lemma exists_realizationStage (F : C(gammaRemainder B, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (m : ℕ) :
    Nonempty (RealizationStage B F m)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose S hS using fun U => gamma_coeff_agree_clopen B F U (m : ℤ)
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s : Finset (gammaRemainder B),
      (Set.univ : Set (gammaRemainder B)) ⊆
        ⋃ U ∈ s, basicClopen B (S U) := by
    exact (isCompact_univ (X := gammaRemainder B)).elim_finite_subcover
      (fun U => basicClopen B (S U))
      (fun U => (basicClopen_isClopen B (S U)).isOpen)
      (fun U _ => Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨U, hS U |>.1⟩)
  have hcofin : (⋃ U ∈ s, (S U).1)ᶜ.Finite :=
    cofinite_union_of_basicClopen_cover B s S hs
  letI : LinearOrder s := LinearOrder.lift' (fun x => Fintype.equivFin s x)
    (Fintype.equivFin s).injective
  obtain ⟨pieces, hdisj, hcofin', hinf, hparent⟩ :=
    finite_cover_disjoint_infinite_refinement B (fun U : s => S U) (by
      rw [show (⋃ U : s, (S U).1) = ⋃ U ∈ s, (S U).1 by
        ext x
        constructor
        · rintro hx
          obtain ⟨U, hxU⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
          exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨U.1,
            Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨U.2, hxU⟩⟩
        · rintro hx
          obtain ⟨U, hx⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
          obtain ⟨hUs, hxU⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
          exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨U, hUs⟩, hxU⟩]
      exact hcofin)
  choose parent hparentSub using hparent
  refine ⟨⟨pieces, hdisj, hcofin', hinf,
    fun A => if hA : A ∈ pieces then F (parent A hA) else 0, ?_⟩⟩
  intro A hA V hVA k hk
  simp only [dif_pos hA]
  exact (hS (parent A hA)).2 V
    (V.1.superset_mem (hparentSub A hA) hVA) k hk

name: QPCF.Gamma.realizationStage_succ
statement:
lemma realizationStage_succ (F : C(gammaRemainder B, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (m : ℕ)
    (P : RealizationStage B F m) :
    ∃ R : RealizationStage B F (m + 1),
      ∀ A ∈ R.pieces, ∃ C ∈ P.pieces, A.1 ⊆ C.1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨Q⟩ := exists_realizationStage B F (m + 1)
  let I := P.pieces ×ˢ Q.pieces
  let T : I → BSet B := fun i =>
    ⟨(i.val.1).1 ∩ (i.val.2).1, B.inter_mem (i.val.1).2 (i.val.2).2⟩
  letI : LinearOrder I := LinearOrder.lift' (fun x => Fintype.equivFin I x)
    (Fintype.equivFin I).injective
  have hcofin : (⋃ i : I, (T i).1)ᶜ.Finite := by
    apply Set.Finite.subset (P.cofin.union Q.cofin)
    intro x hx
    by_cases hp : ∃ C ∈ P.pieces, x ∈ C.1
    · by_cases hq : ∃ D ∈ Q.pieces, x ∈ D.1
      · obtain ⟨C, hCP, hxC⟩ := hp
        obtain ⟨D, hDQ, hxD⟩ := hq
        have hi : (C, D) ∈ I := by exact Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hCP, hDQ⟩
        have hxi : x ∈ (T ⟨(C, D), hi⟩).1 := ⟨hxC, hxD⟩
        exact False.elim (hx (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨_, hxi⟩))
      · right
        simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_iUnion, not_exists]
        intro D hDQ hxD
        exact hq ⟨D, hDQ, hxD⟩
    · left
      simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_iUnion, not_exists]
      intro C hCP hxC
      exact hp ⟨C, hCP, hxC⟩
  obtain ⟨pieces, hdisj, hcofin', hinf, hparent⟩ :=
    finite_cover_disjoint_infinite_refinement B T hcofin
  choose parent hparentSub using hparent
  refine ⟨⟨pieces, hdisj, hcofin', hinf,
    fun A => if hA : A ∈ pieces then Q.val (parent A hA).val.2 else 0, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro A hA V hVA k hk
    simp only [dif_pos hA]
    apply Q.agree (parent A hA).val.2
      (Finset.mem_product.mp (parent A hA).property).2 V
      (V.1.superset_mem (fun x hx => (hparentSub A hA hx).2) hVA) k
    omega
  · intro A hA
    exact ⟨(parent A hA).val.1,
      (Finset.mem_product.mp (parent A hA).property).1,
      fun x hx => (hparentSub A hA hx).1⟩

name: QPCF.Gamma.exists_refining_chain
statement:
lemma exists_refining_chain (F : C(gammaRemainder B, ℚ⸨X⸩)) :
    ∃ St : ∀ m : ℕ, RealizationStage B F m,
      ∀ m, ∀ A ∈ (St (m + 1)).pieces,
        ∃ C ∈ (St m).pieces, A.1 ⊆ C.1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨refiningChainAux B F, ?_⟩
  intro m A hA
  exact (realizationStage_succ B F m (refiningChainAux B F m)).choose_spec A hA

name: QPCF.Gamma.stage_piece_mem_ultrafilter
proof:
:= by
  let A : BSet B → BSet B := id
  have hp : Set.PairwiseDisjoint (↑St.pieces : Set (BSet B))
      (fun C => C.1) := by
    intro C hC D hD hne
    exact Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.mpr (St.disj C hC D hD hne)
  obtain ⟨A, hA, -⟩ := existsUnique_mem_finitePartition B U St.pieces A hp St.cofin
  exact ⟨A, hA.1, hA.2⟩

name: QPCF.Gamma.chain_refines_of_le
statement:
lemma chain_refines_of_le {F : C(gammaRemainder B, ℚ⸨X⸩)}
    (St : ∀ m : ℕ, RealizationStage B F m)
    (href : ∀ m, ∀ A ∈ (St (m + 1)).pieces,
      ∃ C ∈ (St m).pieces, A.1 ⊆ C.1)
    {m s : ℕ} (hms : m ≤ s) :
    ∀ A ∈ (St s).pieces, ∃ C ∈ (St m).pieces, A.1 ⊆ C.1
proof:
:= by
  induction s, hms using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => exact fun A hA => ⟨A, hA, subset_rfl⟩
  | succ s hms ih =>
    intro A hA
    obtain ⟨A', hA', hAA'⟩ := href s A hA
    obtain ⟨C, hC, hA'C⟩ := ih A' hA'
    exact ⟨C, hC, hAA'.trans hA'C⟩

name: QPCF.Gamma.deep_piece_subset_selected
statement:
lemma deep_piece_subset_selected {F : C(gammaRemainder B, ℚ⸨X⸩)}
    (St : ∀ m : ℕ, RealizationStage B F m)
    (href : ∀ m, ∀ A ∈ (St (m + 1)).pieces,
      ∃ C ∈ (St m).pieces, A.1 ⊆ C.1)
    {m s : ℕ} (hms : m ≤ s)
    {A : BSet B} (hA : A ∈ (St s).pieces)
    {A₀ : BSet B} (hA₀ : A₀ ∈ (St m).pieces)
    {n : ℕ} (hnA : n ∈ A.1) (hnA₀ : n ∈ A₀.1) : A.1 ⊆ A₀.1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hAC⟩ := chain_refines_of_le B St href hms A hA
  have hCA₀ : C = A₀ := by
    by_contra hne
    have hd := (St m).disj C hC A₀ hA₀ hne
    have : n ∈ C.1 ∩ A₀.1 := ⟨hAC hnA, hnA₀⟩
    rw [hd] at this
    exact this
  exact hCA₀ ▸ hAC

name: QPCF.Gamma.coeff_agree_of_subset
statement:
lemma coeff_agree_of_subset {F : C(gammaRemainder B, ℚ⸨X⸩)}
    {m s : ℕ} (hms : m ≤ s)
    (Stm : RealizationStage B F m) (Sts : RealizationStage B F s)
    {A : BSet B} (hA : A ∈ Sts.pieces)
    {A₀ : BSet B} (hA₀ : A₀ ∈ Stm.pieces) (hsub : A.1 ⊆ A₀.1)
    {k : ℤ} (hk : k ≤ (m : ℤ)) :
    (Sts.val A).coeff k = (Stm.val A₀).coeff k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V, hV⟩ := exists_free_ultrafilter_containing B A.2 (Sts.inf A hA)
  have hV₀ : V.1.Mem A₀ := V.1.superset_mem hsub hV
  have h1 := Sts.agree A hA V hV k (le_trans hk (by exact_mod_cast hms))
  have h2 := Stm.agree A₀ hA₀ V hV₀ k hk
  rw [← h1, h2]

name: QPCF.Gamma.pval_sub_pval_eq_tail
statement:
lemma pval_sub_pval_eq_tail (g : ℚ⸨X⸩) (N s' : ℤ) (hNs : N ≤ s') (n : ℕ) :
    QPCF.pval g s' n - QPCF.pval g N n =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ioc N s', ((g.coeff k : ℚ) : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) ^ (-k)
proof:
:=
  QPCF.Beta.pval_sub_pval_eq_tail g N s' hNs n

name: QPCF.Gamma.coeffBound_pos
statement:
lemma coeffBound_pos (F : C(gammaRemainder B, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (k : ℤ) :
    0 < coeffBound B F k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : UniformSpace ℚ := ⊥
  unfold coeffBound
  let h := finite_range_of_continuous_discrete B
    (fun U : gammaRemainder B => (F U).coeff k)
    ((LaurentSeries.uniformContinuous_coeff k).continuous.comp F.continuous)
  have hne : h.toFinset.Nonempty := by
    simp only [Set.Finite.toFinset_nonempty]
    exact ⟨_, Set.mem_range_self (Classical.arbitrary (gammaRemainder B))⟩
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hne
  have := Finset.le_sup'_of_le (fun q : ℚ => |(q : ℝ)|) hq (abs_nonneg (q : ℝ))
  linarith

name: QPCF.Gamma.abs_coeff_le_coeffBound
statement:
lemma abs_coeff_le_coeffBound (F : C(gammaRemainder B, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (k : ℤ)
    (U : gammaRemainder B) : |(((F U).coeff k : ℚ) : ℝ)| ≤ coeffBound B F k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : UniformSpace ℚ := ⊥
  unfold coeffBound
  let h := finite_range_of_continuous_discrete B
    (fun V : gammaRemainder B => (F V).coeff k)
    ((LaurentSeries.uniformContinuous_coeff k).continuous.comp F.continuous)
  have hmem : (F U).coeff k ∈ h.toFinset := by simp [Set.mem_toFinset]
  have := Finset.le_sup' (fun q : ℚ => |(q : ℝ)|) hmem
  linarith

name: QPCF.Gamma.realizedSeq_eq_pval_of_mem
statement:
lemma realizedSeq_eq_pval_of_mem {F : C(gammaRemainder B, ℚ⸨X⸩)}
    (St : ∀ m : ℕ, RealizationStage B F m) (M : ℤ → ℝ) (E : ℕ → ℕ)
    (n : ℕ) {A : BSet B}
    (hA : A ∈ (St (QPCF.Beta.stageOf M E n)).pieces) (hnA : n ∈ A.1) :
    realizedSeq B F St M E n =
      QPCF.pval ((St (QPCF.Beta.stageOf M E n)).val A)
        (QPCF.Beta.stageOf M E n : ℤ) n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold realizedSeq
  dsimp only
  split_ifs with h
  · have hp := h.choose_spec
    have heq : h.choose = A := by
      by_contra hne
      have hd := (St (QPCF.Beta.stageOf M E n)).disj
        h.choose hp.1 A hA hne
      have : n ∈ h.choose.1 ∩ A.1 := ⟨hp.2, hnA⟩
      rw [hd] at this
      exact this
    rw [heq]
  · exact False.elim (h ⟨A, hA, hnA⟩)

name: QPCF.Gamma.realizedSeq_govAtU
statement:
lemma realizedSeq_govAtU (F : C(gammaRemainder B, ℚ⸨X⸩))
    (St : ∀ m : ℕ, RealizationStage B F m)
    (href : ∀ m, ∀ A ∈ (St (m + 1)).pieces,
      ∃ C ∈ (St m).pieces, A.1 ⊆ C.1)
    (M : ℤ → ℝ) (hM : ∀ k, M k = coeffBound B F k) (E : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hE : ∀ m n, E m ≤ n → ∃ A ∈ (St m).pieces, n ∈ A.1)
    (U : gammaRemainder B) :
    GovAtGamma B U (F U) (realizedSeq B F St M E)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro N
  let m₀ : ℕ := max N.toNat 1
  obtain ⟨A₀, hA₀p, hA₀U⟩ := stage_piece_mem_ultrafilter B (St m₀) U
  let C : ℝ := (∑ k ∈ Finset.Ioc N (max (N + 1) 1), M k) + 1
  let T : BSet B :=
    ⟨A₀.1 ∩ (bsetTail B (QPCF.Beta.schedThreshold M E m₀)).1,
      B.inter_mem A₀.2 (bsetTail B _).2⟩
  refine ⟨C, T, U.1.inter_mem hA₀U
    (mem_bsetTail B U (QPCF.Beta.schedThreshold M E m₀)), ?_⟩
  intro n hn hn1
  have hnT : QPCF.Beta.schedThreshold M E m₀ ≤ n := hn.2
  have hs_ge : m₀ ≤ QPCF.Beta.stageOf M E n :=
    QPCF.Beta.stageOf_ge M E n m₀ hnT
  have hs_pos : 0 < QPCF.Beta.stageOf M E n :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le (by simp [m₀]) hs_ge
  have hEclear : E (QPCF.Beta.stageOf M E n) ≤ n :=
    QPCF.Beta.stageOf_clears_exception M E n hn1 hs_pos
  obtain ⟨A, hAp, hnA⟩ := hE (QPCF.Beta.stageOf M E n) n hEclear
  have ha_eq := realizedSeq_eq_pval_of_mem B St M E n hAp hnA
  have hsub : A.1 ⊆ A₀.1 :=
    deep_piece_subset_selected B St href hs_ge hAp hA₀p hnA hn.1
  have hNm₀ : N ≤ (m₀ : ℤ) := by
    exact (Int.self_le_toNat N).trans (by exact_mod_cast le_max_left N.toNat 1)
  have hagree : ∀ k : ℤ, k ≤ N →
      ((St (QPCF.Beta.stageOf M E n)).val A).coeff k = (F U).coeff k := by
    intro k hk
    have h1 := coeff_agree_of_subset B hs_ge (St m₀)
      (St (QPCF.Beta.stageOf M E n)) hAp hA₀p hsub (hk.trans hNm₀)
    have h2 := (St m₀).agree A₀ hA₀p U hA₀U k (hk.trans hNm₀)
    rw [h1, ← h2]
  have hpc : QPCF.pval ((St (QPCF.Beta.stageOf M E n)).val A) N n =
      QPCF.pval (F U) N n := QPCF.pval_congr hagree
  have hNs : N ≤ (QPCF.Beta.stageOf M E n : ℤ) :=
    hNm₀.trans (by exact_mod_cast hs_ge)
  have htail := pval_sub_pval_eq_tail
    ((St (QPCF.Beta.stageOf M E n)).val A) N
    (QPCF.Beta.stageOf M E n : ℤ) hNs n
  have hcb : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Ioc N (QPCF.Beta.stageOf M E n : ℤ),
      |((((St (QPCF.Beta.stageOf M E n)).val A).coeff k : ℚ) : ℝ)| ≤ M k := by
    intro k hk
    obtain ⟨V, hV⟩ := exists_free_ultrafilter_containing B A.2
      ((St (QPCF.Beta.stageOf M E n)).inf A hAp)
    have heq := (St (QPCF.Beta.stageOf M E n)).agree A hAp V hV k
      (Finset.mem_Ioc.mp hk).2
    rw [← heq, hM k]
    exact abs_coeff_le_coeffBound B F k V
  have hdom := QPCF.Beta.schedule_dominates M
    (fun k => by rw [hM k]; exact (coeffBound_pos B F k).le) E n hn1
  have hbound := QPCF.Beta.tail_sum_bound
    (0 : C(QPCF.Beta.Remainder, ℚ⸨X⸩)) N (QPCF.Beta.stageOf M E n) n M
    (fun k => by rw [hM k]; exact coeffBound_pos B F k) hn1 hdom
    (fun k => (((St (QPCF.Beta.stageOf M E n)).val A).coeff k : ℝ)) hcb
  calc
    |realizedSeq B F St M E n - QPCF.pval (F U) N n| =
        |QPCF.pval ((St (QPCF.Beta.stageOf M E n)).val A)
          (QPCF.Beta.stageOf M E n : ℤ) n -
          QPCF.pval ((St (QPCF.Beta.stageOf M E n)).val A) N n| := by
            rw [ha_eq, hpc]
    _ = |∑ k ∈ Finset.Ioc N (QPCF.Beta.stageOf M E n : ℤ),
          ((((St (QPCF.Beta.stageOf M E n)).val A).coeff k : ℚ) : ℝ) *
            (n : ℝ) ^ (-k)| := by rw [htail]
    _ ≤ C * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(N + 1)) := hbound

name: QPCF.Gamma.Phi_gamma_surjective
statement: theorem Phi_gamma_surjective : Function.Surjective (Phi_gamma B)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro F
  obtain ⟨St, href⟩ := exists_refining_chain B F
  let E : ℕ → ℕ := fun m =>
    if h : St m |>.cofin.toFinset.Nonempty
    then (St m |>.cofin.toFinset).max' h + 1 else 0
  have hE : ∀ m n, E m ≤ n → ∃ A ∈ (St m).pieces, n ∈ A.1 := by
    intro m n hn
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    have hnc : n ∈ (⋃ A ∈ (St m).pieces, A.1)ᶜ := by
      simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_iUnion, exists_prop, not_exists, not_and]
      exact hcon
    have hmem : n ∈ (St m).cofin.toFinset :=
      (Set.Finite.mem_toFinset _).mpr hnc
    have hne : (St m).cofin.toFinset.Nonempty := ⟨n, hmem⟩
    have hle := Finset.le_max' _ n hmem
    simp only [E, dif_pos hne] at hn
    omega
  let a := realizedSeq B F St (fun k => coeffBound B F k) E
  have hgov : GovGamma B F a := fun U => realizedSeq_govAtU B F St href
    (fun k => coeffBound B F k) (fun _ => rfl) E hE U
  let x : SgovGammaSubring B := ⟨a, ⟨F, hgov⟩⟩
  refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
  exact gammaFamily_eq_iff B |>.2 hgov

name: QPCF.Gamma.SGamma_eq_SGovGamma
statement: theorem SGamma_eq_SGovGamma : SGamma B = SGovGamma B
proof:
:= by
  exact Set.Subset.antisymm (SGamma_subset_SGovGamma B)
    (fun a ⟨F, hF⟩ => gamma_forward B F a hF)

name: QPCF.Gamma.gammaGovSet_mem
statement:
theorem gammaGovSet_mem (a : ℕ → ℝ) (U : gammaRemainder B)
    (hU : ResolvedGamma B a U) (K : ℤ) :
    U.1.Mem (gammaGovSet B a U hU K)
proof:
:= by
  exact (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (gamma_admissible_germ_governs B a U
    (gammaGermValue B a U hU) (gammaGermValue_admissible B a U hU) K))).1

name: QPCF.Gamma.gammaGovSet_bound
statement:
theorem gammaGovSet_bound (a : ℕ → ℝ) (U : gammaRemainder B)
    (hU : ResolvedGamma B a U) (K : ℤ) :
    ∀ n ∈ (gammaGovSet B a U hU K).1, 1 ≤ n →
      |a n - QPCF.pval (gammaGermValue B a U hU) K n| ≤
        gammaGovConst B a U hU K * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(K + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hs := (gamma_admissible_germ_governs B a U (gammaGermValue B a U hU) (gammaGermValue_admissible B a U hU) K).choose_spec.choose_spec
  exact hs.2

name: QPCF.Gamma.gamma_coeff_eq_of_governance_intersection
statement:
theorem gamma_coeff_eq_of_governance_intersection
    (a : ℕ → ℝ) (f g : ℚ⸨X⸩) (K : ℤ)
    (Sf Sg : Set ℕ) (hInf : (Sf ∩ Sg).Infinite)
    (Cf Cg : ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ n ∈ Sf, 1 ≤ n →
      |a n - QPCF.pval f K n| ≤ Cf * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(K + 1)))
    (hg : ∀ n ∈ Sg, 1 ≤ n →
      |a n - QPCF.pval g K n| ≤ Cg * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(K + 1))) :
    ∀ k : ℤ, k ≤ K → f.coeff k = g.coeff k
proof:
:= by
  apply part3_coeff_eq_of_common_governance a f g (Sf ∩ Sg)
  · rw [Filter.frequently_atTop]
    intro n
    rcases hInf.exists_gt n with ⟨ m, hm₁, hm₂ ⟩
    exact ⟨ m, hm₂.le, hm₁ ⟩
  · use Cf
    filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop 1] with n hn hSn
    exact hf n hSn.1 hn
  · use Cg
    filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop 1] with n hn hSn
    exact hg n hSn.2 hn

name: QPCF.Gamma.gamma_witness_coherence
statement:
theorem gamma_witness_coherence
    (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha : a ∈ SGamma B)
    (U V : gammaRemainder B) (K : ℤ)
    (g : ℚ⸨X⸩) (hg : GammaAdmissibleGerm B a V g)
    (hmem : V.1.Mem (gammaGovSet B a U (ha U) K)) :
    ∀ k : ℤ, k ≤ K → (gammaGermValue B a U (ha U)).coeff k = g.coeff k
proof:
:= by
  
  have haU : ResolvedGamma B a U := ha U
  have hgU : GammaAdmissibleGerm B a U (gammaGermValue B a U haU) := gammaGermValue_admissible B a U haU
  
  have hgV : GovAtGamma B V g a := gamma_admissible_germ_governs B a V g hg
  
  obtain ⟨Cg, Sg, hSg_mem, hg_bound⟩ := hgV K
  
  have hU_mem : V.1.Mem (gammaGovSet B a U haU K) := hmem
  
  have hV_mem : V.1.Mem (gammaGovSet B a V (ha V) K) := gammaGovSet_mem B a V (ha V) K
  
  have hU_bound : ∀ n ∈ (gammaGovSet B a U haU K).1, 1 ≤ n →
    |a n - QPCF.pval (gammaGermValue B a U haU) K n| ≤
      gammaGovConst B a U haU K * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(K + 1)) :=
    gammaGovSet_bound B a U haU K
  
  have hInter_mem : V.1.Mem ⟨(gammaGovSet B a U haU K).1 ∩ Sg.1, B.inter_mem (gammaGovSet B a U haU K).2 Sg.2⟩ :=
    V.1.inter_mem hU_mem hSg_mem
  
  have hInter_inf : ((gammaGovSet B a U haU K).1 ∩ Sg.1).Infinite := by
    by_contra hFin
    push_neg at hFin
    
    have hFin' : (((gammaGovSet B a U haU K).1 ∩ Sg.1)ᶜ)ᶜ.Finite := by simp; exact hFin
    have hCompl_mem : V.1.Mem ⟨((gammaGovSet B a U haU K).1 ∩ Sg.1)ᶜ, B.compl_mem (B.inter_mem (gammaGovSet B a U haU K).2 Sg.2)⟩ := V.2 _ hFin'
    have hEmpty_mem := V.1.inter_mem hInter_mem hCompl_mem
    simp [Set.inter_compl_self] at hEmpty_mem
    exact V.1.empty_not_mem hEmpty_mem
  exact gamma_coeff_eq_of_governance_intersection a (gammaGermValue B a U haU) g K
    (gammaGovSet B a U haU K).1 Sg.1 hInter_inf
    (gammaGovConst B a U haU K) Cg hU_bound hg_bound

name: QPCF.Gamma.gamma_finite_governance_cover
statement:
theorem gamma_finite_governance_cover
    (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha : a ∈ SGamma B) (K : ℤ) :
    ∃ s : Finset (gammaRemainder B),
      (Set.univ : Set (gammaRemainder B)) ⊆
        ⋃ U ∈ s, basicClopen B (gammaGovSet B a U (ha U) K) ∧
      (⋃ U ∈ s, (gammaGovSet B a U (ha U) K).1)ᶜ.Finite
proof:
:= by
  
  have hcover : Set.univ ⊆ ⋃ U : gammaRemainder B, basicClopen B (gammaGovSet B a U (ha U) K) := by
    intro x _
    simp [basicClopen]
    exact ⟨x, gammaGovSet_mem B a x (ha x) K⟩
  
  have hopen : ∀ U : gammaRemainder B, IsOpen (basicClopen B (gammaGovSet B a U (ha U) K)) :=
    fun U => (basicClopen_isClopen B (gammaGovSet B a U (ha U) K)).2
  
  have hcompact : IsCompact (Set.univ : Set (gammaRemainder B)) := isCompact_univ
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hcompact.elim_finite_subcover (fun U => basicClopen B (gammaGovSet B a U (ha U) K)) hopen hcover
  use t
  exact ⟨ht, cofinite_union_of_basicClopen_cover B t (fun U => gammaGovSet B a U (ha U) K) ht⟩

name: QPCF.Gamma.gamma_per_cutoff_kernel
statement:
theorem gamma_per_cutoff_kernel
    (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha : a ∈ SGamma B) (K : ℤ) :
    ∀ U : gammaRemainder B, ∃ S : BSet B, U.1.Mem S ∧
      ∀ V : gammaRemainder B, V.1.Mem S →
        ∀ g : ℚ⸨X⸩, GammaAdmissibleGerm B a V g →
          ∀ k : ℤ, k ≤ K →
            (gammaGermValue B a U (ha U)).coeff k = g.coeff k
proof:
:= by
  intro U
  use gammaGovSet B a U (ha U) K
  refine ⟨gammaGovSet_mem B a U (ha U) K, ?_⟩
  intro V hV g hg k hk
  exact gamma_witness_coherence B a ha U V K g hg hV k hk

name: QPCF.Gamma.continuous_gammaGermFunction
statement:
theorem continuous_gammaGermFunction (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha : a ∈ SGamma B) :
    Continuous (gammaGermFunction B a ha)
proof:
:= by
  
  
  refine continuous_laurentSeries_of_eventually_coeff_eq_below _ ?_
  intro U K
  obtain ⟨S, hSU, hS⟩ := gamma_per_cutoff_kernel B a ha K U
  filter_upwards [IsOpen.mem_nhds (basicClopen_isClopen B S).isOpen hSU] with V hV
  intro k hk
  exact Eq.symm (hS V hV (gammaGermValue B a V (ha V)) (gammaGermValue_admissible B a V (ha V)) k (le_of_lt hk))

name: QPCF.Gamma.gammaContinuousFamily_governs
statement:
theorem gammaContinuousFamily_governs (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha : a ∈ SGamma B) :
    GovGamma B (gammaContinuousFamily B a ha) a
proof:
:= by
  intro U
  refine fun N => ⟨gammaGovConst B a U (ha U) N, gammaGovSet B a U (ha U) N, gammaGovSet_mem B a U (ha U) N, ?_⟩
  simp only [gammaContinuousFamily]
  exact gammaGovSet_bound B a U (ha U) N

name: QPCF.Gamma.SGamma_subset_SGovGamma
statement: theorem SGamma_subset_SGovGamma : SGamma B ⊆ SGovGamma B
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha
  exact ⟨gammaContinuousFamily B a ha, gammaContinuousFamily_governs B a ha⟩

name: ConverseGov.evalCast_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma evalCast_apply (n : ℕ) (q : Polynomial ℚ) : evalCast n q = pev q n

name: ConverseGov.cont_link
statement:
lemma cont_link (h1 : H1 a p) (m : ℕ) :
    ∀ᶠ n in atTop,
      hC (bR (a n)) m = pev (hC p m) n ∧ kC (bR (a n)) m = pev (kC p m) n ∧
        cqDef (a n) (m + 1)

name: ConverseGov.pev_lower_bound
statement:
lemma pev_lower_bound (q : Polynomial ℚ) (hq : 0 < q.leadingCoeff) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, c * (n : ℝ) ^ q.natDegree ≤ pev q n

name: ConverseGov.real_err_bound
statement:
lemma real_err_bound (h1 : H1 a p) (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ᶠ n in atTop,
      |a n - pev (hC p m) n / pev (kC p m) n| ≤ 1 / (pev (kC p m) n) ^ 2 ∧
        1 / (pev (kC p m) n) ^ 2 ≤ c * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(2 * (edeg p m) : ℤ))

name: ConverseGov.real_err_isBigO
statement:
lemma real_err_isBigO (h1 : H1 a p) (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    (fun n => a n - pev (hC p m) n / pev (kC p m) n)
      =O[atTop] (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) ^ (-(2 * (edeg p m) : ℤ)))

name: ConverseGov.algMap_single
statement: lemma algMap_single (a : ℚ) : (algebraMap ℚ (LaurentSeries ℚ)) a = HahnSeries.single (0:ℤ) a
proof:
:= by
  have h := HahnSeries.algebraMap_apply (Γ := ℤ) (R := ℚ) (A := ℚ) (r := a)
  rw [HahnSeries.C_apply] at h; simpa using h

name: ConverseGov.iota_monomial
statement:
lemma iota_monomial (a : ℚ) (i : ℕ) :
    iota (Polynomial.monomial i a) = HahnSeries.single (-(i:ℤ)) a
proof:
:= by
  show (Polynomial.aeval tinv) (Polynomial.monomial i a) = _
  rw [aeval_monomial, tinv, single_pow, algMap_single, HahnSeries.single_mul_single]; simp

name: ConverseGov.iota_coeff_neg
statement: lemma iota_coeff_neg (P : Polynomial ℚ) (i : ℕ) : (iota P).coeff (-(i:ℤ)) = P.coeff i
proof:
:= by
  induction P using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq => simp [map_add, hp, hq]
  | monomial j a =>
      rw [iota_monomial, HahnSeries.coeff_single, Polynomial.coeff_monomial]
      by_cases h : i = j <;> simp [h] ; omega

name: ConverseGov.iota_coeff_pos
statement: lemma iota_coeff_pos (P : Polynomial ℚ) (k : ℤ) (hk : 0 < k) : (iota P).coeff k = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction P using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq => simp [map_add, hp, hq]
  | monomial j a =>
      rw [iota_monomial, HahnSeries.coeff_single]
      have : k ≠ -(j:ℤ) := by omega
      simp [this]

name: ConverseGov.iota_ne_zero
statement: lemma iota_ne_zero {P : Polynomial ℚ} (hP : P ≠ 0) : iota P ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h; apply hP; ext i
  have := iota_coeff_neg P i; rw [h] at this; simpa using this.symm

name: ConverseGov.iota_coeff_eq
statement:
lemma iota_coeff_eq (P : Polynomial ℚ) (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≤ 0) :
    (iota P).coeff k = P.coeff (-k).toNat
proof:
:= by
  have hk' : k = -(((-k).toNat : ℤ)) := by omega
  calc (iota P).coeff k = (iota P).coeff (-(((-k).toNat:ℤ))) := by rw [← hk']
    _ = P.coeff (-k).toNat := iota_coeff_neg P _

name: ConverseGov.iota_order
statement: lemma iota_order {P : Polynomial ℚ} (hP : P ≠ 0) : (iota P).order = -(P.natDegree : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply HahnSeries.order_le_of_coeff_ne_zero (g := -(P.natDegree : ℤ))
    rw [iota_coeff_neg]; exact Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hP
  · by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    have hcoeff := HahnSeries.coeff_order_ne_zero (iota_ne_zero hP)
    have hle0 : (iota P).order ≤ 0 :=
      le_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le h (neg_nonpos.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _)))
    rw [iota_coeff_eq _ _ hle0] at hcoeff
    exact hcoeff (Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (by omega))

name: ConverseGov.v_eq_exp_neg_order
statement:
theorem v_eq_exp_neg_order (x : LaurentSeries ℚ) (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    Valued.v x = WithZero.exp (- x.order)
proof:
:= by
  have hne : Valued.v x ≠ 0 := (Valuation.ne_zero_iff Valued.v).mpr hx
  have hle : Valued.v x ≤ WithZero.exp (- x.order) := by
    rw [LaurentSeries.valuation_le_iff_coeff_lt_eq_zero]; intro k hk
    exact HahnSeries.coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_order hk
  have hgt : ¬ Valued.v x ≤ WithZero.exp (-(x.order + 1)) := by
    rw [LaurentSeries.valuation_le_iff_coeff_lt_eq_zero]; push_neg
    exact ⟨x.order, by omega, HahnSeries.coeff_order_ne_zero hx⟩
  set j := (Valued.v x).log with hj
  have hexp : WithZero.exp j = Valued.v x := WithZero.exp_log hne
  rw [← hexp] at hle hgt ⊢
  rw [WithZero.exp_le_exp] at hle; rw [WithZero.exp_le_exp] at hgt; push_neg at hgt
  have : j = - x.order := by omega
  rw [this]

name: ConverseGov.v_iota
statement:
lemma v_iota {P : Polynomial ℚ} (hP : P ≠ 0) :
    Valued.v (iota P) = WithZero.exp (P.natDegree : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [v_eq_exp_neg_order _ (iota_ne_zero hP), iota_order hP, neg_neg]

name: ConverseGov.v_lt_exp_succ_le
statement:
lemma v_lt_exp_succ_le {x : LaurentSeries ℚ} {m : ℤ}
    (h : Valued.v x < WithZero.exp (m + 1)) : Valued.v x ≤ WithZero.exp m
proof:
:= by
  grind +suggestions

name: ConverseGov.iota_kC_ne
statement:
lemma iota_kC_ne (hlead : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → 0 < (p m).leadingCoeff) (m : ℕ) :

proof: := iota_ne_zero (Q_ne_zero hlead m)

      WithZero.exp (-((edeg p (j + 1) : ℤ) + (edeg p j : ℤ)))

        ∀ᶠ j in atTop, Valued.v (g j) < (γ : WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))) :

statement:
lemma Lm_cauchy (hlead : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → 0 < (p m).leadingCoeff) (hH2 : H2 p) :

name: ConverseGov.cq_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma cq_zero (y : ℝ) : cq y 0 = y
proof: := rfl

name: ConverseGov.cq_succ
statement: lemma cq_succ (y : ℝ) (m : ℕ) : cq y (m + 1) = 1 / Int.fract (cq y m)
proof: := rfl

name: ConverseGov.cqDef_mono
statement: lemma cqDef_mono {y : ℝ} {M M' : ℕ} (h : cqDef y M) (hle : M' ≤ M) : cqDef y M'
proof:
:=
  fun j hj => h j (lt_of_lt_of_le hj hle)

name: ConverseGov.cq_gt_one
statement: lemma cq_gt_one {y : ℝ} {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hdef : cqDef y m) : 1 < cq y m

name: ConverseGov.PQ_ge_one
statement: lemma PQ_ge_one {y : ℝ} {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hdef : cqDef y m) : 1 ≤ PQ y m
proof:
:= by
  have := cq_gt_one hm hdef
