name: ConverseGov.kC_pos
statement:
lemma kC_pos {y : ℝ} {m : ℕ} (hdef : cqDef y m) :
    0 ≤ kP (bR y) m ∧ 1 ≤ kC (bR y) m

name: ConverseGov.fund
statement:
lemma fund {y : ℝ} {m : ℕ} (hdef : cqDef y (m + 1)) :
    y = (cq y (m + 1) * hC (bR y) m + hP (bR y) m) /
        (cq y (m + 1) * kC (bR y) m + kP (bR y) m)

name: ConverseGov.fund_denom_pos
statement:
lemma fund_denom_pos {y : ℝ} {m : ℕ} (hdef : cqDef y (m + 1)) :
    0 < cq y (m + 1) * kC (bR y) m + kP (bR y) m

name: ConverseGov.err_eq
statement:
lemma err_eq {y : ℝ} {m : ℕ} (hdef : cqDef y (m + 1)) :
    y - hC (bR y) m / kC (bR y) m =
      (-1) ^ m / (kC (bR y) m * (cq y (m + 1) * kC (bR y) m + kP (bR y) m))

name: ConverseGov.err_bound
statement:
lemma err_bound {y : ℝ} {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hdef : cqDef y (m + 1)) :
    |y - hC (bR y) m / kC (bR y) m| ≤ 1 / (kC (bR y) m) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [ err_eq hdef, abs_div ] ; norm_num [ abs_mul, abs_pow ] ; (
  rw [ ← mul_inv ] ; gcongr ; ring ; (
  exact sq_pos_of_pos ( by linarith [ kC_pos ( show cqDef y m from fun j hj => hdef j ( by linarith ) ) ] ));
  rw [ ← abs_mul ] ; ring_nf at * ; (
  rw [ abs_of_nonneg ] <;> have := kC_pos ( show cqDef y m from cqDef_mono hdef ( by linarith ) ) <;> norm_num at * <;> nlinarith [ show ( 1 : ℝ ) ≤ kC ( bR y ) m from mod_cast this.2, show ( 1 : ℝ ) ≤ cq y ( 1 + m ) from mod_cast cq_gt_one ( by linarith ) ( show cqDef y ( 1 + m ) from hdef ) |> le_of_lt ] ;))

name: ConverseGov.truncSum_congr
ConverseGov.tail_isBigO
statement:
lemma tail_isBigO (U V : Polynomial ℚ) (hV : 0 < V.leadingCoeff) (N : ℤ) :
    (fun n : ℕ => pev U n / pev V n - truncSum (iota U / iota V) N n)
      =O[atTop] (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) ^ (-(N + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  have := tail_core (U := U) (V := V) hV N
  simpa [truncSum, Rser] using this

name: ConverseGov.Lm_eq
statement: lemma Lm_eq (m : ℕ) : Lm p m = iota (hC p m) / iota (kC p m)
proof: := rfl

name: ConverseGov.governance_holds
statement:
lemma governance_holds {a : ℕ → ℝ} (h1 : H1 a p) (hH2 : H2 p)
    {F : LaurentSeries ℚ}
    (hFcoeff : ∀ m, ∀ k : ℤ, k < (edeg p m : ℤ) + (edeg p (m + 1) : ℤ) →
        F.coeff k = (Lm p m).coeff k) :

name: QPCF.C4_error_bigOpowOn
statement:
theorem C4_error_bigOpowOn (a : ℕ → ℝ) (d : CorrectedDef32 a) (k : ℕ)
    (r : ZMod (d.D (k + 2))) :
    ∃ (Pk Qk : Polynomial ℚ), Qk ≠ 0 ∧
      BigOpowOn {n : ℕ | ((n : ℕ) : ZMod (d.D (k + 2))) = r}
        (fun n => a n - ((Pk.eval ((n : ℕ) : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) / ((Qk.eval ((n : ℕ) : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ))
        (-(2 * (Qk.natDegree : ℤ)))

name: QPCF.C4_convergent_governs_on_class
statement:
theorem C4_convergent_governs_on_class (a : ℕ → ℝ) (d : CorrectedDef32 a) (k : ℕ)
    (r : ZMod (d.D (k + 2))) :
    ∃ (g : ℚ⸨X⸩) (e : ℤ),
      ∀ N : ℤ, N < e →
        BigOpowOn {n : ℕ | ((n : ℕ) : ZMod (d.D (k + 2))) = r}
          (fun n => a n - pval g N n) (-(N + 1))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Pk, Qk, hQk0, herr⟩ := C4_error_bigOpowOn a d k r
  obtain ⟨g, hg, _⟩ := ratSeq_governs Pk Qk hQk0
  refine ⟨g, 2 * (Qk.natDegree : ℤ), ?_⟩
  intro N hN
  have hfirst : BigOpowOn {n : ℕ | ((n : ℕ) : ZMod (d.D (k + 2))) = r}
      (fun n => a n - ((Pk.eval ((n : ℕ) : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) / ((Qk.eval ((n : ℕ) : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ))
      (-(N + 1)) :=
    herr.mono (by omega)
  have hsecond : BigOpowOn {n : ℕ | ((n : ℕ) : ZMod (d.D (k + 2))) = r}
      (fun n => ((Pk.eval ((n : ℕ) : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) / ((Qk.eval ((n : ℕ) : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) - pval g N n)
      (-(N + 1)) :=
    (hg N).toOn _
  have hsum := hfirst.add hsecond
  have key : (fun n => a n - pval g N n)
      = fun n => (a n - ((Pk.eval ((n : ℕ) : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) / ((Qk.eval ((n : ℕ) : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ))
          + (((Pk.eval ((n : ℕ) : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) / ((Qk.eval ((n : ℕ) : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) - pval g N n) := by
    funext n; ring
  rw [key]; exact hsum

name: QPCF.coeff_eq_zero_of_pval_bigOpowOn
statement:
theorem coeff_eq_zero_of_pval_bigOpowOn {S : Set ℕ} (hS : ∃ᶠ n in atTop, n ∈ S)
    {h : ℚ⸨X⸩} {e : ℤ}
    (H : ∀ N : ℤ, N < e → BigOpowOn S (fun n => pval h N n) (-(N + 1))) :
    ∀ m : ℤ, m < e → h.coeff m = 0
proof:
:= by
  contrapose! hS; contrapose! H; simp_all +decide [ BigOpowOn ] ;
  
  obtain ⟨m, hm₁, hm₂⟩ : ∃ m < e, ¬h.coeff m = 0 ∧ ∀ k < m, h.coeff k = 0 := by
    have h_min : ∃ m ∈ {m : ℤ | m < e ∧ ¬h.coeff m = 0}, ∀ k ∈ {m : ℤ | m < e ∧ ¬h.coeff m = 0}, m ≤ k := by
      apply_rules [ Int.exists_least_of_bdd ];
      exact ⟨ h.order, fun z hz => HahnSeries.order_le_of_coeff_ne_zero hz.2 ⟩
    generalize_proofs at *; (
    exact ⟨ h_min.choose, h_min.choose_spec.1.1, h_min.choose_spec.1.2, fun k hk => Classical.not_not.1 fun hk' => not_lt_of_ge ( h_min.choose_spec.2 k ⟨ by linarith [ h_min.choose_spec.1.1 ], hk' ⟩ ) hk ⟩)
  use m
  generalize_proofs at *; (
  
  have hpval : ∀ n ≥ 1, pval h m n = (h.coeff m : ℝ) * (n:ℝ)^(-m) := by
    intro n hn; rw [ pval_eq_finset_sum ] ; simp +decide [ hm₂ ] ;
    rw [ Finset.sum_eq_single m ] <;> simp_all +decide [ HahnSeries.order_le_of_coeff_ne_zero ] ; (
    exact fun k hk₁ hk₂ hk₃ => Or.inl <| hm₂.2 k <| lt_of_le_of_ne hk₂ hk₃;)
  generalize_proofs at *; (
  have h_abs : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => |(h.coeff m : ℝ) * (n : ℝ)^(-m)| / (n : ℝ)^(-1 + -m)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop := by
    have h_abs : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => |(h.coeff m : ℝ)| * (n : ℝ)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop := by
      exact Filter.Tendsto.const_mul_atTop ( abs_pos.mpr ( by simpa using hm₂.1 ) ) tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
    generalize_proofs at *; (
    refine h_abs.congr' ?_ ; filter_upwards [ Filter.eventually_gt_atTop 0 ] with n hn ; norm_num [ abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg, hn.ne', zpow_add₀, zpow_neg, hn.le ] ; ring;
    norm_num [ hn.ne', zpow_ne_zero ])
  generalize_proofs at *; (
  have := h_abs.eventually_gt_atTop; simp_all +decide [ Filter.frequently_atTop ] ;
  intro c n; rcases this c with ⟨ a, ha ⟩ ; rcases H ( n + a + 1 ) with ⟨ b, hb₁, hb₂ ⟩ ; use b; simp_all +decide [ div_lt_iff₀, abs_mul, abs_inv ] ;
  exact ⟨ by linarith, by rw [ hpval b ( by linarith ) ] ; have := ha b ( by linarith ) ; rw [ lt_div_iff₀ ( by exact zpow_pos ( by norm_cast; linarith ) _ ) ] at this; simpa [ abs_mul, abs_inv ] using this ⟩ ;)))

name: ConverseGov.contPair_congr
statement:
lemma contPair_congr {b b' : ℕ → A} {m : ℕ} (h : ∀ j ≤ m, b j = b' j) :
    contPair b m = contPair b' m
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp [contPair, h 0 (le_refl 0)]
  | succ k ih =>
      have hk : ∀ j ≤ k, b j = b' j := fun j hj => h j (Nat.le_succ_of_le hj)
      simp only [contPair, ih hk, h (k+1) (le_refl _)]

name: ConverseGov.hC_congr
statement: lemma hC_congr {b b' : ℕ → A} {m : ℕ} (h : ∀ j ≤ m, b j = b' j) : hC b m = hC b' m
proof:
:= by
  simp [hC, contPair_congr h]

name: ConverseGov.kC_congr
statement: lemma kC_congr {b b' : ℕ → A} {m : ℕ} (h : ∀ j ≤ m, b j = b' j) : kC b m = kC b' m
proof:
:= by
  simp [kC, contPair_congr h]

name: ConverseGov.v_single_one
statement:
lemma v_single_one (a : ℤ) :
    Valued.v (HahnSeries.single a (1 : ℚ) : LaurentSeries ℚ) = WithZero.exp (-a)

name: ConverseGov.RmS_coeff_zero
statement: lemma RmS_coeff_zero (N : ℤ) : ∀ k : ℤ, k ≤ N → (Rser U V - Sser U V N).coeff k = 0

name: ConverseGov.v_RmS
statement: lemma v_RmS (N : ℤ) : Valued.v (Rser U V - Sser U V N) ≤ WithZero.exp (-(N + 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [LaurentSeries.valuation_le_iff_coeff_lt_eq_zero]
  intro k hk
  exact RmS_coeff_zero N k (by omega)

name: ConverseGov.iota_Apoly
statement:
lemma iota_Apoly (N : ℤ) :
    iota (Apoly U V N) = HahnSeries.single (-N) 1 * Sser U V N

name: ConverseGov.iota_U_eq
statement: lemma iota_U_eq (hV : V ≠ 0) : iota U = iota V * Rser U V
proof:
:= by
  rw [Rser, mul_div_cancel₀]
  exact iota_ne_zero hV

name: ConverseGov.iota_Bpoly
statement:
lemma iota_Bpoly (hV : V ≠ 0) (N : ℤ) :
    iota (Bpoly U V N) =
      HahnSeries.single (-(N + (shift N : ℤ))) 1 * (iota V * (Rser U V - Sser U V N))

name: ConverseGov.v_Bpoly
statement:
lemma v_Bpoly (hV : V ≠ 0) (N : ℤ) :
    Valued.v (iota (Bpoly U V N)) ≤ WithZero.exp ((V.natDegree : ℤ) + (shift N : ℤ) - 1)

name: ConverseGov.Bpoly_coeff_zero
statement:
lemma Bpoly_coeff_zero (hV : V ≠ 0) (N : ℤ) :
    ∀ i : ℕ, V.natDegree + shift N ≤ i → (Bpoly U V N).coeff i = 0

name: ConverseGov.pev_isBigO_of_coeff_zero
statement:
lemma pev_isBigO_of_coeff_zero (W : Polynomial ℚ) (M : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ i : ℕ, M ≤ i → W.coeff i = 0) :
    (fun n : ℕ => pev W n) =O[atTop] (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) ^ ((M : ℤ) - 1))

name: ConverseGov.real_identity
statement:
lemma real_identity (N : ℤ) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hV : pev V n ≠ 0) :
    pev U n / pev V n -
        (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc (Rser U V).order N, (((Rser U V).coeff k : ℚ) : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) ^ (-k)) =
      pev (Bpoly U V N) n / ((n : ℝ) ^ (N + (shift N : ℤ)) * pev V n)

name: ConverseGov.tail_core
statement:
lemma tail_core (hV : 0 < V.leadingCoeff) (N : ℤ) :
    (fun n : ℕ => pev U n / pev V n -
        (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc (Rser U V).order N, (((Rser U V).coeff k : ℚ) : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) ^ (-k)))
      =O[atTop] (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) ^ (-(N + 1)))

name: ConverseGov.leadingCoeff_add_pos
statement:
lemma leadingCoeff_add_pos {f g : Polynomial ℚ} (hf : 0 < f.leadingCoeff)
    (hg : 0 < g.leadingCoeff) (hdeg : g.natDegree ≤ f.natDegree) :
    0 < (f + g).leadingCoeff ∧ (f + g).natDegree = f.natDegree

name: ConverseGov.Q_lead_deg
statement:
lemma Q_lead_deg (hlead : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → 0 < (p m).leadingCoeff) (m : ℕ) :
    0 < (kC p m).leadingCoeff ∧
      (kC p m).natDegree = ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 m, (p j).natDegree

name: ConverseGov.Q_lead_pos
statement:
lemma Q_lead_pos (hlead : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → 0 < (p m).leadingCoeff) (m : ℕ) :
    0 < (kC p m).leadingCoeff
proof: := (Q_lead_deg hlead m).1

name: ConverseGov.Q_natDegree
statement:
lemma Q_natDegree (hlead : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → 0 < (p m).leadingCoeff) (m : ℕ) :
    (kC p m).natDegree = ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 m, (p j).natDegree
proof: := (Q_lead_deg hlead m).2

name: ConverseGov.Q_ne_zero
statement:
lemma Q_ne_zero (hlead : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → 0 < (p m).leadingCoeff) (m : ℕ) :
    kC p m ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have := Q_lead_pos hlead m
  intro h
  rw [h] at this
  simp at this

name: ConverseGov.Q_natDegree_mono
statement:
lemma Q_natDegree_mono (hlead : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → 0 < (p m).leadingCoeff) :
    Monotone (fun m => (kC p m).natDegree)

name: ConverseGov.deg_to_infty
statement:
lemma deg_to_infty (hlead : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → 0 < (p m).leadingCoeff)
    (hH2 : {m : ℕ | 1 ≤ (p m).natDegree}.Infinite) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun m => (kC p m).natDegree) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop

name: QPCF.part3_canonical_tracking
statement:
theorem part3_canonical_tracking (a : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ZHat)
    (hA : ∀ m : ℕ, ArmA' a t m) (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ M : ℕ,
      (∀ j ≤ m, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ∈ ThreadClass t M →
        realPQ j (a n) = (((part3CanonicalPQ a t hA j).eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)) ∧
      (∀ j ≤ m, ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → n ∈ ThreadClass t M →
        ∃ z : ℤ, (part3CanonicalPQ a t hA j).eval (n : ℚ) = (z : ℚ)) ∧
      (∀ j ≤ m, 1 ≤ j → ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
        n ∈ ThreadClass t M → 1 ≤ (part3CanonicalPQ a t hA j).eval (n : ℚ))

name: QPCF.part3_canonical_leadingCoeff_pos
statement:
theorem part3_canonical_leadingCoeff_pos (a : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ZHat)
    (hA : ∀ m : ℕ, ArmA' a t m) (j : ℕ) (hj : 1 ≤ j) :
    0 < (part3CanonicalPQ a t hA j).leadingCoeff

name: QPCF.part3_continuant_denominator_degree
statement:
theorem part3_continuant_denominator_degree (a : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ZHat)
    (hA : ∀ m : ℕ, ArmA' a t m) (m : ℕ) :
    0 < (polyContDen (part3CanonicalPQ a t hA) (m + 1)).leadingCoeff ∧
      (polyContDen (part3CanonicalPQ a t hA) (m + 1)).natDegree =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, (part3CanonicalPQ a t hA (j + 1)).natDegree
proof:
:= by
  exact polyContDen_natDegree_of_leadingCoeff_pos _
    (part3_canonical_leadingCoeff_pos a t hA) m

name: QPCF.part3_continuant_denominator_degree_unbounded
statement:
theorem part3_continuant_denominator_degree_unbounded (a : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ZHat)
    (hA : ∀ m : ℕ, ArmA' a t m) (hC : CondC a t) (B : ℕ) :
    ∃ m : ℕ, B ≤ (polyContDen (part3CanonicalPQ a t hA) (m + 1)).natDegree

name: QPCF.part3_continuant_determinant
statement:
theorem part3_continuant_determinant (p : ℕ → Polynomial ℚ) (m : ℕ) :
    polyContNum p (m + 1) * polyContDen p (m + 2) -
      polyContNum p (m + 2) * polyContDen p (m + 1) = (-1) ^ (m + 1)

name: QPCF.part3_polyExpansion_add
statement:
theorem part3_polyExpansion_add (P Q : Polynomial ℚ) :
    polyExpansion (P + Q) = polyExpansion P + polyExpansion Q
proof:
:= by
  apply Governs.unique (polyExpansion_governs (P + Q))
  simpa only [Polynomial.eval_add, Rat.cast_add] using
    (polyExpansion_governs P).add (polyExpansion_governs Q)

name: QPCF.part3_polyExpansion_mul
statement:
theorem part3_polyExpansion_mul (P Q : Polynomial ℚ) :
    polyExpansion (P * Q) = polyExpansion P * polyExpansion Q
proof:
:= by
  apply Governs.unique (polyExpansion_governs (P * Q))
  simpa only [Polynomial.eval_mul, Rat.cast_mul] using
    (polyExpansion_governs P).mul (polyExpansion_governs Q)

name: QPCF.part3_polyExpansion_neg
statement:
theorem part3_polyExpansion_neg (P : Polynomial ℚ) :
    polyExpansion (-P) = -polyExpansion P
proof:
:= by
  apply Governs.unique (polyExpansion_governs (-P))
  simpa only [Polynomial.eval_neg, Rat.cast_neg] using
    (polyExpansion_governs P).neg

name: QPCF.part3_consecutive_coeff_eq
statement:
theorem part3_consecutive_coeff_eq
    (a : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ZHat) (hA : ∀ m : ℕ, ArmA' a t m) (m : ℕ) (i : ℤ)
    (hi : i < (polyContDen (part3CanonicalPQ a t hA) (m + 1)).natDegree +
      (polyContDen (part3CanonicalPQ a t hA) (m + 2)).natDegree) :
    (part3ArmAConvergent a t hA (m + 1)).coeff i =
      (part3ArmAConvergent a t hA m).coeff i

name: QPCF.part3_convergents_eventually_coeff_eq
statement:
theorem part3_convergents_eventually_coeff_eq
    (a : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ZHat) (hA : ∀ m : ℕ, ArmA' a t m) (hC : CondC a t)
    (D : ℤ) : ∃ M : ℕ, ∀ m ≥ M, ∀ n ≥ M, ∀ i < D,
      (part3ArmAConvergent a t hA m).coeff i =
        (part3ArmAConvergent a t hA n).coeff i

name: QPCF.part3_germ_limit_cauchy
statement:
theorem part3_germ_limit_cauchy (a : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ZHat)
    (hA : ∀ m : ℕ, ArmA' a t m) (hC : CondC a t) :
    CauchySeq (part3ArmAConvergent a t hA)

name: QPCF.part3_germ_limit
statement:
theorem part3_germ_limit (a : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ZHat)
    (hA : ∀ m : ℕ, ArmA' a t m) (hC : CondC a t) :
    ∃ g : ℚ⸨X⸩, Tendsto (part3ArmAConvergent a t hA) atTop (𝓝 g)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ : ∃ g : ℚ⸨X⸩, Filter.Tendsto (part3ArmAConvergent a t hA) Filter.atTop (nhds g) := by
    have h_cauchy : CauchySeq (part3ArmAConvergent a t hA) := part3_germ_limit_cauchy a t hA hC
    exact cauchy_iff_exists_le_nhds.mp h_cauchy
  use g

name: QPCF.part3_germ_eventually_coeff_eq
statement:
theorem part3_germ_eventually_coeff_eq (a : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ZHat)
    (hA : ∀ m : ℕ, ArmA' a t m) (hC : CondC a t) (D : ℤ) :
    ∃ M : ℕ, ∀ m ≥ M, ∀ i < D,
      (Classical.choose (part3_germ_limit a t hA hC)).coeff i =
        (part3ArmAConvergent a t hA m).coeff i

name: QPCF.part3_armB_germ_governs
statement:
theorem part3_armB_germ_governs (a : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ZHat)
    (P Q : Polynomial ℚ) (hQ : Q ≠ 0)
    (hflat : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ M : ℕ, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ∈ ThreadClass t M →
      Q.eval (n : ℚ) ≠ 0 ∧
      |a n - (((P.eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) / ((Q.eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ))| ≤
        (n : ℝ) ^ (-(k : ℤ))) :
    GovAt t (polyExpansion P * (polyExpansion Q)⁻¹) a

name: QPCF.part3_real_error_of_positive_pq
statement:
theorem part3_real_error_of_positive_pq (x : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (hpos : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ m + 1 → 1 ≤ realPQ j x) :

name: QPCF.part3_real_convergent_error
statement:
theorem part3_real_convergent_error (a : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ZHat)
    (hA : ∀ m : ℕ, ArmA' a t m) (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ M : ℕ, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ∈ ThreadClass t M →
      |a n -
        (((polyContNum (part3CanonicalPQ a t hA) (m + 1)).eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) /
        (((polyContDen (part3CanonicalPQ a t hA) (m + 1)).eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)| ≤
      1 / ((((polyContDen (part3CanonicalPQ a t hA) (m + 1)).eval
        (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) ^ 2)

name: QPCF.part3_convergent_governs_to_degree
statement:
theorem part3_convergent_governs_to_degree (a : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ZHat)
    (hA : ∀ m : ℕ, ArmA' a t m) (m : ℕ) (N : ℤ)
    (hN : N + 1 ≤ 2 *
      (polyContDen (part3CanonicalPQ a t hA) (m + 1)).natDegree) :
    ∃ M : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ∈ ThreadClass t M →
      |a n - pval (part3ArmAConvergent a t hA m) N n| ≤
        C * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(N + 1))

name: QPCF.part3_armA_germ_governs
statement:
theorem part3_armA_germ_governs (a : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ZHat)
    (hA : ∀ m : ℕ, ArmA' a t m) (hC : CondC a t) :
    GovAt t (part3ArmAGerm a t hA hC) a

name: QPCF.Governs.governsUpTo
statement:
theorem Governs.governsUpTo {f : ℚ⸨X⸩} {a : ℕ → ℝ} (h : Governs f a) (K : ℤ) :
    GovernsUpTo K f a
proof: := fun N _ => h N

name: QPCF.full_stability_i_floor_finite
statement:
theorem full_stability_i_floor_finite (a : ℕ → ℝ) (L : ℚ⸨X⸩)
    (D K : ℕ) (hgu : GovernsUpTo (K : ℤ) L a)
    (M s q : ℕ → ℕ) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hq0 : q 0 ≤ K + 1)
    (hne : ∀ m < D, fFract L m ≠ 0)
    (hs : ∀ m < D, (fFract L m).order = (s m : ℤ))
    (hsK : ∀ m < D, s m ≤ K)
    (hs1 : ∀ m < D, 1 ≤ s m)
    (hq : ∀ m ≤ D, 2 * M m < q m)
    (hqstep : ∀ m < D, q (m + 1) + 2 * M m ≤ q m)
    (hqK : ∀ m < D, q (m + 1) + s m + M m ≤ K + 1)
    (hint : ∀ m ≤ D, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      ∃ z : ℤ, pval (fFloor L m) (K : ℤ) n = (z : ℝ))
    (hnondeg : ∀ m ≤ D, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      c / (n : ℝ) ^ M m ≤ pval (fFract L m) (K : ℤ) n ∧
        pval (fFract L m) (K : ℤ) n ≤ 1 - c / (n : ℝ) ^ M m) :
    ∀ m ≤ D, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      realPQ m (a n) = (⌊pval (gaussIter m L) (K : ℤ) n⌋ : ℝ)

name: QPCF.full_stability_i_finite
statement:
theorem full_stability_i_finite (a : ℕ → ℝ) (L : ℚ⸨X⸩)
    (D K : ℕ) (hgu : GovernsUpTo (K : ℤ) L a)
    (M s q : ℕ → ℕ) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hq0 : q 0 ≤ K + 1)
    (hne : ∀ m < D, fFract L m ≠ 0)
    (hs : ∀ m < D, (fFract L m).order = (s m : ℤ))
    (hsK : ∀ m < D, s m ≤ K)
    (hs1 : ∀ m < D, 1 ≤ s m)
    (hq : ∀ m ≤ D, 2 * M m < q m)
    (hqstep : ∀ m < D, q (m + 1) + 2 * M m ≤ q m)
    (hqK : ∀ m < D, q (m + 1) + s m + M m ≤ K + 1)
    (hint : ∀ m ≤ D, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      ∃ z : ℤ, pval (fFloor L m) (K : ℤ) n = (z : ℝ))
    (hnondeg : ∀ m ≤ D, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      c / (n : ℝ) ^ M m ≤ pval (fFract L m) (K : ℤ) n ∧
        pval (fFract L m) (K : ℤ) n ≤ 1 - c / (n : ℝ) ^ M m) :
    ∀ m ≤ D, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      realPQ m (a n) = pval (formalPartialQuotient m L) (K : ℤ) n

name: QPCF.finiteDepthCounterexample_nondeg
statement:
theorem finiteDepthCounterexample_nondeg :
    CFNondegThrough finiteDepthCounterexampleSeries 1

name: QPCF.finiteDepthCounterexampleSeries_eq_ratExpansion
statement:
theorem finiteDepthCounterexampleSeries_eq_ratExpansion :
    finiteDepthCounterexampleSeries =
      polyExpansion ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℚ) - 2) *
        (polyExpansion (2 * (Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℚ)))⁻¹

name: QPCF.finiteDepthCounterexampleSeq_eq_ratSeq
statement:
theorem finiteDepthCounterexampleSeq_eq_ratSeq (n : ℕ) :
    finiteDepthCounterexampleSeq n =
      (((((Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℚ) - 2).eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) /
        (((2 * (Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℚ)).eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ))

name: QPCF.finiteDepthCounterexample_governs
statement:
theorem finiteDepthCounterexample_governs :
    Governs finiteDepthCounterexampleSeries finiteDepthCounterexampleSeq
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteDepthCounterexampleSeries_eq_ratExpansion]
  convert ratSeq_governs_expansion ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℚ) - 2)
    (2 * (Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℚ)) (by simp) using 1
  ext n
  exact finiteDepthCounterexampleSeq_eq_ratSeq n

name: QPCF.finiteDepthCounterexample_realPQ_one
statement:
theorem finiteDepthCounterexample_realPQ_one :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, realPQ 1 (finiteDepthCounterexampleSeq n) = 2

name: QPCF.finiteDepthCounterexample_not_armA
statement:
theorem finiteDepthCounterexample_not_armA (t : ZHat) :
    ¬ RetiredArmA finiteDepthCounterexampleSeq t 1

name: QPCF.realPQ_quasiPoly_caseA_onClass_nondeg_is_false
statement:
theorem realPQ_quasiPoly_caseA_onClass_nondeg_is_false :
    ∃ (F : C(ZHat, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ZHat),
      GovC F a ∧ CFNondegThrough (F t) 1 ∧ ¬ RetiredArmA a t 1
proof:
:= by
  let F : C(ZHat, ℚ⸨X⸩) :=
    ⟨fun _ => finiteDepthCounterexampleSeries, continuous_const⟩
  refine ⟨F, finiteDepthCounterexampleSeq, ZHat.ofNat 0, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro N
    simpa [F] using finiteDepthCounterexample_governs N
  · exact finiteDepthCounterexample_nondeg
  · exact finiteDepthCounterexample_not_armA _

name: QPCF.rnReciprocalError_eventually_neg_of_c5_zero

name: QPCF.sweepNaiveFract_eq
statement:

name: QPCF.lemma_B_usp

    (Fa Fb : X → ℚ⸨X⸩)
    (hirrA : ∀ x, ¬ IsRat (Fa x)) (hirrB : ∀ x, ¬ IsRat (Fb x))
    (hlcSum : ∀ j, IsLocallyConstant (fun x => edeg (Fa x + Fb x) j))
    (hlcA : ∀ j, IsLocallyConstant (fun x => edeg (Fa x) j))
    (hlcB : ∀ j, IsLocallyConstant (fun x => edeg (Fb x) j))

:=
  lemma_6_3 Fa Fb hirrA hirrB hlcSum hlcA hlcB J

name: QPCF.lemma_B_mult

    (IsRat (f * g) ↔ ∃ r : RatFunc ℚ, g = (r : ℚ⸨X⸩) * f⁻¹) ∧

    (IsRat (f * g) → IsRat f → IsRat g)
proof:

    fun hfg hg => isRat_of_mul_right hfg hg hg0,

name: QPCF.formal_stability_i_governs_on_finite
statement:
theorem formal_stability_i_governs_on_finite (S : Set ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (L : ℚ⸨X⸩)
    (K : ℤ) (D : ℕ) (M Nsched : ℕ → ℕ) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hK : (Nsched 0 : ℤ) - 1 ≤ K) (hgu : GovernsUpToOn K S L a)
    (hbud : ∀ m ≤ D, 2 * M m < Nsched m)
    (hsched : ∀ m, m < D → Nsched (m + 1) + 2 * M m ≤ Nsched m)
    (hnondeg : ∀ m ≤ D, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ∈ S →
      c / (n : ℝ) ^ M m ≤ Int.fract (realGaussIter m (pval L ((Nsched 0 : ℤ) - 1) n)) ∧
        Int.fract (realGaussIter m (pval L ((Nsched 0 : ℤ) - 1) n)) ≤ 1 - c / (n : ℝ) ^ M m) :
    ∀ m ≤ D, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ∈ S →
      realPQ m (a n) = (⌊realGaussIter m (pval L ((Nsched 0 : ℤ) - 1) n)⌋ : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀⟩ : ∃ C₀ : ℝ, ∀ᶠ n in atTop, n ∈ S →
      |a n - pval L ((Nsched 0 : ℤ) - 1) n| ≤ C₀ / (n : ℝ) ^ Nsched 0 := by
    convert hgu ((Nsched 0 : ℤ) - 1) hK using 1
    unfold BigOpowOn; aesop
  have hC₂ : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ∈ S →
      |a n - pval L (↑(Nsched 0) - 1) n| ≤ max C₀ 0 / (n : ℝ) ^ Nsched 0 := by
    filter_upwards [hC₀] with n hn hn' using le_trans (hn hn') (by gcongr; norm_num)
  have := formal_stability_i_on (l := atTop ⊓ 𝓟 S) (inf_le_left) a
    (fun n => pval L (↑(Nsched 0) - 1) n) D M Nsched c (max C₀ 0) hc (le_max_right _ _)
    hbud hsched ?_ ?_ <;> simp_all +decide [Filter.eventually_inf_principal]

name: QPCF.govUpToOn_of_govC_agree
statement:
theorem govUpToOn_of_govC_agree (F : C(ZHat, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (hgov : GovC F a)
    (K : ℤ) (S : Set ℕ) (L₀ : ℚ⸨X⸩)
    (hagree : ∀ n ∈ S, ∀ k : ℤ, k ≤ K → (F (ZHat.ofNat n)).coeff k = L₀.coeff k) :
    GovernsUpToOn K S L₀ a
proof:
:= by
  intro N hNK
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hgov N
  refine ⟨C, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hC] with n hn hnS
  have hpv : pval (F (ZHat.ofNat n)) N n = pval L₀ N n := by
    rw [pval_congr]
    intro k hk
    exact hagree n hnS k (le_trans hk hNK)
  rw [← hpv]; exact hn

name: QPCF.realPQ_quasiPoly_caseA_onClass
statement:
theorem realPQ_quasiPoly_caseA_onClass
    (F : C(ZHat, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (hgov : GovC F a)
    (r : ℕ) (hirr : ¬ IsRat (F (ZHat.ofNat r))) (J : ℕ) :
    ∃ (Dstar rstar : ℕ), 0 < Dstar ∧ rstar < Dstar ∧
      (∀ m ≤ J, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n % Dstar = rstar →
          realPQ m (a n)
            = (((bfloorPoly ((allResBranch (F (ZHat.ofNat r)) r).tower m)
                  ((allResBranch (F (ZHat.ofNat r)) r).Ds m)
                  ((allResBranch (F (ZHat.ofNat r)) r).b m)).eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)) ∧
      (∀ m ≤ J, ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → n % Dstar = rstar →
          ∃ z : ℤ, (bfloorPoly ((allResBranch (F (ZHat.ofNat r)) r).tower m)
                  ((allResBranch (F (ZHat.ofNat r)) r).Ds m)
                  ((allResBranch (F (ZHat.ofNat r)) r).b m)).eval (n : ℚ) = (z : ℚ)) ∧
      (∀ B : ℕ, ∃ Mdeg : ℕ, B ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (Mdeg + 1),
          (bfloorPoly ((allResBranch (F (ZHat.ofNat r)) r).tower j)
                  ((allResBranch (F (ZHat.ofNat r)) r).Ds j)
                  ((allResBranch (F (ZHat.ofNat r)) r).b j)).natDegree)
proof:
:= by
  set L₀ := F (ZHat.ofNat r) with hL₀
  set β := allResBranch L₀ r with hβ
  obtain ⟨M, c, K₀, hc, hnd⟩ := β.branch_nondeg hirr J
  obtain ⟨K₇, htrack⟩ := β.branch_tracking hirr J
  set Kbound := max K₀ K₇ with hKbound
  set Nsched : ℕ → ℕ := fun m => (∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc m J, 2 * M i) + Kbound + 1 with hNs
  have hNs0_ge : Kbound + 1 ≤ Nsched 0 := by simp only [hNs]; omega
  have hNs0_pos : 1 ≤ Nsched 0 := by omega
  have hK₀le' : K₀ ≤ Kbound := le_max_left _ _
  have hK₇le' : K₇ ≤ Kbound := le_max_right _ _
  have hbud : ∀ m ≤ J, 2 * M m < Nsched m := by
    intro m hm
    have hle : 2 * M m ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc m J, 2 * M i :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => Nat.zero_le (2 * M i)) (Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨le_rfl, hm⟩)
    simp only [hNs]; omega
  have hsched : ∀ m, m < J → Nsched (m + 1) + 2 * M m ≤ Nsched m := by
    intro m hm
    have hsplit : ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc m J, 2 * M i
        = (∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc (m + 1) J, 2 * M i) + 2 * M m := by
      have hunion : Finset.Icc m J = insert m (Finset.Icc (m + 1) J) := by
        ext x; simp only [Finset.mem_Icc, Finset.mem_insert]; omega
      rw [hunion, Finset.sum_insert (by simp only [Finset.mem_Icc]; omega)]; ring
    simp only [hNs]; omega
  
  obtain ⟨D₀, hD₀, L, -, hlc⟩ := finite_order_local_constancy F ((Nsched 0 : ℤ) - 1)
  have hDsJpos : 0 < β.Ds J := β.hDpos J
  have hDstar_pos : 0 < Nat.lcm D₀ (β.Ds J) := by
    have : 0 < D₀ := hD₀; positivity
  
  have hsub_D₀ : {n : ℕ | n % Nat.lcm D₀ (β.Ds J) = r % Nat.lcm D₀ (β.Ds J)}
      ⊆ {n : ℕ | n % D₀ = r % D₀} := by
    intro n hn
    exact Nat.ModEq.of_dvd (Nat.dvd_lcm_left D₀ (β.Ds J)) hn
  have hbJ : β.b J ≡ r [MOD β.Ds J] := by
    rw [hβ, allResBranch_b]; exact Nat.mod_modEq r _
  have hsub_br : {n : ℕ | n % Nat.lcm D₀ (β.Ds J) = r % Nat.lcm D₀ (β.Ds J)}
      ⊆ {n : ℕ | n ≡ β.b J [MOD β.Ds J]} := by
    intro n hn
    have h1 : n ≡ r [MOD β.Ds J] := Nat.ModEq.of_dvd (Nat.dvd_lcm_right D₀ (β.Ds J)) hn
    exact h1.trans hbJ.symm
  
  have hag : ∀ n ∈ {n : ℕ | n % D₀ = r % D₀}, ∀ k : ℤ, k ≤ (Nsched 0 : ℤ) - 1 →
      (F (ZHat.ofNat n)).coeff k = L₀.coeff k := by
    intro n hn k hk
    have hn' : n % D₀ = r % D₀ := hn
    rw [hlc n k hk, hn', ← hlc r k hk, hL₀]
  have hgu : GovernsUpToOn ((Nsched 0 : ℤ) - 1)
      {n : ℕ | n % Nat.lcm D₀ (β.Ds J) = r % Nat.lcm D₀ (β.Ds J)} L₀ a :=
    (govUpToOn_of_govC_agree F a hgov ((Nsched 0 : ℤ) - 1) _ L₀ hag).subset hsub_D₀
  
  have hstab : ∀ m ≤ J, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      n ∈ {n : ℕ | n % Nat.lcm D₀ (β.Ds J) = r % Nat.lcm D₀ (β.Ds J)} →
      realPQ m (a n) = (⌊realGaussIter m (pval L₀ ((Nsched 0 : ℤ) - 1) n)⌋ : ℝ) := by
    refine formal_stability_i_governs_on_finite _ a L₀ ((Nsched 0 : ℤ) - 1) J M Nsched c hc
      le_rfl hgu hbud hsched ?_
    intro m hm
    have hcast : ((Nsched 0 - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (Nsched 0 : ℤ) - 1 := by omega
    have hK₀le : K₀ ≤ Nsched 0 - 1 := by omega
    filter_upwards [hnd (Nsched 0 - 1) hK₀le m hm] with n hn hnS
    rw [← hcast]
    exact hn (hsub_br hnS)
  
  refine ⟨Nat.lcm D₀ (β.Ds J), r % Nat.lcm D₀ (β.Ds J), hDstar_pos,
    Nat.mod_lt _ hDstar_pos, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro m hm
    have hcast : ((Nsched 0 - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (Nsched 0 : ℤ) - 1 := by omega
    have hK₇le : K₇ ≤ Nsched 0 - 1 := by omega
    filter_upwards [hstab m hm, htrack (Nsched 0 - 1) hK₇le m hm] with n hn hn' hnS
    rw [hn hnS, ← bfloorVal_eq_bfloorPoly_eval, ← hcast]
    exact hn' (hsub_br hnS)
  · intro m hm n hn1 hnS
    have hclass : n ≡ β.b m [MOD β.Ds m] := β.class_subset hm (hsub_br hnS)
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := bfloorVal_intVal (β.hper m) (β.b m) hn1 hclass
    exact ⟨z, by rw [← bfloorVal_eq_bfloorPoly_eval]; exact_mod_cast hz⟩
  · exact fun B => branch_degree_growth hirr β B

name: QPCF.govC_of_local_thread_governance
statement:
lemma govC_of_local_thread_governance (G : C(ZHat, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (b : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hlocal : ∀ t : ZHat, ∀ N : ℤ, ∃ M : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ,
      ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ∈ ThreadClass t M →
        |b n - pval (G t) N n| ≤ C * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(N + 1))) :
    GovC G b
proof:
:= by
  intro N
  choose M₀ C hC using fun t => hlocal t N
  choose Mc hMc using fun t => continuous_cylinder_orderAtLeast G t (N + 1)
  let M : ZHat → ℕ := fun t => max (M₀ t) (Mc t)
  have hM : ∀ t : ZHat, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ∈ ThreadClass t (M t) →
      |b n - pval (G t) N n| ≤ C t * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(N + 1)) ∧
      ∀ k : ℤ, k ≤ N → (G t).coeff k = (G (ZHat.ofNat n)).coeff k := by
    intro t
    filter_upwards [hC t] with n hn hnM
    refine ⟨hn (ThreadClass.antitone t (le_max_left _ _) hnM), ?_⟩
    intro k hk
    have ho := hMc t (ZHat.ofNat n)
      (ThreadClass.antitone t (le_max_right _ _) hnM)
    cases ho with
    | inl hz => rw [sub_eq_zero.mp hz]
    | inr ho =>
      have hz : (G (ZHat.ofNat n) - G t).coeff k = 0 :=
        HahnSeries.coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_order (by linarith)
      rw [HahnSeries.coeff_sub] at hz
      exact (sub_eq_zero.mp hz).symm
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s : Finset ZHat,
      ⋃ t ∈ s, {z : ZHat | ZHat.proj (M t) z = ZHat.proj (M t) t} = Set.univ := by
    have hsub := (isCompact_univ : IsCompact (Set.univ : Set ZHat)).elim_nhds_subcover
      (fun t => {z : ZHat | ZHat.proj (M t) z = ZHat.proj (M t) t})
      (fun t _ => ZHat.cylinder_mem_nhds t (M t))
    exact ⟨hsub.choose,
      Set.Subset.antisymm (Set.subset_univ _) hsub.choose_spec.2⟩
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ : ∃ T : ℕ, ∀ t ∈ s, ∀ n ≥ T,
      n ∈ ThreadClass t (M t) →
      |b n - pval (G t) N n| ≤ C t * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(N + 1)) ∧
      ∀ k : ℤ, k ≤ N → (G t).coeff k = (G (ZHat.ofNat n)).coeff k := by
    choose! T hT using fun t => Filter.eventually_atTop.mp (hM t)
    exact ⟨Finset.sup s T, fun t ht n hn hn' =>
      hT t n (le_trans (Finset.le_sup ht) hn) hn'⟩
  refine ⟨∑ t ∈ s, |C t|, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop T] with n hn
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp
    (hs.symm ▸ Set.mem_univ (ZHat.ofNat n))
  have h := hT t ht.1 n hn ht.2
  rw [pval_congr (fun k hk => h.2 k hk)] at h
  exact le_trans h.1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
    (le_trans (le_abs_self _) (Finset.single_le_sum
      (fun t _ => abs_nonneg (C t)) ht.1)) (by positivity))

name: QPCF.bfract_leadingCoeff_pos_of_ne
statement:
lemma bfract_leadingCoeff_pos_of_ne {L : ℚ⸨X⸩} {D r : ℕ}
    (hne : bfract L D r ≠ 0) : 0 < (bfract L D r).leadingCoeff
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hcase : bconst L D r + (if bcorr L D r then 1 else 0) ≠ 0
  · have horder : (bfract L D r).order = 0 := by
      apply le_antisymm
      · apply HahnSeries.order_le_of_coeff_ne_zero
        rw [bfract_coeff_zero]
        exact hcase
      · exact bfract_order_nonneg L D r
    have hlead : (bfract L D r).leadingCoeff = (bfract L D r).coeff 0 := by
      rw [HahnSeries.leadingCoeff_eq, horder]
    rw [hlead, bfract_coeff_zero]
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne
      (add_nonneg (Int.fract_nonneg _) (by split_ifs <;> norm_num)) hcase.symm
  · have heq : bfract L D r = L - HahnSeries.truncLT (1 : ℤ) L := by
      simp_all +decide [bfract, boffset]
    have hlead : 0 ≤ (L - HahnSeries.truncLT (1 : ℤ) L).leadingCoeff := by
      contrapose! hcase
      simp_all +decide [bcorr]
      split_ifs <;> simp_all +decide [bconst]
    exact heq ▸ lt_of_le_of_ne hlead (Ne.symm (by simpa [heq] using hne))

name: QPCF.oneSub_bfract_pos_of_ne
statement:
lemma oneSub_bfract_pos_of_ne {L : ℚ⸨X⸩} {D r : ℕ}
    (hne : bfract L D r ≠ 0) :
    (1 : ℚ⸨X⸩) - bfract L D r ≠ 0 ∧
      0 < ((1 : ℚ⸨X⸩) - bfract L D r).leadingCoeff
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 < ((1 : ℚ⸨X⸩) - bfract L D r).leadingCoeff := by
    by_cases hc : bcorr L D r
    · have heq : 1 - bfract L D r = -(L - HahnSeries.truncLT (1 : ℤ) L) := by
        unfold bfract
        rw [if_pos hc, hc.1]
        norm_num
      rw [heq, HahnSeries.leadingCoeff_neg]
      linarith [hc.2]
    · have hcoeff : 0 < ((1 : ℚ⸨X⸩) - bfract L D r).coeff 0 := by
        simp_all +decide [bfract, bconst]
        erw [HahnSeries.coeff_single]
        norm_num
        exact Int.fract_lt_one _
      have horder : ((1 : ℚ⸨X⸩) - bfract L D r).order = 0 := by
        apply le_antisymm
        · contrapose! hcoeff
          rw [HahnSeries.coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_order]
          aesop
        · exact oneSub_bfract_order_nonneg L D r
      rw [HahnSeries.leadingCoeff_eq, horder]
      exact hcoeff
  exact ⟨fun h => by rw [h] at hpos; simp at hpos, hpos⟩

name: QPCF.bfract_pval_nondeg_of_ne
statement:
lemma bfract_pval_nondeg_of_ne {L : ℚ⸨X⸩} {D r : ℕ}
    (hne : bfract L D r ≠ 0) (K : ℤ)
    (hK1 : (bfract L D r).order ≤ K)
    (hK2 : ((1 : ℚ⸨X⸩) - bfract L D r).order ≤ K) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, ∃ M : ℕ, 0 < c ∧
      (M : ℤ) ≤ max (bfract L D r).order ((1 - bfract L D r).order) ∧
      ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
        c / (n : ℝ) ^ M ≤ pval (bfract L D r) K n ∧
          pval (bfract L D r) K n ≤ 1 - c / (n : ℝ) ^ M
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨o1, ho1⟩ : ∃ o1 : ℕ, (bfract L D r).order = o1 := by
    exact ⟨Int.toNat (order (bfract L D r)), by
      rw [Int.toNat_of_nonneg (bfract_order_nonneg L D r)]⟩
  obtain ⟨o2, ho2⟩ : ∃ o2 : ℕ, ((1 : ℚ⸨X⸩) - bfract L D r).order = o2 := by
    exact ⟨Int.toNat (order (1 - bfract L D r)), by
      rw [Int.toNat_of_nonneg (oneSub_bfract_order_nonneg L D r)]⟩
  obtain ⟨L1, hL1⟩ : ∃ L1 : ℝ, 0 < L1 ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => pval (bfract L D r) K n * (n : ℝ) ^ o1)
        Filter.atTop (nhds L1) := by
    have h := pval_mul_pow_tendsto (bfract L D r) o1 K ho1 (ho1 ▸ hK1)
    refine ⟨_, ?_, h⟩
    have hp := bfract_leadingCoeff_pos_of_ne hne
    simpa [HahnSeries.leadingCoeff_eq, ho1] using hp
  obtain ⟨L2, hL2⟩ : ∃ L2 : ℝ, 0 < L2 ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => pval (1 - bfract L D r) K n * (n : ℝ) ^ o2)
        Filter.atTop (nhds L2) := by
    have h := pval_mul_pow_tendsto (1 - bfract L D r) o2 K ho2 (ho2 ▸ hK2)
    refine ⟨_, ?_, h⟩
    have hp := (oneSub_bfract_pos_of_ne hne).2
    simpa [HahnSeries.leadingCoeff_eq, ho2] using hp
  have h_pval_sub : ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n →
      pval (1 - bfract L D r) K n = 1 - pval (bfract L D r) K n := by
    intro n hn
    have hs : pval (1 - bfract L D r) K n =
        pval 1 K n - pval (bfract L D r) K n := by
      convert pval_add 1 (-bfract L D r) K n using 1
      · ring
      · rw [pval_neg]
        ring
    rw [hs, pval_one]
    · linarith [bfract_order_nonneg L D r]
    · linarith
  obtain ⟨c, hc_pos, hc⟩ : ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in Filter.atTop,
      c / (n : ℝ) ^ (max o1 o2) ≤ L1 / 2 / (n : ℝ) ^ o1 ∧
      c / (n : ℝ) ^ (max o1 o2) ≤ L2 / 2 / (n : ℝ) ^ o2 := by
    refine ⟨min (L1 / 2) (L2 / 2), ?_, ?_⟩
    · norm_num [hL1.1, hL2.1]
    · filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop 1] with n hn
      constructor <;> gcongr <;> norm_num [hn] <;> linarith
  refine ⟨c, max o1 o2, hc_pos, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [ho1, ho2]
    norm_cast
  filter_upwards [hc,
    hL1.2.eventually (lt_mem_nhds <| half_lt_self hL1.1),
    hL2.2.eventually (lt_mem_nhds <| half_lt_self hL2.1),
    Filter.eventually_ge_atTop 1] with n hn hn1 hn2 hn3
  simp_all +decide [div_le_iff₀, pow_pos]
  constructor <;> nlinarith
    [show (n : ℝ) ^ o1 > 0 by positivity,
     show (n : ℝ) ^ o2 > 0 by positivity,
     mul_div_cancel₀ (L1 / 2) (by positivity : (n : ℝ) ^ o1 ≠ 0),
     mul_div_cancel₀ (L2 / 2) (by positivity : (n : ℝ) ^ o2 ≠ 0)]

name: QPCF.canonicalFloorPeriod_isFloorPeriod
statement:
theorem canonicalFloorPeriod_isFloorPeriod (L : ℚ⸨X⸩) :
    IsFloorPeriod L (canonicalFloorPeriod L)

name: QPCF.pval_bfloorFamilyValue_eq_bfloorVal
statement:
theorem pval_bfloorFamilyValue_eq_bfloorVal
    (F : C(ZHat, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (t : ZHat) (n : ℕ) :
    pval (bfloorFamilyValue F t) 0 n =
      ((bfloorVal (F t) (canonicalFloorPeriod (F t))
        (canonicalFloorResidue (F t) t) n : ℚ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let L := F t
  let D := canonicalFloorPeriod L
  let r := canonicalFloorResidue L t
  have h_const : ∀ c : ℚ, pval (HahnSeries.C c) 0 n = c := by
    intro c
    convert pval_eq_finset_sum (HahnSeries.C c) 0 n using 1
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single 0] <;> norm_num
    · erw [HahnSeries.coeff_single]
      norm_num
    · intro b hb₁ hb₂ hb₃
      erw [HahnSeries.coeff_single]
      aesop
    · intro h
      exact HahnSeries.coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_order h
  have h_trunc : pval (truncLT (1 : ℤ) L) 0 n = pval L 0 n := by
    unfold pval
    simp +decide [Finset.sum_ite]
    rw [← finsum_congr fun k => ?_]
    by_cases hk : k ≤ 0 <;> by_cases hk' : k < 1 <;>
      simp +decide [hk, hk'] <;> omega
  change pval (boffset L D r) 0 n = ((bfloorVal L D r n : ℚ) : ℝ)
  simp only [boffset, bfloorVal]
  convert congr_arg₂ (· + ·) h_trunc
      (congr_arg Neg.neg (h_const (bconst L D r + if bcorr L D r then 1 else 0))) using 1
  · convert pval_add (truncLT 1 L)
        (-HahnSeries.C (bconst L D r + if bcorr L D r then 1 else 0)) 0 n using 1
    · rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
    · rw [pval_neg]
  · rw [← pvalQ_cast]
    push_cast
    ring

name: QPCF.eventually_zpow_le_half_pow
statement:
lemma eventually_zpow_le_half_pow (C c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (M : ℕ) (E : ℤ)
    (hME : (M : ℤ) < E) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      C * (n : ℝ) ^ (-E) ≤ (c / 2) / (n : ℝ) ^ M

name: QPCF.canonicalFloorResidue_eq_mod_on_thread
statement:
lemma canonicalFloorResidue_eq_mod_on_thread (L : ℚ⸨X⸩) (t : ZHat) :
    ∃ M : ℕ, ∀ n ∈ ThreadClass t M,
      n ≡ canonicalFloorResidue L t [MOD canonicalFloorPeriod L]

name: QPCF.govC_fixed_on_thread
statement:
lemma govC_fixed_on_thread (F : C(ZHat, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (hgov : GovC F a)
    (t : ZHat) (K : ℤ) :
    ∃ M : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      n ∈ ThreadClass t M →
        |a n - pval (F t) K n| ≤ C * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(K + 1))

name: QPCF.pval_canonicalFloor_add_bfract
statement:
lemma pval_canonicalFloor_add_bfract (F : C(ZHat, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (t : ZHat)
    (K : ℤ) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (n : ℕ) :
    pval (F t) K n = pval (bfloorFamilyValue F t) 0 n +
      pval (bfract (F t) (canonicalFloorPeriod (F t))
        (canonicalFloorResidue (F t) t)) K n

name: QPCF.floor_pinning
statement:
lemma floor_pinning {F : C(ZHat, ℚ⸨X⸩)} {a : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hgov : GovC F a) (hne : ∀ t, fractFamilyValue F t ≠ 0) (t : ZHat) :
    ∃ M : ℕ, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ∈ ThreadClass t M →
      (⌊a n⌋ : ℝ) = pval (bfloorFamilyValue F t) 0 n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let D := canonicalFloorPeriod (F t)
  let r := canonicalFloorResidue (F t) t
  let B := bfract (F t) D r
  have hBne : B ≠ 0 := by
    have hb := fractFamilyValue_eq_bfract F t
    have ht := hne t
    rw [hb] at ht
    simpa [B, D, r] using ht
  let K := max B.order ((1 - B).order) + 1
  have hK1 : B.order ≤ K := by dsimp [K]; omega
  have hK2 : (1 - B).order ≤ K := by dsimp [K]; omega
  obtain ⟨c, m, hc, hm, hpinch⟩ :=
    bfract_pval_nondeg_of_ne hBne K hK1 hK2
  obtain ⟨Mc, C, herror⟩ := govC_fixed_on_thread F a hgov t K
  obtain ⟨Md, hres⟩ := canonicalFloorResidue_eq_mod_on_thread (F t) t
  have hB0 : (0 : ℤ) ≤ B.order := by
    change (0 : ℤ) ≤ (bfract (F t) D r).order
    exact bfract_order_nonneg (F t) D r
  have hK0 : 0 ≤ K := by
    dsimp [K]
    exact le_add_of_le_of_nonneg (le_trans hB0 (le_max_left _ _)) (by norm_num)
  have hm' : (m : ℤ) ≤ max B.order ((1 - B).order) := by
    change (m : ℤ) ≤ max
      (bfract (F t) D r).order ((1 - bfract (F t) D r).order)
    exact hm
  have hmK : (m : ℤ) < K + 1 := by
    dsimp [K]
    omega
  have hbeat := eventually_zpow_le_half_pow C c hc m (K + 1) hmK
  refine ⟨max Mc Md, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [herror, hpinch, hbeat, Filter.eventually_ge_atTop 1]
    with n hnerr hnpinch hnbeat hn1 hnmem
  have hnMc : n ∈ ThreadClass t Mc :=
    ThreadClass.antitone t (le_max_left _ _) hnmem
  have hnMd : n ∈ ThreadClass t Md :=
    ThreadClass.antitone t (le_max_right _ _) hnmem
  have herr : |a n - pval (F t) K n| ≤ (c / 2) / (n : ℝ) ^ m :=
    le_trans (hnerr hnMc) hnbeat
  have hsplit := pval_canonicalFloor_add_bfract F t K hK0 n
  change pval (F t) K n = pval (bfloorFamilyValue F t) 0 n + pval B K n at hsplit
  obtain ⟨z, hzq⟩ := bfloorVal_intVal
    (canonicalFloorPeriod_isFloorPeriod (F t)) r hn1 (hres n hnMd)
  have hz : pval (bfloorFamilyValue F t) 0 n = (z : ℝ) := by
    rw [pval_bfloorFamilyValue_eq_bfloorVal]
    exact_mod_cast hzq
  have hwindow : (0 : ℝ) < a n - z ∧ a n - z < 1 := by
    have hp := hnpinch
    change c / (n : ℝ) ^ m ≤ pval B K n ∧
      pval B K n ≤ 1 - c / (n : ℝ) ^ m at hp
    have habs := abs_le.mp herr
    rw [hsplit, hz] at habs
    have hpow : 0 < (n : ℝ) ^ m := by positivity
    have hcpow : 0 < c / (n : ℝ) ^ m := div_pos hc hpow
    have hhalf : (c / 2) / (n : ℝ) ^ m = (c / (n : ℝ) ^ m) / 2 := by ring
    rw [hhalf] at habs
    constructor <;> linarith
  have hfloor : ⌊a n⌋ = z := by
    rw [Int.floor_eq_iff]
    constructor <;> linarith [hwindow.1, hwindow.2]
  rw [hfloor, hz]

name: QPCF.pval_truncation_tail_bound
statement:
lemma pval_truncation_tail_bound (L : ℚ⸨X⸩) (N K : ℤ) (hNK : N ≤ K) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      |pval L K n - pval L N n| ≤ C * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(N + 1))

name: QPCF.floor_local_governance
statement:
lemma floor_local_governance {F : C(ZHat, ℚ⸨X⸩)} {a : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hgov : GovC F a) (hne : ∀ t, fractFamilyValue F t ≠ 0) (t : ZHat) (N : ℤ) :
    ∃ M : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ∈ ThreadClass t M →
      |(⌊a n⌋ : ℝ) - pval (bfloorFamily F hne t) N n| ≤
        C * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(N + 1))

name: QPCF.fract_local_approx
statement:
lemma fract_local_approx {F : C(ZHat, ℚ⸨X⸩)} {a : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hgov : GovC F a) (hne : ∀ t, fractFamilyValue F t ≠ 0)
    (t : ZHat) (K : ℕ) :
    ∃ M : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ∈ ThreadClass t M →
      |Int.fract (a n) - pval (fractFamilyValue F t) K n| ≤
        C * (n : ℝ) ^ (-((K : ℤ) + 1))

name: QPCF.gauss_local_governance
statement:
lemma gauss_local_governance {F : C(ZHat, ℚ⸨X⸩)} {a : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hgov : GovC F a) (hne : ∀ t, fractFamilyValue F t ≠ 0) (t : ZHat) (N : ℤ) :
    ∃ M : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ∈ ThreadClass t M →
      |realGaussSeq a n - pval (gaussFamily F hne t) N n| ≤
        C * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(N + 1))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  set L : ℚ⸨X⸩ := F t with hLdef
  set D : ℕ := canonicalFloorPeriod L with hDdef
  set r : ℕ := canonicalFloorResidue L t with hrdef
  have hHb : fractFamilyValue F t = bfract L D r := fractFamilyValue_eq_bfract F t
  have hneB : bfract L D r ≠ 0 := by rw [← hHb]; exact hne t
  have ho1 : (0 : ℤ) ≤ (bfract L D r).order := bfract_order_nonneg L D r
  have ho2 : (0 : ℤ) ≤ ((1 : ℚ⸨X⸩) - bfract L D r).order :=
    oneSub_bfract_order_nonneg L D r
  set s₀ : ℕ := (bfract L D r).order.toNat with hs₀def
  set s₁ : ℕ := (((1 : ℚ⸨X⸩) - bfract L D r).order).toNat with hs₁def
  set smax : ℕ := max s₀ s₁ with hsmaxdef
  have hord : (bfract L D r).order = (s₀ : ℤ) := (Int.toNat_of_nonneg ho1).symm
  have hord1 : ((1 : ℚ⸨X⸩) - bfract L D r).order = (s₁ : ℤ) :=
    (Int.toNat_of_nonneg ho2).symm
  
  set K : ℕ := N.toNat + 2 * smax + 2 with hKdef
  have hs₀K : s₀ ≤ K := by
    rw [hKdef, hsmaxdef]
    omega
  have hK1 : (bfract L D r).order ≤ (K : ℤ) := by
    rw [hord]
    exact_mod_cast (show s₀ ≤ K by rw [hKdef, hsmaxdef]; omega)
  have hK2 : ((1 : ℚ⸨X⸩) - bfract L D r).order ≤ (K : ℤ) := by
    rw [hord1]
    exact_mod_cast (show s₁ ≤ K by rw [hKdef, hsmaxdef]; omega)
  have hK0 : (0 : ℤ) ≤ (K : ℤ) := Int.natCast_nonneg K
  have hNK : N ≤ (K : ℤ) := by
    have := Int.self_le_toNat N
    have h2 : (N.toNat : ℤ) ≤ (K : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast by omega
    omega
  
  obtain ⟨c, M', hc, hM'le, hpinch⟩ :=
    bfract_pval_nondeg_of_ne hneB (K : ℤ) hK1 hK2
  have hM'smax : M' ≤ smax := by
    rw [hord, hord1] at hM'le
    have : ((M' : ℤ)) ≤ max (s₀ : ℤ) (s₁ : ℤ) := hM'le
    have h2 : max (s₀ : ℤ) (s₁ : ℤ) = ((smax : ℤ)) := by
      simp [hsmaxdef, Nat.cast_max]
    omega
  
  obtain ⟨Mc, C₀, herror⟩ := govC_fixed_on_thread F a hgov t (K : ℤ)
  set C : ℝ := max C₀ 1 with hCdef
  have hC1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ C := le_max_right _ _
  have herror' : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ∈ ThreadClass t Mc →
      |a n - pval L (K : ℤ) n| ≤ C * (n : ℝ) ^ (-((K : ℤ) + 1)) := by
    filter_upwards [herror, eventually_ge_atTop 1] with n hn hn1 hmem
    exact le_trans (hn hmem)
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _)
        (zpow_nonneg (by positivity) _))
  
  obtain ⟨Mf, hMf⟩ := floor_pinning hgov hne t
  
  have hlow : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, c / (n : ℝ) ^ M' ≤ pval (bfract L D r) (K : ℤ) n :=
    hpinch.mono fun n hn => hn.1
  obtain ⟨Ci, hCi0, hCi⟩ :=
    pval_inv_approx_gen (bfract L D r) hneB K s₀ M' c hc hs₀K
      (by omega) hord hlow
  
  obtain ⟨Ct, hCt0, hCt⟩ :=
    pval_truncation_tail_bound ((bfract L D r)⁻¹) N (K : ℤ) hNK
  
  refine ⟨max Mc Mf, 2 * C / c ^ 2 + Ci + Ct, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [herror', hpinch, hCi, hCt, hMf,
    eventually_ge_atTop (max 1 ⌈2 * C / c⌉₊)]
    with n herrn hpin hCin hCtn hMfn hnlarge hmem
  have hmemC : n ∈ ThreadClass t Mc :=
    ThreadClass.antitone t (le_max_left _ _) hmem
  have hmemF : n ∈ ThreadClass t Mf :=
    ThreadClass.antitone t (le_max_right _ _) hmem
  have hn1 : 1 ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hnlarge
  have hnthreshold : ⌈2 * C / c⌉₊ ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hnlarge
  have hnR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn1
  have hnbeat : 2 * C / c ≤ (n : ℝ) := by
    exact le_trans (Nat.le_ceil (2 * C / c)) (by exact_mod_cast hnthreshold)
  
  have hmono : ∀ e e' : ℤ, e ≤ e' → (n : ℝ) ^ e ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ e' :=
    fun e e' h => zpow_le_zpow_right₀ hnR h
  
  have hfloor : (⌊a n⌋ : ℝ) = pval (bfloorFamilyValue F t) 0 n := hMfn hmemF
  have hfract_def : Int.fract (a n) = a n - (⌊a n⌋ : ℝ) := by
    rw [Int.fract]
  have hsplit := pval_canonicalFloor_add_bfract F t (K : ℤ) hK0 n
  have hfr_err :
      |Int.fract (a n) - pval (bfract L D r) (K : ℤ) n| ≤
        C * (n : ℝ) ^ (-((K : ℤ) + 1)) := by
    have : Int.fract (a n) - pval (bfract L D r) (K : ℤ) n
        = a n - pval L (K : ℤ) n := by
      rw [hfract_def, hfloor, hsplit]; ring
    rw [this]; exact herrn hmemC
  
  have hpvpos : c / (n : ℝ) ^ M' ≤ pval (bfract L D r) (K : ℤ) n := hpin.1
  have hcpos : (0 : ℝ) < c / (n : ℝ) ^ M' := by positivity
  have hbeat : C * (n : ℝ) ^ (-((K : ℤ) + 1)) ≤ (c / 2) / (n : ℝ) ^ M' := by
    
    
    
    have hn2 : (2 * C / c) ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ ((K : ℤ) + 1 - M') := by
      calc (2 * C / c) ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ (1 : ℤ) := by simpa using hnbeat
        _ ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ ((K : ℤ) + 1 - M') := hmono _ _ (by
              have : (M' : ℤ) ≤ (K : ℤ) := by
                exact_mod_cast le_trans hM'smax (by omega)
              omega)
    have hMle : (M' : ℤ) ≤ (K : ℤ) + 1 := by
      exact_mod_cast le_trans hM'smax (by rw [hKdef]; omega)
    have hsplitpow : (n : ℝ) ^ ((K : ℤ) + 1) =
        (n : ℝ) ^ (M' : ℤ) * (n : ℝ) ^ ((K : ℤ) + 1 - M') := by
      rw [← zpow_add₀ (by positivity : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0)]
      congr 1
      omega
    have hbase : 2 * C ≤ c * (n : ℝ) ^ ((K : ℤ) + 1 - M') := by
      calc
        2 * C = c * (2 * C / c) := by field_simp
        _ ≤ c * (n : ℝ) ^ ((K : ℤ) + 1 - M') :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hn2 hc.le
    have hscaled := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hbase
      (show 0 ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ (M' : ℤ) by positivity)
    rw [zpow_neg, hsplitpow]
    field_simp
    convert hscaled using 1 <;> simp only [zpow_natCast] <;> ring
  have hfrpos : (c / 2) / (n : ℝ) ^ M' ≤ Int.fract (a n) := by
    have h1 : pval (bfract L D r) (K : ℤ) n - C * (n : ℝ) ^ (-((K : ℤ) + 1))
        ≤ Int.fract (a n) := by
      have := abs_le.mp hfr_err; linarith [this.1]
    have : (c / 2) / (n : ℝ) ^ M'
        ≤ pval (bfract L D r) (K : ℤ) n - C * (n : ℝ) ^ (-((K : ℤ) + 1)) := by
      have hhalf : c / (n : ℝ) ^ M' - (c / 2) / (n : ℝ) ^ M'
          = (c / 2) / (n : ℝ) ^ M' := by ring
      linarith [hpvpos, hbeat]
    linarith
  have hfrne : Int.fract (a n) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hfrpos)
  have hpvne : pval (bfract L D r) (K : ℤ) n ≠ 0 :=
    ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le hcpos hpvpos)
  
  have hT1 : |(Int.fract (a n))⁻¹ - (pval (bfract L D r) (K : ℤ) n)⁻¹|
      ≤ (2 * C / c ^ 2) * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(N + 1)) := by
    rw [inv_sub_inv hfrne hpvne, abs_div]
    have hnum : |pval (bfract L D r) (K : ℤ) n - Int.fract (a n)|
        ≤ C * (n : ℝ) ^ (-((K : ℤ) + 1)) := by
      rw [abs_sub_comm]; exact hfr_err
    have hden : (c / 2) / (n : ℝ) ^ M' * (c / (n : ℝ) ^ M')
        ≤ |Int.fract (a n) * pval (bfract L D r) (K : ℤ) n| := by
      rw [abs_of_pos (mul_pos (lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hfrpos)
        (lt_of_lt_of_le hcpos hpvpos))]
      exact mul_le_mul hfrpos hpvpos (le_of_lt hcpos)
        (le_trans (by positivity) hfrpos)
    have hstep : |pval (bfract L D r) (K : ℤ) n - Int.fract (a n)| /
        |Int.fract (a n) * pval (bfract L D r) (K : ℤ) n|
        ≤ (C * (n : ℝ) ^ (-((K : ℤ) + 1))) /
          ((c / 2) / (n : ℝ) ^ M' * (c / (n : ℝ) ^ M')) :=
      div_le_div₀ (by positivity) hnum (by positivity) hden
    refine le_trans hstep ?_
    
    have hexp : (2 * (M' : ℤ)) + (-((K : ℤ) + 1)) ≤ -(N + 1) := by
      have h1 : ((M' : ℤ)) ≤ ((smax : ℤ)) := by exact_mod_cast hM'smax
      have h2 : (N : ℤ) ≤ (N.toNat : ℤ) := Int.self_le_toNat N
      have h3 : ((K : ℤ)) = (N.toNat : ℤ) + 2 * (smax : ℤ) + 2 := by
        exact_mod_cast hKdef
      omega
    calc (C * (n : ℝ) ^ (-((K : ℤ) + 1))) /
          ((c / 2) / (n : ℝ) ^ M' * (c / (n : ℝ) ^ M'))
        = (2 * C / c ^ 2) * ((n : ℝ) ^ (M' : ℤ) * (n : ℝ) ^ (M' : ℤ)
            * (n : ℝ) ^ (-((K : ℤ) + 1))) := by
          field_simp
          simp only [zpow_natCast]
      _ = (2 * C / c ^ 2) * (n : ℝ) ^ ((2 * (M' : ℤ)) + (-((K : ℤ) + 1))) := by
          rw [← zpow_add₀ (by positivity : (n:ℝ) ≠ 0),
              ← zpow_add₀ (by positivity : (n:ℝ) ≠ 0)]
          ring_nf
      _ ≤ (2 * C / c ^ 2) * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(N + 1)) := by
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hmono _ _ hexp) (by positivity)
  
  have hT2 : |pval ((bfract L D r)⁻¹) (K : ℤ) n
      - (pval (bfract L D r) (K : ℤ) n)⁻¹| ≤ Ci * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(N + 1)) := by
    refine le_trans hCin ?_
    have hE : (N + 1 : ℤ) ≤ ((K - s₀ + 1 - M' : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
      have h1 : s₀ + M' ≤ 2 * smax := by
        have := Nat.le_max_left s₀ s₁; have := Nat.le_max_right s₀ s₁; omega
      have h2 : K - s₀ + 1 - M' = K + 1 - s₀ - M' := by omega
      have h3 : N.toNat + 3 ≤ K + 1 - s₀ - M' := by omega
      have h4 : (N : ℤ) ≤ (N.toNat : ℤ) := Int.self_le_toNat N
      push_cast [h2]; omega
    calc Ci / (n : ℝ) ^ (K - s₀ + 1 - M')
        = Ci * (n : ℝ) ^ (-((K - s₀ + 1 - M' : ℕ) : ℤ)) := by
          rw [div_eq_mul_inv, ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_neg]
      _ ≤ Ci * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(N + 1)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hmono _ _ (by omega)) hCi0
  
  have hT3 : |pval ((bfract L D r)⁻¹) (K : ℤ) n
      - pval ((bfract L D r)⁻¹) N n| ≤ Ct * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(N + 1)) := hCtn
  
  have hgoal : realGaussSeq a n - pval (gaussFamily F hne t) N n
      = ((Int.fract (a n))⁻¹ - (pval (bfract L D r) (K : ℤ) n)⁻¹)
      + ((pval (bfract L D r) (K : ℤ) n)⁻¹ - pval ((bfract L D r)⁻¹) (K : ℤ) n)
      + (pval ((bfract L D r)⁻¹) (K : ℤ) n - pval ((bfract L D r)⁻¹) N n) := by
    have hg : pval (gaussFamily F hne t) N n = pval ((bfract L D r)⁻¹) N n := by
      rw [gaussFamily_apply, hHb]
    rw [realGaussSeq, hg]; ring
  calc |realGaussSeq a n - pval (gaussFamily F hne t) N n|
      ≤ |(Int.fract (a n))⁻¹ - (pval (bfract L D r) (K : ℤ) n)⁻¹|
        + |pval ((bfract L D r)⁻¹) (K : ℤ) n
            - (pval (bfract L D r) (K : ℤ) n)⁻¹|
        + |pval ((bfract L D r)⁻¹) (K : ℤ) n - pval ((bfract L D r)⁻¹) N n| := by
        rw [hgoal]
        refine le_trans (abs_add_le _ _) (add_le_add ?_ le_rfl)
        refine le_trans (abs_add_le _ _) (add_le_add le_rfl ?_)
        rw [abs_sub_comm]
    _ ≤ (2 * C / c ^ 2) * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(N + 1)) + Ci * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(N + 1))
        + Ct * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(N + 1)) := add_le_add (add_le_add hT1 hT2) hT3
    _ = (2 * C / c ^ 2 + Ci + Ct) * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(N + 1)) := by ring

name: QPCF.proposition_A_2_ii_local
statement:
lemma proposition_A_2_ii_local {F : C(ZHat, ℚ⸨X⸩)} {a : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hgov : GovC F a) (hne : ∀ t, fractFamilyValue F t ≠ 0) (t : ZHat) (N : ℤ) :
    ∃ M : ℕ, ∃ Cg Cf : ℝ, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ∈ ThreadClass t M →
      |realGaussSeq a n - pval (gaussFamily F hne t) N n| ≤
        Cg * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(N + 1)) ∧
      |(⌊a n⌋ : ℝ) - pval (bfloorFamily F hne t) N n| ≤
        Cf * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(N + 1))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Mg, Cg, hg⟩ := gauss_local_governance hgov hne t N
  obtain ⟨Mf, Cf, hf⟩ := floor_local_governance hgov hne t N
  refine ⟨max Mg Mf, Cg, Cf, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hg, hf] with n hgn hfn hmem
  exact ⟨hgn (ThreadClass.antitone t (le_max_left _ _) hmem),
    hfn (ThreadClass.antitone t (le_max_right _ _) hmem)⟩

name: QPCF.proposition_A_2_ii
statement:
theorem proposition_A_2_ii {F : C(ZHat, ℚ⸨X⸩)} {a : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hgov : GovC F a) (hne : ∀ t, fractFamilyValue F t ≠ 0) :
    GovC (gaussFamily F hne) (realGaussSeq a) ∧
      GovC (bfloorFamily F hne) (fun n => (⌊a n⌋ : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · apply govC_of_local_thread_governance
    intro t N
    obtain ⟨M, Cg, Cf, h⟩ := proposition_A_2_ii_local hgov hne t N
    exact ⟨M, Cg, h.mono fun n hn hnM => (hn hnM).1⟩
  · apply govC_of_local_thread_governance
    intro t N
    obtain ⟨M, Cg, Cf, h⟩ := proposition_A_2_ii_local hgov hne t N
    exact ⟨M, Cf, h.mono fun n hn hnM => (hn hnM).2⟩

name: QPCF.proposition_A_2_iii
statement:
theorem proposition_A_2_iii {F : C(ZHat, ℚ⸨X⸩)} {a : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hgov : GovC F a) (hne : ∀ t, fractFamilyValue F t ≠ 0) :
    govGenFamily ⟨realGaussSeq a, ⟨gaussFamily F hne,
      (proposition_A_2_ii hgov hne).1⟩⟩ = gaussFamily F hne ∧
    govGenFamily ⟨(fun n => (⌊a n⌋ : ℝ)), ⟨bfloorFamily F hne,
      (proposition_A_2_ii hgov hne).2⟩⟩ = bfloorFamily F hne
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> apply govGenFamily_eq_iff.mpr
  · exact (proposition_A_2_ii hgov hne).1
  · exact (proposition_A_2_ii hgov hne).2

name: QPCF.rational_constant_stretch_exhaustion
statement:
theorem rational_constant_stretch_exhaustion
    {L : ℚ⸨X⸩} (hL : ¬ IsRat L) (β : BranchDatum L) :
    ∃ m : ℕ, (β.tower m).order < 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Set.infinite_coe_iff] using (β.btower_order_infinitely_neg hL).nonempty

name: QPCF.rnReciprocalError_exact_formula
statement:
lemma rnReciprocalError_exact_formula (c5 c6 : ℝ) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      (n : ℝ) * rnReciprocalError c5 c6 n =
        (-4 * c5 - (1 / 2 + 4 * c5 + 4 * c6) / (n : ℝ) -
            (2 * c5 + 4 * c6) / (n : ℝ)^2 - 2 * c6 / (n : ℝ)^3) /
          (1 - 1 / (n : ℝ) + 1 / (2 * (n : ℝ)^2) +
            2 * c5 / (n : ℝ)^3 + 2 * c6 / (n : ℝ)^4)

name: QPCF.rnReciprocalError_first_coefficient
statement:
theorem rnReciprocalError_first_coefficient (c5 c6 : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) * rnReciprocalError c5 c6 n)
      atTop (𝓝 (-4 * c5))
proof:
:= by
  
  have h_rewrite : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (-4 * c5 - (1 / 2 + 4 * c5 + 4 * c6) / (n : ℝ) - (2 * c5 + 4 * c6) / (n : ℝ)^2 - 2 * c6 / (n : ℝ)^3) / (1 - 1 / (n : ℝ) + 1 / (2 * (n : ℝ)^2) + 2 * c5 / (n : ℝ)^3 + 2 * c6 / (n : ℝ)^4)) Filter.atTop (nhds (-4 * c5)) := by
    exact le_trans ( Filter.Tendsto.div ( Filter.Tendsto.sub ( Filter.Tendsto.sub ( tendsto_const_nhds.sub ( tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop ) ) ( tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop ( by simpa only [ ← Nat.cast_pow ] using tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop.comp ( by norm_num ) ) ) ) ( tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop ( by simpa only [ ← Nat.cast_pow ] using tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop.comp ( by norm_num ) ) ) ) ( Filter.Tendsto.add ( Filter.Tendsto.add ( Filter.Tendsto.add ( tendsto_const_nhds.sub ( tendsto_one_div_atTop_nhds_zero_nat ) ) ( tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop ( by simpa only [ ← Nat.cast_pow ] using Filter.Tendsto.const_mul_atTop zero_lt_two ( tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop.comp ( by norm_num ) ) ) ) ) ( tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop ( by simpa only [ ← Nat.cast_pow ] using tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop.comp ( by norm_num ) ) ) ) ( tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop ( by simpa only [ ← Nat.cast_pow ] using tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop.comp ( by norm_num ) ) ) ) ( by positivity ) ) ( by norm_num );
  refine' h_rewrite.congr' ( by filter_upwards [ QPCF.rnReciprocalError_exact_formula c5 c6 ] with n hn; rw [ hn ] )

name: QPCF.rnReciprocalError_second_coefficient
statement:
theorem rnReciprocalError_second_coefficient (c6 : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ)^2 * rnReciprocalError 0 c6 n)
      atTop (𝓝 (-(1 / 2 + 4 * c6)))

name: QPCF.rnReciprocalError_RN_sign
statement:
theorem rnReciprocalError_RN_sign :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ)^2 * rnReciprocalError 0 (-1 / 12) n)
      atTop (𝓝 (-1 / 6))
proof:
:= by
  convert rnReciprocalError_second_coefficient (-1 / 12) using 1 <;> norm_num

name: QPCF.rnReciprocalError_eventually_neg_of_c5_pos
statement:
theorem rnReciprocalError_eventually_neg_of_c5_pos {c5 c6 : ℝ} (hc5 : 0 < c5) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, rnReciprocalError c5 c6 n < 0

name: QPCF.bfloorFamilyValue_eq_of_stable
statement:
lemma bfloorFamilyValue_eq_of_stable
    (F : C(ZHat, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (t y : ZHat)
    (hcore : bfloorCore (F y) = bfloorCore (F t))
    (htail :
      (F y - HahnSeries.truncLT (1 : ℤ) (F y)).leadingCoeff =
        (F t - HahnSeries.truncLT (1 : ℤ) (F t)).leadingCoeff)
    (hproj : ZHat.proj (canonicalFloorPeriod (F t)) y =
      ZHat.proj (canonicalFloorPeriod (F t)) t) :
    bfloorFamilyValue F y = bfloorFamilyValue F t

name: QPCF.proposition_C_one_sub_exp
statement:
theorem proposition_C_one_sub_exp :
    (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → realPQ 0 (oneSubExpSeq n) = 0) ∧
    (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → realPQ 1 (oneSubExpSeq n) = 1) ∧
    (∀ k : ℕ, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      (n : ℝ) ^ k ≤ realPQ 2 (oneSubExpSeq n))

name: QPCF.rnThreeTermCounterexample_has_expansion
statement:
theorem rnThreeTermCounterexample_has_expansion :
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      |rnThreeTermCounterexample n -
        (1 / (2 * (n : ℝ)^2) - 1 / (2 * (n : ℝ)^3) +
          1 / (4 * (n : ℝ)^4))| ≤ C / (n : ℝ)^5
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨1, Filter.eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨1, ?_⟩⟩
  intro n hn
  simp [rnThreeTermCounterexample, show n ≠ 0 by omega, abs_of_nonneg]

name: QPCF.rnThreeTermCounterexample_refutes_PQ1
statement:
theorem rnThreeTermCounterexample_refutes_PQ1 :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      realPQ 1 (rnThreeTermCounterexample n) ≠
        (2 * (n : ℝ)^2 + 2 * n : ℝ)

name: QPCF.per_class_governsUpTo
statement:
theorem per_class_governsUpTo (F : C(ZHat, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (hgov : GovC F a)
    (K : ℤ) (D : ℕ) (hD : 1 ≤ D) (L : ℕ → ℚ⸨X⸩)
    (hlc : ∀ (n : ℕ) (k : ℤ), k ≤ K →
      (F (ZHat.ofNat n)).coeff k = (L (n % D)).coeff k)
    (r : ℕ) (hr : r < D) :
    ∀ N : ℤ, N ≤ K →
      BigOpow (fun j => a (D * j + r) - pval (L r) N (D * j + r)) (-(N + 1))

name: QPCF.per_class_governsUpTo_on
statement:
theorem per_class_governsUpTo_on (F : C(ZHat, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (hgov : GovC F a)
    (K : ℤ) (D : ℕ) (L : ℕ → ℚ⸨X⸩)
    (hlc : ∀ (n : ℕ) (k : ℤ), k ≤ K →
      (F (ZHat.ofNat n)).coeff k = (L (n % D)).coeff k)
    (r : ℕ) :
    ∀ N : ℤ, N ≤ K →
      BigOpowOn {n : ℕ | n % D = r} (fun n => a n - pval (L r) N n) (-(N + 1))
proof:
:= by
  intro N hNK
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hgov N
  refine ⟨C, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hC] with n hn hnS
  have hpv : pval (F (ZHat.ofNat n)) N n = pval (L r) N n := by
    rw [pval_congr]
    intro k hk
    have := hlc n k (le_trans hk hNK)
    simpa [Set.mem_setOf_eq.mp hnS] using this
  rw [← hpv]; exact hn

name: QPCF.floor_eq_of_orderAtLeast_one
statement:
lemma floor_eq_of_orderAtLeast_one (x y : ℚ⸨X⸩)
    (h : OrderAtLeast (x - y) 1) :
    (fieldLaurentGauss ℚ).floor x = (fieldLaurentGauss ℚ).floor y

name: QPCF.fract_sub_eq_of_floor_eq
statement:
lemma fract_sub_eq_of_floor_eq (x y : ℚ⸨X⸩)
    (h : (fieldLaurentGauss ℚ).floor x = (fieldLaurentGauss ℚ).floor y) :
    (fieldLaurentGauss ℚ).fract x - (fieldLaurentGauss ℚ).fract y = x - y
proof:
:= by
  unfold GaussStructure.fract; aesop;

name: QPCF.order_eq_of_orderAtLeast_gt
QPCF.inv_sub_inv_orderAtLeast
statement:
lemma inv_sub_inv_orderAtLeast {x y : ℚ⸨X⸩} {b s : ℤ}
    (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) (hox : x.order = s) (hoy : y.order = s)
    (hd : OrderAtLeast (x - y) b) :
    OrderAtLeast (x⁻¹ - y⁻¹) (b - 2 * s)

name: QPCF.rigidityRemainder_zero
statement:
lemma rigidityRemainder_zero (L : ℚ⸨X⸩) (m : ℕ) :
    rigidityRemainder L m 0 = rigidityBudget L m
proof:
:= by
  unfold rigidityRemainder; norm_num;

name: QPCF.rigidityRemainder_succ
statement:
lemma rigidityRemainder_succ (L : ℚ⸨X⸩) (m j : ℕ) :
    rigidityRemainder L m (j + 1) =
      rigidityRemainder L m j - 2 * rigidityOrder L j

name: QPCF.rigidityRemainder_pos
statement:
lemma rigidityRemainder_pos (L : ℚ⸨X⸩) (m j : ℕ)
    (hnd : CFNondegThrough L m) (hj : j ≤ m) :
    1 ≤ rigidityRemainder L m j

name: QPCF.rigidityRemainder_gt_twice
statement:
lemma rigidityRemainder_gt_twice (L : ℚ⸨X⸩) (m j : ℕ)
    (hnd : CFNondegThrough L m) (hj : j < m) :
    2 * rigidityOrder L j < rigidityRemainder L m j

name: QPCF.cf_rigidity_L1
statement:
theorem cf_rigidity_L1 (L L' : ℚ⸨X⸩) (m : ℕ)
    (hnd : CFNondegThrough L m)
    (hclose : OrderAtLeast (L' - L) (rigidityBudget L m)) :
    (∀ j ≤ m, RigidityAt L L' m j) ∧
    (∀ j < m, fFract L' j ≠ 0 ∧ rigidityOrder L' j = rigidityOrder L j)

name: QPCF.continuous_cylinder_orderAtLeast
statement:
lemma continuous_cylinder_orderAtLeast (F : C(ZHat, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (t : ZHat) (b : ℤ) :
    ∃ M : ℕ, ∀ z : ZHat, ZHat.proj M z = ZHat.proj M t →
      OrderAtLeast (F z - F t) b

name: QPCF.cf_rigidity_L1a
statement:
theorem cf_rigidity_L1a (F : C(ZHat, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (t : ZHat) (m : ℕ)
    (hnd : CFNondegThrough (F t) m) :
    ∃ M : ℕ, ∀ z : ZHat, ZHat.proj M z = ZHat.proj M t →
      (∀ j ≤ m, RigidityAt (F t) (F z) m j) ∧
      (∀ j < m, fFract (F z) j ≠ 0 ∧
        rigidityOrder (F z) j = rigidityOrder (F t) j)

name: QPCF.cf_deviation_exact
statement:
lemma cf_deviation_exact (L L' : ℚ⸨X⸩) (m : ℕ) (K : ℤ)
    (hnd : CFNondegThrough L m) (hne : L' ≠ L)
    (hexact : (L' - L).order = K)
    (hbudget : rigidityBudget L m ≤ K) :
    ∀ j ≤ m, cq L' j - cq L j ≠ 0 ∧
      (cq L' j - cq L j).order =
        K - 2 * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, rigidityOrder L i

name: QPCF.cf_rigidity_L1b
statement:
theorem cf_rigidity_L1b (L L' : ℚ⸨X⸩) (d : ℕ) (K : ℤ)
    (hnd : CFNondegThrough L d)
    (hterm : fFract L d = 0)
    (hne : L' ≠ L)
    (hexact : (L' - L).order = K)
    (hbudget : rigidityBudget L d ≤ K) :
    (∀ j ≤ d, RigidityAt L L' d j) ∧
    fFract L' d ≠ 0 ∧
    (fFract L' d).order = K - 2 * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range d, rigidityOrder L j ∧
    fFloor L' (d + 1) ≠ 0 ∧
    -(fFloor L' (d + 1)).order =
      K - 2 * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range d, rigidityOrder L j

name: QPCF.exists_base_of_governsOn
statement:
theorem exists_base_of_governsOn (S : Set ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (L : ℚ⸨X⸩) (Knat : ℕ)
    (h : BigOpowOn S (fun n => a n - pval L (Knat : ℤ) n) (-((Knat : ℤ) + 1))) :
    ∃ (atil : ℕ → ℝ) (C0 : ℝ), 0 ≤ C0 ∧ (∀ n ∈ S, atil n = a n) ∧
      ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, |atil n - pval L (Knat : ℤ) n| ≤ C0 / (n : ℝ) ^ (Knat + 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := h
  refine ⟨fun n => if n ∈ S then a n else pval L (Knat : ℤ) n, max C 0, le_max_right _ _,
    fun n hn => by simp [hn], ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hC, Filter.eventually_gt_atTop 0] with n hn hnpos
  by_cases hnS : n ∈ S
  · simp only [hnS, if_true]
    have hb := hn hnS
    have hcast : (n : ℝ) ^ (-((Knat : ℤ) + 1)) = ((n : ℝ) ^ (Knat + 1))⁻¹ := by
      rw [← zpow_natCast (n : ℝ) (Knat + 1)]; push_cast; rw [zpow_neg]
    rw [hcast] at hb
    rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
    exact le_trans hb (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) (by positivity))
  · simp only [hnS, if_false, sub_self, abs_zero]
    positivity

name: QPCF.caseB_fract_decay
statement:
theorem caseB_fract_decay
    (a : ℕ → ℝ) (L : ℚ⸨X⸩) (S : Set ℕ) (M : ℕ)
    (hgov : GovernsOn S L a)
    (hterm : fFract L M = 0)
    (hnd : ∀ m < M, fFract L m ≠ 0)
    (hs : ∀ m < M, ∃ sm : ℕ, 1 ≤ sm ∧ (fFract L m).order = (sm : ℤ))
    (hint : ∀ m ≤ M, ∀ (K : ℤ), ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, ∃ z : ℤ, pval (fFloor L m) K n = (z : ℝ))
    (hnondeg : ∀ m < M, ∃ (c : ℝ) (Md : ℕ), 0 < c ∧ ∀ (K : ℤ), ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
        c / (n : ℝ) ^ Md ≤ pval (fFract L m) K n ∧
          pval (fFract L m) K n ≤ 1 - c / (n : ℝ) ^ Md)
    (hfloorM : ∀ (K : ℤ), ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ∈ S →
        (⌊realGaussIter M (a n)⌋ : ℝ) = pval (fFloor L M) K n) :
    ∀ k : ℕ, BigOpowOn S (fun n => Int.fract (realGaussIter M (a n))) (-(k : ℤ))

name: QPCF.caseB_superpoly
statement:
theorem caseB_superpoly
    (x : ℕ → ℝ) (S : Set ℕ) (M : ℕ)
    (hdecay : ∀ k : ℕ, BigOpowOn S (fun n => Int.fract (realGaussIter M (x n))) (-(k : ℤ)))
    (hpos : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ∈ S → 0 < Int.fract (realGaussIter M (x n))) :
    ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ∈ S → (n : ℝ) ^ k ≤ realPQ (M + 1) (x n)
proof:
:= by
  intro k;
  
  have h_realPQ_def : ∀ n, realPQ (M + 1) (x n) = ⌊(Int.fract (realGaussIter M (x n)))⁻¹⌋ := by
    intro n
    simp [realPQ, realGaussIter_succ_fract]
  generalize_proofs at *; (
  
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ᶠ n in atTop, n ∈ S → |Int.fract (realGaussIter M (x n))| ≤ C * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(k + 1) : ℤ) := by
    convert hdecay ( k + 1 ) using 1
  generalize_proofs at *; (
  filter_upwards [ hC, hpos, Filter.eventually_ge_atTop ⌈C⌉₊, Filter.eventually_ge_atTop 1 ] with n hn hn' hn'' hn''' ; simp_all +decide [ abs_of_pos ] ; (
  intro hnS
  have h_inv : (Int.fract (realGaussIter M (x n)))⁻¹ ≥ (n : ℝ) ^ k := by
    have h_inv : (Int.fract (realGaussIter M (x n))) ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ (-(k + 1) : ℤ) * n := by
      convert hn hnS |> le_trans <| mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hn'' <| by positivity using 1 ; ring
    generalize_proofs at *; (
    refine' le_trans _ ( inv_anti₀ ( hn' hnS ) h_inv ) ; norm_cast ; norm_num [ pow_succ, mul_assoc, ne_of_gt ( zero_lt_one.trans_le hn''' ) ] ; ring_nf ;
    rw [ mul_right_comm, mul_inv_cancel₀ ( by positivity ), one_mul ])
  generalize_proofs at *; (
  exact_mod_cast Int.le_floor.mpr ( mod_cast h_inv )))))

name: QPCF.governsOn_of_govC_agree
statement:
theorem governsOn_of_govC_agree (F : C(ZHat, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (hgov : GovC F a)
    (S : Set ℕ) (L₀ : ℚ⸨X⸩)
    (hagree : ∀ n ∈ S, ∀ k : ℤ, (F (ZHat.ofNat n)).coeff k = L₀.coeff k) :
    GovernsOn S L₀ a
proof:
:= by
  intro N
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hgov N
  refine ⟨C, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hC] with n hn hnS
  have hpv : pval (F (ZHat.ofNat n)) N n = pval L₀ N n := by
    rw [pval_congr]; intro k _; exact hagree n hnS k
  rw [← hpv]; exact hn

name: QPCF.caseB_forward
statement:
theorem caseB_forward (F : C(ZHat, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (hgov : GovC F a)
    (L : ℚ⸨X⸩) (D r M : ℕ)
    (hagree : ∀ n ∈ ({n : ℕ | n % D = r} : Set ℕ), ∀ k : ℤ,
      (F (ZHat.ofNat n)).coeff k = L.coeff k)
    (hterm : fFract L M = 0) (hnd : ∀ m < M, fFract L m ≠ 0)
    (hs : ∀ m < M, ∃ sm : ℕ, 1 ≤ sm ∧ (fFract L m).order = (sm : ℤ))
    (hint : ∀ m ≤ M, ∀ (K : ℤ), ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, ∃ z : ℤ, pval (fFloor L m) K n = (z : ℝ))
    (hnondeg : ∀ m < M, ∃ (c : ℝ) (Md : ℕ), 0 < c ∧ ∀ (K : ℤ), ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
        c / (n : ℝ) ^ Md ≤ pval (fFract L m) K n ∧
          pval (fFract L m) K n ≤ 1 - c / (n : ℝ) ^ Md)
    (hfloorM : ∀ (K : ℤ), ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ∈ ({n : ℕ | n % D = r} : Set ℕ) →
        (⌊realGaussIter M (a n)⌋ : ℝ) = pval (fFloor L M) K n)
    (hnonvanish : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ∈ ({n : ℕ | n % D = r} : Set ℕ) →
        0 < Int.fract (realGaussIter M (a n)))
    (hB1 : ∀ m ≤ M, ∃ P : Polynomial ℚ,
        (∀ n : ℕ, ∃ z : ℤ, P.eval ((n : ℕ) : ℚ) = (z : ℚ)) ∧
        (∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n % D = r →
          realPQ m (a n) = (((P.eval ((n : ℕ) : ℚ)) : ℚ) : ℝ))) :
    CaseB a D r M
proof:
:= by
  have hgovOn : GovernsOn ({n : ℕ | n % D = r} : Set ℕ) L a :=
    governsOn_of_govC_agree F a hgov _ L hagree
  refine ⟨hB1, ?_⟩
  exact caseB_superpoly a ({n : ℕ | n % D = r} : Set ℕ) M
    (caseB_fract_decay a L _ M hgovOn hterm hnd hs hint hnondeg hfloorM) hnonvanish

name: QPCF.fFloor_eq_polyExpansion_pvalPoly
statement:
theorem fFloor_eq_polyExpansion_pvalPoly (L : ℚ⸨X⸩) (j : ℕ) :
    fFloor L j = polyExpansion (pvalPoly (fFloor L j))
proof:
:= by
  have h_fFloor_eq_poly : ∀ k : ℤ, (fFloor L j).coeff k = (polyExpansion (pvalPoly (fFloor L j))).coeff k := by
    intro k
    by_cases hk_pos : 0 < k
    · have hz : ∀ k : ℤ, 0 < k → (fFloor L j).coeff k = 0 := by
        intro k hk
        convert HahnSeries.coeff_truncLT _ _ _
        grind
      rw [hz k hk_pos, polyExpansion_coeff_pos]
      aesop
    · cases' Int.eq_nat_or_neg k with hk hk <;> simp_all +decide [polyExpansion_coeff]
      cases hk <;> simp_all +decide [fFloor]
      · unfold pvalPoly polyExpansion
        simp +decide [Finset.sum_range_succ']
        rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero] <;> norm_num
        · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single 0] <;> norm_num
          · intros; omega
          · exact fun h => by rw [HahnSeries.coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_order]; aesop
        · grind +suggestions
      · rw [polyExpansion_coeff]
        unfold pvalPoly
        rw [Polynomial.finset_sum_coeff, Finset.sum_eq_single (-hk : ℤ)] <;> norm_num
        · omega
        · grind +suggestions
  ext k
  exact h_fFloor_eq_poly k

name: QPCF.terminating_eq_polyExpansion_div
statement:
theorem terminating_eq_polyExpansion_div (L : ℚ⸨X⸩) (d : ℕ)
    (hnd : CFNondegThrough L d) (hterm : fFract L d = 0) :
    ∃ P Q : Polynomial ℚ, Q ≠ 0 ∧
      L = polyExpansion P * (polyExpansion Q)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hd : d = 0
  · use pvalPoly (fFloor L 0), 1
    simp_all +decide [CFNondegThrough]
    convert fFloor_eq_polyExpansion_pvalPoly L 0 using 1
    · convert gaussIter_split L 0 using 1 <;> aesop
    · unfold polyExpansion; norm_num
  · induction' d with d ih generalizing L
    · contradiction
    · obtain ⟨P, Q, hQ, hL⟩ : ∃ P Q : Polynomial ℚ, Q ≠ 0 ∧ gaussIter 1 L = polyExpansion P * (polyExpansion Q)⁻¹ := by
        by_cases hd : d = 0
        · use pvalPoly (fFloor (gaussIter 1 L) 0), 1
          simp_all +decide [CFNondegThrough]
          convert fFloor_eq_polyExpansion_pvalPoly (gaussIter 1 L) 0 using 1
          · convert gaussIter_split (gaussIter 1 L) 0 using 1
            simp_all +decide [fFloor, fFract]
          · unfold polyExpansion; norm_num
        · apply ih (gaussIter 1 L)
          · intro j hj; convert hnd (j + 1) (by linarith) using 1
          · convert hterm using 1
          · assumption
      obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ : ∃ R : Polynomial ℚ, fFloor L 0 = polyExpansion R :=
        ⟨_, fFloor_eq_polyExpansion_pvalPoly L 0⟩
      have hL_def : L = fFloor L 0 + (gaussIter 1 L)⁻¹ := by
        convert gaussIter_split L 0 using 1
        rw [fFract_inv_eq]
        norm_num
      rw [hL_def, hR, hL]
      by_cases hP : P = 0 <;> simp +decide [hP, hQ, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm]
      · norm_num [hP, polyExpansion] at *
        exact ⟨R, 1, by norm_num, by norm_num⟩
      · refine ⟨R * P + Q, P, hP, ?_⟩
        rw [show polyExpansion (R * P + Q) = polyExpansion R * polyExpansion P + polyExpansion Q from ?_]
        · simp +decide [add_mul, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, hP, hQ, polyExpansion_ne_zero]
          rw [mul_add, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ (polyExpansion_ne_zero _ hP), one_mul]
        · apply polyExpansion_governs (R * P + Q) |> fun h => h.unique (by
            convert Governs.add (Governs.mul (polyExpansion_governs R) (polyExpansion_governs P)) (polyExpansion_governs Q) using 1
            norm_num [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul])
