name: QPCF.caseA_on_class_of_governsUpTo
statement:
theorem caseA_on_class_of_governsUpTo
    {L : ℚ⸨X⸩} (hL : ¬ IsRat L) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (S : Set ℕ)
    (β : BranchDatum L) (J : ℕ)
    (hgu : ∀ K : ℤ, GovernsUpToOn K S L a)
    (hsub : S ⊆ {n : ℕ | n ≡ β.b J [MOD β.Ds J]}) :
    ∃ p : Fin (J + 1) → Polynomial ℚ,
      (∀ j : Fin (J + 1), ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ∈ S →
        realPQ j.1 (a n) = (((p j).eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)) ∧
      (∀ j : Fin (J + 1), ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → n ∈ S →
        ∃ z : ℤ, (p j).eval (n : ℚ) = (z : ℚ)) ∧
      (∀ j : Fin (J + 1), 1 ≤ j.1 → ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
        n ∈ S → 1 ≤ (p j).eval (n : ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, c, K₀, hc, hnd⟩ := β.branch_nondeg hL J
  obtain ⟨K₇, htrack⟩ := β.branch_tracking hL J
  set Kbound := max K₀ K₇
  set Nsched : ℕ → ℕ := fun m => (∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc m J, 2 * M i) + Kbound + 1
  have hNs0_ge : Kbound + 1 ≤ Nsched 0 := by simp only [Nsched]; omega
  have hbud : ∀ m ≤ J, 2 * M m < Nsched m := by
    intro m hm
    have hle : 2 * M m ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc m J, 2 * M i :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => Nat.zero_le (2 * M i))
        (Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨le_rfl, hm⟩)
    simp only [Nsched]; omega
  have hsched : ∀ m, m < J → Nsched (m + 1) + 2 * M m ≤ Nsched m := by
    intro m hm
    have hsplit : ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc m J, 2 * M i
        = (∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc (m + 1) J, 2 * M i) + 2 * M m := by
      have hunion : Finset.Icc m J = insert m (Finset.Icc (m + 1) J) := by
        ext x; simp only [Finset.mem_Icc, Finset.mem_insert]; omega
      rw [hunion, Finset.sum_insert (by simp only [Finset.mem_Icc]; omega)]; ring
    simp only [Nsched]; omega
  have hstab : ∀ m ≤ J, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ∈ S →
      realPQ m (a n) = (⌊realGaussIter m (pval L ((Nsched 0 : ℤ) - 1) n)⌋ : ℝ) := by
    refine formal_stability_i_governs_on_finite S a L ((Nsched 0 : ℤ) - 1)
      J M Nsched c hc le_rfl (hgu _) hbud hsched ?_
    intro m hm
    have hNspos : 1 ≤ Nsched 0 := by simp only [Nsched]; omega
    have hcast : ((Nsched 0 - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (Nsched 0 : ℤ) - 1 := by omega
    have hK₀le : K₀ ≤ Nsched 0 - 1 := by omega
    filter_upwards [hnd (Nsched 0 - 1) hK₀le m hm] with n hn hnS
    rw [← hcast]
    exact hn (hsub hnS)
  refine ⟨fun j => bfloorPoly (β.tower j) (β.Ds j) (β.b j), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j
    have hNspos : 1 ≤ Nsched 0 := by simp only [Nsched]; omega
    have hcast : ((Nsched 0 - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (Nsched 0 : ℤ) - 1 := by omega
    have hK₇le : K₇ ≤ Nsched 0 - 1 := by omega
    filter_upwards [hstab j j.is_le,
      htrack (Nsched 0 - 1) hK₇le j j.is_le] with n hn hn' hnS
    rw [hn hnS, ← bfloorVal_eq_bfloorPoly_eval, ← hcast]
    exact hn' (hsub hnS)
  · intro j n hn1 hnS
    have hclass : n ≡ β.b j [MOD β.Ds j] := β.class_subset j.is_le (hsub hnS)
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := bfloorVal_intVal (β.hper j) (β.b j) hn1 hclass
    exact ⟨z, by rw [← bfloorVal_eq_bfloorPoly_eval]; exact_mod_cast hz⟩
  · intro j hj
    filter_upwards [eventually_one_le_bfloorPoly_on_branch hL β J j j.is_le hj]
      with n hn hnS
    exact hn (hsub hnS)

name: QPCF.threadBranchResidue_coh
statement:
theorem threadBranchResidue_coh (L : ℚ⸨X⸩) (t : ZHat) (k : ℕ) :
    threadBranchResidue L t (k + 1) ≡ threadBranchResidue L t k
      [MOD allResModulus L k]
proof:
:= by
  let D := allResModulus L k
  let E := allResModulus L (k + 1)
  have hD : 0 < D := allResModulus_pos L k
  have hDE : D ∣ E := allResModulus_dvd_succ L k
  have hE : 0 < E := allResModulus_pos L (k + 1)
  have hle : D ≤ E := Nat.le_of_dvd hE hDE
  have hp := ZHat.proj_mono t hle
  have hfac : (ZHat.proj E t).val % D.factorial =
      (ZHat.proj D t).val % D.factorial := by
    erw [← ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff']
    simpa using hp
  have hmod : (ZHat.proj E t).val ≡ (ZHat.proj D t).val [MOD D] :=
    Nat.ModEq.of_dvd (Nat.dvd_factorial hD le_rfl) hfac
  change ((ZHat.proj E t).val % E) % D = ((ZHat.proj D t).val % D) % D
  rw [Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd _ hDE, Nat.mod_mod]
  exact hmod

name: QPCF.btower_threadBranchResidue_eq
statement:
theorem btower_threadBranchResidue_eq (L : ℚ⸨X⸩) (t : ZHat) (k : ℕ) :
    btower L (allResModulus L) (threadBranchResidue L t) k =
      allResTower L k (threadBranchResidue L t k)
proof:
:= by
  induction' k with k ih
  · rfl
  · rw [btower, allResTower_succ, threadBranchResidue_coh]
    rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt]
    · rw [ih]
    · exact Nat.mod_lt _ (allResModulus_pos L k)

name: QPCF.caseA_onThread
statement:
theorem caseA_onThread
    (F : C(ZHat, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (hgov : GovC F a)
    (t : ZHat) (hirr : ¬ IsRat (F t)) (J : ℕ) :
    let β := threadBranch (F t) t
    ∃ M : ℕ,
      (∀ j : Fin (J + 1), ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ∈ ThreadClass t M →
        realPQ j.1 (a n) =
          ((((bfloorPoly (β.tower j) (β.Ds j) (β.b j)).eval (n : ℚ)) : ℚ) : ℝ)) ∧
      (∀ j : Fin (J + 1), ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → n ∈ ThreadClass t M →
        ∃ z : ℤ, (bfloorPoly (β.tower j) (β.Ds j) (β.b j)).eval (n : ℚ) = (z : ℚ)) ∧
      (∀ j : Fin (J + 1), 1 ≤ j.1 → ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
        n ∈ ThreadClass t M →
          1 ≤ (bfloorPoly (β.tower j) (β.Ds j) (β.b j)).eval (n : ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  let D := allResModulus (F t) J
  have hD : 0 < D := allResModulus_pos _ _
  let β := threadBranch (F t) t
  have hDfac : D ∣ D.factorial := Nat.dvd_factorial hD le_rfl
  have hsub0 : ThreadClass t D ⊆ {n : ℕ | n ≡ β.b J [MOD β.Ds J]} := by
    intro n hn
    have hh := threadClass_modEq_proj_val t D D hDfac hn
    change n ≡ (ZHat.proj D t).val % D [MOD D]
    exact hh.trans (Nat.mod_modEq (ZHat.proj D t).val D).symm
  obtain ⟨Md, c, K₀, hc, hnd⟩ := β.branch_nondeg hirr J
  obtain ⟨K₇, htrack⟩ := β.branch_tracking hirr J
  set Kbound := max K₀ K₇
  set Nsched : ℕ → ℕ := fun m => (∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc m J, 2 * Md i) + Kbound + 1
  have hbud : ∀ m ≤ J, 2 * Md m < Nsched m := by
    intro m hm
    have hle : 2 * Md m ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc m J, 2 * Md i :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => Nat.zero_le (2 * Md i))
        (Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨le_rfl, hm⟩)
    simp only [Nsched]; omega
  have hsched : ∀ m, m < J → Nsched (m + 1) + 2 * Md m ≤ Nsched m := by
    intro m hm
    have hsplit : ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc m J, 2 * Md i
        = (∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc (m + 1) J, 2 * Md i) + 2 * Md m := by
      have hunion : Finset.Icc m J = insert m (Finset.Icc (m + 1) J) := by
        ext x; simp only [Finset.mem_Icc, Finset.mem_insert]; omega
      rw [hunion, Finset.sum_insert (by simp only [Finset.mem_Icc]; omega)]; ring
    simp only [Nsched]; omega
  obtain ⟨Mc, hMc⟩ := continuous_cylinder_orderAtLeast F t (Nsched 0)
  let Mf := max D Mc
  have hsubD : ThreadClass t Mf ⊆ ThreadClass t D := ThreadClass.antitone t (le_max_left _ _)
  have hsubC : ThreadClass t Mf ⊆ ThreadClass t Mc := ThreadClass.antitone t (le_max_right _ _)
  have hsub : ThreadClass t Mf ⊆ {n : ℕ | n ≡ β.b J [MOD β.Ds J]} :=
    fun n hn => hsub0 (hsubD hn)
  have hagree : ∀ n ∈ ThreadClass t Mf, ∀ k : ℤ, k ≤ (Nsched 0 : ℤ) - 1 →
      (F (ZHat.ofNat n)).coeff k = (F t).coeff k := by
    intro n hn k hk
    specialize hMc (ZHat.ofNat n) (hsubC hn)
    cases hMc with
    | inl hz =>
      have heq : F (ZHat.ofNat n) = F t := sub_eq_zero.mp hz
      rw [heq]
    | inr ho =>
      rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← HahnSeries.coeff_sub]
      exact HahnSeries.coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_order (by linarith)
  have hgu : GovernsUpToOn ((Nsched 0 : ℤ) - 1) (ThreadClass t Mf) (F t) a :=
    govUpToOn_of_govC_agree F a hgov _ _ _ hagree
  have hstab : ∀ m ≤ J, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ∈ ThreadClass t Mf →
      realPQ m (a n) = (⌊realGaussIter m (pval (F t) ((Nsched 0 : ℤ) - 1) n)⌋ : ℝ) := by
    refine formal_stability_i_governs_on_finite _ a (F t) _ J Md Nsched c hc le_rfl
      hgu hbud hsched ?_
    intro m hm
    have hNspos : 1 ≤ Nsched 0 := by simp only [Nsched]; omega
    have hcast : ((Nsched 0 - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (Nsched 0 : ℤ) - 1 := by omega
    have hK₀le : K₀ ≤ Nsched 0 - 1 := by simp only [Nsched, Kbound]; omega
    filter_upwards [hnd (Nsched 0 - 1) hK₀le m hm] with n hn hnS
    rw [← hcast]
    exact hn (hsub hnS)
  refine ⟨Mf, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j
    have hNspos : 1 ≤ Nsched 0 := by simp only [Nsched]; omega
    have hcast : ((Nsched 0 - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (Nsched 0 : ℤ) - 1 := by omega
    have hK₇le : K₇ ≤ Nsched 0 - 1 := by simp only [Nsched, Kbound]; omega
    filter_upwards [hstab j j.is_le, htrack (Nsched 0 - 1) hK₇le j j.is_le]
      with n hn hn' hnS
    rw [hn hnS, ← bfloorVal_eq_bfloorPoly_eval, ← hcast]
    exact hn' (hsub hnS)
  · intro j n hn1 hnS
    have hclass : n ≡ β.b j [MOD β.Ds j] := β.class_subset j.is_le (hsub hnS)
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := bfloorVal_intVal (β.hper j) (β.b j) hn1 hclass
    exact ⟨z, by rw [← bfloorVal_eq_bfloorPoly_eval]; exact_mod_cast hz⟩
  · intro j hj
    filter_upwards [eventually_one_le_bfloorPoly_on_branch hirr β J j j.is_le hj]
      with n hn hnS
    exact hn (hsub hnS)

name: QPCF.armA'_and_condC_of_govC_of_irrational
statement:
theorem armA'_and_condC_of_govC_of_irrational
    (F : C(ZHat, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (hgov : GovC F a)
    (t : ZHat) (hirr : ¬ IsRat (F t)) :
    (∀ m : ℕ, ArmA' a t m) ∧ CondC a t
proof:
:= by
  let β := threadBranch (F t) t
  constructor
  · intro m
    obtain ⟨M, htrack, hint, hpos⟩ := caseA_onThread F a hgov t hirr m
    exact ⟨M, fun j => bfloorPoly (β.tower j) (β.Ds j) (β.b j),
      htrack, hint, hpos⟩
  · intro B
    obtain ⟨m, hdeg⟩ := branch_degree_growth hirr β B
    obtain ⟨M, htrack, hint, hpos⟩ := caseA_onThread F a hgov t hirr m
    refine ⟨m, M, fun j => bfloorPoly (β.tower j) (β.Ds j) (β.b j),
      htrack, hint, hpos, ?_⟩
    simpa only [Finset.sum_range] using hdeg

name: QPCF.armB_of_govC_of_termination
statement:
theorem armB_of_govC_of_termination
    (F : C(ZHat, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (hgov : GovC F a)
    (t : ZHat) (d : ℕ) (hnd : CFNondegThrough (F t) d)
    (hterm : fFract (F t) d = 0) :
    ArmB a t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, Q, hQ, h⟩ := terminating_eq_polyExpansion_div (F t) d hnd hterm
  refine ⟨P, Q, hQ, ?_⟩
  intro k
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := continuous_cylinder_orderAtLeast F t (k + 1)
  have h_govern : BigOpowOn (ThreadClass t M) (fun n => a n - pval (F t) k n) (-(k + 1 : ℤ)) := by
    apply QPCF.govUpToOn_of_govC_agree F a hgov (k : ℤ) (ThreadClass t M) (F t)
    · intro n hn j hj
      specialize hM (ZHat.ofNat n) hn
      cases hM <;> simp_all +singlePass [sub_eq_iff_eq_add]
      rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← HahnSeries.coeff_sub]
      exact HahnSeries.coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_order (by linarith)
    · norm_num
  have h_rational_govern : BigOpowOn (ThreadClass t M) (fun n => pval (F t) k n - (((P.eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) / ((Q.eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ))) (-(k + 1 : ℤ)) := by
    have hh := @ratSeq_governs_expansion P Q hQ k
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hh
    use C
    filter_upwards [hC] with n hn hn'
    rw [h]
    simpa [abs_sub_comm] using hn
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := BigOpowOn.add h_govern h_rational_govern
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := poly_eval_abs_lower Q hQ
  refine ⟨M, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hC, hN.2, Filter.eventually_gt_atTop 0,
    Filter.eventually_gt_atTop ⌈C⌉₊, Filter.eventually_gt_atTop ⌈N⁻¹⌉₊]
      with n hn hn' hn'' hn''' hn''''
  intro hnM
  have hQ_nonzero : Q.eval (n : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
    contrapose! hn'
    simp [hn']
    exact mul_pos hN.1 (pow_pos (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hn'') _)
  have h_bound : |a n - (P.eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) / (Q.eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ)| ≤ C * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(k + 1) : ℤ) := by
    convert hn hnM using 1 <;> ring
  have h_final_bound : C * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(k + 1) : ℤ) ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ (-k : ℤ) := by
    norm_num [zpow_add₀, zpow_neg, hn''.ne']
    field_simp
    exact le_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_ceil_lt hn''')
  exact ⟨hQ_nonzero, le_trans h_bound h_final_bound⟩

name: QPCF.isRat_of_armB_const
statement:
theorem isRat_of_armB_const (c : ℝ) (t : ZHat)
    (h : ArmB (fun _ : ℕ => c) t) : Irrational c → False
proof:
:= by
  intros h_irr;
  obtain ⟨ P, Q, hQ, h ⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨ M, hM ⟩ := h 1
  generalize_proofs at *; (
  
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s : ℕ, s < Nat.factorial M ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, (s + k * Nat.factorial M) ∈ ThreadClass t M := by
    use (ZHat.proj M t).val
    generalize_proofs at *; (
    simp +decide [ ThreadClass ];
    simp +decide [ ZHat.ofNat ];
    grind +locals)
  generalize_proofs at *; (
  
  have h_seq : Filter.Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => ((P.eval (s + k * Nat.factorial M : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) / ((Q.eval (s + k * Nat.factorial M : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)) Filter.atTop (nhds c) := by
    have h_seq : Filter.Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => |c - ((P.eval (s + k * Nat.factorial M : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) / ((Q.eval (s + k * Nat.factorial M : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)|) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      refine' squeeze_zero_norm' _ _;
      use fun n => ( s + n * M.factorial : ℝ ) ^ ( -1 : ℝ );
      · simp +zetaDelta at *;
        obtain ⟨ a, ha ⟩ := hM; use a; intros b hb; specialize ha ( s + b * M.factorial ) ( by nlinarith ) ( hs.2 b ) ; norm_cast at *; aesop;
      · norm_cast ; norm_num [ Nat.factorial_ne_zero ];
        exact tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp <| tendsto_const_nhds.add_atTop <| tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop.atTop_mul_const ( Nat.cast_pos.mpr <| Nat.factorial_pos _ )
    generalize_proofs at *; (
    rw [ tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero ] ; simpa [ abs_sub_comm ] using h_seq;)
  generalize_proofs at *; (
  
  by_cases h_deg : P.degree ≤ Q.degree;
  · by_cases h_deg_eq : P.degree = Q.degree;
    · have h_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => ((P.eval (s + k * Nat.factorial M : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) / ((Q.eval (s + k * Nat.factorial M : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)) Filter.atTop (nhds ((P.leadingCoeff : ℝ) / (Q.leadingCoeff : ℝ))) := by
        have h_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℚ => ((P.eval x : ℚ) : ℝ) / ((Q.eval x : ℚ) : ℝ)) Filter.atTop (nhds ((P.leadingCoeff : ℝ) / (Q.leadingCoeff : ℝ))) := by
          convert Polynomial.div_tendsto_atTop_leadingCoeff_div_of_degree_eq P Q h_deg_eq using 1
          generalize_proofs at *; (
          norm_num [ tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero ];
          norm_num [ Norm.norm ])
        generalize_proofs at *; (
        exact h_lim.comp <| Filter.tendsto_atTop_mono ( fun k => by norm_cast; nlinarith [ Nat.factorial_pos M ] ) tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop)
      generalize_proofs at *; (
      exact h_irr ⟨ P.leadingCoeff / Q.leadingCoeff, by push_cast; linarith [ tendsto_nhds_unique h_seq h_lim ] ⟩);
    · have h_lim_zero : Filter.Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => ((P.eval (s + k * Nat.factorial M : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) / ((Q.eval (s + k * Nat.factorial M : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
        have h_lim_zero : Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℚ => ((P.eval x : ℚ) : ℝ) / ((Q.eval x : ℚ) : ℝ)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
          convert P.div_tendsto_atTop_zero_of_degree_lt Q _ using 1
          generalize_proofs at *; (
          norm_num [ Metric.tendsto_nhds ]);
          exact lt_of_le_of_ne h_deg h_deg_eq
        generalize_proofs at *; (
        exact h_lim_zero.comp <| Filter.tendsto_atTop_mono ( fun k => by norm_cast; nlinarith [ Nat.factorial_pos M ] ) tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop)
      generalize_proofs at *; (
      exact h_irr.ne_zero ( tendsto_nhds_unique h_seq h_lim_zero ));
  · have h_lim_inf : Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℚ => |(P.eval x : ℚ) / (Q.eval x : ℚ)|) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop := by
      have := Polynomial.abs_div_tendsto_atTop_atTop_of_degree_gt P Q ( lt_of_not_ge h_deg ) ; aesop;
    generalize_proofs at *; (
    have h_lim_inf : Filter.Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => |(P.eval (s + k * Nat.factorial M : ℚ) : ℚ) / (Q.eval (s + k * Nat.factorial M : ℚ) : ℚ)|) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop := by
      exact h_lim_inf.comp <| Filter.tendsto_atTop_mono ( fun k => by norm_cast; nlinarith [ Nat.self_le_factorial M ] ) tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
    generalize_proofs at *; (
    convert not_tendsto_atTop_of_tendsto_nhds ( h_seq.abs ) _ using 1
    generalize_proofs at *; (
    rw [ Filter.tendsto_atTop_atTop ] at *;
    exact fun x => by rcases h_lim_inf ( ⌈x⌉₊ : ℚ ) with ⟨ i, hi ⟩ ; exact ⟨ i, fun n hin => le_trans ( Nat.le_ceil _ ) ( mod_cast hi n hin ) ⟩ ;))))))

  intro h
  specialize h (ZHat.ofNat 0)
  rcases h with hB | ⟨hA, hC⟩

name: QPCF.part3_coeff_eq_of_common_governance
statement:
theorem part3_coeff_eq_of_common_governance (a : ℕ → ℝ) (f g : ℚ⸨X⸩)
    (S : Set ℕ) (hS : ∃ᶠ n in atTop, n ∈ S) (K : ℤ)
    (hf : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ᶠ n in atTop,
      n ∈ S → |a n - pval f K n| ≤ C * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(K + 1)))
    (hg : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ᶠ n in atTop,
      n ∈ S → |a n - pval g K n| ≤ C * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(K + 1))) :
    ∀ k : ℤ, k ≤ K → f.coeff k = g.coeff k
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk
  by_contra h_neq_k
  have h_coeff_neq_k : ¬(f.coeff k = g.coeff k) := by
    assumption
  
  have h_pval_diff : ∃ C, ∀ᶠ n in atTop, n ∈ S → |(pval (f - g) K n)| ≤ C * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(K + 1)) := by
    have h_pval_diff : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, n ∈ S → |pval (f - g) K n| ≤ |a n - pval f K n| + |a n - pval g K n| := by
      have h_pval_diff : ∀ n : ℕ, pval (f - g) K n = pval f K n - pval g K n := by
        intro n; exact (by
          have := QPCF.pval_add f (-g) K n; simp_all +decide [ sub_eq_add_neg ] ;
          exact QPCF.pval_neg g K n ▸ rfl;
        )
      generalize_proofs at *; (
      filter_upwards [ ] using fun n hn => by rw [ h_pval_diff n ] ; cases abs_cases ( a n - pval f K n ) <;> cases abs_cases ( a n - pval g K n ) <;> cases abs_cases ( pval f K n - pval g K n ) <;> linarith;)
    generalize_proofs at *; (
    obtain ⟨ C₁, hC₁ ⟩ := hf; obtain ⟨ C₂, hC₂ ⟩ := hg; use C₁ + C₂; filter_upwards [ h_pval_diff, hC₁, hC₂ ] with n hn₁ hn₂ hn₃; intro hn₄; exact le_trans ( hn₁ hn₄ ) ( by rw [ add_mul ] ; exact add_le_add ( hn₂ hn₄ ) ( hn₃ hn₄ ) ) ;)
  generalize_proofs at *; (
  
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m : ℤ, m ≤ K ∧ (f - g).coeff m ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ n : ℤ, n < m → n ≤ K → (f - g).coeff n = 0 := by
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m : ℤ, m ≤ K ∧ (f - g).coeff m ≠ 0 := by
      exact ⟨ k, hk, sub_ne_zero_of_ne h_neq_k ⟩
    generalize_proofs at *; (
    have h_min : ∃ m ∈ {n : ℤ | n ≤ K ∧ (f - g).coeff n ≠ 0}, ∀ n ∈ {n : ℤ | n ≤ K ∧ (f - g).coeff n ≠ 0}, m ≤ n := by
      apply_rules [ Int.exists_least_of_bdd ];
      · exact ⟨ ( f - g ).order, fun n hn => by exact HahnSeries.order_le_of_coeff_ne_zero hn.2 ⟩;
      · exact ⟨ m, hm ⟩
    generalize_proofs at *; (
    exact ⟨ h_min.choose, h_min.choose_spec.1.1, h_min.choose_spec.1.2, fun n hn₁ hn₂ => Classical.not_not.1 fun hn₃ => not_lt_of_ge ( h_min.choose_spec.2 n ⟨ hn₂, hn₃ ⟩ ) hn₁ ⟩))
  generalize_proofs at *; (
  
  have h_pval_diff_expansion : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ∈ S → |pval (f - g) K n - (f - g).coeff m * (n : ℝ) ^ (-m)| ≤ C * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(m + 1)) := by
    have h_pval_diff_expansion : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ∈ S → |pval (f - g) K n - (f - g).coeff m * (n : ℝ) ^ (-m)| ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc (m + 1) K, |(f - g).coeff j| * (n : ℝ) ^ (-j) := by
      filter_upwards [ Filter.eventually_gt_atTop 0 ] with n hn hnS
      generalize_proofs at *; (
      have h_pval_diff_expansion : pval (f - g) K n = ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc m K, (f - g).coeff j * (n : ℝ) ^ (-j) := by
        unfold pval; simp +decide [ Finset.sum_ite, hm ] ;
        rw [ ← finsum_mem_coe_finset ] ; congr ; ext ; simp +decide [ hm.2.2 ] ;
        by_cases h : m ≤ ‹ℤ› <;> simp_all +decide [ sub_eq_iff_eq_add ]
      generalize_proofs at *; (
      rw [ h_pval_diff_expansion, Finset.Icc_eq_cons_Ioc ( by linarith ), Finset.sum_cons ] ; norm_num [ abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg, hn.le ];
      exact le_trans ( Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _ ) ( Finset.sum_le_sum fun x hx => by rw [ abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ( by positivity : ( 0 : ℝ ) ≤ ( n ^ x : ℝ ) ⁻¹ ) ] ) |> le_trans <| by rw [ show ( Finset.Icc ( m + 1 ) K : Finset ℤ ) = Finset.Ioc m K by ext; aesop ] ;))
    generalize_proofs at *; (
    refine' ⟨ ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc ( m + 1 ) K, |( f - g ).coeff j|, _ ⟩
    generalize_proofs at *; (
    filter_upwards [ h_pval_diff_expansion, Filter.eventually_gt_atTop 0 ] with n hn hn' ; intro hn'' ; refine le_trans ( hn hn'' ) ?_ ; rw [ Finset.sum_mul _ _ _ ] ; gcongr ; aesop;
    · exact_mod_cast hn';
    · linarith [ Finset.mem_Icc.mp ‹_› ]))
  generalize_proofs at *; (
  
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := h_pval_diff
  obtain ⟨C', hC'⟩ := h_pval_diff_expansion
  have h_bound : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ∈ S → |(f - g).coeff m * (n : ℝ) ^ (-m)| ≤ (C + C') * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(m + 1)) := by
    filter_upwards [ hC, hC', Filter.eventually_gt_atTop 0 ] with n hn hn' hn'' ; intro hnS ; simp_all +decide [ abs_le ] ; (
    
    have h_bound : C * (n : ℝ) ^ (-1 + -K) ≤ C * (n : ℝ) ^ (-1 + -m) := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ( zpow_le_zpow_right₀ ( mod_cast hn'' ) ( by linarith ) ) ( show 0 ≤ C by nlinarith [ show ( n : ℝ ) ^ ( -1 + -K ) > 0 by positivity, show ( n : ℝ ) ^ ( -1 + -m ) > 0 by positivity ] )
    generalize_proofs at *; (
    cases abs_cases ( ( f.coeff m : ℝ ) - g.coeff m ) <;> nlinarith [ inv_pos.mpr ( by positivity : 0 < ( n : ℝ ) ^ m ) ] ;))
  generalize_proofs at *; (
  
  have h_div : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ∈ S → |(f - g).coeff m| * (n : ℝ) ≤ C + C' := by
    filter_upwards [ h_bound, Filter.eventually_gt_atTop 0 ] with n hn hn' ; intro hn'' ; specialize hn hn'' ; simp_all +decide [ abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg, Real.rpow_add, Real.rpow_neg ] ;
    convert mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hn ( show ( 0 : ℝ ) ≤ n ^ ( m + 1 ) by positivity ) using 1 <;> ring_nf ; norm_num [ hn'.ne', zpow_add₀, zpow_neg ] ; ring_nf;
    · rw [ mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ ( by positivity ), mul_one ];
    · norm_num [ mul_assoc, ← zpow_add₀ ( by positivity : ( n : ℝ ) ≠ 0 ) ]
  generalize_proofs at *; (
  simp_all +decide [ Filter.frequently_atTop ];
  obtain ⟨ a, ha ⟩ := h_div; obtain ⟨ b, hb₁, hb₂ ⟩ := hS ( a + ⌈ ( C + C' ) / |( f.coeff m : ℝ ) - g.coeff m|⌉₊ + 1 ) ; specialize ha b ( by linarith ) hb₂ ; nlinarith [ Nat.le_ceil ( ( C + C' ) / |( f.coeff m : ℝ ) - g.coeff m| ), abs_pos.mpr ( show ( f.coeff m : ℝ ) - g.coeff m ≠ 0 from mod_cast hm.2.1 ), mul_div_cancel₀ ( C + C' ) ( ne_of_gt ( abs_pos.mpr ( show ( f.coeff m : ℝ ) - g.coeff m ≠ 0 from mod_cast hm.2.1 ) ) ), show ( b : ℝ ) ≥ a + ⌈ ( C + C' ) / |( f.coeff m : ℝ ) - g.coeff m|⌉₊ + 1 by exact_mod_cast hb₁ ] ;)))))

name: QPCF.part3_germ_coherence
statement:
theorem part3_germ_coherence (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha : CorrectedDef32TR' a)
    (t : ZHat) (K : ℤ) :
    ∃ Λ : ℕ, ∀ t' : ZHat, ZHat.proj Λ t' = ZHat.proj Λ t →
      ∀ g' : ℚ⸨X⸩, Part3AdmissibleGerm a t' g' →
        ∀ k : ℤ, k ≤ K → (F_a a ha t).coeff k = g'.coeff k
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨Λ, hΛ⟩ : ∃ Λ : ℕ, ∀ t' : ZHat, (ZHat.proj Λ) t' = (ZHat.proj Λ) t → ∀ g' : ℚ⸨X⸩, Part3AdmissibleGerm a t' g' → ∀ k ≤ K, (F_a a ha t).coeff k = g'.coeff k := by
    have h_gov : GovAt t (F_a a ha t) a := by
      exact part3_admissible_germ_governs a t ( F_a a ha t ) ( F_a_admissible a ha t ) |> fun h => by simpa [ F_a ] using h;
    obtain ⟨ Λ, C, hΛ ⟩ := h_gov K; use Λ; intros t' ht' g' hg' k hk; exact (by
    have := part3_admissible_germ_governs a t' g' hg' K; obtain ⟨ C', hC' ⟩ := this; exact (by
    apply part3_coeff_eq_of_common_governance a (F_a a ha t) g' (ThreadClass t' (max Λ C')) (by
    exact ZHat.frequently_ofNat_proj t' ( max Λ C' ) |> fun h => h.mono fun n hn => by simpa [ ThreadClass ] using hn;) K ⟨ C, by
      filter_upwards [ hΛ ] with n hn hn' using hn ( by simpa [ ThreadClass, ht' ] using ThreadClass.antitone t' ( le_max_left _ _ ) hn' ) ⟩ ⟨ hC'.choose, by
      exact hC'.choose_spec.mono fun n hn hn' => hn <| ThreadClass.antitone _ ( le_max_right _ _ ) hn' ⟩ k hk););
  generalize_proofs at *; (
  use Λ)

name: QPCF.continuous_laurentSeries_of_eventually_coeff_eq_below
statement:
theorem continuous_laurentSeries_of_eventually_coeff_eq_below
    {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (f : X → ℚ⸨X⸩)
    (hcoeff : ∀ x : X, ∀ K : ℤ,
      ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, ∀ k : ℤ, k < K → (f y).coeff k = (f x).coeff k) :
    Continuous f

theorem part3_continuous_family (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha : CorrectedDef32TR' a) :

proof:

name: QPCF.finite_order_local_constancy
statement:
theorem finite_order_local_constancy (F : C(ZHat, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (K : ℤ) :
    ∃ (D : ℕ), 1 ≤ D ∧ ∃ (L : ℕ → ℚ⸨X⸩),
      (∀ r : ℕ, L r = F (ZHat.ofNat r)) ∧
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (k : ℤ), k ≤ K →
        (F (ZHat.ofNat n)).coeff k = (L (n % D)).coeff k

name: QPCF.part3_polynomial_pinning
statement:
theorem part3_polynomial_pinning (P Q : Polynomial ℚ) (S : Set ℕ)
    (hS : S.Infinite) (h : ∀ n ∈ S, P.eval (n : ℚ) = Q.eval (n : ℚ)) : P = Q
proof:
:= by
  exact Polynomial.eq_of_infinite_eval_eq P Q ( Set.Infinite.mono ( by aesop ) ( hS.image fun n => by aesop ) )

name: QPCF.expansion_order_of_eval_decay
statement:
theorem expansion_order_of_eval_decay
    (P Q : Polynomial ℚ) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (D : ℕ) (C : ℝ) (S : Set ℕ)
    (hS : ∃ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ∈ S)
    (hdecay : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ∈ S →
      |(((P.eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) / ((Q.eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ))| ≤
        C * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(D : ℤ))) :
    P = 0 ∨ P.natDegree + D ≤ Q.natDegree

name: QPCF.frequently_classSet
statement: theorem frequently_classSet (r : ZMod M) : ∃ᶠ n in atTop, n ∈ classSet M r
proof:
:= by
  
  have h_exists_n : ∀ K : ℕ, ∃ n ≥ K, (n : ZMod M) = r := by
    intro K
    refine ⟨r.val + M * (K + 1), ?_, ?_⟩
    · nlinarith [ NeZero.pos M ]
    · simp
  exact Filter.frequently_atTop.mpr fun K => by obtain ⟨ n, hn₁, hn₂ ⟩ := h_exists_n K; exact ⟨ n, hn₁, hn₂ ⟩ ;

proof:

statement: theorem govModFamily_spec (x : govModSubring M) : GovByMod M (govModFamily M x) x.1
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec x.2

name: QPCF.govModFamily_eq_iff
statement:
theorem govModFamily_eq_iff {x : govModSubring M} {L : ZMod M → ℚ⸨X⸩} :
    govModFamily M x = L ↔ GovByMod M L x.1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl; exact govModFamily_spec M x
  · intro h; exact govByMod_unique M (govModFamily_spec M x) h

name: QPCF.govModPhi_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem govModPhi_apply (x : govModSubring M) : govModPhi M x = govModFamily M x
proof: := rfl

name: QPCF.govModPhi_surjective
statement: theorem govModPhi_surjective : Function.Surjective (govModPhi M)
proof:
:= by
  intro L
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := GovByMod.exists M L
  exact ⟨⟨a, ⟨L, ha⟩⟩, govModFamily_eq_iff M |>.mpr ha⟩

name: QPCF.govModPhi_eq_iff_asymEquiv
statement:
theorem govModPhi_eq_iff_asymEquiv (x y : govModSubring M) :
    govModPhi M x = govModPhi M y ↔ AsymEquiv x.1 y.1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    simp only [govModPhi_apply] at h
    have hx := govModFamily_spec M x
    have hy := govModFamily_spec M y
    rw [h] at hx
    exact GovByMod.asymEquiv_of_eq M hx hy
  · intro h
    simp only [govModPhi_apply]
    have hx := govModFamily_spec M x
    have hxy : GovByMod M (govModFamily M x) y.1 := GovByMod.congr M hx h
    exact govByMod_unique M hxy (govModFamily_spec M y)

statement: theorem oneAddPow_order (α : ℚ) : (oneAddPow α).order = 0

name: QPCF.oneAddPow_coeff_nat

theorem oneAddPow_coeff_nat (α : ℚ) (k : ℕ) :
    (oneAddPow α).coeff (k : ℤ) = Ring.choose α k
proof:
:= by

name: QPCF.pval_oneAddPow_eq

    pval (oneAddPow α) (N : ℤ) n
      = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (Ring.choose α i : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(i : ℤ))

name: QPCF.ratPowSeq_sub_binom_bigOpow
statement:
theorem ratPowSeq_sub_binom_bigOpow (α : ℚ) (N : ℕ) :
    BigOpow (fun n => ratPowSeq α n
        - ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (Ring.choose α i : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(i : ℤ)))
      (-((N : ℤ) + 1))

name: QPCF.oneAddPow_governs_natOrder
statement:
theorem oneAddPow_governs_natOrder (α : ℚ) (N : ℕ) :
    BigOpow (fun n => ratPowSeq α n - pval (oneAddPow α) (N : ℤ) n) (-((N : ℤ) + 1))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := ratPowSeq_sub_binom_bigOpow α N
  refine ⟨C, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hC] with n hn
  rwa [pval_oneAddPow_eq α N n]

name: QPCF.oneAddPow_governs
statement: theorem oneAddPow_governs (α : ℚ) : Governs (oneAddPow α) (ratPowSeq α)

name: QPCF.coeff_uniform_bound
statement:
theorem coeff_uniform_bound (F : C(ZHat, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (k : ℤ) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ r : ZHat, |((F r).coeff k : ℝ)| ≤ B
proof:
:= by
  have hcont : Continuous (fun r : ZHat => |((F r).coeff k : ℝ)|) := by
    have h2 : Continuous (fun f : ℚ⸨X⸩ => f.coeff k) :=
      (LaurentSeries.uniformContinuous_coeff k).continuous
    fun_prop
  obtain ⟨r0, -, hr0⟩ :=
    (isCompact_univ (X := ZHat)).exists_isMaxOn ⟨ZHat.ofNat 0, trivial⟩ hcont.continuousOn
  exact ⟨_, fun r => hr0 (Set.mem_univ r)⟩

name: QPCF.order_uniform_bound
statement:
theorem order_uniform_bound (F : C(ZHat, ℚ⸨X⸩)) :
    ∃ L : ℤ, ∀ r : ZHat, ∀ k : ℤ, k < L → (F r).coeff k = 0

name: QPCF.coeff_uniform_bound_range
statement:
theorem coeff_uniform_bound_range (F : C(ZHat, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (Lb U : ℤ) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧ ∀ r : ZHat, ∀ k : ℤ, Lb ≤ k → k ≤ U → |((F r).coeff k : ℝ)| ≤ B
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ : ∃ B : ℤ → ℝ, ∀ r : ZHat, ∀ k : ℤ, Lb ≤ k → k ≤ U → |((F r).coeff k : ℝ)| ≤ B k := by
    exact ⟨ fun k => Classical.choose ( coeff_uniform_bound F k ), fun r k hk₁ hk₂ => Classical.choose_spec ( coeff_uniform_bound F k ) r ⟩;
  exact ⟨ ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc Lb U, |B k|, Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _, fun r k hk₁ hk₂ => le_trans ( hB r k hk₁ hk₂ ) ( le_trans ( le_abs_self _ ) ( Finset.single_le_sum ( fun x _ => abs_nonneg ( B x ) ) ( Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨ hk₁, hk₂ ⟩ ) ) ) ⟩

name: QPCF.GovC.zero
statement: theorem GovC.zero : GovC (0 : C(ZHat, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (fun _ => 0)
proof:
:= by
  intro N
  have : (fun n => (0 : ℝ) - pval ((0 : C(ZHat, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (ZHat.ofNat n)) N n)
      = fun n => (0 : ℝ) - pval (0 : ℚ⸨X⸩) N n := by
    funext n; simp
  rw [this]; exact Governs.zero N

name: QPCF.GovC.one
statement: theorem GovC.one : GovC (1 : C(ZHat, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (fun _ => 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro N
  have : (fun n => (1 : ℝ) - pval ((1 : C(ZHat, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (ZHat.ofNat n)) N n)
      = fun n => (1 : ℝ) - pval (1 : ℚ⸨X⸩) N n := by
    funext n; simp
  rw [this]; exact Governs.one N

name: QPCF.GovC.add
statement:
theorem GovC.add {F G : C(ZHat, ℚ⸨X⸩)} {a b : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hf : GovC F a) (hg : GovC G b) : GovC (F + G) (fun n => a n + b n)
proof:
:= by
  intro N
  have key := BigOpow.add (hf N) (hg N)
  have hEq : (fun n => (a n + b n) - pval ((F + G) (ZHat.ofNat n)) N n)
      = fun n => (a n - pval (F (ZHat.ofNat n)) N n) + (b n - pval (G (ZHat.ofNat n)) N n) := by
    funext n
    rw [ContinuousMap.add_apply, pval_add]; ring
  rw [hEq]; exact key

name: QPCF.GovC.neg
statement:
theorem GovC.neg {F : C(ZHat, ℚ⸨X⸩)} {a : ℕ → ℝ} (hf : GovC F a) :
    GovC (-F) (fun n => - a n)
proof:
:= by
  intro N
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hf N
  refine ⟨C, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hC] with n hn
  have hEq : (-a n) - pval ((-F) (ZHat.ofNat n)) N n
      = -((a n) - pval (F (ZHat.ofNat n)) N n) := by
    rw [ContinuousMap.neg_apply, pval_neg]; ring
  rw [hEq, abs_neg]; exact hn

name: QPCF.pval_mul_sub_pointwise
statement:
theorem pval_mul_sub_pointwise (f g : ℚ⸨X⸩) (N M : ℤ)
    (hM2 : N - f.order ≤ M) (hM3 : N - g.order ≤ M) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    |pval f M n * pval g M n - pval (f * g) N n|
      ≤ (∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc f.order M, ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc g.order M,
          (if i + j > N then |(f.coeff i : ℝ)| * |(g.coeff j : ℝ)| else 0)) * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(N + 1))

name: QPCF.pval_mul_sub_bigOpow_uniform
statement:
theorem pval_mul_sub_bigOpow_uniform (F G : C(ZHat, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (N M L : ℤ)
    (hLF : ∀ r : ZHat, ∀ k : ℤ, k < L → (F r).coeff k = 0)
    (hLG : ∀ r : ZHat, ∀ k : ℤ, k < L → (G r).coeff k = 0)
    (hM2 : N - L ≤ M) :
    BigOpow (fun n => pval (F (ZHat.ofNat n)) M n * pval (G (ZHat.ofNat n)) M n
        - pval (F (ZHat.ofNat n) * G (ZHat.ofNat n)) N n) (-(N + 1))

name: QPCF.pval_bigOpow_uniform
statement:
theorem pval_bigOpow_uniform (F : C(ZHat, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (M L : ℤ)
    (hL : ∀ r : ZHat, ∀ k : ℤ, k < L → (F r).coeff k = 0) :
    BigOpow (fun n => pval (F (ZHat.ofNat n)) M n) (-L)

name: QPCF.GovC.mul
statement:
theorem GovC.mul {F G : C(ZHat, ℚ⸨X⸩)} {a b : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hf : GovC F a) (hg : GovC G b) : GovC (F * G) (fun n => a n * b n)

name: QPCF.coeff_fiber_nhds
statement:
theorem coeff_fiber_nhds (k : ℤ) (f₀ : ℚ⸨X⸩) :
    {g : ℚ⸨X⸩ | g.coeff k = f₀.coeff k} ∈ 𝓝 f₀
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : {g : ℚ⸨X⸩ | Valued.v (g - f₀) ≤ exp (-(k + 1))} ⊆ {g : ℚ⸨X⸩ | g.coeff k = f₀.coeff k} := by
    intro g hg
    exact LaurentSeries.eq_coeff_of_valuation_sub_lt ℚ hg (by omega)
  refine Filter.mem_of_superset ?_ hsub
  have hcont : Continuous (fun g : ℚ⸨X⸩ => g - f₀) := by fun_prop
  have hball : IsOpen {x : ℚ⸨X⸩ | Valued.v x ≤ exp (-(k + 1))} :=
    Valued.isOpen_closedBall ℚ⸨X⸩ (exp_ne_zero (a := -(k + 1)))
  exact (hball.preimage hcont).mem_nhds (by simp)

name: QPCF.coeff_fiber_mem_nhds
statement:
theorem coeff_fiber_mem_nhds (H : C(ZHat, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (k : ℤ) (r₀ : ZHat) :
    {r : ZHat | (H r).coeff k = (H r₀).coeff k} ∈ 𝓝 r₀
proof:
:=
  H.continuous.continuousAt (coeff_fiber_nhds k (H r₀))

name: QPCF.vball_mem_nhds
statement:
theorem vball_mem_nhds (H : C(ZHat, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (r₀ : ZHat) (γ : ℤᵐ⁰) (hγ : γ ≠ 0)
    (hle : Valued.v (H r₀) ≤ γ) : {r : ZHat | Valued.v (H r) ≤ γ} ∈ 𝓝 r₀
proof:
:=
  ((Valued.isOpen_closedBall ℚ⸨X⸩ hγ).preimage H.continuous).mem_nhds hle

name: QPCF.eq_zero_of_govNull
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_govNull (H : C(ZHat, ℚ⸨X⸩))
    (hN : ∀ N : ℤ, BigOpow (fun n => pval (H (ZHat.ofNat n)) N n) (-(N + 1))) : H = 0

name: QPCF.GovC.unique
statement:
theorem GovC.unique {F G : C(ZHat, ℚ⸨X⸩)} {a : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hf : GovC F a) (hg : GovC G a) : F = G
proof:
:= by
  have hH : ∀ N : ℤ, BigOpow (fun n => pval ((F - G) (ZHat.ofNat n)) N n) (-(N + 1)) := by
    intro N
    obtain ⟨C₁, hC₁⟩ := hf N
    obtain ⟨C₂, hC₂⟩ := hg N
    refine ⟨C₁ + C₂, ?_⟩
    filter_upwards [hC₁, hC₂] with n hn₁ hn₂
    have hpv : pval ((F - G) (ZHat.ofNat n)) N n
        = pval (F (ZHat.ofNat n)) N n - pval (G (ZHat.ofNat n)) N n := by
      rw [ContinuousMap.sub_apply,
        show F (ZHat.ofNat n) - G (ZHat.ofNat n) = F (ZHat.ofNat n) + (- G (ZHat.ofNat n)) from by ring,
        pval_add, pval_neg]; ring
    rw [hpv]
    rw [abs_le] at hn₁ hn₂
    rw [abs_le, add_mul]
    constructor <;> linarith [hn₁.1, hn₁.2, hn₂.1, hn₂.2]
  have hz : F - G = 0 := eq_zero_of_govNull (F - G) hH
  rw [← sub_eq_zero]; exact hz

name: QPCF.borelSeq_sub_pval_le
statement:
theorem borelSeq_sub_pval_le (f : ℚ⸨X⸩) (N : ℤ) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (hcomplete : ∀ k : ℤ, f.order ≤ k → k ≤ N → (|(f.coeff k : ℝ)| + 1) * 2 ^ k.toNat ≤ (n : ℝ)) :
    |borelSeq f n - pval f N n|
      ≤ ((∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc (N + 1) (max N 0 + 1), |(f.coeff k : ℝ)|) + 2) * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(N + 1))

name: QPCF.borel_diag_bigOpow
statement:
theorem borel_diag_bigOpow (F : C(ZHat, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (N : ℤ) :
    BigOpow (fun n => borelSeq (F (ZHat.ofNat n)) n - pval (F (ZHat.ofNat n)) N n) (-(N + 1))

name: QPCF.GovC.exists
statement: theorem GovC.exists (F : C(ZHat, ℚ⸨X⸩)) : ∃ a : ℕ → ℝ, GovC F a
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun n => borelSeq (F (ZHat.ofNat n)) n, fun N => borel_diag_bigOpow F N⟩

name: QPCF.GovC.congr
statement:
theorem GovC.congr {F : C(ZHat, ℚ⸨X⸩)} {a b : ℕ → ℝ}
    (ha : GovC F a) (hab : AsymEquiv a b) : GovC F b
proof:
:= by
  intro N
  have h_sum : BigOpow (fun n => (a n - pval (F (ZHat.ofNat n)) N n) + (b n - a n)) (-(N + 1)) :=
    BigOpow.add (ha N) (negligible_iff_bigOpow.mp (AsymEquiv.symm hab) _)
  have : (fun n => b n - pval (F (ZHat.ofNat n)) N n)
      = fun n => (a n - pval (F (ZHat.ofNat n)) N n) + (b n - a n) := by
    funext n; ring
  rw [this]; exact h_sum

name: QPCF.GovC.asymEquiv_of_eq
statement:
theorem GovC.asymEquiv_of_eq {F : C(ZHat, ℚ⸨X⸩)} {a b : ℕ → ℝ}
    (ha : GovC F a) (hb : GovC F b) : AsymEquiv a b
proof:
:= by
  rw [AsymEquiv, negligible_iff_bigOpow]
  intro k
  obtain ⟨C₁, hC₁⟩ := ha (k - 1)
  obtain ⟨C₂, hC₂⟩ := hb (k - 1)
  refine ⟨C₁ + C₂, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hC₁, hC₂] with n hn₁ hn₂
  have hk : (-(k - 1 + 1) : ℤ) = -k := by ring
  rw [hk] at hn₁ hn₂
  rw [abs_le] at hn₁ hn₂
  rw [abs_le, add_mul]
  constructor <;> linarith [hn₁.1, hn₁.2, hn₂.1, hn₂.2]

name: QPCF.govGenFamily_spec
statement: theorem govGenFamily_spec (x : govGenSubring) : GovC (govGenFamily x) x.1
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec x.2

name: QPCF.govGenFamily_eq_iff
statement:
theorem govGenFamily_eq_iff {x : govGenSubring} {F : C(ZHat, ℚ⸨X⸩)} :
    govGenFamily x = F ↔ GovC F x.1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl; exact govGenFamily_spec x
  · intro h; exact GovC.unique (govGenFamily_spec x) h

name: QPCF.govGenPhi_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem govGenPhi_apply (x : govGenSubring) : govGenPhi x = govGenFamily x
proof: := rfl

name: QPCF.govGenPhi_surjective
statement: theorem govGenPhi_surjective : Function.Surjective govGenPhi
proof:
:= by
  intro F
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := GovC.exists F
  exact ⟨⟨a, ⟨F, ha⟩⟩, govGenFamily_eq_iff.mpr ha⟩

name: QPCF.govGenPhi_eq_iff_asymEquiv
statement:
theorem govGenPhi_eq_iff_asymEquiv (x y : govGenSubring) :
    govGenPhi x = govGenPhi y ↔ AsymEquiv x.1 y.1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    simp only [govGenPhi_apply] at h
    have hx := govGenFamily_spec x
    have hy := govGenFamily_spec y
    rw [h] at hx
    exact GovC.asymEquiv_of_eq hx hy
  · intro h
    simp only [govGenPhi_apply]
    have hx := govGenFamily_spec x
    have hxy : GovC (govGenFamily x) y.1 := GovC.congr hx h
    exact GovC.unique hxy (govGenFamily_spec y)

name: QPCF.govSeries_spec
statement: theorem govSeries_spec (x : govSubring) : Governs (govSeries x) x.1
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec x.2

name: QPCF.govSeries_eq_iff
statement:
theorem govSeries_eq_iff {x : govSubring} {f : ℚ⸨X⸩} :
    govSeries x = f ↔ Governs f x.1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl; exact govSeries_spec x
  · intro h; exact Governs.unique (govSeries_spec x) h

name: QPCF.govPhi_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem govPhi_apply (x : govSubring) : govPhi x = govSeries x
proof: := rfl

name: QPCF.govPhi_surjective
statement: theorem govPhi_surjective : Function.Surjective govPhi
proof:
:= by
  intro f
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Governs.exists f
  exact ⟨⟨a, ⟨f, ha⟩⟩, govSeries_eq_iff.mpr ha⟩

name: QPCF.govPhi_eq_iff_asymEquiv
statement:
theorem govPhi_eq_iff_asymEquiv (x y : govSubring) :
    govPhi x = govPhi y ↔ AsymEquiv x.1 y.1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    simp only [govPhi_apply] at h
    have hx : Governs (govSeries x) x.1 := govSeries_spec x
    have hy : Governs (govSeries y) y.1 := govSeries_spec y
    rw [h] at hx
    exact Governs.asymEquiv_of_eq hx hy
  · intro h
    simp only [govPhi_apply]
    have hx : Governs (govSeries x) x.1 := govSeries_spec x
    have hxy : Governs (govSeries x) y.1 := Governs.congr hx h
    exact Governs.unique hxy (govSeries_spec y)

name: QPCF.coeff_poly_coe
statement:
theorem coeff_poly_coe (p : ℚ[X]) (i : ℤ) :
    ((p : ℚ⸨X⸩)).coeff i = if i < 0 then 0 else p.coeff i.natAbs
proof:
:= by
  rw [← RatFunc.coe_coe, PowerSeries.coeff_coe]; simp [Polynomial.coeff_coe]

name: QPCF.poly_coe_ne_zero
statement: theorem poly_coe_ne_zero {p : ℚ[X]} (hp : p ≠ 0) : ((p : ℚ⸨X⸩)) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h; apply hp; ext n
  have := coeff_poly_coe p n; rw [h] at this; simp at this
  have h2 : p.coeff (n : ℤ).natAbs = 0 := by
    by_cases hn : (n:ℤ) < 0
    · omega
    · simpa [hn] using this.symm
  simpa using h2

name: QPCF.order_poly_coe
statement:
theorem order_poly_coe (p : ℚ[X]) (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    ((p : ℚ⸨X⸩)).order = (p.natTrailingDegree : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have hcne : ((p : ℚ⸨X⸩)) ≠ 0 := poly_coe_ne_zero hp
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply HahnSeries.order_le_of_coeff_ne_zero (g := (p.natTrailingDegree : ℤ))
    rw [coeff_poly_coe]
    simp only [if_neg (by omega : ¬ ((p.natTrailingDegree:ℤ) < 0)), Int.natAbs_natCast]
    exact Polynomial.coeff_natTrailingDegree_ne_zero.mpr hp
  · rw [HahnSeries.le_order_iff_forall hcne]
    intro j hj; rw [coeff_poly_coe]
    split_ifs with h
    · rfl
    · apply Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_natTrailingDegree; omega

name: QPCF.order_laurent_inv
statement: theorem order_laurent_inv (a : ℚ⸨X⸩) (ha : a ≠ 0) : (a⁻¹).order = - a.order
proof:
:= by
  have : (a * a⁻¹).order = a.order + a⁻¹.order := HahnSeries.order_mul ha (inv_ne_zero ha)
  rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ ha, HahnSeries.order_one] at this; omega

name: QPCF.order_ratFunc_coe
statement:
theorem order_ratFunc_coe (r : RatFunc ℚ) (hr : (r:ℚ⸨X⸩) ≠ 0) :
    (r : ℚ⸨X⸩).order = (r.num.natTrailingDegree : ℤ) - (r.denom.natTrailingDegree : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have hnum : r.num ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; apply hr; rw [← RatFunc.num_div_denom r, h]; simp
  have hden : r.denom ≠ 0 := r.denom_ne_zero
  have hnc : ((r.num : ℚ⸨X⸩)) ≠ 0 := poly_coe_ne_zero hnum
  have hdc : ((r.denom : ℚ⸨X⸩)) ≠ 0 := poly_coe_ne_zero hden
  have key : (r : ℚ⸨X⸩) = (r.num : ℚ⸨X⸩) * ((r.denom : ℚ⸨X⸩))⁻¹ := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← RatFunc.num_div_denom r]
    rw [map_div₀, div_eq_mul_inv]; rfl
  rw [key, HahnSeries.order_mul hnc (inv_ne_zero hdc),
    order_laurent_inv _ hdc, order_poly_coe _ hnum, order_poly_coe _ hden]
  ring

name: QPCF.coe_poly_X_pow
statement: theorem coe_poly_X_pow (m : ℕ) : ((X ^ m : ℚ[X]) : ℚ⸨X⸩) = HahnSeries.single (m:ℤ) (1:ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  rw [coeff_poly_coe, HahnSeries.coeff_single, Polynomial.coeff_X_pow]
  by_cases h : i = (m:ℤ)
  · simp [h]
  · rw [if_neg h]
    by_cases hlt : i < 0
    · simp [hlt]
    · rw [if_neg hlt, if_neg (by omega : ¬ (i.natAbs = m))]

name: QPCF.coe_poly_mul
statement: theorem coe_poly_mul (p q : ℚ[X]) : ((p*q:ℚ[X]):ℚ⸨X⸩) = (p:ℚ⸨X⸩)*(q:ℚ⸨X⸩)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← RatFunc.coe_coe, ← RatFunc.coe_coe, ← RatFunc.coe_coe, Polynomial.coe_mul, map_mul]

name: QPCF.polyFactorTrailing
statement:
theorem polyFactorTrailing {p : ℚ[X]} (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    ∃ A : ℚ[X], p = X ^ p.natTrailingDegree * A ∧ A.coeff 0 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hdvd : X ^ p.natTrailingDegree ∣ p :=
    Polynomial.X_pow_dvd_iff.mpr (fun d hd => Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_natTrailingDegree hd)
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := hdvd
  refine ⟨A, hA, ?_⟩
  intro h0
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := Polynomial.X_dvd_iff.mpr h0
  have hdvd2 : X ^ (p.natTrailingDegree + 1) ∣ p := by
    refine ⟨C, ?_⟩; conv_lhs => rw [hA, hC]
    ring
  rw [Polynomial.X_pow_dvd_iff] at hdvd2
  exact (Polynomial.coeff_natTrailingDegree_ne_zero.mpr hp) (hdvd2 _ (by omega))

name: QPCF.ratHeightR_div_le
statement:
theorem ratHeightR_div_le (N A : ℚ[X]) (hA : A ≠ 0) :
    ratHeightR (algebraMap ℚ[X] (RatFunc ℚ) N / algebraMap ℚ[X] (RatFunc ℚ) A)
      ≤ max N.natDegree A.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  set r := algebraMap ℚ[X] (RatFunc ℚ) N / algebraMap ℚ[X] (RatFunc ℚ) A with hr
  have hnum : r.num.natDegree ≤ N.natDegree := by
    by_cases hN : N = 0
    · simp [hr, hN]
    · exact Polynomial.natDegree_le_of_dvd (RatFunc.num_div_dvd N hA) hN
  have hden : r.denom.natDegree ≤ A.natDegree :=
    Polynomial.natDegree_le_of_dvd (RatFunc.denom_div_dvd N A) hA
  unfold ratHeightR
  omega

name: QPCF.coe_poly_sub
statement: theorem coe_poly_sub (p q : ℚ[X]) : ((p - q:ℚ[X]):ℚ⸨X⸩) = (p:ℚ⸨X⸩) - (q:ℚ⸨X⸩)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← RatFunc.coe_coe, ← RatFunc.coe_coe, ← RatFunc.coe_coe, Polynomial.coe_sub, map_sub]

name: QPCF.core_T
statement:
theorem core_T (A denom : ℚ[X]) (hA0 : A.coeff 0 ≠ 0) (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ T : ℚ[X], T.natDegree ≤ m ∧ X ^ (m+1) ∣ (denom - T * A)

name: QPCF.core_floor
statement:
theorem core_floor (A denom T : ℚ[X]) (hA0 : A.coeff 0 ≠ 0) (m : ℕ)
    (hTdeg : T.natDegree ≤ m) (hTdvd : X ^ (m+1) ∣ (denom - T * A)) :
    (fieldLaurentGauss ℚ).floor
        (HahnSeries.single (-(m:ℤ)) (1:ℚ) * (denom : ℚ⸨X⸩) * ((A : ℚ⸨X⸩))⁻¹)
      = HahnSeries.single (-(m:ℤ)) (1:ℚ) * (T : ℚ⸨X⸩)

name: QPCF.fract_inv_core
statement:
theorem fract_inv_core (A denom : ℚ[X]) (hA0 : A.coeff 0 ≠ 0) (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ N' : ℚ[X],
      (fieldLaurentGauss ℚ).fract
          (HahnSeries.single (-(m:ℤ)) (1:ℚ) * (denom : ℚ⸨X⸩) * ((A : ℚ⸨X⸩))⁻¹)
          = (N' : ℚ⸨X⸩) * ((A : ℚ⸨X⸩))⁻¹
        ∧ N'.natDegree + m ≤ max denom.natDegree (m + A.natDegree)
proof:
:= by
  have hAne : A ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at hA0
  have hAc : ((A : ℚ⸨X⸩)) ≠ 0 := poly_coe_ne_zero hAne
  obtain ⟨T, hTdeg, hTdvd⟩ := core_T A denom hA0 m
  obtain ⟨N', hN'⟩ : X ^ m ∣ (denom - T * A) := dvd_trans (pow_dvd_pow X (by omega)) hTdvd
  refine ⟨N', ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hfloor := core_floor A denom T hA0 m hTdeg hTdvd
    rw [GaussStructure.fract, hfloor]
    have hset : HahnSeries.single (-(m:ℤ)) (1:ℚ) * (denom : ℚ⸨X⸩) * ((A : ℚ⸨X⸩))⁻¹
        - HahnSeries.single (-(m:ℤ)) (1:ℚ) * (T : ℚ⸨X⸩)
        = HahnSeries.single (-(m:ℤ)) (1:ℚ) * ((denom - T*A : ℚ[X]) : ℚ⸨X⸩) * ((A:ℚ⸨X⸩))⁻¹ := by
      rw [coe_poly_sub, coe_poly_mul]
      field_simp
    rw [hset, hN', coe_poly_mul, coe_poly_X_pow]
    rw [show HahnSeries.single (-(m:ℤ)) (1:ℚ)
            * (HahnSeries.single (m:ℤ) (1:ℚ) * (N':ℚ⸨X⸩)) * ((A:ℚ⸨X⸩))⁻¹
          = (HahnSeries.single (-(m:ℤ)) (1:ℚ) * HahnSeries.single (m:ℤ) (1:ℚ))
              * ((N':ℚ⸨X⸩) * ((A:ℚ⸨X⸩))⁻¹) from by ring]
    rw [HahnSeries.single_mul_single]
    simp
  · by_cases hDzero : denom - T * A = 0
    · have hN'0 : N' = 0 := by
        rw [hDzero] at hN'
        exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hN'.symm).resolve_left (pow_ne_zero _ Polynomial.X_ne_zero)
      subst hN'0; simp
    · have hN'ne : N' ≠ 0 := by
        rintro rfl; rw [mul_zero] at hN'; exact hDzero hN'
      have hdegD : (denom - T*A).natDegree = m + N'.natDegree := by
        rw [hN', Polynomial.natDegree_mul (pow_ne_zero _ Polynomial.X_ne_zero) hN'ne,
          Polynomial.natDegree_X_pow]
      have hle1 : (denom - T*A).natDegree ≤ max denom.natDegree (T*A).natDegree :=
        Polynomial.natDegree_sub_le _ _
      have hle2 : (T*A).natDegree ≤ T.natDegree + A.natDegree := Polynomial.natDegree_mul_le
      omega

name: QPCF.degreeDecreaseStep_holds
statement: theorem degreeDecreaseStep_holds : DegreeDecreaseStep
proof:
:= by
  intro r hord hr0
  
  have hnum : r.num ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; apply hr0; rw [← RatFunc.num_div_denom r, h]; simp
  have hden : r.denom ≠ 0 := r.denom_ne_zero
  set m := r.num.natTrailingDegree with hm
  obtain ⟨A, hAeq, hA0⟩ := polyFactorTrailing hnum
  have hAne : A ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at hA0
  
  have hord' : (r : ℚ⸨X⸩).order = (m : ℤ) - (r.denom.natTrailingDegree : ℤ) :=
    order_ratFunc_coe r hr0
  have hm1 : 1 ≤ m := by
    have : (1:ℤ) ≤ (m:ℤ) - (r.denom.natTrailingDegree : ℤ) := by rw [← hord']; exact hord
    omega
  
  have hdegnum : r.num.natDegree = m + A.natDegree := by
    rw [hAeq, Polynomial.natDegree_mul (pow_ne_zero _ Polynomial.X_ne_zero) hAne,
      Polynomial.natDegree_X_pow]
  
  have hnc : ((r.num : ℚ⸨X⸩)) ≠ 0 := poly_coe_ne_zero hnum
  have hdc : ((r.denom : ℚ⸨X⸩)) ≠ 0 := poly_coe_ne_zero hden
  have hAc : ((A : ℚ⸨X⸩)) ≠ 0 := poly_coe_ne_zero hAne
  have hnum_coe : (r.num : ℚ⸨X⸩) = HahnSeries.single (m:ℤ) (1:ℚ) * (A : ℚ⸨X⸩) := by
    rw [hAeq, coe_poly_mul, coe_poly_X_pow]
  have hrinv : (r : ℚ⸨X⸩)⁻¹
      = HahnSeries.single (-(m:ℤ)) (1:ℚ) * (r.denom : ℚ⸨X⸩) * ((A : ℚ⸨X⸩))⁻¹ := by
    have hkey : (r : ℚ⸨X⸩) = (r.num : ℚ⸨X⸩) * ((r.denom : ℚ⸨X⸩))⁻¹ := by
      conv_lhs => rw [← RatFunc.num_div_denom r]
      rw [map_div₀, div_eq_mul_inv]; rfl
    rw [hkey, mul_inv, inv_inv, hnum_coe, mul_inv]
    rw [show (HahnSeries.single (m:ℤ) (1:ℚ))⁻¹ = HahnSeries.single (-(m:ℤ)) (1:ℚ) from by
      rw [HahnSeries.inv_single]; simp]
    ring
  
  obtain ⟨N', hN'eq, hN'deg⟩ := fract_inv_core A r.denom hA0 m
  refine ⟨algebraMap ℚ[X] (RatFunc ℚ) N' / algebraMap ℚ[X] (RatFunc ℚ) A, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hrinv, hN'eq, map_div₀, div_eq_mul_inv]; rfl
  · 
    have hle := ratHeightR_div_le N' A hAne
    have hheight : ratHeightR r = max r.num.natDegree r.denom.natDegree := rfl
    
    have hge : m ≤ ratHeightR r := by
      rw [hheight, hdegnum]; omega
    omega

name: QPCF.ordered_not_ocorr_in_phase
proof:
:= by
  intro J hJ hcorr
  have hpole : (ogaussG (ogaussG (ogaussG^[J] L))).order < 0 :=
    ocorr_forces_pole (H J hJ) hcorr
  have : ogaussG (ogaussG (ogaussG^[J] L)) = ogaussG^[J + 2] L := by
    rw [show J + 2 = J + 1 + 1 from rfl, Function.iterate_succ_apply',
      Function.iterate_succ_apply']
  rw [this] at hpole
  exact absurd (H (J + 2) (by omega)) (by simpa using not_le.mpr hpole)

name: QPCF.ogaussG_iterate_eq_agaussG_phase
proof:
:= by
  intro L'
  induction' L' with L' ih
  · simp
  · rw [Nat.add_succ, Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih, Function.iterate_succ_apply',
      ← ih, ogaussG_eq_agaussG_of_not_ocorr
        (ordered_not_ocorr_in_phase H (N + L') (Nat.le_add_right _ _))]

name: QPCF.ogaussG_order_infinitely_neg
statement:
theorem ogaussG_order_infinitely_neg {L : ℚ⸨X⸩} (hL : ¬ IsRat L) :
    ∀ N : ℕ, ∃ J, N ≤ J ∧ (ogaussG^[J] L).order < 0
proof:
:= by
  intro N
  by_contra hcon
  push_neg at hcon
  
  have H : ∀ J, N ≤ J → 0 ≤ (ogaussG^[J] L).order := fun J hJ => hcon J hJ
  
  have hgN : ¬ IsRat (ogaussG^[N] L) := fun h => hL (isRat_of_ogaussG_iterate N h)
  
  obtain ⟨j, _, hj⟩ := edeg_infinitely_pos hgN 0
  have hjneg : (agaussG^[j] (ogaussG^[N] L)).order < 0 := edeg_pos_iff.mp hj
  
  rw [← ogaussG_iterate_eq_agaussG_phase H j] at hjneg
  exact absurd (H (N + j) (Nat.le_add_right _ _)) (not_le.mpr hjneg)

name: QPCF.exists_depth_ratPow_tendsto_atTop
statement:
theorem exists_depth_ratPow_tendsto_atTop (α : ℚ) (hα : α.den ≠ 1) :
    ∃ d : ℕ, Tendsto (fun n => |realPQ d (ratPowSeq α n)|) atTop atTop
proof:
:= by
  have hα0 : α ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl; simp at hα
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hα0 with h | h
  · exact ⟨2, realPQ_two_ratPow_tendsto_atTop α h⟩
  · exact ⟨1, realPQ_one_ratPow_tendsto_atTop α h⟩

name: QPCF.exists_depth_ratPow_unbounded_on_infinite
statement:
theorem exists_depth_ratPow_unbounded_on_infinite (α : ℚ) (hα : α.den ≠ 1)
    (S : Set ℕ) (hS : S.Infinite) :
    ∃ d : ℕ, ∀ M : ℝ, ∃ n ∈ S, M < |realPQ d (ratPowSeq α n)|
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := exists_depth_ratPow_tendsto_atTop α hα
  refine ⟨d, fun M => ?_⟩
  have hev : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, M < |realPQ d (ratPowSeq α n)| :=
    hd.eventually (eventually_gt_atTop M)
  obtain ⟨n, hnS, hMn⟩ := ((frequently_atTop_of_infinite hS).and_eventually hev).exists
  exact ⟨n, hnS, hMn⟩

    (F : X → ℚ⸨X⸩) (hlc : ∀ j, IsLocallyConstant (fun x => edeg (F x) j)) (K : ℕ) :
    IsLocallyConstant (fun x => edegSum (F x) K)

name: QPCF.lemma_5_3
statement:
theorem lemma_5_3 {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [CompactSpace X]
    (F : X → ℚ⸨X⸩) (hirr : ∀ x, ¬ IsRat (F x))
    (hlc : ∀ j, IsLocallyConstant (fun x => edeg (F x) j)) :
    ∀ M : ℕ, ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ x : X, M < edegSum (F x) K

name: QPCF.corollary_5_4
statement:
theorem corollary_5_4 {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [CompactSpace X]
    (F G : X → ℚ⸨X⸩) (hF : ∀ x, ¬ IsRat (F x)) (hG : ∀ x, ¬ IsRat (G x))
    (hlcF : ∀ j, IsLocallyConstant (fun x => edeg (F x) j))
    (hlcG : ∀ j, IsLocallyConstant (fun x => edeg (G x) j)) :
    ∀ M : ℕ, ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ x : X, M < edegSum (F x) K ∧ M < edegSum (G x) K
proof:
:= by
      intro M;
      have := lemma_5_3 F hF hlcF M; ( have := lemma_5_3 G hG hlcG M; (
      obtain ⟨ K₁, hK₁ ⟩ := ‹∃ K, ∀ x, M < edegSum ( F x ) K›; obtain ⟨ K₂, hK₂ ⟩ := ‹∃ K, ∀ x, M < edegSum ( G x ) K›; use Max.max K₁ K₂; intro x; exact ⟨ lt_of_lt_of_le ( hK₁ x ) ( edegSum_mono ( F x ) ( le_max_left _ _ ) ), lt_of_lt_of_le ( hK₂ x ) ( edegSum_mono ( G x ) ( le_max_right _ _ ) ) ⟩ ; ) )

:= by
  obtain ⟨ C₁, hC₁ ⟩ := hg; obtain ⟨ C₂, hC₂ ⟩ := hh; use C₁ + C₂; filter_upwards [ hC₁, hC₂ ] with n hn hn' using by rw [ abs_le ] ; constructor <;> linarith [ abs_le.mp hn, abs_le.mp hn' ] ;

name: QPCF.pval_support_finite
statement:
theorem pval_support_finite (f : ℚ⸨X⸩) (N : ℤ) (n : ℕ) :
    (Function.support
      (fun k : ℤ => if k ≤ N then (f.coeff k : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) ^ (-k) else 0)).Finite
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Finite.subset (Set.finite_Icc f.order N)
  intro k hk
  simp only [Function.mem_support, ne_eq] at hk
  split_ifs at hk with h
  · refine ⟨?_, h⟩
    by_contra hlt
    push_neg at hlt
    rw [HahnSeries.coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_order hlt] at hk
    simp at hk
  · simp at hk

theorem Governs.add {f g : ℚ⸨X⸩} {a b : ℕ → ℝ}

proof:
:= by
  
  intros N

name: QPCF.Governs.mul
statement:
theorem Governs.mul {f g : ℚ⸨X⸩} {a b : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hf : Governs f a) (hg : Governs g b) : Governs (f * g) (fun n => a n * b n)
proof:
:= by
  intro N
  set M : ℤ :=
    (Int.natAbs N : ℤ) + (Int.natAbs f.order : ℤ) + (Int.natAbs g.order : ℤ) + 1 with hMdef
  have hM1 : N ≤ M := by omega
  have hM2 : N - f.order ≤ M := by omega
  have hM3 : N - g.order ≤ M := by omega
  have hmain := pval_mul_sub_bigOpow f g N M hM1 hM2 hM3
  have h1 : BigOpow (fun n => pval f M n * (b n - pval g M n)) (-(N + 1)) :=
    BigOpow.mono (BigOpow.mul (pval_bigOpow f M) (hg M)) (by omega)
  have h2 : BigOpow (fun n => (a n - pval f M n) * pval g M n) (-(N + 1)) :=
    BigOpow.mono (BigOpow.mul (hf M) (pval_bigOpow g M)) (by omega)
  have h3 : BigOpow (fun n => (a n - pval f M n) * (b n - pval g M n)) (-(N + 1)) :=
    BigOpow.mono (BigOpow.mul (hf M) (hg M)) (by omega)
  have key : (fun n => a n * b n - pval (f * g) N n)
      = fun n => ((pval f M n * pval g M n - pval (f * g) N n)
          + pval f M n * (b n - pval g M n)) + (a n - pval f M n) * pval g M n
          + (a n - pval f M n) * (b n - pval g M n) := by
    funext n; ring
  rw [key]
  exact BigOpow.add (BigOpow.add (BigOpow.add hmain h1) h2) h3

name: QPCF.Governs.congr

theorem Governs.congr {f : ℚ⸨X⸩} {a b : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hf : Governs f a) (hab : AsymEquiv a b) : Governs f b
proof:
:= by
  intro N
  have h_sum : BigOpow (fun n => (a n - pval f N n) + (b n - a n)) (-(N + 1)) := by
    exact BigOpow.add ( hf N ) ( negligible_iff_bigOpow.mp ( AsymEquiv.symm hab ) _ ) |> fun ⟨ C, hC ⟩ => ⟨ C, hC ⟩
  generalize_proofs at *; (
  convert h_sum using 2 ; ring!;)

name: QPCF.lemma_6_3
statement:
theorem lemma_6_3 {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [CompactSpace X]
    (Fa Fb : X → ℚ⸨X⸩)
    (hirrA : ∀ x, ¬ IsRat (Fa x)) (hirrB : ∀ x, ¬ IsRat (Fb x))
    (hlcSum : ∀ j, IsLocallyConstant (fun x => edeg (Fa x + Fb x) j))
    (hlcA : ∀ j, IsLocallyConstant (fun x => edeg (Fa x) j))
    (hlcB : ∀ j, IsLocallyConstant (fun x => edeg (Fb x) j))
    (J : ℕ) :
    ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ x : X,
      2 * edegSum (Fa x + Fb x) J + edeg (Fa x + Fb x) J
        < 2 * min (edegSum (Fa x) K) (edegSum (Fb x) K)
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨M1, hM1⟩ : ∃ M : ℕ, ∀ x, edegSum (Fa x + Fb x) J ≤ M := by
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ :=
      ((edegSum_isLocallyConstant (fun x => Fa x + Fb x) hlcSum J).range_finite).bddAbove
    exact ⟨M, fun x => hM ⟨x, rfl⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨M2, hM2⟩ : ∃ M : ℕ, ∀ x, edeg (Fa x + Fb x) J ≤ M := by
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := ((hlcSum J).range_finite).bddAbove
    exact ⟨M, fun x => hM ⟨x, rfl⟩⟩
  
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := corollary_5_4 Fa Fb hirrA hirrB hlcA hlcB (2 * M1 + M2)
  refine ⟨K, fun x => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨hKa, hKb⟩ := hK x
  have h1 : 2 * edegSum (Fa x + Fb x) J + edeg (Fa x + Fb x) J ≤ 2 * M1 + M2 := by
    have := hM1 x; have := hM2 x; omega
  omega

name: QPCF.theorem_6_4_add
statement:
theorem theorem_6_4_add (a b : govGenSubring) :
    ∃ c : govGenSubring,
      govGenPhi c = govGenPhi a + govGenPhi b ∧ AsymEquiv (a.1 + b.1) c.1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨cseq, hc⟩ := GovC.exists (govGenFamily a + govGenFamily b)
  refine ⟨⟨cseq, ⟨_, hc⟩⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact govGenFamily_eq_iff.mpr hc
  · exact GovC.asymEquiv_of_eq
      (GovC.add (govGenFamily_spec a) (govGenFamily_spec b)) hc

    ∃ c : govGenSubring,

proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨cseq, hc⟩ := GovC.exists (govGenFamily a * govGenFamily b)
  refine ⟨⟨cseq, ⟨_, hc⟩⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact govGenFamily_eq_iff.mpr hc
  · exact GovC.asymEquiv_of_eq
      (GovC.mul (govGenFamily_spec a) (govGenFamily_spec b)) hc

name: QPCF.realPQ_eq_bfloorVal_on_class
statement:
theorem realPQ_eq_bfloorVal_on_class
    (hL : ¬ IsRat L) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (hgov : Governs L a)
    (S : Set ℕ) (hS : S.Infinite) :
    ∃ β : BranchDatum L, ∀ m : ℕ,
      ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ≡ β.b m [MOD β.Ds m] →
        realPQ m (a n) = ((bfloorVal (β.tower m) (β.Ds m) (β.b m) n : ℚ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨β, -⟩ := exists_adapted_branch L S hS
  exact ⟨β, fun m => (β.per_residue_stability hL a hgov m) m le_rfl⟩

name: QPCF.realPQ_floor_quasiPoly_on_class
statement:
theorem realPQ_floor_quasiPoly_on_class
    (hL : ¬ IsRat L) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (hgov : Governs L a)
    (S : Set ℕ) (hS : S.Infinite) :
    ∃ β : BranchDatum L, ∀ m : ℕ,
      ∃ g : ℕ → ℤ, IsQuasiPoly g ∧
        ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ≡ β.b m [MOD β.Ds m] → ⌊realPQ m (a n)⌋ = g n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ := realPQ_eq_bfloorVal_on_class hL a hgov S hS
  refine ⟨β, fun m => ⟨fun n => ⌊(bfloorVal (β.tower m) (β.Ds m) (β.b m) n : ℚ)⌋,
    bfloorVal_isQuasiPoly _ _ _, ?_⟩⟩
  filter_upwards [hβ m] with n hn hclass
  rw [hn hclass]
  exact_mod_cast rfl

statement:
theorem branch_degree_growth (hL : ¬ IsRat L) (β : BranchDatum L) (B : ℕ) :
    ∃ M : ℕ, B ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (M + 1),
      (bfloorPoly (β.tower j) (β.Ds j) (β.b j)).natDegree

name: QPCF.realPQ_corrected_def_3_2_forward
statement:
theorem realPQ_corrected_def_3_2_forward
    (hL : ¬ IsRat L) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (hgov : Governs L a) :
    ∃ (D b : ℕ → ℕ) (p : ℕ → Polynomial ℚ),
      (∀ m, 0 < D m) ∧
      (∀ m, D m ∣ D (m + 1)) ∧
      (∀ m, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
          n ≡ b m [MOD D m] → realPQ m (a n) = (((p m).eval (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)) ∧
      (∀ m, ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → n ≡ b m [MOD D m] →
          ∃ z : ℤ, (p m).eval (n : ℚ) = (z : ℚ)) ∧
      (∀ B : ℕ, ∃ M : ℕ, B ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (M + 1), (p j).natDegree)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨β, -⟩ := exists_adapted_branch L (Set.univ) Set.infinite_univ
  refine ⟨β.Ds, β.b, fun m => bfloorPoly (β.tower m) (β.Ds m) (β.b m),
    β.hDpos, β.hdvd, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro m
    filter_upwards [(β.per_residue_stability hL a hgov m) m le_rfl] with n hn hclass
    rw [hn hclass, bfloorVal_eq_bfloorPoly_eval]
  · intro m n hn hclass
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := bfloorVal_intVal (β.hper m) (β.b m) hn hclass
    exact ⟨z, by rw [← bfloorVal_eq_bfloorPoly_eval]; exact_mod_cast hz⟩
  · exact fun B => branch_degree_growth hL β B

    (hord : F.order < 0) (hK : F.order ≤ K) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => |pval F (K : ℤ) n|) atTop atTop

name: QPCF.afloorG_iterate_order_neg
statement:
theorem afloorG_iterate_order_neg (L : ℚ⸨X⸩) (J : ℕ) (h : 0 < edeg L J) :
    (afloorG (agaussG^[J] L)).order < 0
proof:
:= by
  have hlt : (agaussG^[J] L).order < 0 := edeg_pos_iff.mp h
  rw [afloorG_order_of_order_neg hlt]
  exact hlt

name: QPCF.frequently_atTop_of_infinite
statement:
theorem frequently_atTop_of_infinite {S : Set ℕ} (hS : S.Infinite) :
    ∃ᶠ n in atTop, n ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  rw [Filter.frequently_atTop]
  intro a
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hab⟩ := hS.exists_gt a
  exact ⟨b, hab.le, hb⟩

name: QPCF.theorem_7_1
statement:
theorem theorem_7_1 (L : ℚ⸨X⸩) (hL : ¬ IsRat L)
    (a : ℕ → ℝ) (K : ℕ)
    (hstab : ∀ J : ℕ, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
        realPQ J (a n) = pval (afloorG (agaussG^[J] L)) (K : ℤ) n)
    (S : Set ℕ) (hS : S.Infinite) :
    {J : ℕ | ∀ M : ℝ, ∃ n ∈ S, M < |realPQ J (a n)|}.Infinite
proof:
:= by
  
  apply Set.Infinite.mono (s := {J : ℕ | 0 < edeg L J})
  · 
    intro J (hJ : 0 < edeg L J) M
    
    have hord : (afloorG (agaussG^[J] L)).order < 0 := afloorG_iterate_order_neg L J hJ
    have hK : (afloorG (agaussG^[J] L)).order ≤ (K : ℤ) := le_trans hord.le (by positivity)
    have hT : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => |pval (afloorG (agaussG^[J] L)) (K : ℤ) n|) atTop atTop :=
      pval_abs_tendsto_atTop_of_order_neg _ _ hord hK
    
    have hT' : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => |realPQ J (a n)|) atTop atTop := by
      apply hT.congr'
      filter_upwards [hstab J] with n hn using by rw [hn]
    
    have hev : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, M < |realPQ J (a n)| := hT'.eventually (eventually_gt_atTop M)
    obtain ⟨n, hnS, hMn⟩ :=
      ((frequently_atTop_of_infinite hS).and_eventually hev).exists
    exact ⟨n, hnS, hMn⟩
  · 
    apply Set.infinite_of_not_bddAbove
    rintro ⟨B, hB⟩
    obtain ⟨j, hj, hjpos⟩ := edeg_infinitely_pos hL (B + 1)
    have := hB (show j ∈ {J : ℕ | 0 < edeg L J} from hjpos)
    omega

name: QPCF.realGauss_gauss_eq

proof:

name: QPCF.bridge_step
statement:
theorem bridge_step (r A : ℕ → ℝ) (N M : ℕ) (c C : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (h2 : 2 * M < N)
    (hclose : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, |r n - A n| ≤ C / (n : ℝ) ^ N)
    (hnondeg : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      c / (n : ℝ) ^ M ≤ Int.fract (A n) ∧ Int.fract (A n) ≤ 1 - c / (n : ℝ) ^ M) :
    (∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, ⌊r n⌋ = ⌊A n⌋) ∧
      ∃ C' : ℝ, 0 ≤ C' ∧ ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
        |(Int.fract (r n))⁻¹ - (Int.fract (A n))⁻¹| ≤ C' / (n : ℝ) ^ (N - 2 * M)

name: QPCF.formal_stability_i_err
statement:
theorem formal_stability_i_err (a A0 : ℕ → ℝ) (D : ℕ) (M Nsched : ℕ → ℕ) (c C : ℝ)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hbud : ∀ m ≤ D, 2 * M m < Nsched m)
    (hsched : ∀ m, m < D → Nsched (m + 1) + 2 * M m ≤ Nsched m)
    (hclose0 : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, |a n - A0 n| ≤ C / (n : ℝ) ^ Nsched 0)
    (hnondeg : ∀ m ≤ D, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      c / (n : ℝ) ^ M m ≤ Int.fract (realGaussIter m (A0 n)) ∧
        Int.fract (realGaussIter m (A0 n)) ≤ 1 - c / (n : ℝ) ^ M m) :
    ∀ m ≤ D, ∃ C' : ℝ, 0 ≤ C' ∧ ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      |realGaussIter m (a n) - realGaussIter m (A0 n)| ≤ C' / (n : ℝ) ^ Nsched m

name: QPCF.formal_stability_i
statement:
theorem formal_stability_i (a A0 : ℕ → ℝ) (D : ℕ) (M Nsched : ℕ → ℕ) (c C : ℝ)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hbud : ∀ m ≤ D, 2 * M m < Nsched m)
    (hsched : ∀ m, m < D → Nsched (m + 1) + 2 * M m ≤ Nsched m)
    (hclose0 : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, |a n - A0 n| ≤ C / (n : ℝ) ^ Nsched 0)
    (hnondeg : ∀ m ≤ D, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      c / (n : ℝ) ^ M m ≤ Int.fract (realGaussIter m (A0 n)) ∧
        Int.fract (realGaussIter m (A0 n)) ≤ 1 - c / (n : ℝ) ^ M m) :
    ∀ m ≤ D, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, realPQ m (a n) = (⌊realGaussIter m (A0 n)⌋ : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  intro m hm; by_cases h : 0 ≤ D <;> simp_all +decide [ QPCF.realPQ ] ;
  
  obtain ⟨Cm, hCm, herr⟩ : ∃ Cm : ℝ, 0 ≤ Cm ∧ ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, |realGaussIter m (a n) - realGaussIter m (A0 n)| ≤ Cm / (n : ℝ) ^ Nsched m := by
    convert formal_stability_i_err a A0 D M Nsched c C hc hC hbud hsched ( by simpa using hclose0 ) ( by simpa using hnondeg ) m hm using 1
  generalize_proofs at *; (
  have := @bridge_step ( fun n => realGaussIter m ( a n ) ) ( fun n => realGaussIter m ( A0 n ) ) ( Nsched m ) ( M m ) c Cm hc hCm ( hbud m hm ) herr ( by obtain ⟨ a, ha ⟩ := hnondeg m hm; exact Filter.eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨ a, ha ⟩ ) ; aesop;)

name: QPCF.formal_stability_i_governs
statement:
theorem formal_stability_i_governs (a : ℕ → ℝ) (L : ℚ⸨X⸩) (hgov : Governs L a)
    (D : ℕ) (M Nsched : ℕ → ℕ) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hbud : ∀ m ≤ D, 2 * M m < Nsched m)
    (hsched : ∀ m, m < D → Nsched (m + 1) + 2 * M m ≤ Nsched m)
    (hnondeg : ∀ m ≤ D, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      c / (n : ℝ) ^ M m ≤ Int.fract (realGaussIter m (pval L ((Nsched 0 : ℤ) - 1) n)) ∧
        Int.fract (realGaussIter m (pval L ((Nsched 0 : ℤ) - 1) n)) ≤ 1 - c / (n : ℝ) ^ M m) :
    ∀ m ≤ D, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      realPQ m (a n) = (⌊realGaussIter m (pval L ((Nsched 0 : ℤ) - 1) n)⌋ : ℝ)

name: QPCF.oneAddPowPS_zero
statement: theorem oneAddPowPS_zero : oneAddPowPS 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  
  have h_choose : ∀ k : ℕ, Ring.choose (0 : ℚ) k = if k = 0 then 1 else 0 := by
    grind +suggestions;
  
  ext k
  simp [h_choose]

name: QPCF.oneAddPow_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem oneAddPow_zero : oneAddPow 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [oneAddPow, oneAddPowPS_zero]; exact map_one _

name: QPCF.oneAddPow_pow
statement: theorem oneAddPow_pow (α : ℚ) (n : ℕ) : (oneAddPow α) ^ n = oneAddPow ((n : ℚ) * α)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih => rw [pow_succ, ih, oneAddPow_mul]; congr 1; push_cast; ring

name: QPCF.oneAddPow_one_eq
statement: theorem oneAddPow_one_eq : oneAddPow 1 = ((RatFunc.X + 1 : RatFunc ℚ) : ℚ⸨X⸩)

name: QPCF.coe_ratX_add_one_zpow
statement:
theorem coe_ratX_add_one_zpow (m : ℤ) :
    (((RatFunc.X + 1 : RatFunc ℚ) ^ m : RatFunc ℚ) : ℚ⸨X⸩) = oneAddPow (m : ℚ)

name: QPCF.qpow_ratX_dvd
statement:
theorem qpow_ratX_dvd {r : RatFunc ℚ} {q : ℕ} {p : ℤ}
    (h : r ^ q = (RatFunc.X + 1 : RatFunc ℚ) ^ p) : (q : ℤ) ∣ p

name: QPCF.oneAddPow_not_isRat
statement: theorem oneAddPow_not_isRat {α : ℚ} (hα : α.den ≠ 1) : ¬ IsRat (oneAddPow α)
proof:
:= by
  intro hL
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hL
  set q := α.den
  set p := α.num
  have hp : (q : ℤ) * α = p := by
    simp +zetaDelta at *
  have h_pow : (r : ℚ⸨X⸩) ^ q = oneAddPow p := by
    simp_all +decide [ ← hp, oneAddPow_pow ]
  have h_eq : r ^ q = (RatFunc.X + 1 : RatFunc ℚ) ^ p := by
    convert h_pow using 1;
    rw [ ← coe_ratX_add_one_zpow ] ; norm_cast;
  have h_div : (q : ℤ) ∣ p := by
    exact qpow_ratX_dvd h_eq
  have h_contra : q ∣ Int.natAbs p := by
    exact Int.natCast_dvd.mp h_div
  have h_gcd : Nat.gcd (Int.natAbs p) q = 1 := by
    exact α.reduced
  have h_final : q = 1 := by
    exact Nat.dvd_one.mp ( h_gcd ▸ Nat.dvd_gcd h_contra ( dvd_refl q ) )
  contradiction

name: QPCF.ofloorG_add_ofractG
statement: theorem ofloorG_add_ofractG (F : ℚ⸨X⸩) : ofloorG F + ofractG F = F
proof:
:= by

name: QPCF.ofractG_eq_inv_ogaussG
statement: theorem ofractG_eq_inv_ogaussG (F : ℚ⸨X⸩) : ofractG F = (ogaussG F)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [show ogaussG F = (ofractG F)⁻¹ from rfl, inv_inv]

name: QPCF.ofloorG_eq_afloorG_or
statement:
theorem ofloorG_eq_afloorG_or (F : ℚ⸨X⸩) :
    ofloorG F = afloorG F ∨ ofloorG F = afloorG F - HahnSeries.C (1 : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold ofloorG afloorG
  by_cases h : ocorr F
  · right; simp only [if_pos h]; rw [map_sub, map_one]; ring
  · left; simp only [if_neg h]

statement: theorem ofractG_order_nonneg (F : ℚ⸨X⸩) : 0 ≤ (ofractG F).order

name: QPCF.ofractG_leadingCoeff_pos

theorem ofractG_leadingCoeff_pos (F : ℚ⸨X⸩) (h : ofractG F ≠ 0) :

statement: theorem isRat_ofloorG (F : ℚ⸨X⸩) : IsRat (ofloorG F)

statement: theorem isRat_of_ogaussG {F : ℚ⸨X⸩} (h : IsRat (ogaussG F)) : IsRat F

name: QPCF.oneSub_ofractG_order_nonneg
statement: theorem oneSub_ofractG_order_nonneg (F : ℚ⸨X⸩) : 0 ≤ ((1 : ℚ⸨X⸩) - ofractG F).order

name: QPCF.oneSub_ofractG_leadingCoeff_pos

theorem oneSub_ofractG_leadingCoeff_pos (F : ℚ⸨X⸩) :

name: QPCF.oneSub_ofractG_ne_zero
statement: theorem oneSub_ofractG_ne_zero (F : ℚ⸨X⸩) : (1 : ℚ⸨X⸩) - ofractG F ≠ 0

name: QPCF.pval_pos_of_leadingCoeff_pos
statement:
theorem pval_pos_of_leadingCoeff_pos (H : ℚ⸨X⸩) (hne : H ≠ 0) (hord : 0 ≤ H.order)
    (K : ℤ) (hK : H.order ≤ K) (hlead : 0 < H.leadingCoeff) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in Filter.atTop, 0 < pval H K n

name: QPCF.isRat_of_ogaussG_iterate
statement:
theorem isRat_of_ogaussG_iterate : ∀ (j : ℕ) {f : ℚ⸨X⸩},
    IsRat (ogaussG^[j] f) → IsRat f
proof:
:= by
  intro j f
  induction' j with j ih generalizing f
  · simp only [Function.iterate_zero, id]; exact id
  · intro h
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply'] at h
    exact ih (isRat_of_ogaussG h)

name: QPCF.pval_mul_pow_tendsto
statement:
theorem pval_mul_pow_tendsto (g : ℚ⸨X⸩) (s : ℕ) (K : ℤ)
    (hord : g.order = (s : ℤ)) (hsK : (s : ℤ) ≤ K) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => pval g K n * (n : ℝ) ^ s) atTop
      (nhds ((g.coeff (s : ℤ) : ℝ)))

name: QPCF.pval_tendsto_zero
statement:
theorem pval_tendsto_zero (g : ℚ⸨X⸩) (s : ℕ) (K : ℤ)
    (hord : g.order = (s : ℤ)) (hs1 : 1 ≤ s) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => pval g K n) atTop (nhds 0)

name: QPCF.pval_nondeg
statement:
theorem pval_nondeg (g : ℚ⸨X⸩) (s : ℕ) (K : ℤ)
    (hord : g.order = (s : ℤ)) (hs1 : 1 ≤ s) (hsK : (s : ℤ) ≤ K)
    (hpos : 0 < (g.coeff (s : ℤ) : ℝ)) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      c / (n : ℝ) ^ s ≤ pval g K n ∧ pval g K n ≤ 1 - c / (n : ℝ) ^ s

name: QPCF.fFract_nondeg_uniform
statement:
theorem fFract_nondeg_uniform (L : ℚ⸨X⸩) (D : ℕ) (K : ℤ) (s : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hs : ∀ m ≤ D, (fFract L m).order = (s m : ℤ))
    (hs1 : ∀ m ≤ D, 1 ≤ s m)
    (hsK : ∀ m ≤ D, (s m : ℤ) ≤ K)
    (hpos : ∀ m ≤ D, 0 < ((fFract L m).coeff (s m : ℤ) : ℝ)) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ m ≤ D, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      c / (n : ℝ) ^ s m ≤ pval (fFract L m) K n ∧
        pval (fFract L m) K n ≤ 1 - c / (n : ℝ) ^ s m

name: QPCF.full_stability_i_of_pos_leading
statement:
theorem full_stability_i_of_pos_leading (a : ℕ → ℝ) (L : ℚ⸨X⸩) (hgov : Governs L a)
    (D K : ℕ) (s q : ℕ → ℕ) (hq0 : q 0 ≤ K + 1)
    (hne : ∀ m < D, fFract L m ≠ 0)
    (hs : ∀ m ≤ D, (fFract L m).order = (s m : ℤ))
    (hsK : ∀ m ≤ D, s m ≤ K)
    (hs1 : ∀ m ≤ D, 1 ≤ s m)
    (hpos : ∀ m ≤ D, 0 < ((fFract L m).coeff (s m : ℤ) : ℝ))
    (hq : ∀ m ≤ D, 2 * s m < q m)
    (hqstep : ∀ m < D, q (m + 1) + 2 * s m ≤ q m)
    (hqK : ∀ m < D, q (m + 1) + s m + s m ≤ K + 1)
    (hint : ∀ m ≤ D, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      ∃ z : ℤ, pval (fFloor L m) (K : ℤ) n = (z : ℝ)) :
    ∀ m ≤ D, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      realPQ m (a n) = pval (formalPartialQuotient m L) (K : ℤ) n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hnondeg⟩ :=
    fFract_nondeg_uniform L D (K : ℤ) s hs hs1
      (fun m hm => by exact_mod_cast hsK m hm) hpos
  exact full_stability_i a L hgov D K s s q c hc hq0
    (fun m hm => hne m hm)
    (fun m hm => hs m hm.le)
    (fun m hm => hsK m hm.le)
    (fun m hm => hs1 m hm.le)
    hq hqstep hqK hint hnondeg

name: QPCF.realValue_exact_of_terminates
statement:
theorem realValue_exact_of_terminates (x : ℝ) (d : ℕ)
    (hd : Int.fract (realGaussIter d x) = 0)
    (hnd : ∀ j < d, Int.fract (realGaussIter j x) ≠ 0) :
    x * contDen (fun j => realPQ j x) (d + 1) = contNum (fun j => realPQ j x) (d + 1)
      ∧ 1 ≤ contDen (fun j => realPQ j x) (d + 1)

name: QPCF.terminatesAt_converse
statement:
theorem terminatesAt_converse (a : ℕ → ℝ) (D r M : ℕ) (hD : 0 < D) (hr : r < D)
    (hterm : TerminatesAt a D r M) :
    ∃ g : ℚ⸨X⸩, IsRat g ∧ GovernsOn {n : ℕ | n % D = r} g a

name: QPCF.caseB'_converse
statement:
theorem caseB'_converse (a : ℕ → ℝ) (D r M : ℕ) (hD : 0 < D) (hr : r < D)
    (hcase : CaseB' a D r M) :
    ∃ g : ℚ⸨X⸩, IsRat g ∧ GovernsOn {n : ℕ | n % D = r} g a
proof:
:= by
  rcases hcase with hterm | hsuper
  · exact terminatesAt_converse a D r M hD hr hterm
  · exact caseB_converse a D r M hD hr hsuper

name: QPCF.continuousMapFloor_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem continuousMapFloor_apply (hfloor : Continuous G.floor) (f : C(X, R)) (x : X) :
    continuousMapFloor G hfloor f x = G.floor (f x)
proof: := rfl

name: QPCF.collective_unboundedness_of_tendsto
statement:
theorem collective_unboundedness_of_tendsto (a : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hinf : {J : ℕ | Tendsto (fun n => |realPQ J (a n)|) atTop atTop}.Infinite)
    (S : Set ℕ) (hS : S.Infinite) :
    {J : ℕ | ∀ M : ℝ, ∃ n ∈ S, M < |realPQ J (a n)|}.Infinite
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Infinite.mono (s := {J : ℕ | Tendsto (fun n => |realPQ J (a n)|) atTop atTop})
  · intro J hJ M
    have hev : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, M < |realPQ J (a n)| := hJ.eventually (eventually_gt_atTop M)
    obtain ⟨n, hnS, hMn⟩ :=
      ((frequently_atTop_of_infinite hS).and_eventually hev).exists
    exact ⟨n, hnS, hMn⟩
  · exact hinf

name: QPCF.afloorG_overpredicts
statement:
theorem afloorG_overpredicts :
    afloorG ((1 : ℚ⸨X⸩) - HahnSeries.single (1 : ℤ) (1 : ℚ)) = HahnSeries.C (1 : ℚ) ∧
    ofloorG ((1 : ℚ⸨X⸩) - HahnSeries.single (1 : ℤ) (1 : ℚ)) = 0 ∧
    ∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n → ⌊(1 : ℝ) - 1 / (n : ℝ)⌋ = 0

name: QPCF.pval_ofractG_mem_Ioo
statement:
theorem pval_ofractG_mem_Ioo (F : ℚ⸨X⸩) (h : ofractG F ≠ 0) (K : ℤ)
    (hK1 : (ofractG F).order ≤ K) (hK2 : ((1 : ℚ⸨X⸩) - ofractG F).order ≤ K) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, 0 < pval (ofractG F) K n ∧ pval (ofractG F) K n < 1

name: QPCF.collective_unboundedness_ratPow_corrected
statement:
theorem collective_unboundedness_ratPow_corrected (α : ℚ)
    (htend : {J : ℕ | Tendsto (fun n => |realPQ J (ratPowSeq α n)|) atTop atTop}.Infinite)
    (S : Set ℕ) (hS : S.Infinite) :
    {J : ℕ | ∀ M : ℝ, ∃ n ∈ S, M < |realPQ J (ratPowSeq α n)|}.Infinite
proof:
:=
  collective_unboundedness_of_tendsto (ratPowSeq α) htend S hS

name: QPCF.ordered_pole_depths_infinite
statement:
theorem ordered_pole_depths_infinite {L : ℚ⸨X⸩} (hL : ¬ IsRat L) :
    {J : ℕ | (ogaussG^[J] L).order < 0}.Infinite
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.infinite_of_not_bddAbove
  rintro ⟨B, hB⟩
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hjneg⟩ := ogaussG_order_infinitely_neg hL (B + 1)
  have := hB (show j ∈ {J : ℕ | (ogaussG^[J] L).order < 0} from hjneg)
  omega

name: QPCF.collective_unboundedness_ratPow_of_pole_stability
statement:
theorem collective_unboundedness_ratPow_of_pole_stability (α : ℚ) (hα : α.den ≠ 1)
    (hstab : ∀ J : ℕ, (ogaussG^[J] (oneAddPow α)).order < 0 →
        Tendsto (fun n => |realPQ J (ratPowSeq α n)|) atTop atTop)
    (S : Set ℕ) (hS : S.Infinite) :
    {J : ℕ | ∀ M : ℝ, ∃ n ∈ S, M < |realPQ J (ratPowSeq α n)|}.Infinite
proof:
:= by
  have hinf : {J : ℕ | Tendsto (fun n => |realPQ J (ratPowSeq α n)|) atTop atTop}.Infinite := by
    apply Set.Infinite.mono (s := {J : ℕ | (ogaussG^[J] (oneAddPow α)).order < 0})
    · intro J hJ; exact hstab J hJ
    · exact ordered_pole_depths_infinite (oneAddPow_not_isRat hα)
  exact collective_unboundedness_of_tendsto (ratPowSeq α) hinf S hS

name: QPCF.ratPow_irrational_and_governed'
statement:
theorem ratPow_irrational_and_governed' (α : ℚ) (hα : α.den ≠ 1) :
    ¬ IsRat (oneAddPow α) ∧ Governs (oneAddPow α) (ratPowSeq α)
proof:
:=
  ⟨oneAddPow_not_isRat hα, oneAddPow_governs α⟩

name: QPCF.Negligible.mul_polyBounded
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  obtain ⟨C, d, hC⟩ := hb
  have h_bound : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, |n ^ k * (a n * b n)| ≤ C * |n ^ (k + d) * a n| := by
    filter_upwards [ hC, Filter.eventually_gt_atTop 0 ] with n hn hn' ; ring_nf at * ; simp_all +decide [ abs_mul, mul_comm, mul_left_comm ];
    nlinarith [ show 0 ≤ |a n| * ( n ^ k : ℝ ) by positivity ];
  exact squeeze_zero_norm' h_bound ( by simpa using Filter.Tendsto.const_mul C ( ha ( k + d ) |> Filter.Tendsto.abs ) )

  obtain ⟨ C, d, h ⟩ := ha; exact ⟨ C, d, by filter_upwards [ h ] with n hn using by simpa using hn ⟩ ;
