name: QPCF.Compactification.coeff_uniform_bound
statement:
theorem coeff_uniform_bound (F : C(Y, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (k : ℤ) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ r : Y, |((F r).coeff k : ℝ)| ≤ B
proof:
:= by
  have hcont : Continuous (fun r : Y => |((F r).coeff k : ℝ)|) := by
    have h2 : Continuous (fun f : ℚ⸨X⸩ => f.coeff k) :=
      (LaurentSeries.uniformContinuous_coeff k).continuous
    fun_prop
  obtain ⟨r0, -, hr0⟩ :=
    (isCompact_univ (X := Y)).exists_isMaxOn ⟨ev 0, trivial⟩ hcont.continuousOn
  exact ⟨_, fun r => hr0 (Set.mem_univ r)⟩

name: QPCF.Compactification.order_uniform_bound
statement:
theorem order_uniform_bound (F : C(Y, ℚ⸨X⸩)) :
    ∃ L : ℤ, ∀ r : Y, ∀ k : ℤ, k < L → (F r).coeff k = 0

name: QPCF.Compactification.coeff_uniform_bound_range
statement:
theorem coeff_uniform_bound_range (F : C(Y, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (Lb U : ℤ) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧ ∀ r : Y, ∀ k : ℤ, Lb ≤ k → k ≤ U → |((F r).coeff k : ℝ)| ≤ B
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ : ∃ B : ℤ → ℝ, ∀ r : Y, ∀ k : ℤ, Lb ≤ k → k ≤ U → |((F r).coeff k : ℝ)| ≤ B k := by
    exact ⟨ fun k => Classical.choose ( coeff_uniform_bound ev F k ), fun r k hk₁ hk₂ => Classical.choose_spec ( coeff_uniform_bound ev F k ) r ⟩;
  exact ⟨ ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc Lb U, |B k|, Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _, fun r k hk₁ hk₂ => le_trans ( hB r k hk₁ hk₂ ) ( le_trans ( le_abs_self _ ) ( Finset.single_le_sum ( fun x _ => abs_nonneg ( B x ) ) ( Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨ hk₁, hk₂ ⟩ ) ) ) ⟩

name: QPCF.Compactification.GovC.zero
statement: theorem GovC.zero : GovC ev (0 : C(Y, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (fun _ => 0)
proof:
:= by
  intro N
  have : (fun n => (0 : ℝ) - pval ((0 : C(Y, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (ev n)) N n)
      = fun n => (0 : ℝ) - pval (0 : ℚ⸨X⸩) N n := by
    funext n; simp
  rw [this]; exact Governs.zero N

name: QPCF.Compactification.GovC.one
statement: theorem GovC.one : GovC ev (1 : C(Y, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (fun _ => 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro N
  have : (fun n => (1 : ℝ) - pval ((1 : C(Y, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (ev n)) N n)
      = fun n => (1 : ℝ) - pval (1 : ℚ⸨X⸩) N n := by
    funext n; simp
  rw [this]; exact Governs.one N

name: QPCF.Compactification.GovC.add
statement:
theorem GovC.add {F G : C(Y, ℚ⸨X⸩)} {a b : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hf : GovC ev F a) (hg : GovC ev G b) : GovC ev (F + G) (fun n => a n + b n)
proof:
:= by
  intro N
  have key := BigOpow.add (hf N) (hg N)
  have hEq : (fun n => (a n + b n) - pval ((F + G) (ev n)) N n)
      = fun n => (a n - pval (F (ev n)) N n) + (b n - pval (G (ev n)) N n) := by
    funext n
    rw [ContinuousMap.add_apply, pval_add]; ring
  rw [hEq]; exact key

name: QPCF.Compactification.GovC.neg
statement:
theorem GovC.neg {F : C(Y, ℚ⸨X⸩)} {a : ℕ → ℝ} (hf : GovC ev F a) :
    GovC ev (-F) (fun n => - a n)
proof:
:= by
  intro N
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hf N
  refine ⟨C, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hC] with n hn
  have hEq : (-a n) - pval ((-F) (ev n)) N n
      = -((a n) - pval (F (ev n)) N n) := by
    rw [ContinuousMap.neg_apply, pval_neg]; ring
  rw [hEq, abs_neg]; exact hn

name: QPCF.Compactification.pval_mul_sub_bigOpow_uniform
statement:
theorem pval_mul_sub_bigOpow_uniform (F G : C(Y, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (N M L : ℤ)
    (hLF : ∀ r : Y, ∀ k : ℤ, k < L → (F r).coeff k = 0)
    (hLG : ∀ r : Y, ∀ k : ℤ, k < L → (G r).coeff k = 0)
    (hM2 : N - L ≤ M) :
    BigOpow (fun n => pval (F (ev n)) M n * pval (G (ev n)) M n
        - pval (F (ev n) * G (ev n)) N n) (-(N + 1))

name: QPCF.Compactification.pval_bigOpow_uniform
statement:
theorem pval_bigOpow_uniform (F : C(Y, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (M L : ℤ)
    (hL : ∀ r : Y, ∀ k : ℤ, k < L → (F r).coeff k = 0) :
    BigOpow (fun n => pval (F (ev n)) M n) (-L)

name: QPCF.Compactification.GovC.mul
statement:
theorem GovC.mul {F G : C(Y, ℚ⸨X⸩)} {a b : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hf : GovC ev F a) (hg : GovC ev G b) : GovC ev (F * G) (fun n => a n * b n)

name: QPCF.Compactification.coeff_fiber_mem_nhds
statement:
theorem coeff_fiber_mem_nhds (H : C(Y, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (k : ℤ) (r₀ : Y) :
    {r : Y | (H r).coeff k = (H r₀).coeff k} ∈ 𝓝 r₀
proof:
:=
  H.continuous.continuousAt (QPCF.coeff_fiber_nhds k (H r₀))

name: QPCF.Compactification.vball_mem_nhds
statement:
theorem vball_mem_nhds (H : C(Y, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (r₀ : Y) (γ : ℤᵐ⁰) (hγ : γ ≠ 0)
    (hle : Valued.v (H r₀) ≤ γ) : {r : Y | Valued.v (H r) ≤ γ} ∈ 𝓝 r₀
proof:
:=
  ((Valued.isOpen_closedBall ℚ⸨X⸩ hγ).preimage H.continuous).mem_nhds hle

name: QPCF.Compactification.eq_zero_of_govNull
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_govNull (H : C(Y, ℚ⸨X⸩))
    (hN : ∀ N : ℤ, BigOpow (fun n => pval (H (ev n)) N n) (-(N + 1))) : H = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h_nonzero
  obtain ⟨r₀, hr₀⟩ : ∃ r₀ : Y, H r₀ ≠ 0 :=
    not_forall.mp fun h => h_nonzero <| ContinuousMap.ext h
  obtain ⟨k₀, c, hc0, hck, hclt⟩ :
      ∃ k₀ : ℤ, ∃ c : ℚ, c ≠ 0 ∧ (H r₀).coeff k₀ = c ∧ ∀ j < k₀, (H r₀).coeff j = 0 :=
    ⟨(H r₀).order, _, mt HahnSeries.coeff_order_eq_zero.mp hr₀, rfl,
      fun j hj => HahnSeries.coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_order hj⟩
  
  have hVmem : {r : Y | (H r).coeff k₀ = c} ∩ {r : Y | Valued.v (H r) ≤ WithZero.exp (-k₀)} ∈ 𝓝 r₀ := by
    refine Filter.inter_mem ?_ ?_
    · have h := coeff_fiber_mem_nhds H k₀ r₀
      simpa only [hck] using h
    · apply vball_mem_nhds
      · exact WithZero.exp_ne_zero
      · rw [LaurentSeries.valuation_le_iff_coeff_lt_eq_zero]; exact hclt
  have hfreq : ∃ᶠ n in atTop, ev n ∈ {r : Y | (H r).coeff k₀ = c} ∩ {r : Y | Valued.v (H r) ≤ WithZero.exp (-k₀)} :=
    hclus r₀ _ hVmem
  
  obtain ⟨Cst, hCst⟩ := hN k₀
  have hcpos : (0 : ℝ) < |(c : ℝ)| := abs_pos.mpr (by exact_mod_cast hc0)
  
  have hbad : ∃ᶠ (n : ℕ) in atTop, |(c : ℝ)| * (n : ℝ) ≤ Cst := by
    refine (hfreq.and_eventually (hCst.and (eventually_gt_atTop 0))).mono ?_
    rintro n ⟨hnV, hnC, hnpos⟩
    obtain ⟨hc_eq, hc_zero'⟩ := hnV
    have hc_eq : (H (ev n)).coeff k₀ = c := hc_eq
    have hc_zero : ∀ j < k₀, (H (ev n)).coeff j = 0 :=
      (LaurentSeries.valuation_le_iff_coeff_lt_eq_zero (f := H (ev n)) (D := k₀)).mp hc_zero'
    have hpv : pval (H (ev n)) k₀ n = (c : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) ^ (-k₀) := by
      rw [pval_eq_finset_sum]
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single k₀]
      · rw [hc_eq]
      · intro j hjmem hjne
        have hjle : j ≤ k₀ := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hjmem).2
        rw [hc_zero j (lt_of_le_of_ne hjle hjne)]; simp
      · intro h
        exfalso
        have hord : (H (ev n)).order ≤ k₀ :=
          HahnSeries.order_le_of_coeff_ne_zero (g := k₀) (by rw [hc_eq]; exact hc0)
        rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at h
        exact h ⟨hord, le_refl _⟩
    have hnpos' : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hnpos
    have hbnd : |pval (H (ev n)) k₀ n| ≤ Cst * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(k₀ + 1)) := hnC
    rw [hpv] at hbnd
    have habs : |(c : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) ^ (-k₀)| = |(c : ℝ)| * (n : ℝ) ^ (-k₀) := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (zpow_nonneg (le_of_lt hnpos') _)]
    rw [habs] at hbnd
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hbnd (le_of_lt (zpow_pos hnpos' (k₀ + 1)))
    have hL : (n : ℝ) ^ (-k₀) * (n : ℝ) ^ (k₀ + 1) = (n : ℝ) := by
      rw [← zpow_add₀ (ne_of_gt hnpos'), show -k₀ + (k₀ + 1) = 1 by ring, zpow_one]
    have hR : (n : ℝ) ^ (-(k₀ + 1)) * (n : ℝ) ^ (k₀ + 1) = 1 := by
      rw [← zpow_add₀ (ne_of_gt hnpos'), show -(k₀ + 1) + (k₀ + 1) = 0 by ring, zpow_zero]
    rw [mul_assoc, mul_assoc, hL, hR, mul_one] at hmul
    exact hmul
  
  have hdiv : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => |(c : ℝ)| * (n : ℝ)) atTop atTop :=
    Filter.Tendsto.const_mul_atTop hcpos tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  have hev : ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in atTop, Cst < |(c : ℝ)| * (n : ℝ) := hdiv.eventually_gt_atTop Cst
  obtain ⟨n, hn1, hn2⟩ := (hbad.and_eventually hev).exists
  linarith

name: QPCF.Compactification.GovC.unique
statement:
theorem GovC.unique {F G : C(Y, ℚ⸨X⸩)} {a : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hf : GovC ev F a) (hg : GovC ev G a) : F = G
proof:
:= by
  have hH : ∀ N : ℤ, BigOpow (fun n => pval ((F - G) (ev n)) N n) (-(N + 1)) := by
    intro N
    obtain ⟨C₁, hC₁⟩ := hf N
    obtain ⟨C₂, hC₂⟩ := hg N
    refine ⟨C₁ + C₂, ?_⟩
    filter_upwards [hC₁, hC₂] with n hn₁ hn₂
    have hpv : pval ((F - G) (ev n)) N n
        = pval (F (ev n)) N n - pval (G (ev n)) N n := by
      rw [ContinuousMap.sub_apply,
        show F (ev n) - G (ev n) = F (ev n) + (- G (ev n)) from by ring,
        pval_add, pval_neg]; ring
    rw [hpv]
    rw [abs_le] at hn₁ hn₂
    rw [abs_le, add_mul]
    constructor <;> linarith [hn₁.1, hn₁.2, hn₂.1, hn₂.2]
  have hz : F - G = 0 := eq_zero_of_govNull ev hclus (F - G) hH
  rw [← sub_eq_zero]; exact hz

name: QPCF.Compactification.borel_diag_bigOpow
statement:
theorem borel_diag_bigOpow (F : C(Y, ℚ⸨X⸩)) (N : ℤ) :
    BigOpow (fun n => borelSeq (F (ev n)) n - pval (F (ev n)) N n) (-(N + 1))

name: QPCF.Compactification.GovC.exists
statement: theorem GovC.exists (F : C(Y, ℚ⸨X⸩)) : ∃ a : ℕ → ℝ, GovC ev F a
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun n => borelSeq (F (ev n)) n, fun N => borel_diag_bigOpow ev F N⟩

name: QPCF.Compactification.GovC.congr
statement:
theorem GovC.congr {F : C(Y, ℚ⸨X⸩)} {a b : ℕ → ℝ}
    (ha : GovC ev F a) (hab : AsymEquiv a b) : GovC ev F b
proof:
:= by
  intro N
  have h_sum : BigOpow (fun n => (a n - pval (F (ev n)) N n) + (b n - a n)) (-(N + 1)) :=
    BigOpow.add (ha N) (negligible_iff_bigOpow.mp (AsymEquiv.symm hab) _)
  have : (fun n => b n - pval (F (ev n)) N n)
      = fun n => (a n - pval (F (ev n)) N n) + (b n - a n) := by
    funext n; ring
  rw [this]; exact h_sum

name: QPCF.Compactification.GovC.asymEquiv_of_eq
statement:
theorem GovC.asymEquiv_of_eq {F : C(Y, ℚ⸨X⸩)} {a b : ℕ → ℝ}
    (ha : GovC ev F a) (hb : GovC ev F b) : AsymEquiv a b
proof:
:= by
  rw [AsymEquiv, negligible_iff_bigOpow]
  intro k
  obtain ⟨C₁, hC₁⟩ := ha (k - 1)
  obtain ⟨C₂, hC₂⟩ := hb (k - 1)
  refine ⟨C₁ + C₂, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hC₁, hC₂] with n hn₁ hn₂
  have hk : (-(k - 1 + 1) : ℤ) = -k := by ring
  rw [hk] at hn₁ hn₂
  rw [abs_le] at hn₁ hn₂
  rw [abs_le, add_mul]
  constructor <;> linarith [hn₁.1, hn₁.2, hn₂.1, hn₂.2]

name: QPCF.Compactification.govFamily_spec
statement: theorem govFamily_spec (x : govSubring ev) : GovC ev (govFamily ev x) x.1
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec x.2

name: QPCF.Compactification.govFamily_eq_iff
statement:
theorem govFamily_eq_iff {x : govSubring ev} {F : C(Y, ℚ⸨X⸩)} :
    govFamily ev x = F ↔ GovC ev F x.1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl; exact govFamily_spec ev x
  · intro h; exact GovC.unique ev hclus (govFamily_spec ev x) h

name: QPCF.Compactification.govPhi_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem govPhi_apply (x : govSubring ev) : govPhi ev hclus x = govFamily ev x
proof: := rfl

name: QPCF.Compactification.govPhi_surjective
statement: theorem govPhi_surjective : Function.Surjective (govPhi ev hclus)
proof:
:= by
  intro F
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := GovC.exists ev F
  exact ⟨⟨a, ⟨F, ha⟩⟩, (govFamily_eq_iff ev hclus).mpr ha⟩

name: QPCF.Compactification.govPhi_eq_iff_asymEquiv
statement:
theorem govPhi_eq_iff_asymEquiv (x y : govSubring ev) :
    govPhi ev hclus x = govPhi ev hclus y ↔ AsymEquiv x.1 y.1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    simp only [govPhi_apply] at h
    have hx := govFamily_spec ev x
    have hy := govFamily_spec ev y
    rw [h] at hx
    exact GovC.asymEquiv_of_eq ev hx hy
  · intro h
    simp only [govPhi_apply]
    have hx := govFamily_spec ev x
    have hxy : GovC ev (govFamily ev x) y.1 := GovC.congr ev hx h
    exact GovC.unique ev hclus hxy (govFamily_spec ev y)

name: QPCF.Compactification.clustering_ZHat
statement: theorem clustering_ZHat : Clustering (ZHat.ofNat)
proof:
:= by
  intro r U hU
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := ZHat.exists_proj_subset r hU
  have hfreq := ZHat.frequently_ofNat_proj r M
  refine hfreq.mono ?_
  intro n hn
  exact hM (by simpa using hn)

name: QPCF.partialSum_tendsto_of_infinitely_pos
statement:
theorem partialSum_tendsto_of_infinitely_pos (e : ℕ → ℕ)
    (h : ∀ N : ℕ, ∃ j, N ≤ j ∧ 0 < e j) :
    ∀ M : ℕ, ∃ K : ℕ, M < ∑ j ∈ Finset.range K, e j

name: QPCF.uniform_of_pointwise
statement:
theorem uniform_of_pointwise {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [CompactSpace X]
    (s : ℕ → X → ℕ)
    (hmono : ∀ x : X, Monotone fun K => s K x)
    (hopen : ∀ (K M : ℕ), IsOpen {x : X | M < s K x})
    (hpt : ∀ (x : X) (M : ℕ), ∃ K, M < s K x) :
    ∀ M : ℕ, ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ x : X, M < s K x

name: QPCF.uniform_of_pointwise₂
statement:
theorem uniform_of_pointwise₂ {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [CompactSpace X]
    (s t : ℕ → X → ℕ)
    (hmono_s : ∀ x : X, Monotone fun K => s K x)
    (hmono_t : ∀ x : X, Monotone fun K => t K x)
    (hopen_s : ∀ (K M : ℕ), IsOpen {x : X | M < s K x})
    (hopen_t : ∀ (K M : ℕ), IsOpen {x : X | M < t K x})
    (hpt_s : ∀ (x : X) (M : ℕ), ∃ K, M < s K x)
    (hpt_t : ∀ (x : X) (M : ℕ), ∃ K, M < t K x) :
    ∀ M : ℕ, ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ x : X, M < s K x ∧ M < t K x

name: QPCF.realPQ_forward_corrected_allResidues
statement:
theorem realPQ_forward_corrected_allResidues
    (hL : ¬ IsRat L) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (hgov : Governs L a) :
    ∃ (D : ℕ → ℕ) (p : ∀ m, ZMod (D m) → Polynomial ℚ),
      (∀ m, 0 < D m) ∧
      (∀ m, D m ∣ D (m + 1)) ∧
      
      (∀ m (r : ZMod (D m)), ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
          ((n : ℕ) : ZMod (D m)) = r →
            realPQ m (a n) = (((p m r).eval ((n : ℕ) : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)) ∧
      
      (∀ m (r : ZMod (D m)) (n : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ((n : ℕ) : ZMod (D m)) = r →
          ∃ z : ℤ, (p m r).eval ((n : ℕ) : ℚ) = (z : ℚ)) ∧
      
      (∀ β : BranchDatum L, (∀ m, β.Ds m = D m) → ∀ B : ℕ, ∃ M : ℕ,
          B ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (M + 1),
                (p j (((β.b j : ℕ) : ZMod (D j)))).natDegree)

name: QPCF.realPQ_forward_isQuasiPoly
statement:
theorem realPQ_forward_isQuasiPoly
    (hL : ¬ IsRat L) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (hgov : Governs L a) (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ g : ℕ → ℤ, IsQuasiPoly g ∧ (∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, ⌊realPQ m (a n)⌋ = g n)
proof:
:=
  realPQ_floor_isQuasiPoly_of_governs hL a hgov m

name: QPCF.isPolyPartField_zero
statement: theorem isPolyPartField_zero : IsPolyPartField K (0 : LaurentSeries K)
proof:
:= by
  intro i _; simp

name: QPCF.isPolyPartField_one
statement: theorem isPolyPartField_one : IsPolyPartField K (1 : LaurentSeries K)
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi; by_cases hi' : i = 0 <;> simp_all

name: QPCF.isPolyPartField_add
statement:
theorem isPolyPartField_add {f g : LaurentSeries K}
    (hf : IsPolyPartField K f) (hg : IsPolyPartField K g) : IsPolyPartField K (f + g)
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi; simp [hf i hi, hg i hi]

name: QPCF.isPolyPartField_neg
statement:
theorem isPolyPartField_neg {f : LaurentSeries K} (hf : IsPolyPartField K f) :
    IsPolyPartField K (-f)
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi; simp [hf i hi]

name: QPCF.isPolyPartField_mul
statement:
theorem isPolyPartField_mul {f g : LaurentSeries K}
    (hf : IsPolyPartField K f) (hg : IsPolyPartField K g) : IsPolyPartField K (f * g)
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  rw [HahnSeries.coeff_mul, Finset.sum_eq_zero]
  simp_all [Finset.mem_addAntidiagonal]
  intro a b ha hb hab; have := hf a; have := hg b; simp_all [IsPolyPartField]
  grind

name: QPCF.fieldLaurentFloor_mem
statement:
theorem fieldLaurentFloor_mem (f : LaurentSeries K) :
    IsPolyPartField K (fieldLaurentFloor f)
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  simp [fieldLaurentFloor, HahnSeries.coeff_truncLT]
  grind

name: QPCF.fieldLaurentFloor_eq_self
statement:
theorem fieldLaurentFloor_eq_self (f : LaurentSeries K) (hf : IsPolyPartField K f) :
    fieldLaurentFloor f = f
proof:
:= by
  ext i; simp [fieldLaurentFloor]; exact fun hi => (hf i (by linarith)).symm

name: QPCF.floor_stability
statement:
theorem floor_stability (x y : ℕ → ℝ) (N M : ℕ) (c C : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hMN : M < N)
    (hclose : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, |x n - y n| ≤ C / (n : ℝ) ^ N)
    (hdist : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      c / (n : ℝ) ^ M ≤ Int.fract (y n) ∧ Int.fract (y n) ≤ 1 - c / (n : ℝ) ^ M) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, ⌊x n⌋ = ⌊y n⌋

name: QPCF.inversion_stability
statement:
theorem inversion_stability (x A : ℕ → ℝ) (α β : ℕ) (c C : ℝ)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hne : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, A n ≠ 0)
    (hclose : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, |x n - A n| ≤ C / (n : ℝ) ^ α)
    (hlow : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, c / (n : ℝ) ^ β ≤ |A n|)
    (hαβ : 2 * β < α) :
    ∃ C' : ℝ, 0 ≤ C' ∧
      ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, |1 / x n - 1 / A n| ≤ C' * (n : ℝ) ^ (2 * β - α : ℤ)

name: QPCF.ZHat.isClosed
statement: theorem ZHat.isClosed : IsClosed (ZHat : Set (Π M : ℕ, ZMod (M !)))
proof:
:= by
  have he : (ZHat : Set (Π M : ℕ, ZMod (M !))) = ⋂ M, {x | transZMF M (x (M + 1)) = x M} := by
    ext x; simp [ZHat]
  rw [he]; apply isClosed_iInter; intro M
  exact isClosed_eq (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)

name: QPCF.ZHat.proj_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem ZHat.proj_apply (M : ℕ) (y : ZHat) :
    ZHat.proj M y = (y : Π M, ZMod (M !)) M
proof: := rfl

name: QPCF.ZHat.continuous_proj
statement:
@[continuity, fun_prop]
theorem ZHat.continuous_proj (M : ℕ) : Continuous (ZHat.proj M)
proof:
:=
  (continuous_apply M).comp continuous_subtype_val

name: QPCF.ZHat.proj_succ
statement:
theorem ZHat.proj_succ (y : ZHat) (M : ℕ) :
    transZMF M (ZHat.proj (M + 1) y) = ZHat.proj M y

name: QPCF.ZHat.proj_mono
statement:
theorem ZHat.proj_mono (y : ZHat) {M M' : ℕ} (h : M ≤ M') :
    ZMod.castHom (Nat.factorial_dvd_factorial h) (ZMod (M !)) (ZHat.proj M' y) = ZHat.proj M y
proof:
:= by
  induction M', h using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => simp
  | succ M' hMM' ih =>
      rw [← ih, ← ZHat.proj_succ y M', transZMF]
      conv_rhs => rw [← RingHom.comp_apply, ZMod.castHom_comp]

name: QPCF.ZHat.proj_ofNat
statement:
@[simp] theorem ZHat.proj_ofNat (M n : ℕ) :
    ZHat.proj M (ZHat.ofNat n) = (n : ZMod (M !))
proof: := rfl

name: QPCF.ZHat.exists_proj_subset
statement:
theorem ZHat.exists_proj_subset (r : ZHat) {U : Set ZHat} (hU : U ∈ 𝓝 r) :
    ∃ M : ℕ, {y : ZHat | ZHat.proj M y = ZHat.proj M r} ⊆ U

name: QPCF.ZHat.cylinder_mem_nhds
statement:
theorem ZHat.cylinder_mem_nhds (r : ZHat) (M : ℕ) :
    {y : ZHat | ZHat.proj M y = ZHat.proj M r} ∈ 𝓝 r
proof:
:= by
  have hcl : IsOpen {y : ZHat | ZHat.proj M y = ZHat.proj M r} := by
    have : {y : ZHat | ZHat.proj M y = ZHat.proj M r}
        = (ZHat.proj M) ⁻¹' {ZHat.proj M r} := rfl
    rw [this]
    exact (ZHat.continuous_proj M).isOpen_preimage _ (isOpen_discrete _)
  exact hcl.mem_nhds rfl

name: QPCF.ZHat.frequently_ofNat_proj
statement:
theorem ZHat.frequently_ofNat_proj (r : ZHat) (M : ℕ) :
    ∃ᶠ n in atTop, ZHat.proj M (ZHat.ofNat n) = ZHat.proj M r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n0, hn0⟩ : ∃ n0 : ℕ, (n0 : ZMod (M !)) = ZHat.proj M r :=
    ⟨(ZHat.proj M r).val, by simp⟩
  rw [Filter.frequently_atTop]
  intro a
  refine ⟨n0 + (a + 1) * (M !), by nlinarith [Nat.factorial_pos M], ?_⟩
  rw [ZHat.proj_ofNat, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_mul, ZMod.natCast_self, mul_zero, add_zero, hn0]

name: QPCF.GaussHom.map_fract
statement:
theorem map_fract (φ : GaussHom G₁ G₂) (x : R) :
    φ.toRingHom (G₁.fract x) = G₂.fract (φ.toRingHom x)
proof:
:= by
  simp +decide [ GaussStructure.fract, φ.map_floor ]

name: QPCF.GaussHom.map_gauss
statement:
theorem map_gauss (φ : GaussHom G₁ G₂) (x : R) (hx : IsUnit (G₁.fract x)) :
    φ.toRingHom (G₁.gauss x) = G₂.gauss (φ.toRingHom x)

name: QPCF.chosenPeriod_spec
statement: theorem chosenPeriod_spec (F : ℚ⸨X⸩) : IsFloorPeriod F (chosenPeriod F)
proof:
:=
  (isFloorPeriod_exists F).choose_spec

name: QPCF.chosenPeriod_pos
statement: theorem chosenPeriod_pos (F : ℚ⸨X⸩) : 0 < chosenPeriod F
proof: := (chosenPeriod_spec F).1

name: QPCF.allResModulus_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem allResModulus_zero : allResModulus L 0 = chosenPeriod L
proof: := rfl

name: QPCF.allResTower_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem allResTower_zero (r : ℕ) : allResTower L 0 r = L
proof: := rfl

name: QPCF.allResModulus_succ
statement:
theorem allResModulus_succ (k : ℕ) :
    allResModulus L (k + 1) = allResModulus L k *
      ∏ r ∈ Finset.range (allResModulus L k),
        chosenPeriod (bgauss (allResTower L k r) (allResModulus L k) r)
proof: := rfl

name: QPCF.allResTower_succ
statement:
theorem allResTower_succ (k r : ℕ) :
    allResTower L (k + 1) r =
      bgauss (allResTower L k (r % allResModulus L k)) (allResModulus L k)
        (r % allResModulus L k)
proof: := rfl

name: QPCF.allResModulus_pos
statement: theorem allResModulus_pos (L : ℚ⸨X⸩) (k : ℕ) : 0 < allResModulus L k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simpa using chosenPeriod_pos L
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [allResModulus_succ]
    exact Nat.mul_pos ih (Finset.prod_pos (fun r _ => chosenPeriod_pos _))

name: QPCF.allResModulus_dvd_succ
statement:
theorem allResModulus_dvd_succ (L : ℚ⸨X⸩) (k : ℕ) :
    allResModulus L k ∣ allResModulus L (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [allResModulus_succ]; exact dvd_mul_right _ _

name: QPCF.allResTower_isFloorPeriod
statement:
theorem allResTower_isFloorPeriod (L : ℚ⸨X⸩) (k r : ℕ) :
    IsFloorPeriod (allResTower L k r) (allResModulus L k)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simpa using chosenPeriod_spec L
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [allResTower_succ]
    set s := r % allResModulus L k with hs
    have hslt : s < allResModulus L k := Nat.mod_lt _ (allResModulus_pos L k)
    have hdvd : chosenPeriod (bgauss (allResTower L k s) (allResModulus L k) s)
        ∣ allResModulus L (k + 1) := by
      rw [allResModulus_succ]
      exact (Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem
        (fun r => chosenPeriod (bgauss (allResTower L k r) (allResModulus L k) r))
        (Finset.mem_range.2 hslt)).mul_left (allResModulus L k)
    exact IsFloorPeriod.of_dvd (chosenPeriod_spec _) (allResModulus_pos L (k + 1)) hdvd

name: QPCF.allResThread_coh
statement:
theorem allResThread_coh (L : ℚ⸨X⸩) (v : ℕ) (k : ℕ) :
    allResThread L v (k + 1) ≡ allResThread L v k [MOD allResModulus L k]
proof:
:= by
  show (v % allResModulus L (k + 1)) % allResModulus L k
      = (v % allResModulus L k) % allResModulus L k
  rw [Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd v (allResModulus_dvd_succ L k), Nat.mod_mod]

name: QPCF.btower_eq
statement:
theorem btower_eq (L : ℚ⸨X⸩) (v k : ℕ) :
    btower L (allResModulus L) (allResThread L v) k
      = allResTower L k (v % allResModulus L k)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [btower]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [btower, ih, allResTower_succ]
    have h : (v % allResModulus L (k + 1)) % allResModulus L k = v % allResModulus L k :=
      Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd v (allResModulus_dvd_succ L k)
    rw [h]
    rfl

name: QPCF.allResBranch_Ds
statement:
@[simp] theorem allResBranch_Ds (L : ℚ⸨X⸩) (v : ℕ) :
    (allResBranch L v).Ds = allResModulus L
proof: := rfl

name: QPCF.allResBranch_b
statement:
@[simp] theorem allResBranch_b (L : ℚ⸨X⸩) (v : ℕ) :
    (allResBranch L v).b = allResThread L v
proof: := rfl

name: QPCF.allResBranch_tower
statement:
theorem allResBranch_tower (L : ℚ⸨X⸩) (v m : ℕ) :
    (allResBranch L v).tower m = allResTower L m (v % allResModulus L m)
proof:
:=
  btower_eq L v m

name: QPCF.floorFamily_isQuasiPoly
statement:
theorem floorFamily_isQuasiPoly {D : ℕ} (hD : 0 < D) (P : ZMod D → Polynomial ℚ) :
    IsQuasiPoly (fun n => ⌊(P (n : ZMod D)).eval (n : ℚ)⌋)

name: QPCF.realPQ_floor_isQuasiPoly_of_governs
statement:
theorem realPQ_floor_isQuasiPoly_of_governs
    (hL : ¬ IsRat L) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (hgov : Governs L a) (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ g : ℕ → ℤ, IsQuasiPoly g ∧
      (∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, ⌊realPQ m (a n)⌋ = g n)
proof:
:= by
  set D := allResModulus L m with hDdef
  have hDpos : 0 < D := allResModulus_pos L m
  haveI : NeZero D := ⟨hDpos.ne'⟩
  refine ⟨fun n =>
      ⌊(bfloorPoly (allResTower L m ((n : ZMod D).val)) D ((n : ZMod D).val)).eval (n : ℚ)⌋,
    floorFamily_isQuasiPoly hDpos
      (fun r => bfloorPoly (allResTower L m r.val) D r.val), ?_⟩
  
  have key : ∀ r ∈ Finset.range D, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      n ≡ r [MOD D] →
        realPQ m (a n) = ((bfloorVal (allResTower L m r) D r n : ℚ) : ℝ) := by
    intro r hr
    have hrlt : r < D := Finset.mem_range.1 hr
    have hstab := (allResBranch L r).per_residue_stability hL a hgov m m le_rfl
    rw [allResBranch_Ds, allResBranch_b, allResBranch_tower] at hstab
    simp only [allResThread] at hstab
    rw [← hDdef] at hstab
    rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hrlt] at hstab
    exact hstab
  have hall : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, ∀ r ∈ Finset.range D,
      n ≡ r [MOD D] →
        realPQ m (a n) = ((bfloorVal (allResTower L m r) D r n : ℚ) : ℝ) :=
    (Finset.eventually_all (Finset.range D)).2 key
  filter_upwards [hall, eventually_ge_atTop 1] with n hn hn1
  have hr : n % D ∈ Finset.range D := Finset.mem_range.2 (Nat.mod_lt _ hDpos)
  have hmod : n ≡ n % D [MOD D] := (Nat.mod_modEq n D).symm
  have heq := hn (n % D) hr hmod
  have hval : ((n : ZMod D).val) = n % D := by rw [ZMod.val_natCast]
  rw [heq, Rat.floor_cast, hval, ← bfloorVal_eq_bfloorPoly_eval]

name: QPCF.truncLT_one_eq_zero_of_val
statement:
theorem truncLT_one_eq_zero_of_val (f : ℚ⸨X⸩) (h : Valued.v f ≤ exp (-1 : ℤ)) :
    HahnSeries.truncLT (1 : ℤ) f = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hz : ∀ n : ℤ, n < 1 → f.coeff n = 0 := (valuation_le_iff_coeff_lt_eq_zero ℚ).mp h
  ext i
  simp only [HahnSeries.coeff_truncLT, HahnSeries.coeff_zero]
  split_ifs with hi
  · exact hz i hi
  · rfl

name: QPCF.laurentFloor_continuous
statement: theorem laurentFloor_continuous : Continuous (fieldLaurentFloor (K := ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  
  have hV : {f : ℚ⸨X⸩ | HahnSeries.truncLT (1 : ℤ) f = 0} ∈ 𝓝 (0 : ℚ⸨X⸩) := by
    rw [Valued.mem_nhds_zero]
    refine ⟨Units.mk0 (exp (-1 : ℤ)) WithZero.exp_ne_zero, ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    exact truncLT_one_eq_zero_of_val x (le_of_lt (by simpa using hx))
  have hCA : ContinuousAt (HahnSeries.truncLT (1 : ℤ) : ℚ⸨X⸩ → ℚ⸨X⸩) 0 := by
    have hEq : (HahnSeries.truncLT (1 : ℤ) : ℚ⸨X⸩ → ℚ⸨X⸩) =ᶠ[𝓝 0] (fun _ => 0) := by
      filter_upwards [hV] with f hf using hf
    have : Tendsto (HahnSeries.truncLT (1 : ℤ) : ℚ⸨X⸩ → ℚ⸨X⸩) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0) :=
      tendsto_const_nhds.congr' hEq.symm
    simpa [ContinuousAt] using this
  exact continuous_of_continuousAt_zero
    (HahnSeries.truncLTLinearMap (R := ℚ) (1 : ℤ)).toAddMonoidHom hCA

name: QPCF.contNum_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem contNum_zero (a : ℕ → K) : contNum a 0 = 1
proof: := rfl

name: QPCF.contNum_one
statement: @[simp] theorem contNum_one (a : ℕ → K) : contNum a 1 = a 0
proof: := rfl

name: QPCF.contDen_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem contDen_zero (a : ℕ → K) : contDen a 0 = 0
proof: := rfl

name: QPCF.contDen_one
statement: @[simp] theorem contDen_one (a : ℕ → K) : contDen a 1 = 1
proof: := rfl

name: QPCF.contNum_succ2
statement:
theorem contNum_succ2 (a : ℕ → K) (n : ℕ) :
    contNum a (n + 2) = a (n + 1) * contNum a (n + 1) + contNum a n
proof: := rfl

name: QPCF.contDen_succ2
statement:
theorem contDen_succ2 (a : ℕ → K) (n : ℕ) :
    contDen a (n + 2) = a (n + 1) * contDen a (n + 1) + contDen a n
proof: := rfl

name: QPCF.cont_det
statement:
theorem cont_det (a : ℕ → K) (k : ℕ) :
    contNum a k * contDen a (k + 1) - contNum a (k + 1) * contDen a k = (-1) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [contNum, contDen]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [show n + 1 + 1 = n + 2 from rfl, contNum_succ2, contDen_succ2]
    ring_nf
    ring_nf at ih
    linear_combination -ih

name: QPCF.conv_sub
statement:
theorem conv_sub (a : ℕ → K) (n : ℕ)
    (h1 : contDen a (n + 1) ≠ 0) (h0 : contDen a n ≠ 0) :
    contNum a (n + 1) / contDen a (n + 1) - contNum a n / contDen a n
      = (-1) ^ (n + 1) / (contDen a (n + 1) * contDen a n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [div_sub_div _ _ h1 h0]
  congr 1
  have := cont_det a n
  rw [pow_succ]
  linear_combination -this

name: QPCF.cont_value
statement:
theorem cont_value (a x : ℕ → K) (k : ℕ)
    (hrec : ∀ j ≤ k, x j = a j + (x (j + 1))⁻¹)
    (hx : ∀ j ≤ k + 1, x j ≠ 0) :
    x 0 * (contDen a (k + 1) * x (k + 1) + contDen a k)
      = contNum a (k + 1) * x (k + 1) + contNum a k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    have h0 := hrec 0 (le_refl 0)
    have hx1 : x 1 ≠ 0 := hx 1 (by norm_num)
    simp only [Nat.zero_add, contDen_one, contDen_zero, contNum_one, contNum_zero]
    rw [h0]; field_simp; ring
  | succ n ih =>
    have hxrec : x (n + 1) = a (n + 1) + (x (n + 2))⁻¹ := hrec (n + 1) (le_refl _)
    have hxn2 : x (n + 2) ≠ 0 := hx (n + 2) (by norm_num)
    have ih' := ih (fun j hj => hrec j (by omega)) (fun j hj => hx j (by omega))
    rw [contDen_succ2, contNum_succ2]
    have key : x (n + 1) * x (n + 2) = a (n + 1) * x (n + 2) + 1 := by
      rw [hxrec]; field_simp
    
    
    have goalEq :
        x 0 * ((a (n + 1) * contDen a (n + 1) + contDen a n) * x (n + 2) + contDen a (n + 1))
          = (a (n + 1) * contNum a (n + 1) + contNum a n) * x (n + 2) + contNum a (n + 1) := by
      have lhs :
          x 0 * ((a (n + 1) * contDen a (n + 1) + contDen a n) * x (n + 2) + contDen a (n + 1))
            = x 0 * (contDen a (n + 1) * (a (n + 1) * x (n + 2) + 1) + contDen a n * x (n + 2)) := by
        ring
      have rhs :
          (a (n + 1) * contNum a (n + 1) + contNum a n) * x (n + 2) + contNum a (n + 1)
            = contNum a (n + 1) * (a (n + 1) * x (n + 2) + 1) + contNum a n * x (n + 2) := by
        ring
      rw [lhs, rhs, ← key]
      
      have := ih'
      
      calc
        x 0 * (contDen a (n + 1) * (x (n + 1) * x (n + 2)) + contDen a n * x (n + 2))
            = (x 0 * (contDen a (n + 1) * x (n + 1) + contDen a n)) * x (n + 2) := by ring
        _ = (contNum a (n + 1) * x (n + 1) + contNum a n) * x (n + 2) := by rw [ih']
        _ = contNum a (n + 1) * (x (n + 1) * x (n + 2)) + contNum a n * x (n + 2) := by ring
    exact goalEq

name: QPCF.formal_gaussIter_step
statement:
theorem formal_gaussIter_step (f : ℚ⸨X⸩) (j : ℕ) :
    gaussIter j f
      = formalPartialQuotient j f + (gaussIter (j + 1) f)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hfract : (fieldLaurentGauss ℚ).fract (gaussIter j f)
      = (gaussIter (j + 1) f)⁻¹ := by
    rw [gaussIter_succ', gauss_eq_inv, inv_inv]
  have hsplit : gaussIter j f
      = (fieldLaurentGauss ℚ).floor (gaussIter j f)
        + (fieldLaurentGauss ℚ).fract (gaussIter j f) := by
    simp [GaussStructure.fract]
  rw [hsplit, hfract]
  rfl

name: QPCF.gaussIter_succ_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [gaussIter_succ', gauss_eq_inv]
  simpa using h

name: QPCF.formal_cont_value
statement:
theorem formal_cont_value (f : ℚ⸨X⸩) (k : ℕ)
    (hne : ∀ j ≤ k, (fieldLaurentGauss ℚ).fract (gaussIter j f) ≠ 0) :
    f * (contDen (fun m => formalPartialQuotient m f) (k + 1) * gaussIter (k + 1) f
          + contDen (fun m => formalPartialQuotient m f) k)
      = contNum (fun m => formalPartialQuotient m f) (k + 1) * gaussIter (k + 1) f
          + contNum (fun m => formalPartialQuotient m f) k
proof:
:= by
  have := cont_value (fun m => formalPartialQuotient m f) (fun m => gaussIter m f) k
    (fun j _ => formal_gaussIter_step f j)
    (fun j hj => by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos j with hj0 | hjpos
      · subst hj0
        
        intro hf0
        refine (hne 0 (Nat.zero_le _)) ?_
        rw [show gaussIter 0 f = 0 from hf0]
        simp [GaussStructure.fract, fieldLaurentGauss, fieldLaurentFloor]
      · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hjpos.ne'
        exact gaussIter_succ_ne_zero (hne i (by omega)))
  simpa using this

name: QPCF.GaussStructure.transport_floor
statement:
@[simp] theorem GaussStructure.transport_floor (G : GaussStructure S) (e : R ≃+* S) (x : R) :
    (G.transport e).floor x = e.symm (G.floor (e x))
proof: := rfl

name: QPCF.gaussIter_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem gaussIter_zero (f : ℚ⸨X⸩) : gaussIter 0 f = f
proof: := rfl

name: QPCF.gaussIter_succ
statement:
theorem gaussIter_succ (m : ℕ) (f : ℚ⸨X⸩) :
    gaussIter (m + 1) f = gaussIter m ((fieldLaurentGauss ℚ).gauss f)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [gaussIter, Function.iterate_succ, Function.comp_apply]

name: QPCF.gaussIter_succ'
statement:
theorem gaussIter_succ' (m : ℕ) (f : ℚ⸨X⸩) :
    gaussIter (m + 1) f = (fieldLaurentGauss ℚ).gauss (gaussIter m f)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [gaussIter, Function.iterate_succ', Function.comp_apply]

name: QPCF.isRat_single
statement: theorem isRat_single (k : ℤ) (c : ℚ) : IsRat (single k c)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨RatFunc.X ^ k * (Polynomial.C c : RatFunc ℚ), ?_⟩
  have hcoe : ∀ r : RatFunc ℚ, (r : ℚ⸨X⸩) = algebraMap (RatFunc ℚ) ℚ⸨X⸩ r := fun _ => rfl
  rw [hcoe, map_mul, map_zpow₀]
  rw [show algebraMap (RatFunc ℚ) ℚ⸨X⸩ RatFunc.X = single 1 1 from RatFunc.coe_X]
  rw [show algebraMap (RatFunc ℚ) ℚ⸨X⸩ (Polynomial.C c : RatFunc ℚ) = single 0 c from by
        rw [← hcoe, ← RatFunc.coe_coe, Polynomial.coe_C, HahnSeries.ofPowerSeries_C,
          HahnSeries.C_apply]]
  rw [← RatFunc.single_zpow, single_mul_single]; simp

name: QPCF.isRat_of_support_subset
statement:
theorem isRat_of_support_subset (s : Finset ℤ) :
    ∀ x : ℚ⸨X⸩, x.support ⊆ ↑s → IsRat x
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty =>
    intro x hx
    simp only [Finset.coe_empty, Set.subset_empty_iff] at hx
    have hx0 : x = 0 := by
      ext i
      have : i ∉ x.support := by rw [hx]; exact Set.notMem_empty i
      simpa [HahnSeries.mem_support] using this
    rw [hx0]; exact isRat_zero
  | insert a s _ ih =>
    intro x hx
    set x' := x - single a (x.coeff a) with hx'
    have hsub : x'.support ⊆ ↑s := by
      intro y hy
      rw [HahnSeries.mem_support] at hy
      by_cases hya : y = a
      · exfalso; apply hy; simp [hx', hya]
      · have hyx : y ∈ x.support := by
          rw [HahnSeries.mem_support]
          simp only [hx', HahnSeries.coeff_sub, HahnSeries.coeff_single] at hy
          simpa [hya] using hy
        have hmem := hx hyx
        simp only [Finset.coe_insert, Set.mem_insert_iff] at hmem
        rcases hmem with h | h
        · exact absurd h hya
        · exact h
    have hxeq : x = x' + single a (x.coeff a) := by rw [hx']; ring
    rw [hxeq]
    exact (ih x' hsub).add (isRat_single a (x.coeff a))

name: QPCF.isRat_of_support_finite
statement: theorem isRat_of_support_finite {x : ℚ⸨X⸩} (h : x.support.Finite) : IsRat x
proof:
:= by
  apply isRat_of_support_subset h.toFinset
  intro y hy; simp only [Set.Finite.coe_toFinset]; exact hy

name: QPCF.support_floor_finite
statement:
theorem support_floor_finite (g : ℚ⸨X⸩) :
    ((fieldLaurentGauss ℚ).floor g).support.Finite
proof:
:= by
  show (HahnSeries.truncLT (1 : ℤ) g).support.Finite
  rw [HahnSeries.support_truncLT]
  have hbb : BddBelow g.support := ⟨g.order, fun y hy => order_le_of_coeff_ne_zero hy⟩
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := hbb
  apply Set.Finite.subset (Set.finite_Icc L 0)
  intro y hy
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hy
  simp only [Set.mem_Icc]
  exact ⟨hL hy.1, by omega⟩

name: QPCF.isRat_floor
statement: theorem isRat_floor (g : ℚ⸨X⸩) : IsRat ((fieldLaurentGauss ℚ).floor g)
proof:
:=
  isRat_of_support_finite (support_floor_finite g)

name: QPCF.isRat_of_isRat_gauss
statement:
theorem isRat_of_isRat_gauss {g : ℚ⸨X⸩}
    (h : IsRat ((fieldLaurentGauss ℚ).gauss g)) : IsRat g
proof:
:= by
  have hsplit : g = (fieldLaurentGauss ℚ).floor g + (fieldLaurentGauss ℚ).fract g := by
    simp [GaussStructure.fract]
  have hfr : (fieldLaurentGauss ℚ).fract g = ((fieldLaurentGauss ℚ).gauss g)⁻¹ := by
    rw [gauss_eq_inv, inv_inv]
  rw [hsplit, hfr]
  exact (isRat_floor g).add h.inv

name: QPCF.fract_gaussIter_zero_isRat
statement:
theorem fract_gaussIter_zero_isRat :
    ∀ (m : ℕ) (f : ℚ⸨X⸩), (fieldLaurentGauss ℚ).fract (gaussIter m f) = 0 → IsRat f
proof:
:= by
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    intro f hm
    rw [gaussIter_zero] at hm
    have hf : f = (fieldLaurentGauss ℚ).floor f := by
      rw [GaussStructure.fract, sub_eq_zero] at hm; exact hm
    rw [hf]; exact isRat_floor f
  | succ n ih =>
    intro f hm
    rw [gaussIter_succ] at hm
    exact isRat_of_isRat_gauss (ih _ hm)

name: QPCF.terminates_isRat
statement: theorem terminates_isRat {f : ℚ⸨X⸩} (h : Terminates f) : IsRat f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := h
  exact fract_gaussIter_zero_isRat m f hm

name: QPCF.order_floor_eq_of_order_nonpos
statement:
theorem order_floor_eq_of_order_nonpos {g : ℚ⸨X⸩} (hg : g ≠ 0) (h : g.order ≤ 0) :
    ((fieldLaurentGauss ℚ).floor g).order = g.order
proof:
:= by
  have hcoeff_order : ((fieldLaurentGauss ℚ).floor g).coeff g.order = g.coeff g.order := by
    simp only [fieldLaurentGauss, fieldLaurentFloor, HahnSeries.coeff_truncLT]
    rw [if_pos (by omega)]
  have hne : g.coeff g.order ≠ 0 := fun hz => hg (coeff_order_eq_zero.mp hz)
  have hfloor_ne : (fieldLaurentGauss ℚ).floor g ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero; rw [hzero] at hcoeff_order; simp at hcoeff_order; exact hne hcoeff_order.symm
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact order_le_of_coeff_ne_zero (hcoeff_order ▸ hne)
  · rw [HahnSeries.le_order_iff_forall hfloor_ne]
    intro j hj
    simp only [fieldLaurentGauss, fieldLaurentFloor, HahnSeries.coeff_truncLT]
    have hzero : g.coeff j = 0 := coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_order (by omega)
    split_ifs <;> simp [hzero]

name: QPCF.formalPartialQuotient_order_le_neg_one
proof:
:= by
  have hord : (gaussIter (m + 1) f).order ≤ -1 := by
    rw [gaussIter_succ']; exact order_gauss_le_neg_one h
  have hne : gaussIter (m + 1) f ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz; rw [hz, HahnSeries.order_zero] at hord; omega
  unfold formalPartialQuotient
  rw [order_floor_eq_of_order_nonpos hne (by omega)]
  exact hord

name: QPCF.collective_unboundedness_ratPow
statement:
theorem collective_unboundedness_ratPow (α : ℚ) (hα : α.den ≠ 1) (K : ℕ)
    (hstab : ∀ J : ℕ, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
        realPQ J (ratPowSeq α n)
          = pval (afloorG (agaussG^[J] (oneAddPow α))) (K : ℤ) n)
    (S : Set ℕ) (hS : S.Infinite) :
    {J : ℕ | ∀ M : ℝ, ∃ n ∈ S, M < |realPQ J (ratPowSeq α n)|}.Infinite
proof:
:=
  theorem_7_1 (oneAddPow α) (oneAddPow_not_isRat hα) (ratPowSeq α) K hstab S hS

name: QPCF.ratPow_irrational_and_governed
statement:
theorem ratPow_irrational_and_governed (α : ℚ) (hα : α.den ≠ 1) :
    ¬ IsRat (oneAddPow α) ∧ Governs (oneAddPow α) (ratPowSeq α)
proof:
:=
  ⟨oneAddPow_not_isRat hα, oneAddPow_governs α⟩

name: QPCF.fract_zero
statement: theorem fract_zero : (fieldLaurentGauss ℚ).fract (0 : ℚ⸨X⸩) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [GaussStructure.fract, fieldLaurentGauss, fieldLaurentFloor]

name: QPCF.terminates_of_fract_zero
statement:
theorem terminates_of_fract_zero {f : ℚ⸨X⸩} (h : (fieldLaurentGauss ℚ).fract f = 0) :
    Terminates f
proof: := ⟨0, by simpa using h⟩

name: QPCF.terminates_gauss_iff
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨m, hm⟩
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with rfl | hpos
    · exact absurd (by simpa using hm) h
    · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hpos.ne'
      refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
      rwa [gaussIter_succ] at hm
  · rintro ⟨m, hm⟩
    exact ⟨m + 1, by rwa [gaussIter_succ]⟩

name: QPCF.floor_eq_zero_of_order_ge_one
statement:
theorem floor_eq_zero_of_order_ge_one {h : ℚ⸨X⸩} (hord : 1 ≤ h.order) :
    (fieldLaurentGauss ℚ).floor h = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp only [fieldLaurentGauss, fieldLaurentFloor, HahnSeries.coeff_truncLT,
    HahnSeries.coeff_zero]
  split_ifs with hi
  · exact HahnSeries.coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_order (by omega)
  · rfl

name: QPCF.fract_eq_self_of_order_ge_one
statement:
theorem fract_eq_self_of_order_ge_one {h : ℚ⸨X⸩} (hord : 1 ≤ h.order) :
    (fieldLaurentGauss ℚ).fract h = h
proof:
:= by
  rw [GaussStructure.fract, floor_eq_zero_of_order_ge_one hord, sub_zero]

name: QPCF.terminates_inv_iff
statement:
theorem terminates_inv_iff {h : ℚ⸨X⸩} (hord : 1 ≤ h.order) (hh : h ≠ 0) :
    Terminates h ↔ Terminates h⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hfr : (fieldLaurentGauss ℚ).fract h ≠ 0 := by
    rw [fract_eq_self_of_order_ge_one hord]; exact hh
  rw [terminates_gauss_iff hfr, gauss_eq_inv, fract_eq_self_of_order_ge_one hord]

name: QPCF.properTerminates
statement:
theorem properTerminates (hstep : DegreeDecreaseStep) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (r : RatFunc ℚ), 1 ≤ (r : ℚ⸨X⸩).order → ratHeightR r ≤ n →
      Terminates (r : ℚ⸨X⸩)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro r hord hle
    by_cases hh : (r : ℚ⸨X⸩) = 0
    · rw [hh]; exact terminates_of_fract_zero fract_zero
    · exfalso
      obtain ⟨r', _, hr'lt⟩ := hstep r hord hh
      omega
  | succ n ih =>
    intro r hord hle
    by_cases hh : (r : ℚ⸨X⸩) = 0
    · rw [hh]; exact terminates_of_fract_zero fract_zero
    · rw [terminates_inv_iff hord hh]
      by_cases hphi : (fieldLaurentGauss ℚ).fract (r : ℚ⸨X⸩)⁻¹ = 0
      · exact terminates_of_fract_zero hphi
      · obtain ⟨r', hr'eq, hr'lt⟩ := hstep r hord hh
        have hΦ_ord : 1 ≤ ((fieldLaurentGauss ℚ).fract (r : ℚ⸨X⸩)⁻¹).order :=
          order_fract_ge_one hphi
        
        rw [terminates_gauss_iff hphi, gauss_eq_inv, ← hr'eq,
          ← terminates_inv_iff (hr'eq ▸ hΦ_ord) (by rw [hr'eq]; exact hphi)]
        exact ih r' (hr'eq ▸ hΦ_ord) (by omega)

name: QPCF.isRat_terminates
statement:
theorem isRat_terminates (hstep : DegreeDecreaseStep) {f : ℚ⸨X⸩} (hr : IsRat f) :
    Terminates f
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hfr : (fieldLaurentGauss ℚ).fract f = 0
  · exact terminates_of_fract_zero hfr
  · have hfract_rat : IsRat ((fieldLaurentGauss ℚ).fract f) := by
      rw [GaussStructure.fract, sub_eq_add_neg]; exact hr.add (isRat_floor f).neg
    obtain ⟨r0, hr0⟩ := hfract_rat
    have hord : 1 ≤ ((fieldLaurentGauss ℚ).fract f).order := order_fract_ge_one hfr
    have hp : Terminates ((fieldLaurentGauss ℚ).fract f) := by
      rw [← hr0]
      exact properTerminates hstep _ r0 (hr0 ▸ hord) (le_refl _)
    rw [terminates_gauss_iff hfr, gauss_eq_inv, ← terminates_inv_iff hord hfr]
    exact hp

name: QPCF.terminates_iff_isRat
statement:
theorem terminates_iff_isRat (hstep : DegreeDecreaseStep) {f : ℚ⸨X⸩} :
    Terminates f ↔ IsRat f
proof:
:=
  ⟨terminates_isRat, isRat_terminates hstep⟩

name: QPCF.not_terminates_of_not_isRat
statement: theorem not_terminates_of_not_isRat {f : ℚ⸨X⸩} (hf : ¬ IsRat f) : ¬ Terminates f
proof:
:=
  fun h => hf (terminates_isRat h)

name: QPCF.gaussIter_split
statement:
theorem gaussIter_split (L : ℚ⸨X⸩) (m : ℕ) :
    gaussIter m L = fFloor L m + fFract L m
proof:
:= by
  simp [fFloor, fFract, GaussStructure.fract]

name: QPCF.pval_gaussIter_split
statement:
theorem pval_gaussIter_split (L : ℚ⸨X⸩) (m : ℕ) (K : ℤ) (n : ℕ) :
    pval (gaussIter m L) K n = pval (fFloor L m) K n + pval (fFract L m) K n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pval_add, ← gaussIter_split]

name: QPCF.fFract_inv_eq
statement:
theorem fFract_inv_eq (L : ℚ⸨X⸩) (m : ℕ) :
    gaussIter (m + 1) L = (fFract L m)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [gaussIter_succ', fFract, GaussStructure.gauss, Ring.inverse_eq_inv']

name: QPCF.pval_one
statement:
theorem pval_one (N : ℤ) (hN : 0 ≤ N) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    pval (1 : ℚ⸨X⸩) N n = 1

name: QPCF.pval_inv_mul_sub
statement:
theorem pval_inv_mul_sub (h : ℚ⸨X⸩) (hh : h ≠ 0) (K s : ℕ) (hs1 : 1 ≤ s) (hsK : s ≤ K)
    (hord : h.order = (s : ℤ)) :
    BigOpow (fun n => pval (h⁻¹) (K : ℤ) n * pval h (K : ℤ) n - 1) (-((K : ℤ) - s + 1))

name: QPCF.pval_inv_approx
statement:
theorem pval_inv_approx (h : ℚ⸨X⸩) (hh : h ≠ 0) (K s M' : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hs1 : 1 ≤ s) (hsK : s ≤ K) (hbud : M' + s ≤ K + 1) (hord : h.order = (s : ℤ))
    (hlow : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, c / (n : ℝ) ^ M' ≤ pval h (K : ℤ) n) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      |pval (h⁻¹) (K : ℤ) n - (pval h (K : ℤ) n)⁻¹| ≤ C / (n : ℝ) ^ (K - s + 1 - M')

name: QPCF.int_fract_pval_gaussIter
statement:
theorem int_fract_pval_gaussIter (L : ℚ⸨X⸩) (m : ℕ) (K : ℤ) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (M' : ℕ)
    (hint : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, ∃ z : ℤ, pval (fFloor L m) K n = (z : ℝ))
    (hnondeg : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      c / (n : ℝ) ^ M' ≤ pval (fFract L m) K n ∧
        pval (fFract L m) K n ≤ 1 - c / (n : ℝ) ^ M') :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, Int.fract (pval (gaussIter m L) K n) = pval (fFract L m) K n

name: QPCF.pval_dist_int
statement:
theorem pval_dist_int (L : ℚ⸨X⸩) (m : ℕ) (K : ℤ) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (M' : ℕ)
    (hint : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, ∃ z : ℤ, pval (fFloor L m) K n = (z : ℝ))
    (hnondeg : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      c / (n : ℝ) ^ M' ≤ pval (fFract L m) K n ∧
        pval (fFract L m) K n ≤ 1 - c / (n : ℝ) ^ M') :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      c / (n : ℝ) ^ M' ≤ Int.fract (pval (gaussIter m L) K n) ∧
        Int.fract (pval (gaussIter m L) K n) ≤ 1 - c / (n : ℝ) ^ M'
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [int_fract_pval_gaussIter L m K c hc M' hint hnondeg, hnondeg] with n h1 h2
  rw [h1]; exact h2

name: QPCF.real_tracks_formal
statement:
theorem real_tracks_formal (L : ℚ⸨X⸩) (r : ℕ → ℝ) (D K : ℕ) (M s q : ℕ → ℕ) (c C0 : ℝ)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hC0 : 0 ≤ C0)
    (hbase : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, |r n - pval L (K : ℤ) n| ≤ C0 / (n : ℝ) ^ q 0)
    (hne : ∀ m < D, fFract L m ≠ 0)
    (hs : ∀ m < D, (fFract L m).order = (s m : ℤ))
    (hsK : ∀ m < D, s m ≤ K)
    (hs1 : ∀ m < D, 1 ≤ s m)
    (hq : ∀ m ≤ D, 2 * M m < q m)
    (hqstep : ∀ m < D, q (m + 1) + 2 * M m ≤ q m)
    (hqK : ∀ m < D, q (m + 1) + s m + M m ≤ K + 1)
    (hint : ∀ m ≤ D, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      ∃ z : ℤ, pval (fFloor L m) (K : ℤ) n = (z : ℝ))
    (hnondeg : ∀ m < D, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      c / (n : ℝ) ^ M m ≤ pval (fFract L m) (K : ℤ) n ∧
        pval (fFract L m) (K : ℤ) n ≤ 1 - c / (n : ℝ) ^ M m) :
    ∀ m ≤ D, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      |realGaussIter m (r n) - pval (gaussIter m L) (K : ℤ) n| ≤
        C / (n : ℝ) ^ q m

name: QPCF.full_stability_i_floor
statement:
theorem full_stability_i_floor (a : ℕ → ℝ) (L : ℚ⸨X⸩) (hgov : Governs L a)
    (D K : ℕ) (M s q : ℕ → ℕ) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hq0 : q 0 ≤ K + 1)
    (hne : ∀ m < D, fFract L m ≠ 0)
    (hs : ∀ m < D, (fFract L m).order = (s m : ℤ))
    (hsK : ∀ m < D, s m ≤ K)
    (hs1 : ∀ m < D, 1 ≤ s m)
    (hq : ∀ m ≤ D, 2 * M m < q m)
    (hqstep : ∀ m < D, q (m + 1) + 2 * M m ≤ q m)
    (hqK : ∀ m < D, q (m + 1) + s m + M m ≤ K + 1)
    (hint : ∀ m ≤ D, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      ∃ z : ℤ, pval (fFloor L m) (K : ℤ) n = (z : ℝ))
    (hnondeg : ∀ m ≤ D, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      c / (n : ℝ) ^ M m ≤ pval (fFract L m) (K : ℤ) n ∧
        pval (fFract L m) (K : ℤ) n ≤ 1 - c / (n : ℝ) ^ M m) :
    ∀ m ≤ D, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      realPQ m (a n) = (⌊pval (gaussIter m L) (K : ℤ) n⌋ : ℝ)

name: QPCF.full_stability_i
statement:
theorem full_stability_i (a : ℕ → ℝ) (L : ℚ⸨X⸩) (hgov : Governs L a)
    (D K : ℕ) (M s q : ℕ → ℕ) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hq0 : q 0 ≤ K + 1)
    (hne : ∀ m < D, fFract L m ≠ 0)
    (hs : ∀ m < D, (fFract L m).order = (s m : ℤ))
    (hsK : ∀ m < D, s m ≤ K)
    (hs1 : ∀ m < D, 1 ≤ s m)
    (hq : ∀ m ≤ D, 2 * M m < q m)
    (hqstep : ∀ m < D, q (m + 1) + 2 * M m ≤ q m)
    (hqK : ∀ m < D, q (m + 1) + s m + M m ≤ K + 1)
    (hint : ∀ m ≤ D, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      ∃ z : ℤ, pval (fFloor L m) (K : ℤ) n = (z : ℝ))
    (hnondeg : ∀ m ≤ D, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      c / (n : ℝ) ^ M m ≤ pval (fFract L m) (K : ℤ) n ∧
        pval (fFract L m) (K : ℤ) n ≤ 1 - c / (n : ℝ) ^ M m) :
    ∀ m ≤ D, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      realPQ m (a n) = pval (formalPartialQuotient m L) (K : ℤ) n

name: QPCF.pvalQ_cast
statement:
theorem pvalQ_cast (f : ℚ⸨X⸩) (N : ℤ) (n : ℕ) :
    ((pvalQ f N n : ℚ) : ℝ) = pval f N n

name: QPCF.exists_poly_pvalQ_zero
statement:
theorem exists_poly_pvalQ_zero (F : ℚ⸨X⸩) :
    ∃ P : Polynomial ℚ, ∀ n : ℕ, pvalQ F 0 n = P.eval (n : ℚ)

name: QPCF.isFloorPeriod_exists
statement: theorem isFloorPeriod_exists (F : ℚ⸨X⸩) : ∃ D : ℕ, IsFloorPeriod F D
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := exists_poly_pvalQ_zero F
  obtain ⟨D, hD_pos, hD⟩ := fract_poly_periodic P
  exact ⟨D, hD_pos, fun m n _ _ hmn => by rw [hP m, hP n]; exact hD m n hmn⟩

name: QPCF.IsFloorPeriod.of_dvd
statement:
theorem IsFloorPeriod.of_dvd {F : ℚ⸨X⸩} {D D' : ℕ} (h : IsFloorPeriod F D)
    (hD' : 0 < D') (hdvd : D ∣ D') : IsFloorPeriod F D'
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨ hD', fun m n hm hn hmn => h.2 m n hm hn <| hmn.of_dvd hdvd ⟩

name: QPCF.bfloorVal_intVal
statement:
theorem bfloorVal_intVal {F : ℚ⸨X⸩} {D : ℕ} (hper : IsFloorPeriod F D) (r : ℕ)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hclass : n ≡ r [MOD D]) :
    ∃ z : ℤ, bfloorVal F D r n = (z : ℚ)

name: QPCF.bfract_eq_sub
statement: theorem bfract_eq_sub (F : ℚ⸨X⸩) (D r : ℕ) : bfract F D r = F - boffset F D r
proof:
:= by
  unfold bfract boffset; ring

name: QPCF.isRat_boffset
statement: theorem isRat_boffset (F : ℚ⸨X⸩) (D r : ℕ) : IsRat (boffset F D r)

name: QPCF.bfract_ne_zero
statement:
theorem bfract_ne_zero {F : ℚ⸨X⸩} (hF : ¬ IsRat F) (D r : ℕ) :
    bfract F D r ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h_zero
  have h_eq : F = boffset F D r := by
    exact eq_of_sub_eq_zero ( bfract_eq_sub F D r ▸ h_zero );
  exact hF <| h_eq ▸ isRat_boffset F D r

name: QPCF.bfract_order_nonneg
statement: theorem bfract_order_nonneg (F : ℚ⸨X⸩) (D r : ℕ) : 0 ≤ (bfract F D r).order

name: QPCF.bfract_tail_ne_zero
statement:
theorem bfract_tail_ne_zero {F : ℚ⸨X⸩} (hF : ¬ IsRat F) :
    F - HahnSeries.truncLT (1 : ℤ) F ≠ 0

name: QPCF.bfract_coeff_zero
statement:
theorem bfract_coeff_zero (F : ℚ⸨X⸩) (D r : ℕ) :
    (bfract F D r).coeff 0 = bconst F D r + (if bcorr F D r then 1 else 0)

name: QPCF.bfract_leadingCoeff_pos
statement:
theorem bfract_leadingCoeff_pos {F : ℚ⸨X⸩} (hF : ¬ IsRat F) (D r : ℕ) :
    0 < (bfract F D r).leadingCoeff

name: QPCF.oneSub_bfract_order_nonneg
statement:
theorem oneSub_bfract_order_nonneg (F : ℚ⸨X⸩) (D r : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ ((1 : ℚ⸨X⸩) - bfract F D r).order

name: QPCF.oneSub_bfract_leadingCoeff_pos
statement:
theorem oneSub_bfract_leadingCoeff_pos {F : ℚ⸨X⸩} (hF : ¬ IsRat F) (D r : ℕ) :
    0 < ((1 : ℚ⸨X⸩) - bfract F D r).leadingCoeff

name: QPCF.oneSub_bfract_ne_zero
statement:
theorem oneSub_bfract_ne_zero {F : ℚ⸨X⸩} (hF : ¬ IsRat F) (D r : ℕ) :
    (1 : ℚ⸨X⸩) - bfract F D r ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have := oneSub_bfract_leadingCoeff_pos hF D r
  rw [h] at this; simp at this

name: QPCF.bfract_pval_nondeg
statement:
theorem bfract_pval_nondeg {F : ℚ⸨X⸩} (hF : ¬ IsRat F) (D r : ℕ) (K : ℤ)
    (hK1 : (bfract F D r).order ≤ K) (hK2 : ((1 : ℚ⸨X⸩) - bfract F D r).order ≤ K) :
    ∃ (c : ℝ) (M : ℕ), 0 < c ∧ ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      c / (n : ℝ) ^ M ≤ pval (bfract F D r) K n ∧
        pval (bfract F D r) K n ≤ 1 - c / (n : ℝ) ^ M

name: QPCF.bfract_pval_nondeg_unif
statement:
theorem bfract_pval_nondeg_unif {F : ℚ⸨X⸩} (hF : ¬ IsRat F) (D r : ℕ) :
    ∃ (c : ℝ) (M : ℕ), 0 < c ∧ ∀ K : ℤ, (bfract F D r).order ≤ K →
      ((1 : ℚ⸨X⸩) - bfract F D r).order ≤ K → ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
        c / (n : ℝ) ^ M ≤ pval (bfract F D r) K n ∧
          pval (bfract F D r) K n ≤ 1 - c / (n : ℝ) ^ M

name: QPCF.bgauss_not_isRat
statement:
theorem bgauss_not_isRat {F : ℚ⸨X⸩} (hF : ¬ IsRat F) (D r : ℕ) :
    ¬ IsRat (bgauss F D r)

name: QPCF.pvalQ_zero_of_order_nonneg
statement:
theorem pvalQ_zero_of_order_nonneg (F : ℚ⸨X⸩) (h : 0 ≤ F.order) (n : ℕ) :
    pvalQ F 0 n = F.coeff 0

name: QPCF.bfract_eq_ofractG_of_order_nonneg
statement:
theorem bfract_eq_ofractG_of_order_nonneg {F : ℚ⸨X⸩} (h : 0 ≤ F.order) (D r : ℕ) :
    bfract F D r = ofractG F

name: QPCF.bgauss_eq_ogaussG_of_order_nonneg
statement:
theorem bgauss_eq_ogaussG_of_order_nonneg {F : ℚ⸨X⸩} (h : 0 ≤ F.order) (D r : ℕ) :
    bgauss F D r = ogaussG F
proof:
:= by
  rw [bgauss, ogaussG, bfract_eq_ofractG_of_order_nonneg h]

name: QPCF.pval_inv_mul_sub_gen
statement:
theorem pval_inv_mul_sub_gen (h : ℚ⸨X⸩) (hh : h ≠ 0) (K s : ℕ) (hsK : s ≤ K)
    (hord : h.order = (s : ℤ)) :
    BigOpow (fun n => pval (h⁻¹) (K : ℤ) n * pval h (K : ℤ) n - 1) (-((K : ℤ) - s + 1))

name: QPCF.pval_inv_approx_gen
statement:
theorem pval_inv_approx_gen (h : ℚ⸨X⸩) (hh : h ≠ 0) (K s M' : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hsK : s ≤ K) (hbud : M' + s ≤ K + 1) (hord : h.order = (s : ℤ))
    (hlow : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, c / (n : ℝ) ^ M' ≤ pval h (K : ℤ) n) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      |pval (h⁻¹) (K : ℤ) n - (pval h (K : ℤ) n)⁻¹| ≤ C / (n : ℝ) ^ (K - s + 1 - M')

name: QPCF.pval_tendsto_atTop
statement:
theorem pval_tendsto_atTop (g : ℚ⸨X⸩) (K : ℤ) (hne : g ≠ 0) (hord : g.order < 0)
    (hK : g.order ≤ K) (hlead : 0 < g.leadingCoeff) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => pval g K n) atTop atTop

name: QPCF.floor_stability_on
statement:
theorem floor_stability_on (l : Filter ℕ) (hl : l ≤ atTop) (x y : ℕ → ℝ) (N M : ℕ)
    (c C : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hMN : M < N)
    (hclose : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in l, |x n - y n| ≤ C / (n : ℝ) ^ N)
    (hdist : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in l,
      c / (n : ℝ) ^ M ≤ Int.fract (y n) ∧ Int.fract (y n) ≤ 1 - c / (n : ℝ) ^ M) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in l, ⌊x n⌋ = ⌊y n⌋

name: QPCF.inversion_stability_on
statement:
theorem inversion_stability_on (l : Filter ℕ) (hl : l ≤ atTop) (x A : ℕ → ℝ)
    (a b : ℕ) (c C : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hne : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in l, A n ≠ 0)
    (hclose : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in l, |x n - A n| ≤ C / (n : ℝ) ^ a)
    (hlow : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in l, c / (n : ℝ) ^ b ≤ |A n|)
    (hab : 2 * b < a) :
    ∃ C' : ℝ, 0 ≤ C' ∧
      ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in l, |1 / x n - 1 / A n| ≤ C' * (n : ℝ) ^ (2 * b - a : ℤ)

name: QPCF.bridge_step_on
statement:
theorem bridge_step_on (l : Filter ℕ) (hl : l ≤ atTop) (r A : ℕ → ℝ) (N M : ℕ)
    (c C : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (h2 : 2 * M < N)
    (hclose : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in l, |r n - A n| ≤ C / (n : ℝ) ^ N)
    (hnondeg : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in l,
      c / (n : ℝ) ^ M ≤ Int.fract (A n) ∧ Int.fract (A n) ≤ 1 - c / (n : ℝ) ^ M) :
    (∀ᶠ n : ℕ in l, ⌊r n⌋ = ⌊A n⌋) ∧
      ∃ C' : ℝ, 0 ≤ C' ∧ ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in l,
        |(Int.fract (r n))⁻¹ - (Int.fract (A n))⁻¹| ≤ C' / (n : ℝ) ^ (N - 2 * M)

name: QPCF.formal_stability_i_err_on
statement:
theorem formal_stability_i_err_on (l : Filter ℕ) (hl : l ≤ atTop) (a A0 : ℕ → ℝ)
    (D : ℕ) (M Nsched : ℕ → ℕ) (c C : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hbud : ∀ m ≤ D, 2 * M m < Nsched m)
    (hsched : ∀ m, m < D → Nsched (m + 1) + 2 * M m ≤ Nsched m)
    (hclose0 : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in l, |a n - A0 n| ≤ C / (n : ℝ) ^ Nsched 0)
    (hnondeg : ∀ m ≤ D, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in l,
      c / (n : ℝ) ^ M m ≤ Int.fract (realGaussIter m (A0 n)) ∧
        Int.fract (realGaussIter m (A0 n)) ≤ 1 - c / (n : ℝ) ^ M m) :
    ∀ m ≤ D, ∃ C' : ℝ, 0 ≤ C' ∧ ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in l,
      |realGaussIter m (a n) - realGaussIter m (A0 n)| ≤ C' / (n : ℝ) ^ Nsched m

name: QPCF.formal_stability_i_on
statement:
theorem formal_stability_i_on (l : Filter ℕ) (hl : l ≤ atTop) (a A0 : ℕ → ℝ)
    (D : ℕ) (M Nsched : ℕ → ℕ) (c C : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hbud : ∀ m ≤ D, 2 * M m < Nsched m)
    (hsched : ∀ m, m < D → Nsched (m + 1) + 2 * M m ≤ Nsched m)
    (hclose0 : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in l, |a n - A0 n| ≤ C / (n : ℝ) ^ Nsched 0)
    (hnondeg : ∀ m ≤ D, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in l,
      c / (n : ℝ) ^ M m ≤ Int.fract (realGaussIter m (A0 n)) ∧
        Int.fract (realGaussIter m (A0 n)) ≤ 1 - c / (n : ℝ) ^ M m) :
    ∀ m ≤ D, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in l, realPQ m (a n) = (⌊realGaussIter m (A0 n)⌋ : ℝ)

name: QPCF.BranchDatum.tower_not_isRat
statement: theorem tower_not_isRat (hL : ¬ IsRat L) (m : ℕ) : ¬ IsRat (β.tower m)

name: QPCF.BranchDatum.tower_succ_bfr
statement: theorem tower_succ_bfr (m : ℕ) : β.tower (m + 1) = (β.bfr m)⁻¹
proof: := rfl

name: QPCF.BranchDatum.tower_eq_bfl_add_bfr
statement: theorem tower_eq_bfl_add_bfr (m : ℕ) : β.tower m = β.bfl m + β.bfr m
proof:
:= by
  rw [bfl, bfr, bfract_eq_sub]; ring

name: QPCF.BranchDatum.pval_tower_split
statement:
theorem pval_tower_split (m : ℕ) (K : ℤ) (n : ℕ) :
    pval (β.tower m) K n = pval (β.bfl m) K n + pval (β.bfr m) K n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pval_add, ← tower_eq_bfl_add_bfr]

name: QPCF.BranchDatum.Ds_dvd_of_le
statement: theorem Ds_dvd_of_le {m J : ℕ} (hm : m ≤ J) : β.Ds m ∣ β.Ds J

name: QPCF.BranchDatum.class_subset
statement:
theorem class_subset {m J : ℕ} (hm : m ≤ J) {n : ℕ} (h : n ≡ β.b J [MOD β.Ds J]) :
    n ≡ β.b m [MOD β.Ds m]

name: QPCF.BranchDatum.pval_bfl_eq_bfloorVal
statement:
theorem pval_bfl_eq_bfloorVal (m : ℕ) (K : ℤ) (hK : 0 ≤ K) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, pval (β.bfl m) K n = (bfloorVal (β.tower m) (β.Ds m) (β.b m) n : ℝ)

name: QPCF.BranchDatum.bfl_pval_int_on_class
statement:
theorem bfl_pval_int_on_class {m J : ℕ} (hm : m ≤ J) (K : ℤ) (hK : 0 ≤ K) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ≡ β.b J [MOD β.Ds J] →
      ∃ z : ℤ, pval (β.bfl m) K n = (z : ℝ)

name: QPCF.BranchDatum.branch_int_fract
statement:
theorem branch_int_fract (l : Filter ℕ) (hl : l ≤ atTop) (m : ℕ) (K : ℤ) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (M' : ℕ)
    (hint : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in l, ∃ z : ℤ, pval (β.bfl m) K n = (z : ℝ))
    (hnondeg : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in l,
      c / (n : ℝ) ^ M' ≤ pval (β.bfr m) K n ∧ pval (β.bfr m) K n ≤ 1 - c / (n : ℝ) ^ M') :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in l, Int.fract (pval (β.tower m) K n) = pval (β.bfr m) K n

name: QPCF.BranchDatum.branch_dist_int
statement:
theorem branch_dist_int (l : Filter ℕ) (hl : l ≤ atTop) (m : ℕ) (K : ℤ) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (M' : ℕ)
    (hint : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in l, ∃ z : ℤ, pval (β.bfl m) K n = (z : ℝ))
    (hnondeg : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in l,
      c / (n : ℝ) ^ M' ≤ pval (β.bfr m) K n ∧ pval (β.bfr m) K n ≤ 1 - c / (n : ℝ) ^ M') :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in l,
      c / (n : ℝ) ^ M' ≤ Int.fract (pval (β.tower m) K n) ∧
        Int.fract (pval (β.tower m) K n) ≤ 1 - c / (n : ℝ) ^ M'
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [ branch_int_fract β l hl m K c hc M' ‹_› ‹_›, hnondeg ] with n hn hn' ; aesop

name: QPCF.BranchDatum.branch_track_err
statement:
theorem branch_track_err (l : Filter ℕ) (hl : l ≤ atTop)
    (K : ℕ) (D : ℕ) (M s q : ℕ → ℕ) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hne : ∀ m < D, β.bfr m ≠ 0)
    (hs : ∀ m < D, (β.bfr m).order = (s m : ℤ))
    (hsK : ∀ m < D, s m ≤ K)
    (hq : ∀ m ≤ D, 2 * M m < q m)
    (hqstep : ∀ m < D, q (m + 1) + 2 * M m ≤ q m)
    (hqK : ∀ m < D, q (m + 1) + s m + M m ≤ K + 1)
    (hint : ∀ m ≤ D, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in l, ∃ z : ℤ, pval (β.bfl m) (K : ℤ) n = (z : ℝ))
    (hnondeg : ∀ m ≤ D, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      c / (n : ℝ) ^ M m ≤ pval (β.bfr m) (K : ℤ) n ∧
        pval (β.bfr m) (K : ℤ) n ≤ 1 - c / (n : ℝ) ^ M m) :
    ∀ m ≤ D, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in l,
      |realGaussIter m (pval L (K : ℤ) n) - pval (β.tower m) (K : ℤ) n| ≤ C / (n : ℝ) ^ q m

name: QPCF.BranchDatum.branch_nondeg_unif_m
statement:
theorem branch_nondeg_unif_m (hL : ¬ IsRat L) (J : ℕ) :
    ∃ (c : ℝ) (M s : ℕ → ℕ) (K₀ : ℕ), 0 < c ∧ (∀ m ≤ J, β.bfr m ≠ 0) ∧
      (∀ m ≤ J, (β.bfr m).order = (s m : ℤ)) ∧ (∀ m ≤ J, s m ≤ K₀) ∧
      (∀ m ≤ J, ((1 : ℚ⸨X⸩) - β.bfr m).order ≤ (K₀ : ℤ)) ∧
      ∀ K : ℤ, (K₀ : ℤ) ≤ K → ∀ m ≤ J, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
        c / (n : ℝ) ^ M m ≤ pval (β.bfr m) K n ∧ pval (β.bfr m) K n ≤ 1 - c / (n : ℝ) ^ M m

name: QPCF.BranchDatum.branch_track_class
statement:
theorem branch_track_class (hL : ¬ IsRat L) (J : ℕ) :
    ∃ (M : ℕ → ℕ) (c : ℝ) (K₀ : ℕ), 0 < c ∧
      (∀ K : ℕ, K₀ ≤ K → ∀ m ≤ J, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ≡ β.b J [MOD β.Ds J] →
        c / (n : ℝ) ^ M m ≤ pval (β.bfr m) (K : ℤ) n ∧
          pval (β.bfr m) (K : ℤ) n ≤ 1 - c / (n : ℝ) ^ M m) ∧
      (∀ K : ℕ, K₀ ≤ K → ∀ m ≤ J, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ≡ β.b J [MOD β.Ds J] →
        ∃ z : ℤ, pval (β.bfl m) (K : ℤ) n = (z : ℝ)) ∧
      ∀ K : ℕ, K₀ ≤ K → ∀ m ≤ J, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
        n ≡ β.b J [MOD β.Ds J] →
          |realGaussIter m (pval L (K : ℤ) n) - pval (β.tower m) (K : ℤ) n|
            ≤ C / (n : ℝ) ^ (M m + 1)

name: QPCF.BranchDatum.branch_stab_all
statement:
theorem branch_stab_all (hL : ¬ IsRat L) (J : ℕ) :
    ∃ (M : ℕ → ℕ) (c : ℝ) (K₀ : ℕ), 0 < c ∧ ∀ K : ℕ, K₀ ≤ K → ∀ m ≤ J,
      ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ≡ β.b J [MOD β.Ds J] →
        (⌊realGaussIter m (pval L (K : ℤ) n)⌋ : ℝ)
            = ((bfloorVal (β.tower m) (β.Ds m) (β.b m) n : ℚ) : ℝ) ∧
          c / (n : ℝ) ^ M m ≤ Int.fract (realGaussIter m (pval L (K : ℤ) n)) ∧
            Int.fract (realGaussIter m (pval L (K : ℤ) n)) ≤ 1 - c / (n : ℝ) ^ M m

name: QPCF.BranchDatum.branch_nondeg
statement:
theorem branch_nondeg (hL : ¬ IsRat L) (J : ℕ) :
    ∃ (M : ℕ → ℕ) (c : ℝ) (K₀ : ℕ), 0 < c ∧
      ∀ K : ℕ, K₀ ≤ K → ∀ m ≤ J, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ≡ β.b J [MOD β.Ds J] →
        c / (n : ℝ) ^ M m ≤ Int.fract (realGaussIter m (pval L (K : ℤ) n)) ∧
          Int.fract (realGaussIter m (pval L (K : ℤ) n)) ≤ 1 - c / (n : ℝ) ^ M m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, c, K₀, hc, H⟩ := branch_stab_all β hL J
  exact ⟨M, c, K₀, hc, fun K hK m hm => (H K hK m hm).mono (fun n h hcl => (h hcl).2)⟩

name: QPCF.BranchDatum.formal_stability_i_governs_on
statement:
theorem formal_stability_i_governs_on (S : Set ℕ)
    (a : ℕ → ℝ) (hgov : GovernsOn S L a)
    (D : ℕ) (M Nsched : ℕ → ℕ) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hbud : ∀ m ≤ D, 2 * M m < Nsched m)
    (hsched : ∀ m, m < D → Nsched (m + 1) + 2 * M m ≤ Nsched m)
    (hnondeg : ∀ m ≤ D, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ∈ S →
      c / (n : ℝ) ^ M m ≤ Int.fract (realGaussIter m (pval L ((Nsched 0 : ℤ) - 1) n)) ∧
        Int.fract (realGaussIter m (pval L ((Nsched 0 : ℤ) - 1) n)) ≤ 1 - c / (n : ℝ) ^ M m) :
    ∀ m ≤ D, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ∈ S →
      realPQ m (a n) = (⌊realGaussIter m (pval L ((Nsched 0 : ℤ) - 1) n)⌋ : ℝ)

name: QPCF.BranchDatum.branch_tracking
statement:
theorem branch_tracking (hL : ¬ IsRat L) (J : ℕ) :
    ∃ K₀ : ℕ, ∀ K : ℕ, K₀ ≤ K → ∀ m ≤ J,
      ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ≡ β.b J [MOD β.Ds J] →
        (⌊realGaussIter m (pval L (K : ℤ) n)⌋ : ℝ)
          = ((bfloorVal (β.tower m) (β.Ds m) (β.b m) n : ℚ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, c, K₀, hc, H⟩ := branch_stab_all β hL J
  exact ⟨K₀, fun K hK m hm => (H K hK m hm).mono (fun n h hcl => (h hcl).1)⟩

name: QPCF.BranchDatum.per_residue_stability
statement:
theorem per_residue_stability (hL : ¬ IsRat L)
    (a : ℕ → ℝ) (hgov : Governs L a) (J : ℕ) :
    ∀ m ≤ J, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ≡ β.b J [MOD β.Ds J] →
      realPQ m (a n) = ((bfloorVal (β.tower m) (β.Ds m) (β.b m) n : ℚ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, c, K₀, hc, hnd⟩ := branch_nondeg β hL J
  obtain ⟨K₇, htrack⟩ := branch_tracking β hL J
  let Kbound := max K₀ K₇
  let Nsched : ℕ → ℕ := fun m => (∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc m J, 2 * M i) + Kbound + 1
  have hNsched0 : Nsched 0 - 1 = (Nsched 0 : ℤ) - 1 := by
    rfl
  have hbud : ∀ m ≤ J, 2 * M m < Nsched m := by
    exact fun m hm => lt_add_of_le_of_pos ( le_add_of_le_of_nonneg ( Finset.single_le_sum ( fun i _ => Nat.zero_le ( 2 * M i ) ) ( Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨ le_rfl, hm ⟩ ) ) ( Nat.zero_le _ ) ) zero_lt_one;
  have hsched : ∀ m, m < J → Nsched (m + 1) + 2 * M m ≤ Nsched m := by
    intro m hm; simp +arith +decide [ Nsched ] ; ring;
    rw [ show Finset.Icc m J = Finset.Icc ( m + 1 ) J ∪ { m } by ext x; simp +decide ; omega, Finset.sum_union ] <;> norm_num ; ring ; norm_num
  generalize_proofs at *; (
  intro m hm
  have hnd' : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, n ≡ β.b J [MOD β.Ds J] → c / (n : ℝ) ^ M m ≤ Int.fract (realGaussIter m (pval L ((Nsched 0 : ℤ) - 1) n)) ∧ Int.fract (realGaussIter m (pval L ((Nsched 0 : ℤ) - 1) n)) ≤ 1 - c / (n : ℝ) ^ M m := by
    convert hnd ( Nsched 0 - 1 ) _ m hm using 1
    generalize_proofs at *; (
    lia);
    grind
  generalize_proofs at *; (
  have := @formal_stability_i_governs_on;
  specialize this { n | n ≡ β.b J [MOD β.Ds J] } a (Governs.toOn { n | n ≡ β.b J [MOD β.Ds J] } hgov) J M Nsched c hc hbud hsched (fun m hm => by
    convert hnd ( Nsched 0 - 1 ) ( Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt ( by
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt ( le_max_left _ _ ) ( Nat.lt_succ_of_le ( Nat.le_add_left _ _ ) ) ) ) m hm using 1
    generalize_proofs at *; (
    rw [ Nat.cast_sub ] <;> norm_num ; linarith [ show 0 < Nsched 0 from Nat.succ_pos _ ] ;)) m hm
  generalize_proofs at *; (
  filter_upwards [ this, htrack ( Nsched 0 - 1 ) ( by
    exact Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt ( lt_add_of_le_of_pos ( le_add_of_nonneg_of_le ( Nat.zero_le _ ) ( le_max_right _ _ ) ) zero_lt_one ) ) m hm ] with n hn hn' using by aesop;)))

name: QPCF.BranchDatum.bfloorVal_tendsto_atTop
statement:
theorem bfloorVal_tendsto_atTop (hL : ¬ IsRat L) {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (hpole : β.PoleDepth m) :
    Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => (bfloorVal (β.tower m) (β.Ds m) (β.b m)
        (β.b m % β.Ds m + k * β.Ds m) : ℝ)) atTop atTop

name: QPCF.BranchDatum.btower_order_infinitely_neg
statement:
theorem btower_order_infinitely_neg (hL : ¬ IsRat L) :
    {m : ℕ | β.PoleDepth m}.Infinite

name: QPCF.exists_infinite_class
statement:
theorem exists_infinite_class (T : Set ℕ) (hT : T.Infinite) (D : ℕ) (hD : 0 < D) :
    ∃ r : ℕ, {n ∈ T | n ≡ r [MOD D]}.Infinite

name: QPCF.refine_step
statement:
theorem refine_step (F : ℚ⸨X⸩) (T : Set ℕ) (hT : T.Infinite) (D b : ℕ) (hD : 0 < D)
    (hTb : ∀ n ∈ T, n ≡ b [MOD D]) :
    ∃ D' b' : ℕ, 0 < D' ∧ D ∣ D' ∧ IsFloorPeriod F D' ∧ b' ≡ b [MOD D] ∧
      {n ∈ T | n ≡ b' [MOD D']}.Infinite ∧ (∀ n ∈ {n ∈ T | n ≡ b' [MOD D']}, n ≡ b' [MOD D'])

name: QPCF.exists_adapted_branch
statement:
theorem exists_adapted_branch (L : ℚ⸨X⸩) (S : Set ℕ) (hS : S.Infinite) :
    ∃ β : BranchDatum L, ∀ m, {n ∈ S | n ≡ β.b m [MOD β.Ds m]}.Infinite

name: QPCF.collective_unboundedness_of_governs
statement:
theorem collective_unboundedness_of_governs (L : ℚ⸨X⸩) (hL : ¬ IsRat L)
    (a : ℕ → ℝ) (hgov : Governs L a)
    (S : Set ℕ) (hS : S.Infinite) :
    {J : ℕ | ∀ M : ℝ, ∃ n ∈ S, M < |realPQ J (a n)|}.Infinite

name: QPCF.collective_unboundedness_ratPow_unconditional
statement:
theorem collective_unboundedness_ratPow_unconditional (α : ℚ) (hα : α.den ≠ 1)
    (S : Set ℕ) (hS : S.Infinite) :
    {J : ℕ | ∀ M : ℝ, ∃ n ∈ S, M < |realPQ J (ratPowSeq α n)|}.Infinite
proof:
:=
  collective_unboundedness_of_governs (oneAddPow α) (ratPow_irrational_and_governed' α hα).1
    (ratPowSeq α) (ratPow_irrational_and_governed' α hα).2 S hS

name: QPCF.ratGauss_den_lt
statement: theorem ratGauss_den_lt {x : ℚ} (hx : Int.fract x ≠ 0) : (ratGauss x).den < x.den

name: QPCF.ratGauss_exhausts
statement: theorem ratGauss_exhausts (c : ℚ) : ∃ L : ℕ, Int.fract (ratGauss^[L] c) = 0

name: QPCF.afract_coeff_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem afract_coeff_zero (F : ℚ⸨X⸩) : (afract F).coeff 0 = Int.fract (F.coeff 0)
proof:
:= by
  unfold afract
  rw [HahnSeries.coeff_sub, HahnSeries.C_apply, HahnSeries.coeff_single_same, Int.fract]

name: QPCF.afract_coeff_ne
statement: theorem afract_coeff_ne (F : ℚ⸨X⸩) {i : ℤ} (hi : i ≠ 0) : (afract F).coeff i = F.coeff i
proof:
:= by
  unfold afract
  rw [HahnSeries.coeff_sub, HahnSeries.C_apply, HahnSeries.coeff_single_of_ne hi, sub_zero]

name: QPCF.afract_sub_const
statement:
theorem afract_sub_const (F : ℚ⸨X⸩) :
    afract F - HahnSeries.C ((afract F).coeff 0) = F - HahnSeries.C (F.coeff 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [afract_coeff_zero, afract, sub_sub, ← map_add]
  congr 2
  rw [Int.floor_add_fract]

name: QPCF.inv_order_zero
statement:
theorem inv_order_zero {h : ℚ⸨X⸩} (h0 : h.order = 0) (hne : h ≠ 0) :
    (h⁻¹).order = 0 ∧ (h⁻¹).coeff 0 = (h.coeff 0)⁻¹

name: QPCF.inv_order_neg
statement: theorem inv_order_neg {h : ℚ⸨X⸩} (h1 : 1 ≤ h.order) (hne : h ≠ 0) : (h⁻¹).order < 0

name: QPCF.inv_const_of_const
statement:
theorem inv_const_of_const {h : ℚ⸨X⸩} (_hne : h ≠ 0)
    (hc : h⁻¹ - HahnSeries.C ((h⁻¹).coeff 0) = 0) : h - HahnSeries.C (h.coeff 0) = 0

name: QPCF.agauss_step
statement:
theorem agauss_step {F : ℚ⸨X⸩} (hord : 0 ≤ F.order)
    (htail : F - HahnSeries.C (F.coeff 0) ≠ 0) (hnint : Int.fract (F.coeff 0) ≠ 0) :
    0 ≤ (agauss F).order ∧ agauss F - HahnSeries.C ((agauss F).coeff 0) ≠ 0 ∧
      (agauss F).coeff 0 = ratGauss (F.coeff 0)

name: QPCF.agauss_terminal
statement:
theorem agauss_terminal {F : ℚ⸨X⸩} (hord : 0 ≤ F.order)
    (htail : F - HahnSeries.C (F.coeff 0) ≠ 0) (hint : Int.fract (F.coeff 0) = 0) :
    (agauss F).order < 0
proof:
:= by
  
  have h_afract_lt_zero : ∀ i < 0, (afract F).coeff i = 0 := by
    intro i hi
    rw [afract_coeff_ne F (ne_of_lt hi)]
    exact HahnSeries.coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_order (lt_of_lt_of_le hi hord)
  have h_afract_ge_one : 1 ≤ (afract F).order := by
    refine' le_of_not_gt fun h => _;
    have h_afract_zero : (afract F).coeff ((afract F).order) = 0 := by
      cases lt_or_eq_of_le ( show order ( afract F ) ≤ 0 from Int.le_of_lt_add_one h ) <;> aesop;
    have hne : afract F ≠ 0 := by
      rw [afract]
      have hc : (⌊F.coeff 0⌋ : ℚ) = F.coeff 0 := by
        have h0 := hint; rw [Int.fract] at h0; linarith
      rw [hc]; exact htail
    exact HahnSeries.coeff_order_ne_zero hne h_afract_zero
  apply inv_order_neg h_afract_ge_one
  intro h
  rw [h, HahnSeries.order_zero] at h_afract_ge_one
  exact absurd h_afract_ge_one (by norm_num)

name: QPCF.agauss_iterate_invariant
statement:
theorem agauss_iterate_invariant {F : ℚ⸨X⸩} (hord : 0 ≤ F.order)
    (htail : F - HahnSeries.C (F.coeff 0) ≠ 0) :
    ∀ L : ℕ, (∀ j < L, Int.fract (ratGauss^[j] (F.coeff 0)) ≠ 0) →
      0 ≤ (agauss^[L] F).order ∧
      agauss^[L] F - HahnSeries.C ((agauss^[L] F).coeff 0) ≠ 0 ∧
      (agauss^[L] F).coeff 0 = ratGauss^[L] (F.coeff 0)

name: QPCF.lemma_5_1
statement:
theorem lemma_5_1 {F : ℚ⸨X⸩} (hord : 0 ≤ F.order) (_hpos : 0 < F.coeff 0)
    (htail : F - HahnSeries.C (F.coeff 0) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ L : ℕ, (agauss^[L] F).order < 0

name: QPCF.lemma_5_1_positive_degree
statement:
theorem lemma_5_1_positive_degree {F : ℚ⸨X⸩} (hord : 0 ≤ F.order) (hpos : 0 < F.coeff 0)
    (htail : F - HahnSeries.C (F.coeff 0) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ L : ℕ, ((fieldLaurentGauss ℚ).floor (agauss^[L] F)).order ≤ -1

name: QPCF.tendsto_abs_floor_atTop
proof:
:= by
  have hb : ∀ n, |x n| - 1 ≤ |(⌊x n⌋ : ℝ)| := by
    intro n
    have hlt : |x n - (⌊x n⌋ : ℝ)| < 1 := by
      rw [show x n - (⌊x n⌋ : ℝ) = Int.fract (x n) from by rw [Int.fract]]
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (Int.fract_nonneg _)]; exact Int.fract_lt_one _
    have := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub (x n) ((⌊x n⌋ : ℝ))
    linarith
  exact tendsto_atTop_mono hb (hx.atTop_add tendsto_const_nhds)

name: QPCF.hstab_ratPow_of_realCF
statement:
theorem hstab_ratPow_of_realCF (α : ℚ) (J : ℕ)
    (M Nsched : ℕ → ℕ) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hbud : ∀ m ≤ J, 2 * M m < Nsched m)
    (hsched : ∀ m, m < J → Nsched (m + 1) + 2 * M m ≤ Nsched m)
    (hnondeg : ∀ m ≤ J, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
        c / (n : ℝ) ^ M m ≤ Int.fract (realGaussIter m (pval (oneAddPow α) ((Nsched 0 : ℤ) - 1) n)) ∧
          Int.fract (realGaussIter m (pval (oneAddPow α) ((Nsched 0 : ℤ) - 1) n)) ≤ 1 - c / (n : ℝ) ^ M m)
    (hdiv : Tendsto (fun n => |realGaussIter J (pval (oneAddPow α) ((Nsched 0 : ℤ) - 1) n)|) atTop atTop) :
    Tendsto (fun n => |realPQ J (ratPowSeq α n)|) atTop atTop
proof:
:= by
  have hstab := formal_stability_i_governs (ratPowSeq α) (oneAddPow α) (oneAddPow_governs α)
    J M Nsched c hc hbud hsched hnondeg J le_rfl
  have hgoal := tendsto_abs_floor_atTop hdiv
  refine hgoal.congr' ?_
  filter_upwards [hstab] with n hn
  rw [hn]

name: QPCF.isRat_zero
statement: theorem isRat_zero : IsRat 0
proof: := ⟨0, by simp⟩

name: QPCF.isRat_one
statement: theorem isRat_one : IsRat 1
proof: := ⟨1, by simp⟩

name: QPCF.IsRat.add
statement: theorem IsRat.add {f g : ℚ⸨X⸩} (hf : IsRat f) (hg : IsRat g) : IsRat (f + g)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hf; obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hg
  exact ⟨a + b, by rw [← ha, ← hb]; push_cast; ring⟩

name: QPCF.IsRat.mul
statement: theorem IsRat.mul {f g : ℚ⸨X⸩} (hf : IsRat f) (hg : IsRat g) : IsRat (f * g)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hf; obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hg
  exact ⟨a * b, by rw [← ha, ← hb]; push_cast; ring⟩

name: QPCF.IsRat.neg
statement: theorem IsRat.neg {f : ℚ⸨X⸩} (hf : IsRat f) : IsRat (-f)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hf; exact ⟨-a, by rw [← ha]; push_cast; ring⟩

name: QPCF.IsRat.inv
statement: theorem IsRat.inv {f : ℚ⸨X⸩} (hf : IsRat f) : IsRat f⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hf; exact ⟨a⁻¹, by rw [← ha]; exact map_inv₀ _ a⟩

name: QPCF.isRat_of_mul_right
statement:
theorem isRat_of_mul_right {f g : ℚ⸨X⸩} (hfg : IsRat (f * g)) (hg : IsRat g) (hg0 : g ≠ 0) :
    IsRat f
proof:
:= by
  have : f = (f * g) * g⁻¹ := by field_simp
  rw [this]; exact hfg.mul hg.inv

name: QPCF.isRat_of_mul_left
statement:
theorem isRat_of_mul_left {f g : ℚ⸨X⸩} (hfg : IsRat (f * g)) (hf : IsRat f) (hf0 : f ≠ 0) :
    IsRat g
proof:
:= by
  have : g = (f * g) * f⁻¹ := by
    rw [mul_comm f g, mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hf0, mul_one]
  rw [this]; exact hfg.mul hf.inv

name: QPCF.mul_isRat_iff
statement:
theorem mul_isRat_iff {f g : ℚ⸨X⸩} (hf0 : f ≠ 0) :
    IsRat (f * g) ↔ ∃ r : RatFunc ℚ, g = (r : ℚ⸨X⸩) * f⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨r, hr⟩
    refine ⟨r, ?_⟩
    rw [hr]
    rw [mul_comm f g, mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hf0, mul_one]
  · rintro ⟨r, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨r, ?_⟩
    rw [← mul_assoc, mul_comm f (r : ℚ⸨X⸩), mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hf0, mul_one]

name: QPCF.not_isRat_mul_of_not_reciprocal
statement:
theorem not_isRat_mul_of_not_reciprocal {f g : ℚ⸨X⸩} (hf0 : f ≠ 0)
    (h : ∀ r : RatFunc ℚ, g ≠ (r : ℚ⸨X⸩) * f⁻¹) : ¬ IsRat (f * g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_isRat_iff hf0]
  rintro ⟨r, hr⟩
  exact h r hr

name: QPCF.not_irrational_product_irrational
statement:
theorem not_irrational_product_irrational {f : ℚ⸨X⸩} (hf0 : f ≠ 0) (hf : ¬ IsRat f) :
    ¬ IsRat f ∧ ¬ IsRat f⁻¹ ∧ IsRat (f * f⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hf, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h; exact hf (by simpa [inv_inv] using h.inv)
  · rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hf0]; exact isRat_one

name: QPCF.order_mul_eq
statement:
theorem order_mul_eq {f g : ℚ⸨X⸩} (hf : f ≠ 0) (hg : g ≠ 0) :
    (f * g).order = f.order + g.order
proof:
:=
  HahnSeries.order_mul hf hg

name: QPCF.doubly_infinite_quadrant_of_tendsto
statement:
theorem doubly_infinite_quadrant_of_tendsto (a : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hinf : {J : ℕ | Tendsto (fun n => |realPQ J (a n)|) atTop atTop}.Infinite)
    (N J₀ : ℕ) (M : ℝ) :
    ∃ n j : ℕ, N ≤ n ∧ J₀ ≤ j ∧ M < |realPQ j (a n)|
proof:
:= by
  
  have hS : ({n : ℕ | N ≤ n}).Infinite := by simpa using Set.Ici_infinite N
  
  have hcol := collective_unboundedness_of_tendsto a hinf {n : ℕ | N ≤ n} hS
  
  obtain ⟨j, hjmem, hjgt⟩ := hcol.exists_gt J₀
  
  obtain ⟨n, hnN, hMn⟩ := hjmem M
  exact ⟨n, j, hnN, hjgt.le, hMn⟩

name: QPCF.doubly_infinite_quadrant_ratPow
statement:
theorem doubly_infinite_quadrant_ratPow (α : ℚ) (hα : α.den ≠ 1)
    (hstab : ∀ J : ℕ, (ogaussG^[J] (oneAddPow α)).order < 0 →
        Tendsto (fun n => |realPQ J (ratPowSeq α n)|) atTop atTop)
    (N J₀ : ℕ) (M : ℝ) :
    ∃ n j : ℕ, N ≤ n ∧ J₀ ≤ j ∧ M < |realPQ j (ratPowSeq α n)|
proof:
:= by
  
  have hinf : {J : ℕ | Tendsto (fun n => |realPQ J (ratPowSeq α n)|) atTop atTop}.Infinite := by
    apply Set.Infinite.mono (s := {J : ℕ | (ogaussG^[J] (oneAddPow α)).order < 0})
    · intro J hJ; exact hstab J hJ
    · exact ordered_pole_depths_infinite (oneAddPow_not_isRat hα)
  exact doubly_infinite_quadrant_of_tendsto (ratPowSeq α) hinf N J₀ M

name: QPCF.poly_eval_isBigOpow
statement:
theorem poly_eval_isBigOpow (Q : Polynomial ℚ) :
    BigOpow (fun n : ℕ => ((Q.eval ((n : ℕ) : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)) (Q.natDegree)

name: QPCF.poly_eval_abs_lower
statement:
theorem poly_eval_abs_lower (Q : Polynomial ℚ) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      c * (n : ℝ) ^ (Q.natDegree) ≤ |((Q.eval ((n : ℕ) : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)|

name: QPCF.polyExpansion_coeff
statement:
theorem polyExpansion_coeff (P : Polynomial ℚ) (i : ℕ) :
    (polyExpansion P).coeff (-(i : ℤ)) = P.coeff i

name: QPCF.polyExpansion_coeff_pos
statement:
theorem polyExpansion_coeff_pos (P : Polynomial ℚ) {k : ℤ} (hk : 0 < k) :
    (polyExpansion P).coeff k = 0

name: QPCF.polyExpansion_coeff_lt
statement:
theorem polyExpansion_coeff_lt (P : Polynomial ℚ) {k : ℤ} (hk : k < -(P.natDegree : ℤ)) :
    (polyExpansion P).coeff k = 0

name: QPCF.monomial_governs
statement:
theorem monomial_governs (i : ℕ) (c : ℚ) :
    Governs (HahnSeries.single (-(i : ℤ)) c) (fun n : ℕ => (c : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) ^ i)

name: QPCF.polyExpansion_governs
statement:
theorem polyExpansion_governs (P : Polynomial ℚ) :
    Governs (polyExpansion P) (fun n : ℕ => ((P.eval ((n : ℕ) : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ))

name: QPCF.polyExpansion_ne_zero
statement: theorem polyExpansion_ne_zero (P : Polynomial ℚ) (hP : P ≠ 0) : polyExpansion P ≠ 0

name: QPCF.polyExpansion_order
statement:
theorem polyExpansion_order (P : Polynomial ℚ) (hP : P ≠ 0) :
    (polyExpansion P).order = -(P.natDegree : ℤ)

name: QPCF.poly_governs
statement:
theorem poly_governs (P : Polynomial ℚ) :
    ∃ g : ℚ⸨X⸩,
      Governs g (fun n : ℕ => ((P.eval ((n : ℕ) : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ))
        ∧ (P ≠ 0 → g ≠ 0 ∧ g.order = -(P.natDegree : ℤ))
proof:
:=
  ⟨polyExpansion P, polyExpansion_governs P,
    fun hP => ⟨polyExpansion_ne_zero P hP, polyExpansion_order P hP⟩⟩

name: QPCF.Governs.abs_lower
statement:
theorem Governs.abs_lower {f : ℚ⸨X⸩} {a : ℕ → ℝ} (hf : Governs f a) (hf0 : f ≠ 0) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, c * (n : ℝ) ^ (-f.order) ≤ |a n|

name: QPCF.Negligible.congr_ev
statement:
theorem Negligible.congr_ev {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (ha : Negligible a) (h : a =ᶠ[atTop] b) :
    Negligible b

name: QPCF.Governs.eventually_ne_zero
statement:
theorem Governs.eventually_ne_zero {f : ℚ⸨X⸩} {a : ℕ → ℝ} (hf : Governs f a) (hf0 : f ≠ 0) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, a n ≠ 0

name: QPCF.Governs.polyBounded_inv
statement:
theorem Governs.polyBounded_inv {f : ℚ⸨X⸩} {a : ℕ → ℝ} (hf : Governs f a) (hf0 : f ≠ 0) :
    PolyBounded (fun n : ℕ => (a n)⁻¹)

name: QPCF.Governs.inv
statement:
theorem Governs.inv {f : ℚ⸨X⸩} {a : ℕ → ℝ} (hf : Governs f a) (hf0 : f ≠ 0) :
    Governs f⁻¹ (fun n : ℕ => (a n)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := Governs.exists f⁻¹
  
  have hmul : Governs (1 : ℚ⸨X⸩) (fun n => a n * b n) := by
    have := Governs.mul hf hb
    rwa [mul_inv_cancel₀ hf0] at this
  have hae1 : AsymEquiv (fun n => a n * b n) (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) :=
    Governs.asymEquiv_of_eq hmul Governs.one
  
  have hne : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, a n ≠ 0 := Governs.eventually_ne_zero hf hf0
  have hpb : PolyBounded (fun n : ℕ => (a n)⁻¹) := Governs.polyBounded_inv hf hf0
  have hneg : Negligible (fun n => (a n * b n - 1) * (a n)⁻¹) :=
    Negligible.mul_polyBounded hae1 hpb
  have hae2 : AsymEquiv b (fun n => (a n)⁻¹) := by
    refine hneg.congr_ev ?_
    filter_upwards [hne] with n hn
    field_simp
  exact Governs.congr hb hae2

name: QPCF.ratSeq_governs
statement:
theorem ratSeq_governs (P Q : Polynomial ℚ) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) :
    ∃ g : ℚ⸨X⸩,
      Governs g (fun n : ℕ => ((P.eval ((n : ℕ) : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) / ((Q.eval ((n : ℕ) : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ))
        ∧ (P ≠ 0 → g ≠ 0 ∧ g.order = (Q.natDegree : ℤ) - (P.natDegree : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨gP, hgP, hgP'⟩ := poly_governs P
  obtain ⟨gQ, hgQ, hgQ'⟩ := poly_governs Q
  have hgQ0 : gQ ≠ 0 := (hgQ' hQ).1
  refine ⟨gP * gQ⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have := Governs.mul hgP (Governs.inv hgQ hgQ0)
    simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv] using this
  · intro hP
    have hgP0 : gP ≠ 0 := (hgP' hP).1
    refine ⟨mul_ne_zero hgP0 (inv_ne_zero hgQ0), ?_⟩
    rw [HahnSeries.order_mul hgP0 (inv_ne_zero hgQ0), order_laurent_inv gQ hgQ0,
      (hgP' hP).2, (hgQ' hQ).2]
    ring

name: QPCF.ratSeq_governs_expansion
statement:
theorem ratSeq_governs_expansion (P Q : Polynomial ℚ) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) :
    Governs (polyExpansion P * (polyExpansion Q)⁻¹)
      (fun n : ℕ => ((P.eval ((n : ℕ) : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) / ((Q.eval ((n : ℕ) : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have := Governs.mul (polyExpansion_governs P)
    (Governs.inv (polyExpansion_governs Q) (polyExpansion_ne_zero Q hQ))
  simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv] using this

name: QPCF.order_inv_eq
statement: theorem order_inv_eq {g : LaurentSeries K} (hg : g ≠ 0) : g⁻¹.order = -g.order
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (g * g⁻¹).order = g.order + g⁻¹.order := order_mul hg (by simpa using hg)
  rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hg, HahnSeries.order_one] at h1
  omega

name: QPCF.fract_coeff
statement:
theorem fract_coeff (f : LaurentSeries K) :
    ((fieldLaurentGauss K).fract f).coeff = fun i => if i < 1 then 0 else f.coeff i
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  simp only [GaussStructure.fract, fieldLaurentGauss, fieldLaurentFloor, HahnSeries.coeff_sub,
    HahnSeries.coeff_truncLT]
  split_ifs <;> ring

name: QPCF.order_fract_ge_one
statement:
theorem order_fract_ge_one {f : LaurentSeries K} (h : (fieldLaurentGauss K).fract f ≠ 0) :
    1 ≤ ((fieldLaurentGauss K).fract f).order
proof:
:= by
  rw [HahnSeries.le_order_iff_forall h]
  intro j hj
  simp only [GaussStructure.fract, fieldLaurentGauss, fieldLaurentFloor, HahnSeries.coeff_sub,
    HahnSeries.coeff_truncLT]
  rw [if_pos hj]; ring

name: QPCF.gauss_eq_inv
statement:
theorem gauss_eq_inv (f : LaurentSeries K) :
    (fieldLaurentGauss K).gauss f = ((fieldLaurentGauss K).fract f)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [GaussStructure.gauss, Ring.inverse_eq_inv']

name: QPCF.order_gauss_eq
statement:
theorem order_gauss_eq {f : LaurentSeries K} (h : (fieldLaurentGauss K).fract f ≠ 0) :
    ((fieldLaurentGauss K).gauss f).order = -((fieldLaurentGauss K).fract f).order
proof:
:= by
  rw [gauss_eq_inv, order_inv_eq h]

name: QPCF.order_gauss_le_neg_one
statement:
theorem order_gauss_le_neg_one {f : LaurentSeries K} (h : (fieldLaurentGauss K).fract f ≠ 0) :
    ((fieldLaurentGauss K).gauss f).order ≤ -1
proof:
:= by
  rw [order_gauss_eq h]
  have := order_fract_ge_one h
  omega
